attributes.name: advisory_failure_count
attributes.description: The number of advisory (non-blocking) requirements that failed in this test run.

attributes.name: certification_outcome
attributes.description: The final outcome decision from the platform holder for this certification test run. Values: approved (build certified for release), rejected (build failed certification), resubmission_required (build must be fixed and resubmitted), pending_review (awaiting platform holder decision).

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the platform certification review for this build with the relevant first-party platform holder. Tracks the build through the TRC/TCR certification lifecycle from submission to approval or rejection. [Moved from build: This attribute represents the certification review status for a specific build-checklist pairing. A single build can have different certification statuses for different platform checklists (e.g., passed PlayStation TRC but failed Xbox TCR). The status belongs to the test run association, not the build entity.]
attributes.references: Console SDK TRC/TCR; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; ESRB; PEGI

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of this build against this checklist. Values: pending (not yet tested), in_progress (testing underway), passed (all requirements met), failed (one or more mandatory requirements failed), conditional_pass (passed with conditions), waived (failed requirements waived by platform holder).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this certification test run record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: failure_count
attributes.description: The number of certification requirements that failed in this test run.

attributes.name: mandatory_pass_count
attributes.description: The number of mandatory requirements that passed in this test run.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the certification testing process, including tester observations, platform holder feedback, or waiver justifications.

attributes.name: platform_submission_reference
attributes.description: The external submission identifier or tracking number assigned by the platform holder for this certification test run.

attributes.name: resubmission_number
attributes.description: The sequential resubmission attempt number for this build-checklist pairing (1 for first submission, 2 for first resubmission, etc.).

attributes.name: test_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when certification testing was completed for this build-checklist pairing.

attributes.name: test_execution_date
attributes.description: The date when this certification test run was executed against the build.

attributes.name: test_started_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when certification testing began for this build-checklist pairing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this certification test run record was last modified in the data platform.

attributes.name: waiver_count
attributes.description: The number of certification requirements for which waivers were requested or granted in this test run.

domains.name: monetization
domains.description: Owns all in-game and platform revenue mechanisms including IAP, MTX, virtual currency economies, F2P conversion funnels, battle pass and subscription entitlements, loot box/gacha transaction records, DLC sales, and season passes. Tracks ARPU, ARPPU, DAP, LTV, whale segmentation, conversion rates, and P2W mechanics. The authoritative SSOT for HOW the business captures revenue from players.

products.name: subscription_plan
products.description: Master definition of recurring subscription products offered to players (e.g., monthly premium membership, game pass, cloud gaming subscription). Captures plan name, billing cycle (monthly/annual), price, trial period, entitlement grants (game access, currency stipend, exclusive content), auto-renew policy, platform availability, and lifecycle status. The SSOT for subscription product definitions.

attributes.name: subscription_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for subscription_plan

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Subscription plans have infrastructure and support costs budgeted. Product budget management for platform operations and customer support.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.game_studio. Business justification: Subscription plans may be studio-specific (e.g., studio-branded premium tiers in multi-studio publishers). Tracking studio ownership supports revenue share calculations, brand management, and studio-l

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Subscription plans have jurisdiction-specific pricing, tax treatment, auto-renewal regulations, and cancellation rights. Required for regional plan configuration, tax calculation, and regulatory compl

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Subscription plans granting access to licensed content libraries (EA Play, Game Pass with licensed titles) require IP tracking for revenue allocation, content rights validation, and per-subscriber roy

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Subscription plans require marketing campaigns for acquisition, retention, and win-back initiatives. Linking enables subscription marketing ROI analysis, attribution of subscriber acquisition to campa

attributes.name: name_localization_string_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.localization_string. Business justification: Subscription tier names and benefit descriptions require localization for international storefronts. Mandatory for global subscription service operations and regional marketing.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Subscription plans are profit center products for segment P&L. Management accounting for subscription business unit reporting.

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Minimum age required to purchase subscription, enforced per COPPA, GDPR, and regional regulations. Zero indicates no age restriction.

attributes.name: auto_renew_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription automatically renews at the end of each billing cycle. False requires manual renewal by player.

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Recurring billing frequency for the subscription plan. Defines how often the player is charged.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_length
attributes.description: Number of billing periods in the subscription cycle (e.g., 1 for monthly, 12 for annual). Used for prorated calculations and renewal scheduling.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing when subscription benefits terminate after cancellation and whether refunds are issued. Critical for churn rate analysis and player retention.

attributes.name: cloud_gaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscription includes cloud gaming streaming capability, allowing gameplay without local hardware requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subscription plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the subscription price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount on in-game purchases (MTX, DLC, IAP) granted to active subscribers. Used to calculate subscriber ROI and conversion incentives.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the subscription plan configuration is superseded by a new version. Null for current active version.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the subscription plan configuration becomes effective. Used for price changes, benefit updates, and historical tracking.

attributes.name: exclusive_content_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscribers receive access to exclusive game content, DLC, or early releases not available to non-subscribers.

attributes.name: game_library_access
attributes.description: Level of access to game catalog or library granted by subscription. Defines which game titles subscribers can play without additional purchase.

attributes.name: geographic_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where subscription is available for purchase. Used for regional pricing and compliance with local regulations (GDPR, COPPA).

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after failed payment before subscription is suspended. Allows players to update payment method without losing access.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription plan was first made available for purchase. Used for product lifecycle analysis and cohort segmentation.

attributes.name: max_concurrent_devices
attributes.description: Maximum number of devices that can simultaneously use the subscription. Used for family plans and multi-device access control.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the subscription plan record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subscription plan record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: multiplayer_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscription is required for online multiplayer gameplay (PvP, MMO, co-op). Common requirement for console platform subscriptions.

attributes.name: parental_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental consent is required for minors to subscribe, per COPPA and regional child protection regulations.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the subscription plan (e.g., PREMIUM_MONTHLY, GAMEPASS_ANNUAL). Used in platform APIs, billing systems, and player-facing interfaces.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscription plan by product category. Determines entitlement structure and billing behavior.

attributes.name: platform_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platforms where subscription can be purchased and used (e.g., PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Mobile, Nintendo Switch). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PlayStation|Xbox|Mobile|Nintendo_Switch|Steam|Epic_Games_Store|iOS|Android — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: price_amount
attributes.description: Base recurring price charged per billing cycle before taxes, discounts, or promotional adjustments. Used for ARPU and ARPPU calculations.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: Grouping of related subscription plans for reporting and analytics (e.g., Premium Tier, Game Pass Family, VIP Club). Used for portfolio analysis and cross-sell strategies.

attributes.name: refund_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscription purchases are eligible for refund per platform policies and consumer protection regulations.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting method for recognizing subscription revenue per GAAP/IFRS standards. Determines when revenue is recorded in financial statements.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Platform-specific SKU identifier used in app stores, console marketplaces, and distribution platforms for inventory and sales tracking.

attributes.name: subscription_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscription plan. Active plans are available for new subscriptions; deprecated plans are closed to new subscribers but honor existing subscriptions.

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription plan will be discontinued and no longer available for new or renewing subscriptions. Null for plans with no planned sunset.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax classification code for the subscription plan used to determine applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST rates per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: trial_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the free trial period before first billing. Zero indicates no trial. Critical for F2P conversion funnel analysis and D1/D7/D30 retention tracking.

attributes.name: trial_price_amount
attributes.description: Discounted price charged during trial period. Typically zero for free trials or reduced for promotional trials.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_grant
attributes.description: Amount of in-game virtual currency (coins, gems, credits) granted to subscribers each billing cycle. Zero indicates no currency stipend. Key component of subscription LTV calculation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created the subscription plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: player_subscription
products.description: Transactional record of a player's active or historical subscription to a subscription plan. Tracks player reference, plan reference, subscription start/end dates, current billing period, renewal status, cancellation reason, payment method token, platform storefront, trial used flag, and churn timestamp. The SSOT for individual player subscription lifecycle — feeds churn rate and LTV calculations.

attributes.name: player_subscription_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the player subscription record. Primary key for the player subscription entity.

attributes.name: ab_experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.ab_experiment. Business justification: Subscription pricing, trial period length, feature sets, and cancellation flows are standard A/B test subjects. Linking subscriptions to experiments enables conversion funnel analysis and LTV impact m

attributes.name: consent_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.consent_policy. Business justification: Subscriptions require explicit consent under GDPR/CCPA for recurring billing, data processing, and auto-renewal. Critical for consent audit trail, regulatory compliance verification, and right-to-with

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Subscriptions tracked by cost center for revenue attribution. Revenue accounting for subscription business unit performance.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.deferred_revenue. Business justification: Each player subscription instance creates specific deferred revenue liability. Direct accounting requirement for contract liability tracking and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: finance_tax_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_tax_record. Business justification: Subscription revenue generates tax obligations. Tax accounting requirement for recurring billing tax compliance.

attributes.name: infrastructure_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.infrastructure_incident. Business justification: Subscription service availability tracking requires linking incidents affecting payment processing or entitlement delivery to subscription records for SLA credit calculation, churn analysis, and custo

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.league. Business justification: Premium subscriptions for league content access (exclusive VODs, stats, fantasy leagues). Real subscription model tied to esports content. Tracks league-specific subscription revenue and content engag

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Subscriptions are contracts with specific legal entities. Legal entity revenue recognition for subscription billing and contract management.

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the marketing campaign that led to the player subscribing. Used for campaign ROI analysis and budget allocation optimization.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who holds this subscription. Links to the player master entity.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.storefront. Business justification: Player subscriptions are purchased and managed through specific platform storefronts. Required for subscription billing reconciliation, platform fee calculation, churn analysis by platform, and storef

attributes.name: subscription_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscription plan that defines the entitlements, pricing, and billing cycle for this subscription.

attributes.name: acquisition_channel
attributes.description: The marketing channel through which the player was acquired and subsequently subscribed. Used for CPI (Cost Per Install) and ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic|paid_social|paid_search|email|in_game_promotion|referral|influencer|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription will automatically renew at the end of the current billing period. True means the subscription will renew unless cancelled. False means the subscription will expire at period end.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_count
attributes.description: The number of billing cycles that have been completed for this subscription. Used for retention cohort analysis and subscription age segmentation.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the subscription is billed. Determines billing cycle length, revenue recognition schedule, and churn calculation windows.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date when the player cancelled the subscription. Null if the subscription has not been cancelled. Used for churn analysis and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: cancellation_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text feedback provided by the player at the time of cancellation. Provides qualitative insights into churn drivers and player sentiment.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the player for cancelling the subscription. Used for churn analysis, product improvement, and retention strategy development.

attributes.name: coppa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription complies with COPPA requirements for players under 13 years of age. Used to enforce parental consent and data collection restrictions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this subscription record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the subscription price. Used for multi-currency reporting and revenue normalization.

attributes.name: current_billing_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the current billing cycle. The next renewal or cancellation will occur on or before this date.

attributes.name: current_billing_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the current billing cycle. Used to calculate prorated charges, usage windows, and renewal timing.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the discount applied to the subscription price. Null if no discount was applied. Used for net revenue calculation and promotion cost analysis.

attributes.name: discount_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a promotional discount or coupon was applied to this subscription. Used for promotion effectiveness analysis and revenue attribution.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: The promotional code or coupon code applied to the subscription. Null if no discount was applied. Used for campaign attribution and ROI (Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the subscription price. Null if no discount was applied or if discount was a fixed amount. Used for promotion effectiveness reporting.

attributes.name: entitlement_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player currently has access to the subscription entitlements. May be false even if subscription status is active, due to payment failures or grace period expiration.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_given
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Consent Given Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has provided explicit consent for data processing under GDPR requirements. Required for players in EU jurisdictions.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the grace period for payment retry ends. After this date, the subscription will be suspended or cancelled if payment is not successful. Null if no grace period is active.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this subscription record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing.

attributes.name: last_payment_failure_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent payment failure. Null if no payment failures have occurred. Used for dunning workflow triggers and grace period calculation.

attributes.name: lifetime_revenue
attributes.description: The total revenue generated from this subscription since inception, including all billing cycles. Used for LTV (Lifetime Value) calculation and whale segmentation.

attributes.name: next_billing_date
attributes.description: The date when the next subscription charge will be processed. Null if subscription is cancelled or not set to auto-renew.

attributes.name: payment_failure_count
attributes.description: The number of times payment processing has failed for this subscription. Used for involuntary churn risk scoring and dunning campaign targeting.

attributes.name: payment_method_token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the payment method used for recurring billing. The token is provided by the payment processor and does not contain actual card numbers, ensuring PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) compliance.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: The payment processor or platform storefront that handles billing for this subscription. Determines reconciliation process, fee structure, and refund policies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stripe|paypal|apple_iap|google_play|steam|epic_games|console_first_party — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: The referral code used by the player when subscribing, if applicable. Links to the referring player for K-Factor (Viral Coefficient) calculation and referral reward distribution.

attributes.name: subscription_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the subscription is scheduled to end or did end. Null for active subscriptions with auto-renewal enabled. Populated for cancelled or expired subscriptions.

attributes.name: subscription_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique identifier for the subscription, used in customer communications, support tickets, and billing statements.

attributes.name: subscription_price
attributes.description: The recurring price charged for the subscription per billing cycle. Stored in the currency specified in the currency_code field. Used for ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) and ARPPU (Average Revenue Per Paying User) calculations.

attributes.name: subscription_source
attributes.description: Indicates how this subscription originated. New player indicates first subscription at account creation. Existing player upgrade indicates conversion from free-to-play. Reactivation indicates return of a previously churned subscriber. Cross-sell indicates purchase of an additional subscription product.

attributes.name: subscription_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the subscription became active and entitlements were first granted to the player. Used to calculate subscription age and LTV (Lifetime Value).

attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscription. Active indicates the subscription is in good standing and entitlements are available. Trial indicates the player is in a trial period. Paused indicates temporary suspension by player request. Cancelled indicates the player has terminated the subscription. Expired indicates the subscription ended due to non-renewal. Suspended indicates administrative hold due to payment failure or policy violation.

attributes.name: subscription_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level of the subscription plan, indicating the scope of entitlements and benefits. Used for segmentation and upsell targeting.

attributes.name: trial_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the trial period ended and the subscription converted to paid status. Null if no trial was used or trial is still active.

attributes.name: trial_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the trial period began. Null if no trial was used for this subscription.

attributes.name: trial_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has used a trial period for this subscription plan. Used to enforce one-trial-per-player business rules and prevent trial abuse.

products.name: dlc_entitlement
products.description: Transactional record of a player's ownership of a specific DLC (Downloadable Content) or expansion pack. Captures player reference, DLC SKU reference, acquisition method (purchased, gifted, promotional, bundle), acquisition timestamp, platform storefront, license key token, download status, and revocation flag. The SSOT for DLC ownership rights — distinct from the MTX catalog definition.

attributes.name: dlc_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DLC entitlement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset_bundle. Business justification: DLC entitlements unlock specific asset bundles for download. Core DLC delivery process requires linking entitlement to downloadable content package for CDN access and installation.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: DLC entitlements tracked by cost center for revenue attribution. Revenue accounting for downloadable content sales.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.deferred_revenue. Business justification: DLC purchases may create deferred revenue depending on content delivery schedule. ASC 606 performance obligation tracking for multi-element arrangements.

attributes.name: dlc_bundle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the content bundle if this DLC was part of a bundle purchase. Null if not from a bundle.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the base game title that this DLC extends.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: DLC purchases generate invoices for revenue recognition, tax compliance, and financial reporting. Gaming companies must link entitlements to invoices for audit trails and refund processing workflows.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.ip_agreement. Business justification: DLC entitlements for licensed content require agreement tracking for platform rights validation, territory restriction enforcement, and expiration date compliance. Critical for preventing unauthorized

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign if this entitlement was granted as a promotion. Null if not promotional.

attributes.name: primary_dlc_player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who owns this DLC entitlement.

attributes.name: season_pass_id
attributes.description: Reference to the season pass if this DLC was granted through season pass ownership. Null if not from a season pass.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gaming platform where this entitlement is valid (console, PC, mobile).

attributes.name: storefront_transaction_id
attributes.description: External transaction identifier from the platform storefront (Steam, Epic, PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, App Store, Google Play).

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscription service if this DLC was granted through subscription membership. Null if not from a subscription.

attributes.name: title_sku_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Downloadable Content (DLC) Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) ID
attributes.description: Reference to the DLC product SKU in the content catalog.

attributes.name: tournament_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.tournament. Business justification: Tournament-themed DLC/cosmetics (team skins, championship bundles). Real business model for event-driven cosmetic sales. Tracks tournament-specific DLC revenue and promotional effectiveness.

attributes.name: acquisition_method
attributes.description: Method by which the player acquired this DLC entitlement.

attributes.name: acquisition_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player acquired this DLC entitlement. The principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Age rating classification for the DLC content (ESRB, PEGI, CERO, etc.).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this entitlement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: download_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the DLC content download was completed. Null if not yet completed.

attributes.name: download_status
attributes.description: Current status of the DLC content download to the players device.

attributes.name: entitlement_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that originated this entitlement record (Steamworks, Epic Games Store, PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, etc.).

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DLC entitlement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this DLC entitlement expires. Null for permanent entitlements.

attributes.name: first_activation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player first activated or used the DLC content in-game.

attributes.name: is_revoked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this entitlement has been revoked due to refund, fraud, or policy violation.

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this entitlement can be transferred to another player account.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this entitlement record was last updated.

attributes.name: license_key_token
attributes.description: Unique license key or token that grants access to the DLC content. Used for DRM validation.

attributes.name: purchase_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the purchase transaction.

attributes.name: purchase_price_amount
attributes.description: The amount paid by the player for this DLC if acquired through purchase. Null for non-purchase acquisitions.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country/region code where this entitlement is valid. Used for regional licensing restrictions.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why the entitlement was revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the entitlement was revoked. Null if not revoked.

products.name: player_ltv_segment
products.description: Master segmentation record classifying each player into a monetization value tier based on cumulative spend and ad engagement. Captures player reference, LTV segment label (F2P, minnow, dolphin, whale), total lifetime IAP spend, total ad revenue generated, combined LTV score, ARPU/ARPPU period metrics, DAP flag, segment assignment date, previous segment, and change reason. The SSOT for whale/dolphin/minnow classification — incorporates hybrid LTV (IAP + ad revenue) for mobile-first titles.

attributes.name: player_ltv_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the player LTV segment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: LTV segments drive budget allocation decisions for UA and retention spend. Marketing budget optimization based on player value segmentation.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player being segmented. Links to the player master record in the Player domain.

attributes.name: player_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.player_segment. Business justification: LTV segments (whale, dolphin, minnow) are monetization-derived classifications that feed marketing segmentation for targeting, personalization, and lookalike modeling. Essential for audience building,

attributes.name: primary_game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title where the player has generated the most revenue. Used for cross-promotion and portfolio analysis.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform (mobile, console, PC) where the player has generated the most revenue. Used for platform-specific monetization strategies.

attributes.name: arppu
attributes.description: Average revenue per paying user over the measurement period (typically 30 days), in USD. Calculated only for players who made at least one IAP transaction.

attributes.name: arpu
attributes.description: Average revenue per user over the measurement period (typically 30 days), in USD. Includes both IAP and ad revenue divided by active days.

attributes.name: average_transaction_value
attributes.description: Average value per IAP transaction in USD. Calculated as total_iap_spend divided by total_transaction_count. Used to identify whale spending patterns.

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Machine learning predicted probability of player churn in the next 30 days, ranging from 0.0000 (no risk) to 1.0000 (certain churn). Used for retention campaign targeting.

attributes.name: combined_ltv_score
attributes.description: Hybrid LTV score combining IAP spend and ad revenue to represent total player value in USD. Calculated as total_iap_spend + total_ad_revenue. Used for unified player value ranking.

attributes.name: conversion_probability_score
attributes.description: Machine learning predicted probability that a F2P player will make their first purchase in the next 30 days, ranging from 0.0000 (no chance) to 1.0000 (certain conversion). Null for players who have already made a purchase.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the players primary transaction currency. All monetary amounts in this record are converted to USD, but this field preserves the players native currency for localization.

attributes.name: days_in_current_segment
attributes.description: Number of days the player has been in the current LTV segment. Calculated as current date minus segment_assignment_date. Used for segment stability analysis.

attributes.name: days_since_last_purchase
attributes.description: Number of days since the players last IAP transaction. Calculated as current date minus last_purchase_date. Null for F2P players. Used for churn prediction and reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: first_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date of the players first IAP transaction. Null for F2P players who have never made a purchase. Used to calculate payer tenure and conversion funnel metrics.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region of the player based on their primary platform account location. NAM = North America, EUR = Europe, APAC = Asia-Pacific, LATAM = Latin America, MEA = Middle East and Africa. Used for regional monetization strategy and pricing localization.

attributes.name: is_dap
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player is a daily active payer (made at least one IAP transaction in the last 24 hours). True = DAP, False = not DAP.

attributes.name: largest_single_transaction
attributes.description: The highest single IAP transaction amount the player has ever made, in USD. Used to identify whale potential and spending ceiling.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date of the players most recent IAP transaction. Null for F2P players. Used to identify lapsed payers and calculate recency metrics.

attributes.name: last_recalculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the LTV segment and associated metrics were last recalculated. Used to ensure data freshness and trigger scheduled updates.

attributes.name: predicted_ltv_30d
attributes.description: Machine learning predicted LTV for the next 30 days, in USD. Used for player acquisition ROI optimization and marketing budget allocation.

attributes.name: predicted_ltv_90d
attributes.description: Machine learning predicted LTV for the next 90 days, in USD. Used for cohort analysis and long-term player value forecasting.

attributes.name: preferred_payment_method
attributes.description: The payment method the player uses most frequently for IAP transactions. Used for payment optimization and fraud detection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|carrier_billing|gift_card|cryptocurrency — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: previous_segment_label
attributes.description: The LTV segment label the player held immediately before the current assignment. Used to track player progression and churn patterns. New Player indicates first-time segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whale|dolphin|minnow|f2p|at_risk_whale|lapsed_payer|new_player — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: segment_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the player was assigned to the current LTV segment. Used to track segment tenure and transition history.

attributes.name: segment_change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the most recent segment transition. Spend Increase = player moved up tier, Spend Decrease = player moved down tier, Inactivity = player became inactive, Reactivation = lapsed player returned, First Purchase = F2P converted to payer, Churn = player stopped spending, Periodic Refresh = scheduled recalculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spend_increase|spend_decrease|inactivity|reactivation|first_purchase|churn|periodic_refresh — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the segment record. Active = player is actively segmented and metrics are current, Inactive = player has not been active recently, Suspended = player account is suspended, Archived = historical record for churned player.

attributes.name: total_ad_impressions
attributes.description: Cumulative number of ad impressions served to the player across all games. Used to calculate ad engagement and eCPM metrics.

attributes.name: total_ad_revenue
attributes.description: Cumulative lifetime ad revenue generated by the player through ad impressions, rewarded video views, and interstitial ads, in USD. Critical for F2P monetization models.

attributes.name: total_iap_spend
attributes.description: Cumulative lifetime spend on in-app purchases (IAP) by the player across all games and platforms, in USD. Includes microtransactions, DLC, battle passes, and subscription fees.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: total_rewarded_ad_views
attributes.description: Cumulative number of rewarded video ads the player has watched to completion. Indicates player willingness to engage with ads for in-game rewards.

attributes.name: total_transaction_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IAP transactions the player has completed across all games and platforms. Used to distinguish high-frequency low-value spenders from low-frequency high-value spenders.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: ad_placement
products.description: Master definition of in-game advertising placements available for monetization (rewarded video ads, interstitial ads, banner ads, native ads, playable ads). Captures placement name, ad format, game title scope, trigger context (between levels, opt-in reward, storefront), ad network partner (Unity Ads, ironSource, AdMob, AppLovin), fill rate target, eCPM floor, frequency cap, player segment eligibility, and active status. The SSOT for ad inventory definitions enabling hybrid F2P monetization (IAP + ads).

attributes.name: ad_placement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ad placement definition. Primary key.

attributes.name: ad_unit_id
attributes.description: External ad network-specific unit identifier used to integrate this placement with the ad network SDK.

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.dev_project. Business justification: Ad placements are designed UX elements implemented by dev teams. Linking supports A/B testing attribution (which project version introduced the placement), ad-to-content performance analysis, and cros

attributes.name: game_mode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.game_mode. Business justification: Ad placements trigger in specific game modes (e.g., rewarded video after multiplayer match). Business optimizes ad yield and player experience by mode. Critical for ad ops, fill rate analysis, and UX

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title where this ad placement is available.

attributes.name: name_localization_string_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.localization_string. Business justification: Ad placement UI text (reward descriptions, call-to-action) needs localization for international audiences. Essential for global ad monetization and player comprehension.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Ad placements must comply with policies governing COPPA compliance, GDPR consent for behavioral targeting, and advertising restrictions to minors. Essential for placement approval process and regulato

attributes.name: primary_ad_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this ad placement record.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Ad placements generate revenue for specific profit centers. Revenue attribution for advertising monetization by game/platform.

attributes.name: reward_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: Rewarded video ads grant cosmetic assets (skins, emotes) as player incentives. Links ad placement to specific reward content for entitlement delivery and ad performance tracking.

attributes.name: seasonal_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.seasonal_event. Business justification: Event-specific ad placements with themed rewards (holiday currency, event items). Links ad strategy to event lifecycle for targeted monetization and player re-engagement.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform where this ad placement is served (iOS, Android, Web).

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: A/B test variant identifier if this ad placement is part of an experimentation cohort.

attributes.name: ad_format
attributes.description: Type of ad format served in this placement (rewarded video, interstitial, banner, native, playable, offerwall).

attributes.name: ad_network_partner
attributes.description: Primary ad network partner serving ads to this placement (Unity Ads, ironSource, AdMob, AppLovin, Vungle, Chartboost).

attributes.name: age_gate_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum age required for a player to be eligible to see this ad placement, enforced for COPPA and regional compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad placement was approved for production deployment.

attributes.name: average_ctr_pct
attributes.description: Average click-through rate percentage for this ad placement calculated from lifetime impressions and clicks.

attributes.name: average_ecpm_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Effective Cost Per Mille (eCPM) USD
attributes.description: Average eCPM in USD achieved by this ad placement over its lifetime.

attributes.name: cooldown_seconds
attributes.description: Minimum time in seconds that must elapse between consecutive displays of this ad placement to the same player.

attributes.name: coppa_compliant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this ad placement is compliant with COPPA regulations for child-directed content.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad placement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: display_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this ad placement when multiple placements are eligible at the same trigger context (lower number = higher priority).

attributes.name: ecpm_floor_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Effective Cost Per Mille (eCPM) Floor USD
attributes.description: Minimum eCPM floor price in USD that ad networks must meet to serve ads in this placement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this ad placement is scheduled to be retired or deactivated (nullable for indefinite placements).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this ad placement becomes active and eligible to serve ads.

attributes.name: exclude_paying_players
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether players who have made any in-app purchase should be excluded from seeing this ad placement.

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target fill rate percentage for this ad placement representing the desired proportion of ad requests that should be filled with ads.

attributes.name: frequency_cap_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this ad placement can be shown to a player within a 24-hour period.

attributes.name: frequency_cap_per_session
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this ad placement can be shown to a player within a single game session.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether explicit GDPR consent is required before serving ads in this placement to EU players.

attributes.name: geographic_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this ad placement is available (e.g., USA,CAN,GBR).

attributes.name: lifetime_clicks
attributes.description: Total cumulative number of ad clicks recorded for this placement since activation.

attributes.name: lifetime_impressions
attributes.description: Total cumulative number of ad impressions served through this placement since activation.

attributes.name: lifetime_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Total cumulative ad revenue in USD generated by this placement since activation.

attributes.name: mediation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether ad mediation is enabled for this placement to optimize fill rate and eCPM across multiple networks.

attributes.name: minimum_player_level
attributes.description: Minimum player level required to be eligible to see this ad placement.

attributes.name: placement_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the ad placement used across ad networks and internal systems.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: placement_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments about this ad placement for operational reference and context.

attributes.name: placement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ad placement indicating whether it is actively serving ads.

attributes.name: player_segment_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of player segments eligible to see this ad placement (e.g., f2p_non_payer, low_ltv, new_user, churned_user).

attributes.name: reward_amount
attributes.description: Quantity of the reward granted to the player for completing the ad interaction (e.g., 100 coins, 1 life).

attributes.name: reward_currency_code
attributes.description: Code of the virtual currency awarded as a reward for this ad placement (if reward_type is virtual_currency).

attributes.name: reward_type
attributes.description: Type of in-game reward granted to the player for engaging with this ad placement (applicable for rewarded ad formats).

attributes.name: trigger_context
attributes.description: Game event or player action that triggers the ad placement (e.g., between_levels, opt_in_reward, storefront_entry, session_start, game_over).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad placement record was last modified.

attributes.name: fallback_ad_placement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ad_placement (fallback_ad_placement_id)

products.name: ad_impression
products.description: Transactional record of every ad view or rewarded video completion by a player. Captures player reference, ad placement reference (FK to ad_placement), impression timestamp, ad network, creative ID, watch completion percentage, reward granted flag and amount, eCPM-based revenue earned, and device/session context. The SSOT for ad revenue events — feeds ARPDAU calculations and hybrid LTV modeling alongside IAP revenue.

attributes.name: ad_impression_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ad impression event. Primary key for the ad impression transactional record.

attributes.name: ab_experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.ab_experiment. Business justification: Ad placement location, format, frequency caps, and reward amounts are commonly A/B tested. Experiment attribution enables measurement of ad revenue impact, player retention effects, and optimal ad loa

attributes.name: ad_creative_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the specific ad creative that was displayed. Used for creative performance analysis and A/B testing.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Creative Asset Standards

attributes.name: ad_placement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ad placement configuration that defines where and how the ad was displayed within the game. Links to the ad placement master entity.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Ad Placement Standards

attributes.name: ad_unit_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the ad unit within the ad network. Used for tracking and reconciliation with ad network reporting.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Ad Unit Specification

attributes.name: build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.build. Business justification: Ad impressions occur within specific builds. Tracking build version supports ad network certification (revenue reconciliation by certified build), A/B test attribution for ad placement changes, and fr

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Ad revenue posts to specific GL accounts. Revenue accounting for advertising monetization account mapping.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Ad impressions tracked by cost center for revenue attribution. Ad revenue accounting by game/platform.

attributes.name: finance_tax_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_tax_record. Business justification: Ad revenue generates tax obligations. Tax compliance for advertising monetization streams.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title in which the ad impression occurred. Links to the game title master entity.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Ad revenue must post to GL for financial reporting. Standard revenue recognition requirement for advertising monetization streams.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Ad revenue booked to specific legal entities. Legal entity accounting for advertising monetization by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: The advertising campaign identifier from the ad network. Used for campaign-level performance tracking and attribution.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Campaign Tracking Standards

attributes.name: match_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.match. Business justification: Ads served during match viewing (in-client spectator mode, companion apps). Core esports monetization model. Tracks ad revenue attribution to specific matches for broadcast rights valuation and sponso

attributes.name: network_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.network_region. Business justification: Geographic ad targeting, regional eCPM analysis, GDPR/COPPA compliance by jurisdiction, and ad network partner selection by region require linking impressions to network regions for regulatory and rev

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who viewed the ad impression. Links to the player master entity.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player session during which the ad impression occurred. Links to the session event entity.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform on which the ad impression occurred (iOS, Android, Web, Console). Links to the platform master entity.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: The A/B test variant or experiment group the player was assigned to at the time of the ad impression. Used for ad placement optimization experiments.

attributes.name: ad_format
attributes.description: The format or type of ad that was displayed. Defines the user experience and engagement model for the ad impression.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Ad Format Standards

attributes.name: ad_network
attributes.description: The advertising network or mediation platform that served the ad impression. Identifies the source of the ad inventory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: admob|unity_ads|ironsource|applovin|vungle|chartboost|facebook_audience_network|mopub|adcolony|tapjoy|direct — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Ad Network Standards

attributes.name: ad_size
attributes.description: The dimensions of the ad creative in pixels (e.g., 320x50, 728x90, fullscreen). Used for creative optimization and placement analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Ad Size Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the ad impression occurred. Used for geographic revenue analysis and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ad impression record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: days_since_install
attributes.description: The number of days between the player's first app install and this ad impression. Used for cohort analysis and retention modeling.

attributes.name: device_model
attributes.description: The specific model of the device on which the ad impression occurred (e.g., iPhone 14 Pro, Samsung Galaxy S23). Used for device-specific optimization.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Device Model Standards

attributes.name: device_os
attributes.description: The operating system of the device on which the ad impression occurred (e.g., iOS 16.2, Android 13, Windows 11).
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Operating System Standards

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device on which the ad impression was displayed. Used for device-specific ad performance analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile|tablet|desktop|console|tv|vr_headset|unknown — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Device Classification Standards

attributes.name: ecpm_revenue
attributes.description: The estimated revenue earned from this ad impression based on eCPM rates. Calculated as (revenue / impressions) * 1000. Used for hybrid LTV modeling.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - eCPM Calculation Standards

attributes.name: exchange_rate_to_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchange Rate to United States Dollar (USD)
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert the revenue amount to USD for consolidated reporting. Rate at the time of impression.

attributes.name: fill_rate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the ad request was successfully filled by the ad network. True if filled, False if no fill. Used for fill rate calculations.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Fill Rate Metrics

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ad impression was flagged as potentially fraudulent by fraud detection systems. True if fraud suspected, False otherwise.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Ad Fraud Prevention Standards

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: The fraud risk score assigned to this ad impression by fraud detection algorithms. Range 0.00 (no risk) to 100.00 (high risk).
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Ad Fraud Detection Standards

attributes.name: impression_date
attributes.description: The calendar date when the ad impression occurred. Used for daily aggregation and reporting of ad revenue.

attributes.name: impression_status
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the ad impression indicating whether it was successfully served, viewed, or encountered an error. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: served|viewed|clicked|completed|skipped|error|timeout — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Impression Measurement Standards

attributes.name: impression_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the ad impression was served to the player. Business event timestamp for the ad view.

attributes.name: is_first_impression
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this was the player's first ad impression in the game. True if first impression, False otherwise. Used for FTUE analysis.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics - First Time User Experience (FTUE) Metrics

attributes.name: is_rewarded
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this ad impression was a rewarded ad (player receives in-game reward for watching). True if rewarded, False if non-rewarded.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Rewarded Ad Standards

attributes.name: mediation_waterfall_position
attributes.description: The position in the ad mediation waterfall where this ad network was called. Used for mediation optimization and fill rate analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Ad Mediation Standards

attributes.name: player_level_at_impression
attributes.description: The player's in-game level or progression tier at the time of the ad impression. Used for player segmentation and ad targeting analysis.

attributes.name: player_segment
attributes.description: The player segment or cohort classification at the time of the ad impression (e.g., whale, minnow, free_rider, at_risk). Used for targeted ad strategies.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: The geographic region or state code where the ad impression occurred. Used for regional ad performance analysis.

attributes.name: revenue_amount
attributes.description: The actual revenue earned from this ad impression in the reporting currency. The net proceeds after ad network fees.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Revenue Attribution Standards

attributes.name: revenue_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the revenue amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Used for multi-currency revenue reporting.

attributes.name: revenue_usd
attributes.description: The revenue amount converted to USD using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting and ARPDAU calculations.

attributes.name: reward_amount
attributes.description: The quantity of the reward granted to the player (e.g., 100 coins, 1 extra life). Null if no reward granted.

attributes.name: reward_currency_code
attributes.description: The virtual currency code or item identifier for the reward granted. Links to the virtual currency or item catalog.

attributes.name: reward_granted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the in-game reward was successfully granted to the player after ad completion. True if reward granted, False if not granted.

attributes.name: reward_type
attributes.description: The type of in-game reward granted to the player for watching the rewarded ad. None if non-rewarded ad or reward not granted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: virtual_currency|extra_life|power_up|unlock|time_skip|loot_box|xp_boost|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ad impression record was last updated in the data platform. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: viewability_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the ad impression met viewability standards (e.g., 50% of pixels visible for 1 second). True if viewable, False otherwise.

attributes.name: watch_completion_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the ad video that the player watched before closing or completing. Range 0.00 to 100.00. Critical for rewarded video completion tracking.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab - Video Ad Completion Metrics

attributes.name: previous_ad_impression_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ad_impression (previous_ad_impression_id)

products.name: price_point
products.description: Master catalog of standardized IAP price points across platforms and currencies, capturing platform-specific pricing tiers, currency conversion rules, and regional pricing strategies.

attributes.name: price_point_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price point record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ab_experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.ab_experiment. Business justification: Price point testing is fundamental to monetization optimization across regions and platforms. Experiment attribution enables measurement of price elasticity, conversion impact, and revenue maximizatio

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title for which this price point is configured. Nullable for platform-wide standard price points.

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice_line. Business justification: Invoice lines reference price points for dynamic pricing audit trails and revenue recognition. Gaming companies use price point history to validate invoiced amounts and resolve pricing disputes.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Price points are jurisdiction-specific for tax compliance, VAT/sales tax calculation, currency regulations, and regional pricing strategies. Essential for regional pricing configuration, tax reporting

attributes.name: primary_price_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user or role who approved this price point for publication.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gaming platform or storefront where this price point is applicable (e.g., iOS App Store, Google Play, Steam, PlayStation Store, Xbox Store).

attributes.name: tertiary_price_updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user who last updated this price point record.

attributes.name: age_gate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether age verification is required before displaying or allowing purchase of this price point (True for compliance with COPPA, GDPR, regional laws).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval workflow status for the price point before it goes live: draft (being configured), pending_review (awaiting approval), approved (ready for activation), rejected (not approved).

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the price point was approved for publication.

attributes.name: base_price_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Base Price in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Base price amount in USD, serving as the reference currency for conversion and reporting.

attributes.name: bonus_currency_amount
attributes.description: Additional bonus virtual currency awarded on top of the base amount (used for promotional bundles or first-time purchase incentives).

attributes.name: conversion_optimization_variant
attributes.description: A/B test or conversion optimization variant identifier for this price point, used to track performance of different pricing strategies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the price point record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base price for promotional price points (e.g., 25.00 for 25% off).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this price point expires or is no longer available. Nullable for indefinite price points.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this price point becomes active and available for purchase.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_to_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchange Rate to United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert local currency to USD at the time of price point creation or last update.

attributes.name: is_default_for_tier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price point is the default or recommended option for its tier level across regions (True) or a regional variant (False).

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price point is part of a limited-time promotional campaign (True) or a standard catalog price (False).

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the local price (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, KRW).

attributes.name: local_price_amount
attributes.description: Price amount in the local currency for the target market or region.

attributes.name: minimum_player_age
attributes.description: Minimum age required to purchase this price point, enforced for regulatory compliance (e.g., 13, 16, 18).

attributes.name: net_proceeds_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the transaction that the publisher receives after platform fees (e.g., 70.00 for 70%).

attributes.name: original_price_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Price in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Original non-discounted price in USD, used for displaying savings to players during promotions.

attributes.name: parental_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental consent is required for minors to purchase this price point (True for COPPA compliance in US, similar regulations in other jurisdictions).

attributes.name: platform_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the transaction that the platform (Apple, Google, Steam, etc.) retains as commission (e.g., 30.00 for 30%).

attributes.name: platform_sku
attributes.description: Platform-specific SKU or product identifier used by the storefront API for transaction processing.

attributes.name: price_display_format
attributes.description: Localized format string for displaying the price to players (e.g., $0.99, €0,99, ¥120), respecting regional conventions.

attributes.name: price_point_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the price point, used for external reference and integration with platform storefronts.

attributes.name: price_point_description
attributes.description: Internal notes or description of the price point, including business rationale, target segment, or special conditions.

attributes.name: price_point_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name for the price point shown to players in storefronts.

attributes.name: price_point_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price point: active (live and available), inactive (not currently offered), pending (awaiting platform approval), deprecated (phased out), suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: price_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price point: standard (regular catalog price), promotional (temporary discount), dynamic (algorithmically adjusted), regional (geo-specific), premium (high-value tier), introductory (first-time buyer).

attributes.name: price_rounding_rule
attributes.description: Rounding convention applied to the local price (e.g., nearest_99 for psychological pricing ending in .99, platform_standard for platform-mandated rounding).

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country or region code where this price point applies (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN, KOR, EU).

attributes.name: tax_inclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the price includes applicable taxes (True) or taxes are added at checkout (False).

attributes.name: tier_label
attributes.description: Platform-specific tier label or identifier (e.g., Apple Tier 1, Google Play Tier A).

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Numeric tier level representing the price point position in the platform pricing ladder (e.g., 1=lowest, 100=highest).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the price point record was last modified.

attributes.name: vat_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Applicable VAT or sales tax rate percentage for this price point in the target region (e.g., 20.00 for 20% VAT in UK).

attributes.name: virtual_currency_equivalent
attributes.description: Amount of virtual currency (e.g., coins, gems, credits) that this price point grants to the player upon purchase.
