attributes.name: ad_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ad unit format determining how the advertisement is displayed to the player.

attributes.name: advertiser_exclusions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of advertiser identifiers that are blocked from serving ads through this unit due to competitive or content conflicts.

attributes.name: auto_refresh_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ad unit automatically refreshes to serve new ads at the defined refresh rate interval.

attributes.name: category_exclusions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IAB content categories that are blocked from serving ads through this unit to maintain brand safety.

attributes.name: coppa_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad unit complies with COPPA regulations for child-directed content, restricting behavioral targeting and data collection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad unit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetization transactions associated with this ad unit.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the ad unit purpose, placement context, and targeting strategy for internal documentation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this ad unit is scheduled to become inactive and stop serving advertisements. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this ad unit becomes active and eligible to serve advertisements.

attributes.name: floor_price_usd
attributes.description: Minimum cost per mille (CPM) bid price in USD required for an ad to be served through this unit, protecting revenue quality.

attributes.name: frequency_cap_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of times the same ad can be shown to a single user within the frequency cap period, preventing ad fatigue.

attributes.name: frequency_cap_period_hours
attributes.description: Time window in hours over which the frequency cap count is enforced.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether user consent under GDPR is required before serving personalized ads through this unit.

attributes.name: height_pixels
attributes.description: Display height of the ad unit in pixels, defining the vertical dimension of the ad creative space.

attributes.name: mediation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad unit uses mediation to optimize ad fill rate and revenue by routing requests across multiple ad networks.

attributes.name: mediation_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this ad unit within the mediation waterfall, determining the order in which ad networks are queried.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad unit record was last modified, tracking configuration changes and optimization updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, optimization insights, or special instructions related to this ad unit.

attributes.name: placement_location
attributes.description: In-game location or screen where the ad unit is displayed, critical for user experience and monetization optimization.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Gaming platform where this ad unit is available for serving advertisements.

attributes.name: refresh_rate_seconds
attributes.description: Time interval in seconds between automatic ad refreshes for this unit, impacting impression volume and user experience.

attributes.name: reward_amount
attributes.description: Quantity of the reward granted to players for completing a rewarded ad view.

attributes.name: reward_type
attributes.description: Type of in-game reward granted to players upon successful ad completion for rewarded ad units.

attributes.name: rewarded_ad_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad unit provides in-game rewards (virtual currency, extra lives, power-ups) to players who complete the ad view.

attributes.name: skip_offset_seconds
attributes.description: Number of seconds that must elapse before the skip button becomes available to the player for skippable ads.

attributes.name: skippable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether players can skip the ad before completion, impacting user experience and advertiser value.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ad unit determining whether it can serve advertisements.

attributes.name: target_audience_age_max
attributes.description: Maximum age of the intended audience for this ad unit, enabling demographic targeting optimization.

attributes.name: target_audience_age_min
attributes.description: Minimum age of the intended audience for this ad unit, ensuring compliance with age-appropriate advertising regulations.

attributes.name: test_mode_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad unit is operating in test mode, serving test ads for quality assurance without generating revenue.

attributes.name: video_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Standard duration in seconds for video ads served through this unit, applicable to video and rewarded video ad types.

attributes.name: width_pixels
attributes.description: Display width of the ad unit in pixels, defining the horizontal dimension of the ad creative space.

attributes.name: parent_ad_unit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ad_unit (parent_ad_unit_id)

products.name: storefront_transaction
products.description: Master reference table for storefront_transaction. Referenced by storefront_transaction_id.

attributes.name: storefront_transaction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for storefront_transaction

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign that influenced or attributed to this transaction.

attributes.name: device_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device (console, mobile, PC) from which the transaction was initiated.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title in which this storefront transaction occurred.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: External transaction identifier provided by the payment processor for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the player who initiated this storefront transaction.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the player game session during which the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the gaming platform where the transaction was executed (console, PC, mobile).

attributes.name: storefront_item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific item, bundle, or offer purchased from the in-game storefront.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was successfully completed and items were delivered to the player.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the players location at the time of transaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction monetary amounts.

attributes.name: days_since_install
attributes.description: Number of days elapsed between the players initial game installation and this transaction, used for lifetime value (LTV) analysis.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the transaction from promotional offers, coupons, or loyalty rewards.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transaction was flagged as potentially fraudulent by automated or manual review.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Risk score assigned by fraud detection system indicating the likelihood of fraudulent activity (0-100 scale).

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total transaction amount before any adjustments, taxes, or platform fees are applied.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol address of the device from which the transaction was initiated, used for fraud detection and geolocation.

attributes.name: is_first_purchase
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the players first-ever purchase in the game, used for conversion funnel analysis.

attributes.name: is_whale_transaction
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transaction qualifies as a high-value whale purchase based on business-defined thresholds.

attributes.name: item_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the storefront item purchased in this transaction.

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Net revenue retained by the business after deducting discounts, taxes, and platform fees from the gross amount.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument used by the player to complete the transaction.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processor or gateway that handled the transaction (e.g., Stripe, Braintree, Adyen).

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the distribution platform (e.g., Apple App Store, Google Play, Steam) for processing the transaction.

attributes.name: player_level
attributes.description: In-game level or progression rank of the player at the time of the transaction, used for monetization segmentation analysis.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional or coupon code applied by the player to receive a discount on this transaction.

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for transaction refund, if applicable (e.g., accidental purchase, dissatisfaction, technical issue).

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction refund was processed, if applicable.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region or state code where the transaction originated, used for tax and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: storefront_location
attributes.description: Specific in-game location or menu where the storefront item was displayed and purchased (e.g., main menu, post-match screen, battle pass tab).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the transaction, including sales tax, VAT, or GST as applicable by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique transaction number displayed to players and used in customer service interactions.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the storefront transaction in the payment and fulfillment workflow.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player initiated the storefront purchase transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Category of monetization transaction: in-app purchase (IAP), microtransaction (MTX), downloadable content (DLC), battle pass, subscription, virtual currency purchase, loot box, or season pass.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_amount
attributes.description: Quantity of virtual currency (e.g., V-Bucks, Apex Coins) granted to the player as part of this transaction.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_type
attributes.description: Name or code of the virtual currency type awarded in this transaction.

attributes.name: original_storefront_transaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on storefront_transaction (original_storefront_transaction_id)

products.name: storefront_item
products.description: Master reference table for storefront_item. Referenced by storefront_item_id.

attributes.name: storefront_item_id
attributes.description: Primary key for storefront_item

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: Standard retail price of the storefront item in the platform's base currency before any discounts or promotions.

attributes.name: bundle_item_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct items or rewards included in the bundle (null for non-bundle items).

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Age-appropriateness rating for the storefront item content, aligned with platform content policies (ESRB, PEGI equivalent).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this storefront item record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Current promotional discount percentage applied to the base price (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: discounted_price
attributes.description: Final price after applying discount percentage, used for player-facing display and transaction processing.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this storefront item is removed from the store or becomes unavailable (null for permanent items).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date and time when this storefront item becomes available for purchase in the store.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the special in-game event associated with this item (e.g., Halloween_2024, Winter_Festival).

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL path to the primary promotional image or icon asset for the storefront item.

attributes.name: is_bundle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront item is a bundle containing multiple sub-items or rewards.

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is currently featured in promotional storefront placements or hero banners.

attributes.name: is_time_limited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item has a limited availability window (true for seasonal, event-exclusive, or rotating shop items).

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Business category of the storefront item by player value proposition: cosmetic (appearance), gameplay (mechanics), progression (advancement), social (interaction), utility (convenience), or bundle (multi-item package).

attributes.name: item_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the storefront item, used in catalogs, APIs, and player-facing interfaces.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed marketing description of the storefront item, including benefits, contents, and value proposition.

attributes.name: item_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the storefront item shown to players in the game store.

attributes.name: item_rarity
attributes.description: Rarity tier of the storefront item, used for perceived value signaling and collection mechanics.

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storefront item by consumption model: consumable (single-use), durable (permanent), currency (virtual currency pack), subscription (recurring access), battle_pass (seasonal progression), or loot_box (randomized reward container).

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the storefront item: draft (not yet published), active (available for purchase), featured (promoted placement), limited (time-limited availability), retired (no longer sold but owned items remain), or disabled (temporarily unavailable).

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user or process that last modified this storefront item record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this storefront item record was last updated.

attributes.name: monetization_model
attributes.description: Revenue mechanism classification: In-App Purchase (IAP), Microtransaction (MTX), Downloadable Content (DLC), subscription, battle pass, or gacha/loot box.

attributes.name: platform_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of gaming platforms where this item is available for purchase (e.g., PC, PlayStation, Xbox, iOS, Android, Switch).

attributes.name: player_level_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum player level required to view or purchase this storefront item (null if no level gate).

attributes.name: purchase_limit_per_player
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single player can purchase this item (null for unlimited purchases).

attributes.name: region_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic regions or markets where this item is available, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region codes.

attributes.name: season_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game season or content update during which this item was introduced (e.g., Season_12, Chapter_3).

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Display sequence number for controlling the presentation order of items in the storefront interface.

attributes.name: stock_quantity
attributes.description: Total available inventory quantity for limited-edition items (null for unlimited digital goods).

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of searchable tags or keywords for storefront filtering and discovery (e.g., new, trending, exclusive, limited).

attributes.name: total_revenue
attributes.description: Cumulative revenue generated from all sales of this storefront item in the base currency.

attributes.name: total_sales_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times this storefront item has been purchased across all players and platforms.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this storefront item record, incremented with each modification for optimistic locking and change tracking.

attributes.name: video_preview_url
attributes.description: URL path to the video preview or trailer showcasing the storefront item (null if no video available).

attributes.name: virtual_currency_price
attributes.description: Price of the storefront item in the game's virtual currency (e.g., V-Bucks, Riot Points, Apex Coins) if purchasable with in-game currency.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_type
attributes.description: Name or code of the virtual currency used for pricing (e.g., gold, gems, premium_coins) if applicable.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user or process that created this storefront item record.

attributes.name: parent_storefront_item_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on storefront_item (parent_storefront_item_id)

domains.name: platform
domains.description: Manages gaming platforms, distribution channels, console SDK integrations (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo), PC storefronts (Steamworks, Epic Games Store), mobile app store pipelines (Apple App Store, Google Play), platform certification submissions, TRC/TCR compliance checklists, DRM entitlement systems, and cross-platform compatibility. Enables multi-platform distribution and deployment.
domains.references: Steamworks SDK, Apple/Google Policies, Platform TRC/TCR

products.name: storefront
products.description: Master catalog of digital distribution storefronts, platform channels, and their governing platform holders through which game titles are published and sold. Covers first-party console storefronts (PlayStation Store, Xbox Marketplace, Nintendo eShop), PC storefronts (Steamworks, Epic Games Store, GOG), and mobile app stores (Apple App Store, Google Play). Tracks storefront identity, owning platform holder (Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo, Apple, Google, Valve), platform holder type (console OEM, PC storefront, mobile app store), region availability, supported payment methods, revenue share terms, developer portal URL, integration SDK version, and supported platform generations. This is the SSOT for all distribution channel and platform holder definitions.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the digital distribution storefront. Primary key.

attributes.name: ad_network_id

attributes.name: developer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.developer_account. Business justification: A storefront is managed through a specific developer account on the platform holder's developer portal. This is the primary link to connect the siloed developer_account product. N:1 relationship - man

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Storefronts operate under specific jurisdictional regulations (GDPR, COPPA, age verification, content restrictions). Compliance teams must know which regulations apply to each storefront for content p

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Storefronts are operated by legal entities for tax compliance, revenue recognition, and regulatory filings. Essential for financial reporting and intercompany transaction tracking in multi-entity gami

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Storefronts distribute licensed middleware (Unity, Unreal SDKs) and branded content. Tracks which IP assets are available per storefront for developer onboarding, SDK distribution, and brand partnersh

attributes.name: network_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.network_region. Business justification: Storefronts are deployed in specific network regions for content delivery and latency optimization. Critical for regional availability planning, CDN topology design, and storefront performance SLAs. G

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform holder entity that owns and operates this storefront (e.g., Sony, Microsoft, Valve, Apple, Google).

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Storefronts must comply with platform-specific regulatory obligations (payment processing, refunds, consumer rights). Real business process: storefront operations compliance and regulatory audit prepa

attributes.name: age_rating_system
attributes.description: Primary age rating classification system required for games on this storefront: ESRB (North America), PEGI (Europe), USK (Germany), CERO (Japan), GRAC (South Korea), or IARC (International Age Rating Coalition for digital storefronts).

attributes.name: analytics_integration
attributes.description: Native analytics and reporting platform provided by this storefront for tracking sales, player engagement, and performance metrics (e.g., Steamworks Analytics, App Store Analytics, Google Play Console).

attributes.name: api_endpoint
attributes.description: Base URL of the storefront's API for programmatic integration, build uploads, metadata management, and analytics retrieval.

attributes.name: cdn_provider
attributes.description: Content delivery network provider used by this storefront for game distribution and patch delivery (e.g., Akamai, Amazon CloudFront, platform-native CDN).

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether game builds must pass formal platform certification (TRC/TCR compliance) before release. True for console storefronts, typically false for open PC storefronts.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary business contact email address for developer relations, technical support, or partnership inquiries for this storefront.

attributes.name: content_policy_url
attributes.description: Web URL of the storefront's content policy and submission guidelines that define acceptable game content, prohibited material, and editorial standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storefront record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Primary currency used for pricing and transactions on this storefront. ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP). May support multiple currencies by region.

attributes.name: developer_portal_url
attributes.description: Web URL of the developer portal or partner center for this storefront where game submissions, builds, and metadata are managed (e.g., Steamworks, Epic Dev Portal, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

attributes.name: drm_system
attributes.description: Digital rights management and entitlement system used by this storefront to control game access and prevent piracy (e.g., Steam DRM, Denuvo, platform-native entitlement, none for DRM-free stores like GOG).

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when this storefront officially launched and became available for game distribution and player purchases.

attributes.name: maximum_build_size_gb
attributes.description: Maximum game build package size in gigabytes accepted by this storefront. Null if no hard limit enforced.

attributes.name: minimum_build_size_mb
attributes.description: Minimum game build package size in megabytes accepted by this storefront. Null if no minimum enforced.

attributes.name: platform_generation
attributes.description: Hardware or platform generation supported by this storefront (e.g., PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, PC, iOS 15+, Android 12+). May support multiple generations.

attributes.name: platform_holder_type
attributes.description: Classification of the platform holder operating this storefront: console OEM (Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo), PC storefront (Valve, Epic), mobile app store (Apple, Google), or cloud gaming platform.

attributes.name: refund_policy_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which players can request refunds for game purchases on this storefront (e.g., 14 for Steam, 14 for Epic). Null if no standard refund window.

attributes.name: region_availability
attributes.description: Geographic regions or countries where this storefront is available for game distribution and player purchases. Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region identifiers.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of gross revenue retained by the platform holder as commission (e.g., 30.00 for standard 30% platform fee, 70.00 means publisher receives 70%). Business-confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: sdk_version
attributes.description: Current version of the platform SDK or integration library required for game builds submitted to this storefront (e.g., Steamworks SDK 1.55, Epic Online Services 1.15, iOS SDK 16.2).

attributes.name: storefront_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code identifier for the storefront used in internal systems and integrations (e.g., PSN_STORE, XBOX_STORE, STEAM, EPIC, APPLE_APP, GOOGLE_PLAY).

attributes.name: storefront_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the digital distribution storefront (e.g., PlayStation Store, Xbox Marketplace, Steam, Epic Games Store, Apple App Store, Google Play).

attributes.name: storefront_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storefront: active (accepting submissions and sales), deprecated (legacy support only), sunset (end-of-life), beta (limited access), or coming soon (announced but not launched).

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when this storefront will cease operations or no longer accept new game submissions. Null if storefront is active with no announced sunset.

attributes.name: supported_payment_methods
attributes.description: Payment instruments accepted by this storefront (e.g., credit card, debit card, PayPal, platform wallet, gift card, carrier billing). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: supports_cross_platform
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports cross-platform multiplayer, cross-save, or cross-buy features with other platforms.

attributes.name: supports_dlc
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports distribution of downloadable content, expansions, and add-ons for base games.

attributes.name: supports_early_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports early access or soft launch programs where games can be released in incomplete or beta state with player access.

attributes.name: supports_iap
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports in-app purchases and microtransactions within games. True for most mobile and modern console/PC storefronts.

attributes.name: supports_subscriptions
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront supports recurring subscription billing for games or services (e.g., Xbox Game Pass, PlayStation Plus, Apple Arcade).

attributes.name: supports_ugc
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront provides infrastructure for user-generated content distribution (e.g., Steam Workshop, console mod support).

attributes.name: tax_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method by which sales tax or VAT is calculated and displayed: inclusive (tax included in displayed price), exclusive (tax added at checkout), or varies by region.

attributes.name: trc_tcr_version

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

This is the SSOT for what a game looks like as both a purchasable product and a discoverable listing on each platform storefront.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.network_region. Business justification: SKU regional availability is constrained by infrastructure deployment regions. attributes.name: certification_submission_date

products.name: platform_cert_submission
products.description: Transactional record of the complete platform certification lifecycle from build preparation and packaging through formal platform holder submission, review, and outcome resolution. At the build level: captures build version string, build type (debug, release candidate, gold master, patch, hotfix), target platform, build size (bytes), build hash/checksum, submission pipeline status (packaging, uploading, validating, submitted, in-review, approved, rejected), submission channel (PlayStation DevNet, Xbox Partner Center, App Store Connect, Steamworks), and gold master flag. At the submission level: captures TRC/TCR checklist version applied, submission type (initial, resubmission, patch), and platform holder review tracking. At the result level: captures certification outcome per review cycle (pass, fail, conditional pass), failure count and categories, waiver grants, resubmission deadline, certification certificate ID, gold master approval flag, and platform holder reviewer notes. One submission may have multiple result records across resubmission cycles. This is the SSOT for the entire build-to-certification pipeline including build preparation, formal submission, and all platform holder review outcomes.

products.name: certification_checklist
products.description: Master record of a TRC (Technical Requirements Checklist) or TCR (Technical Certification Requirements) checklist version issued by a platform holder, including all individual requirement line items at full granularity. Captures checklist version number, platform holder (Sony/Microsoft/Nintendo/Apple/Google), platform generation (PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2), effective date, expiry date, total requirement count, mandatory vs. advisory breakdown, and category taxonomy. Each requirement line item includes requirement code, title, detailed description, category (audio, video, network, save data, accessibility, age rating), severity (mandatory, advisory, conditional), platform holder guidance notes, waiver eligibility flag, and associated test case reference. This is the SSOT for all platform certification requirements and their hierarchical organization within versioned checklists.

attributes.description: Number of critical severity failures that must be resolved before resubmission. Critical failures block certification approval.

attributes.name: detailed_failure_report_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the comprehensive failure report document provided by the platform holder, containing screenshots, logs, and reproduction steps.

attributes.name: executive_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the certification result intended for studio leadership and project stakeholders.

attributes.name: fast_track_resubmission_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submission qualifies for expedited fast-track resubmission review, typically for minor fixes only.

attributes.name: functional_failure_count
attributes.description: Number of failures related to game functionality, gameplay mechanics, or feature implementation.

attributes.name: gold_master_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result represents final gold master approval, authorizing the build for commercial distribution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this submission result record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: localization_failure_count
attributes.description: Number of failures related to language translation, regional content adaptation, or cultural compliance.

attributes.name: major_failure_count
attributes.description: Number of major severity failures identified. Major failures significantly impact user experience or platform compliance.

attributes.name: minor_failure_count
attributes.description: Number of minor severity failures identified. Minor failures have limited impact and may be eligible for waivers.

attributes.name: network_failure_count
attributes.description: Number of failures related to online connectivity, multiplayer functionality, or network error handling.

attributes.name: performance_failure_count
attributes.description: Number of failures related to performance metrics such as frame rate (FPS), load times, or memory usage.

attributes.name: platform_holder_reviewer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the platform holder reviewer for follow-up communication regarding the certification result.

attributes.name: platform_holder_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the platform holder certification reviewer who conducted the evaluation and issued the result.

attributes.name: resubmission_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which the studio must resubmit a corrected build if the result was fail or conditional pass. Null if result was pass.

attributes.name: result_notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the platform holder sent the formal result notification to the studio via email or platform portal.

attributes.name: result_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of result records for a given submission across resubmission cycles. First submission is 1, first resubmission is 2, etc.

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the result record. Active indicates the current result, superseded indicates a newer result exists, appealed indicates under appeal review, archived indicates historical record.

attributes.name: result_type
attributes.description: Outcome classification of the certification review. Pass indicates full approval, fail requires resubmission, conditional pass requires minor fixes, waiver granted allows exceptions, withdrawn indicates studio cancellation, cancelled indicates platform holder cancellation.

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the platform holder completed their certification review and issued the formal result.

attributes.name: review_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the platform holder spent conducting the certification review for this submission.

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes and feedback from the platform holder reviewer explaining failures, waivers, and recommendations for resubmission.

attributes.name: studio_acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the studio acknowledged receipt and review of the certification result.

attributes.name: test_environment_configuration
attributes.description: Description of the hardware, firmware, and software configuration used by the platform holder during certification testing.

attributes.name: total_failure_count
attributes.description: Total number of Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC) or Technical Certification Requirements (TCR) failures identified in this review cycle.

attributes.name: ui_ux_failure_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: User Interface and User Experience (UI/UX) Failure Count
attributes.description: Number of failures related to user interface design, navigation, accessibility, or user experience standards.

attributes.name: waiver_granted_count
attributes.description: Number of failures for which the platform holder granted waivers, allowing the submission to proceed despite non-compliance.

products.name: drm_entitlement
products.description: Master and transactional record governing DRM (Digital Rights Management) entitlement rules and the complete audit trail of individual player-level access grants for platform SKUs. At the rule level: captures entitlement type (purchase, subscription, trial, F2P, rental), license scope (single-device, multi-device, family share), offline play allowance, region lock configuration, expiry rules, and revocation policy. At the grant level: tracks individual player entitlement grants including grant timestamp, source transaction reference (IAP, promotion, subscription, key redemption), platform account ID, device binding, grant channel (storefront purchase, key redemption, promotional grant, subscription benefit), grant expiry, and revocation status. This is the SSOT for both DRM licensing policy definitions and the complete audit trail of player access rights across all platforms. Supports entitlement verification, access revocation, and compliance audit queries.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DRM entitlement record. Primary key for both entitlement rules and individual player grants.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the admin or system user who initiated the revocation. Null for automated system revocations.

attributes.name: entitlement_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master entitlement rule definition that governs this grant. Links grant-level records to their governing rule-level configuration. Null for rule-level records themselves.

attributes.name: platform_identity_id
attributes.description: The player's account identifier on the external platform (Steam ID, PSN ID, Xbox Live Gamertag, Epic Account ID, etc.). Used for platform-level entitlement verification.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the player who received this entitlement grant. Links to the player master record. Null for rule-level records, populated for grant-level records.

attributes.name: title_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.sku. Business justification: DRM entitlements protect specific SKUs with region locks, offline play rules, and device binding. Real DRM systems (Denuvo, platform DRM) enforce at SKU level for regional licensing compliance, editio

attributes.name: allowed_regions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this entitlement is valid. Empty if region_lock_enabled is false. Example: USA,CAN,GBR,DEU.

attributes.name: concurrent_device_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of devices that can simultaneously use this entitlement. Applicable for multi-device license scope. Null for single-device or unlimited scope.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this entitlement record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record creation tracking.

attributes.name: device_binding_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device to which this entitlement is bound. Applicable for single-device license scope. May be device serial number, hardware fingerprint, or platform device ID.

attributes.name: entitlement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or administrative comments related to this entitlement. Used for documenting exceptions, special grants, or support case references.

attributes.name: entitlement_type
attributes.description: The type of entitlement governing access rights. Purchase = permanent ownership, Subscription = recurring access, Trial = time-limited evaluation, F2P = free-to-play access, Rental = temporary paid access, Promotional = marketing grant.

attributes.name: expiry_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days from grant timestamp until entitlement expires. Applicable only when expiry_rule is duration_days. Null for other expiry rule types.

attributes.name: expiry_fixed_date
attributes.description: Specific calendar date when entitlement expires. Applicable only when expiry_rule is fixed_date. Null for other expiry rule types.

attributes.name: expiry_rule
attributes.description: Defines how entitlement expiration is calculated. Perpetual = never expires, Fixed-date = expires on specific date, Duration-days = expires N days after grant, Subscription-cycle = expires with subscription period.

attributes.name: family_share_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement can be shared with family group members as defined by the platform's family sharing feature. True = shareable, False = not shareable.

attributes.name: grant_channel
attributes.description: The channel or method through which this entitlement was granted. Storefront-purchase = direct store purchase, Key-redemption = activation code, Promotional-grant = marketing campaign, Subscription-benefit = included in subscription, Bundle-inclusion = part of bundle purchase, Platform-plus = platform subscription service (PS Plus, Game Pass).

attributes.name: grant_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The calculated date and time when this specific entitlement grant expires. Computed based on grant_timestamp and expiry_rule configuration. Null for perpetual entitlements.

attributes.name: grant_source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the originating transaction that triggered this entitlement grant. May reference IAP transaction, subscription activation, promotional campaign, or key redemption event.

attributes.name: grant_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this entitlement was granted to the player. Null for rule-level records, populated for grant-level records.

attributes.name: last_verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this entitlement was last verified with the platform DRM service. Used to enforce verification_required_interval_hours policy.

attributes.name: license_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of device/account binding for this entitlement. Single-device = locked to one device, Multi-device = usable across multiple devices, Family-share = shareable within family group, Account-bound = tied to player account regardless of device.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this entitlement record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: offline_play_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement permits offline gameplay without active internet connection. True = offline play enabled, False = requires online verification.

attributes.name: region_lock_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic region restrictions apply to this entitlement. True = region-locked, False = globally accessible.

attributes.name: revocation_grace_period_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours of continued access after revocation is triggered. Applicable only when revocation_policy is grace_period. Null for other policies.

attributes.name: revocation_policy
attributes.description: Defines the policy for revoking this entitlement. Immediate = access removed instantly, Grace-period = access continues for defined period, Non-revocable = cannot be revoked once granted.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this entitlement was revoked. Chargeback = payment reversed, Fraud = fraudulent acquisition detected, Policy-violation = terms of service breach, Subscription-cancellation = subscription ended, Refund = purchase refunded, Admin-action = manual revocation by support.

attributes.name: revocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of this entitlement grant. Active = valid and usable, Revoked = access removed by admin/system, Suspended = temporarily disabled, Expired = past expiry timestamp.

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this entitlement was revoked or suspended. Null if revocation_status is active or expired.

attributes.name: transfer_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement can be transferred to another player account. True = transferable, False = non-transferable. Most digital entitlements are non-transferable per platform policies.

attributes.name: verification_required_interval_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours between required online entitlement verification checks. Applicable for entitlements that allow offline play but require periodic online check-ins. Null for always-online or fully-offline entitlements.

Enables audit of player access rights across all platforms.

attributes.name: content_version
attributes.description: The version or build number of the content that this entitlement grants access to. Used for patch management and backward compatibility tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this entitlement grant record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: grant_channel
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the entitlement was granted: storefront_purchase (IAP or store transaction), key_redemption (product key activation), promotional_grant (marketing campaign), subscription_benefit (GaaS membership perk), bundle_unlock (part of bundle purchase), support_compensation (customer service remedy).

attributes.name: grant_notes

attributes.name: grant_source_system

attributes.name: grant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the entitlement grant: active (valid and usable), revoked (administratively withdrawn), expired (past validity period), pending (awaiting activation), suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: grant_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the entitlement was granted to the player account. Primary business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entitlement can be transferred to another player account (true) or is permanently bound to the original recipient (false). Enforces platform transfer policies and secondary market restrictions.

attributes.name: max_activations
attributes.description: The maximum number of devices or accounts that can activate this entitlement concurrently. Null indicates unlimited activations. Enforces platform TRC/TCR device limits.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this entitlement grant record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the geographic region where this entitlement is valid. Used for regional licensing restrictions and content rating compliance (ESRB, PEGI, CERO, USK).

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for entitlement revocation: chargeback (payment disputed), fraud (fraudulent acquisition), policy_violation (terms of service breach), refund (purchase refunded), account_closure (player account terminated), license_transfer (moved to different account).

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the entitlement was revoked, if applicable. Null for active entitlements. Used for audit trail of access rights withdrawal.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The platform-specific product SKU or item identifier for the entitlement. Maps to storefront catalog entries and platform certification submissions.

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier to the originating transaction (IAP receipt ID, promotional campaign ID, subscription order ID, support ticket ID) that triggered this entitlement grant.

products.name: storefront_campaign
products.description: This association product represents the placement and execution of a marketing campaign on a specific digital storefront. It captures the business reality that campaigns are executed across multiple storefronts with storefront-specific budgets, targeting rules, co-marketing agreements with platform holders, and featured placement timing. Each record links one storefront to one campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific storefront-campaign execution.. Existence Justification: In gaming marketing operations, campaigns are executed across multiple digital storefronts (Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation Store, Xbox Marketplace, etc.), and each storefront hosts multiple campaigns from various publishers. The business actively manages these placements as distinct operational entities, allocating storefront-specific budgets, configuring platform-specific targeting rules, negotiating co-marketing agreements with platform holders, and tracking featured placement timing and performance per storefront-campaign combination.

products.name: creative_listing_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment between ad_creative and storefront_listing. It captures the operational linkage between advertising creative assets and the specific storefront listing variants they drive traffic to, enabling A/B testing, conversion funnel tracking, and creative performance optimization. Each record links one ad_creative to one storefront_listing with performance metrics and test configuration that exist only in the context of this pairing.. Existence Justification: In gaming UA operations, ad creatives are strategically assigned to multiple storefront listing variants as part of A/B testing and conversion optimization campaigns. A single video creative may drive traffic to different listing presentations (control vs. variant) to test messaging alignment, while a single listing is promoted by multiple creative formats (video, playable, static) across different audience segments and platforms. Marketing teams actively manage these assignments as operational entities, tracking impression-to-view and view-to-install conversion rates for each creative-listing pairing to optimize the full funnel from ad exposure to game installation.

products.name: storefront_release
products.description: This association product represents the Release Event between dev_project and storefront. It captures the publication and distribution lifecycle of a game development project on a specific digital storefront. Each record links one dev_project to one storefront with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific platform release: release dates, pricing strategy, regional availability, certification status, and listing lifecycle state.. Existence Justification: In the gaming industry, a single game development project publishes to multiple digital storefronts simultaneously (e.g., Fortnite releases on PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, Steam, Epic Games Store, Nintendo eShop), and each storefront hosts thousands of game titles. Each project-storefront pairing has distinct operational attributes: release dates vary by platform (staggered launches), pricing differs based on platform holder policies, regional availability is storefront-specific, and certification is a per-storefront process (Sony TRC, Microsoft TCR, Nintendo lotcheck). Platform/publishing teams actively manage these storefront releases as distinct operational entities with their own lifecycle (submission, certification, approval, live, delisted).

products.name: developer_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between developer accounts and regulatory obligations. It captures the compliance status, certification dates, audit results, and evidence documentation for each developer account's adherence to specific regulatory requirements. Each record links one developer account to one regulatory obligation with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In gaming platform operations, each developer account must comply with multiple regulatory obligations (GDPR, COPPA, loot box disclosure, age rating mandates, tax reporting, etc.), and each regulatory obligation applies to multiple developer accounts across the platform. The compliance team actively manages this many-to-many relationship by tracking per-account, per-obligation compliance status, conducting audits, maintaining certification dates, and storing evidence documentation. This is not a derivable correlation but an operational compliance management process.

attributes.description: The teams current global ranking position within their primary game title. Lower numbers indicate higher ranking (1 is best). Used for seeding, tournament invitations, and performance tracking.

attributes.name: discord_server_code
attributes.description: Official Discord server identifier for the teams community. Used for fan engagement, community management, and player-fan interaction tracking.

attributes.name: founding_date
attributes.description: The date when the esports team or organization was officially founded or established. Used for historical tracking and legacy analysis.

attributes.name: franchise_fee_paid
attributes.description: The total franchise fee paid by the organization to secure a permanent league slot. Tracked in USD. Highly confidential financial data used for revenue recognition and partnership valuation.

attributes.name: general_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the teams general manager or director of esports operations. Responsible for roster decisions, contracts, and organizational strategy.

attributes.name: head_coach_name
attributes.description: Full name of the teams current head coach or manager. Key personnel information for broadcasts, media, and organizational tracking.

attributes.name: headquarters_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the teams headquarters, training facility, or primary business location. Used for legal correspondence, contract execution, and facility management.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the teams headquarters or primary facility is located. Used for geographic analysis and regional market segmentation.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the teams headquarters location. Used for shipping, logistics, and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: is_franchise_team
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this team holds a franchise slot in a Gaming-operated franchised league. Franchise teams have permanent league positions and revenue sharing agreements.

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the team has been officially verified by Gaming as a legitimate competitive organization. Verified teams have completed compliance checks and meet league standards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this team record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit trails.

attributes.name: league_championships
attributes.description: Total number of league championships won by the team in Gaming-operated leagues. Distinct from tournament wins, represents seasonal league titles.

attributes.name: organization_legal_name
attributes.description: The legal registered name of the organization or entity that owns and operates the esports team. Used for contracts, prize pool disbursements, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: regional_ranking
attributes.description: The teams current ranking position within their home region. Used for regional tournament seeding and qualification tracking.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of league revenue that this team is entitled to receive as part of their franchise or partnership agreement. Confidential financial term used for revenue distribution calculations.

attributes.name: roster_lock_date
attributes.description: The date when the current roster lock period began. Used to enforce roster change restrictions during tournament phases and calculate lock duration.

attributes.name: roster_lock_status
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the teams roster is currently locked for tournament play. True means no roster changes are allowed during the lock period (typically during active tournament phases), False means roster changes are permitted.

attributes.name: roster_size
attributes.description: The current number of active players on the teams roster. Used for roster compliance checks against league minimum and maximum roster size rules.

attributes.name: secondary_game_title_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional game title IDs that this team competes in beyond their primary title. Supports multi-game organizations.

attributes.name: sponsorship_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the teams sponsorship level or tier within Gaming-operated leagues. Higher tiers indicate more valuable sponsorship packages and revenue sharing agreements. Used for revenue allocation and partnership management.

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric abbreviation or tag for the team (e.g., 'C9', 'TL', 'FNC'). Used in scoreboards, brackets, and compact displays. Typically 2-5 uppercase characters.

attributes.name: team_name
attributes.description: The full display name of the esports team or organization (e.g., 'Cloud9', 'Team Liquid', 'FaZe Clan'). This is the primary human-readable identifier used in broadcasts, standings, and marketing materials.

attributes.name: team_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the esports team. Active teams are competing, inactive teams are not currently competing but still exist, disbanded teams have permanently ceased operations, suspended teams are temporarily barred from competition, on_hiatus teams are taking a break.

attributes.name: tier_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the teams competitive tier or level (Tier 1 for top-level professional teams, Tier 2/3 for semi-professional, Academy for development teams, Amateur for grassroots). Determines tournament eligibility and prize pool access.

attributes.name: total_prize_money_won
attributes.description: Cumulative total prize money won by the team across all Gaming-operated tournaments and leagues. Tracked in USD. Used for performance analytics, team valuation, and historical achievement tracking.

attributes.name: tournament_wins
attributes.description: Total number of tournament championships won by the team in Gaming-operated competitions. Key performance indicator for team success and legacy.

attributes.name: twitch_channel
attributes.description: Official Twitch channel name for the team. Used for live streaming, broadcast rights tracking, and viewership analytics.

attributes.name: twitter_handle
attributes.description: Official Twitter/X handle for the team (e.g., '@Cloud9'). Used for social media tracking, engagement analytics, and community management.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the team was officially verified by Gaming. Used for compliance tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL for the esports team or organization. Primary digital presence for fans, sponsors, and media.

attributes.name: youtube_channel
attributes.description: Official YouTube channel name or handle for the team. Used for content distribution, VOD hosting, and video engagement tracking.

products.name: roster
products.description: Tracks the active and historical roster composition of an esports team for a specific league season or tournament. Records player reference, team reference, role (IGL, support, carry, flex, substitute), jersey number, join date, departure date, roster lock date, eligibility status, and nationality for regional compliance. Captures the M:N relationship between teams and players over time, enabling roster lock enforcement and regional eligibility validation.

attributes.name: roster_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the esports team roster entry. Primary key for the roster product.

attributes.name: esports_season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific league season or tournament edition for which this roster is active. Links to the season master data.

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Reference to the esports league or competitive circuit for which this roster is registered. Links to the league master data.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the professional esports player assigned to this roster position. Links to the player master data.

attributes.name: player_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player contract that governs the terms of this roster assignment. Links to the contract master data for salary, duration, and performance clauses.

attributes.name: roster_previous_team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the team the player was rostered with immediately before joining this team. Nullable for players entering professional competition for the first time. Links to the team master data.

attributes.name: roster_team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the esports team that this roster entry belongs to. Links to the team master data.

attributes.name: age_at_roster_lock
attributes.description: The player's age in years at the time of roster lock. Used for age eligibility validation and compliance with league minimum/maximum age requirements.

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: The date when the roster change or player signing was officially announced to the public. Used for tracking announcement timing and media coordination.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this roster entry was officially approved by the league or team management. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the league official or team manager who approved this roster entry. Used for accountability and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this roster record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: The date when the player officially left the team roster. Nullable for active roster members. Marks the end of the player's tenure with the team for this roster period.

attributes.name: eligibility_status
attributes.description: The current eligibility status of the player for competitive play in this league or tournament. Eligible players can compete, ineligible players cannot, suspended players are temporarily barred, pending_review indicates ongoing investigation, restricted indicates conditional eligibility, and retired indicates the player has withdrawn from competition.

attributes.name: in_game_name
attributes.description: The player's official in-game alias or gamertag used during competitive matches and broadcasts. This is the name displayed to viewers and used for player identification in match statistics.

attributes.name: is_academy_promotion
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player was promoted from the organization's academy or development team (true) or acquired externally (false). Used for tracking talent development pipeline effectiveness.

attributes.name: is_captain
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player is designated as the team captain (true) or not (false). The captain typically has leadership responsibilities and represents the team in official matters.

attributes.name: is_starter
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player is designated as a starting lineup member (true) or a substitute/reserve (false). Determines default match participation.

attributes.name: jersey_number
attributes.description: The official jersey or uniform number assigned to the player for identification during broadcasts and live events. Used for merchandising and fan engagement.

attributes.name: join_date
attributes.description: The date when the player officially joined the team roster. Marks the start of the player's tenure with the team for this roster period.

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: The date when the roster was locked for the league or tournament, after which no changes are permitted without league approval. Critical for competitive integrity and compliance with league rules.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this roster record was last modified in the system. Used for tracking changes and data freshness.

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the player's nationality. Used for regional eligibility validation, import slot tracking, and compliance with league residency rules.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context about the roster entry, such as special conditions, trial periods, or administrative notes. Used by team management and league officials.

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: The residency classification of the player for league import slot rules. Resident players count as local talent, import players occupy limited foreign slots, exempt players have special status, and pending indicates residency determination is in progress.

attributes.name: roster_role
attributes.description: The competitive role or position assigned to the player within the team structure. IGL (In-Game Leader) directs strategy, support provides utility, carry focuses on damage output, flex adapts to multiple roles, substitute is a backup player, and coach provides strategic guidance.

attributes.name: roster_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of this roster entry. Active indicates the player is available for competition, inactive indicates temporary unavailability, on_loan indicates the player is temporarily assigned to another team, injured_reserve indicates medical leave, and suspended indicates disciplinary action.

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount paid to acquire the player from their previous team, if applicable. Nullable for free agent signings or internal promotions. Expressed in the organization's reporting currency.

attributes.name: transfer_fee_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transfer fee amount. Nullable if no transfer fee was paid.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number for tracking roster changes within a season. Increments with each roster modification to maintain historical audit trail.

products.name: player_contract
products.description: Esports player contract record governing the competitive relationship between a player and an esports team or organization. Captures contract type (standard, loan, trial), start date, end date, salary, performance bonus structure, revenue share percentage, buyout clause amount, non-compete terms, streaming rights restrictions, image rights, governing jurisdiction, contract status, and signing date. Owned by esports domain as competitive contracts are distinct from general workforce contracts.

attributes.name: player_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the esports player contract record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player agent or representative who negotiated this contract on behalf of the player, if applicable.

attributes.name: finance_tax_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_tax_record. Business justification: Player contracts trigger tax withholding obligations (income tax, social security) in multiple jurisdictions. Required for tax compliance, regulatory reporting (1099/W-2), and audit trail.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Player contracts are signed by specific legal entities (publisher subsidiaries, team legal entities). Required for contract liability tracking, legal compliance, tax withholding, and financial consoli

attributes.name: parent_contract_player_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original contract if this is a loan or amendment contract, establishing the contract hierarchy.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the esports player who is party to this contract.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Contracts must comply with specific regulatory obligations including employment law, minor protection rules, data retention requirements, and contract disclosure obligations. Required for contract tem

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the esports team or organization that employs the player under this contract.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews for an additional term upon expiration if not explicitly terminated by either party.

attributes.name: buyout_clause_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount required for another team to acquire the player before contract expiration, releasing the player from current obligations.

attributes.name: buyout_clause_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the buyout clause amount.

attributes.name: confidentiality_terms
attributes.description: Non-disclosure obligations protecting team strategies, roster changes, financial information, and other proprietary business information.

attributes.name: contract_language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code indicating the primary language in which the contract is written and legally binding.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the player contract, used for legal and operational reference.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the player contract. Draft indicates unsigned or pending approval; active indicates in force; suspended indicates temporarily paused; terminated indicates ended before expiration; expired indicates naturally ended; completed indicates fulfilled all terms.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract governing the player-team relationship. Standard contracts are full-time competitive agreements; loan contracts are temporary assignments from another team; trial contracts are probationary periods; academy contracts are for developmental rosters; substitute contracts are for backup players; free agent contracts are short-term engagements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The agreed-upon mechanism for resolving contractual disputes between player and team, including arbitration, mediation, litigation, or league-administered tribunal.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract expires or is scheduled to terminate. Nullable for indefinite contracts.

attributes.name: equipment_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the team provides gaming equipment (PC, peripherals, etc.) to the player as part of the contract.

attributes.name: exclusivity_clause
attributes.description: Terms requiring the player to compete exclusively for this team and prohibiting simultaneous contracts with other esports organizations.

attributes.name: health_insurance_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the team provides health insurance coverage for the player as part of the contract benefits.

attributes.name: housing_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the team provides housing accommodations for the player as part of the contract terms.

attributes.name: image_rights_terms
attributes.description: Terms governing the use of the players name, likeness, and image in marketing, merchandise, and promotional materials, including revenue sharing and approval rights.

attributes.name: non_compete_terms
attributes.description: Textual description of restrictions on the player competing for rival teams or in competing leagues during and after the contract period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contract details, special clauses, or internal annotations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the contract without penalty.

attributes.name: performance_bonus_structure
attributes.description: Textual description of the performance-based bonus terms, including tournament placement bonuses, MVP awards, and other achievement-based incentives.

attributes.name: relocation_assistance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount provided to the player to cover relocation expenses when joining the team, if applicable.

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: The duration in months for which the contract will automatically renew if auto-renewal is enabled.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of team revenue (e.g., prize winnings, sponsorship, merchandise) that the player is entitled to receive under this contract. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: salary_amount
attributes.description: The base annual salary paid to the player under this contract, excluding bonuses and revenue share.

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the salary amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract was signed by all parties, establishing legal commitment.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract becomes effective and the player is officially bound to the team.

attributes.name: streaming_rights_restrictions
attributes.description: Contractual limitations on the players ability to stream gameplay, including platform exclusivity, content restrictions, and revenue sharing for streaming income.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the contract was terminated early, if applicable. Null if contract was not terminated early.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for early contract termination, including mutual agreement, breach of contract, performance issues, or organizational restructuring.

attributes.name: tournament_participation_requirements
attributes.description: Contractual obligations regarding minimum tournament participation, practice schedules, and competitive availability requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract record was last modified in the system.

products.description: Defines a competitive season within a league, including season name, ordinal number, split (Spring/Summer/Fall/Winter), start date, end date, patch version range, prize pool allocation, qualification slots to next tier, relegation slots, and season status. A season is the primary scheduling and standings container for league play.

attributes.name: esports_season_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the esports season. Primary key for the season entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Seasons have approved budgets for planning and financial control. Linking enables season-level budget vs actual variance reporting, budget approval workflows, and financial planning.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title that this season is played on. Identifies which game this competitive season is for.

attributes.name: league_id

attributes.name: patch_release_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.storefront. Business justification: Competitive seasons define which storefront version is the official competitive standard, managing platform-specific patches, DLC requirements, and ensuring competitive parity. Essential for cross-pla

attributes.name: crowdfunded_amount

attributes.name: is_lan_event

attributes.name: max_teams

attributes.name: min_teams
attributes.description: The minimum number of teams required for the season to proceed. Used for viability assessment and cancellation decisions.

attributes.name: ordinal
attributes.description: Sequential number of this season within the league (e.g., 1 for first season, 5 for fifth season). Used for historical ordering and analytics.

attributes.name: peak_ccu
attributes.description: The highest number of concurrent viewers across all broadcast channels during the season. Key performance indicator for viewership success.

attributes.name: prize_pool_currency

attributes.name: sponsor_primary

attributes.name: start_date
