attributes.name: year

attributes.name: created_by

Enables reconstruction of the full competitive tree and drives match scheduling within the tournament. Parent entity for all matches within a given stage.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bracket or group stage within a tournament. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.description: Reference to the specific game title or intellectual property (IP) that this bracket competition is for. Links bracket to the game being played competitively.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.league. Business justification: Brackets are structural components of league competitive formats. While brackets are nested within tournaments, they also belong to a league context for organizational and reporting purposes. The busi

attributes.description: Reference to the physical or virtual venue where this bracket stage is being held. Null for fully online brackets. Used for logistics, ticketing, and broadcast production planning.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the final match of this bracket stage actually concluded. Used for operational tracking, broadcast analytics, and schedule variance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp

products.name: team_asset_license
products.description: This association product represents the licensing agreement between an esports team and a digital asset. It captures the legal rights, usage terms, and approval workflow for teams to use specific assets (logos, jerseys, promotional materials, in-game skins, sponsor assets) in competitive play, broadcasts, and marketing. Each record links one esports team to one asset with licensing terms, usage rights periods, approval status, and asset version tracking that exist only in the context of this IP rights relationship.. Existence Justification: In esports operations, teams actively manage licensing relationships for multiple digital assets (team logos, jersey designs, promotional graphics, in-game skins, sponsor-provided assets) with specific usage rights, approval workflows, and time-bound terms. Simultaneously, individual assets (particularly sponsor logos and shared promotional materials) are licensed to multiple teams under different terms. The business recognizes these as 'Team Asset Licenses' that require active management for IP compliance, tournament eligibility, and brand governance.

products.name: tournament_promotion
products.description: This association product represents the Event between promotion and tournament. It captures the activation of a specific promotional pricing event within the context of a specific esports tournament, tracking performance metrics and timing for each promotion-tournament pairing. Each record links one promotion to one tournament with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In gaming monetization operations, promotional pricing events are strategically activated across multiple esports tournaments to drive in-game purchase conversions during high-engagement competitive events. A single promotion (e.g., '20% off battle pass') can run concurrently across multiple tournaments (Spring Championship, Regional Qualifiers, Community Cup), and each tournament features multiple concurrent promotions targeting different player segments or product categories. The business actively manages these promotion-tournament activations as discrete marketing events, tracking performance metrics (impressions, conversions, revenue) per tournament to optimize promotional calendars and calculate tournament-specific ROI.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the promotional pricing event activated for this tournament

attributes.name: tournament_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the esports tournament during which this promotion is active

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Current status of this promotion activation for this tournament: scheduled (not yet started), active (currently running), paused (temporarily disabled), completed (ended normally), cancelled (terminated early).

attributes.name: conversion_count
attributes.description: Number of times players redeemed this promotion during this specific tournament. Tournament-specific conversion metric.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion expired for this specific tournament. May differ from the promotion's global end_timestamp if the promotion is deactivated at different times for different tournaments.

attributes.name: impression_count
attributes.description: Number of times this promotion was displayed to players during this specific tournament. Tournament-specific metric for ROI analysis.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Display priority ranking for this promotion within the context of this specific tournament. Determines ordering when multiple promotions are active during the same tournament event.

attributes.name: revenue_generated
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated from this promotion during this specific tournament. Tournament-specific revenue attribution for promotional ROI analysis.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion became active for this specific tournament. May differ from the promotion's global start_timestamp if the promotion is activated at different times for different tournaments.

products.name: tournament_asset_usage
products.description: This association product represents the usage relationship between tournaments and digital assets. It captures the operational tracking of which assets (logos, overlays, sponsor graphics, promotional videos) are deployed in which tournaments, including usage context, placement, duration, and rights compliance. Each record links one tournament to one asset with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific usage instance.. Existence Justification: In esports tournament operations, tournaments use multiple digital assets (logos, overlays, sponsor graphics, promotional videos) across different contexts (broadcast, venue, social media), and assets are reused across multiple tournaments. Tournament organizers actively manage asset usage as part of sponsor deliverable fulfillment, broadcast production, and rights compliance. This is an operational relationship with specific usage data (context, placement, duration, rights status) that belongs to neither the tournament nor the asset alone.

products.name: team_event_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between esports teams and community events. It captures the business arrangement when an esports team participates in, sponsors, or appears at a community-organized event. Each record links one esports team to one community event with attributes that describe the nature and terms of that specific participation.. Existence Justification: In gaming and esports operations, teams participate in multiple community events throughout the year (meet-and-greets, charity streams, fan tournaments, AMAs, signing events), and each community event typically features multiple teams to drive engagement and attendance. The business actively manages these participation arrangements as operational records with specific terms (appearance fees, participation type, roles) and tracks engagement outcomes (attendance count, social media reach, engagement scores) for each team-event combination.

products.name: league_influencer_partnership
products.description: This association product represents the contractual partnership between an esports league and an influencer/content creator. It captures the business agreement governing content creation, promotional activities, and compensation for influencer coverage of league events. Each record links one league to one influencer with partnership-specific terms, deliverables, exclusivity scope, and financial arrangements that exist only in the context of this marketing relationship.. Existence Justification: In the gaming industry, esports leagues routinely engage multiple influencers to create content, drive viewership, and promote events across different platforms and audience segments. Simultaneously, successful influencers partner with multiple leagues (e.g., covering both League of Legends LCS and Valorant Champions Tour) to diversify their content portfolio and revenue streams. Each league-influencer partnership is a distinct contractual relationship with its own terms, deliverables, compensation, and exclusivity scope.

domains.name: content
domains.description: Owns the digital asset pipeline for all in-game content: art assets, audio, localization strings, level/map data, NPC definitions, textures, and UGC moderation queues. Manages LOD asset variants, content versioning in Perforce Helix Core, live-ops content drops (seasonal events, patches, hotfixes), and asset lifecycle from creation to deployment. Distinct from title: title owns the product catalog; content owns the asset and creative deliverable layer.

products.name: asset
products.description: Master record for every digital asset in the game content pipeline — art, audio, texture, mesh, animation, shader, VFX, UI element, video, and scripted data. Tracks asset name, type, format, file size, resolution/bitrate specs, LOD tier, platform target, engine compatibility (Unity/Unreal), creation date, author, current lifecycle status (draft, review, approved, deprecated), Perforce depot path, content hash for integrity verification, classification tags (genre, art style, feature area, platform, sensitivity), audio-specific metadata (sample rate, bit depth, channel config, middleware format like Wwise/FMOD), supported locale list, and locale-specific variant flags. This is the authoritative SSOT for all creative deliverables managed in Perforce Helix Core, including locale reference data for asset-level localization targeting.
products.reference: Digital Asset Management (DAM) — Perforce Helix Core Asset Record

attributes.name: localization_languages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of language codes (ISO 639-1) for which localization strings are included in this bundle (e.g., 'en,es,fr,de,ja,zh').

attributes.name: lod_variant_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Level of Detail (LOD) Variant Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bundle includes multiple LOD (Level of Detail) variants of assets for performance optimization across different hardware tiers.

attributes.name: manifest_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the bundle manifest file, used for integrity verification and version control in Perforce Helix Core and distribution systems.

attributes.name: minimum_engine_version
attributes.description: Minimum version of the game engine (Unity, Unreal Engine, or proprietary) required to load and run this asset bundle. Ensures compatibility with the game client.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset bundle record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, release notes, known issues, or special instructions related to this asset bundle. Used for internal communication and documentation.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority for this bundle release: critical (urgent hotfix), high (major patch or DLC), medium (seasonal event), low (minor update). Used for resource allocation and scheduling.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset bundle was published to production CDN and made available to players. Null if not yet published.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when the asset bundle was or will be released to players. Used for live operations (live-ops) scheduling and content roadmap planning.

attributes.name: requires_player_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether downloading this bundle requires explicit player consent due to size, data usage, or content nature. Aligns with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) requirements.

attributes.name: target_platform
attributes.description: Platform(s) this bundle is built for, pipe-separated if multi-platform (e.g., 'PC', 'PlayStation 5', 'Xbox Series X|S', 'Nintendo Switch', 'iOS', 'Android'). Aligns with first-party console manufacturer and mobile platform requirements.

attributes.name: ugc_content_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bundle includes UGC (User-Generated Content) that has passed moderation review. Important for content policy compliance and community management.

attributes.name: uncompressed_size_mb
attributes.description: Total size of the asset bundle in megabytes after decompression on the player's device, used for storage requirement planning.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the asset bundle (e.g., '1.5.3', '2.0.0') used for tracking iterations and compatibility in Perforce Helix Core and CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines.

products.name: lod_variant
products.description: Level-of-Detail (LOD) variant record for a parent asset, defining the specific geometry, texture resolution, or audio bitrate tier used at a given rendering distance or device performance tier. Captures LOD level index (LOD0–LOD5), polygon count or texture resolution, target platform performance tier (high/medium/low), file size, generation method (manual/auto-generated), and quality validation status. Critical for optimizing game performance across console, PC, and mobile hardware tiers.
products.reference: LOD (Level of Detail) — Unity/Unreal LOD Group

attributes.name: lod_variant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the LOD variant record. Primary key.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game development studio that owns and maintains this LOD variant. Supports multi-studio asset governance.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title this LOD variant is associated with. Supports cross-title asset reuse tracking and licensing.

attributes.name: parent_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent asset for which this LOD variant is defined. Links to the master asset record in the content domain.

attributes.name: source_asset_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset_version. Business justification: LOD variants are generated from a specific source asset version (the high-res master). Currently lod_variant has parent_asset_id (asset-level) but no version-level FK. Adding source_asset_version_id e

attributes.name: audio_bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Audio bitrate in kilobits per second for audio LOD variants. Null for non-audio assets. Higher bitrate means better quality but larger file size.
attributes.references: Unity Audio Clip Settings, Unreal Engine Sound Wave

attributes.name: checksum_hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 or MD5 hash of the LOD variant asset file. Used for integrity verification, duplicate detection, and CDN cache validation.

attributes.name: compression_method
attributes.description: Compression algorithm applied to this LOD variant (e.g., 'DXT5', 'BC7', 'ASTC', 'Vorbis', 'None'). Affects runtime decompression performance and memory usage.
attributes.references: Unity Texture Compression, Unreal Engine Compression Settings

attributes.name: content_rating_impact
attributes.description: Indicates if this LOD variant contains content that affects ESRB, PEGI, or other content rating classifications. Used for compliance and regional variant management.
attributes.references: ESRB Content Descriptors, PEGI Content Descriptors

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this LOD variant record was first created. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports asset lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: deployment_status
attributes.description: Current deployment lifecycle status of this LOD variant. Deployed variants are live in production builds; deprecated variants are scheduled for removal.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: File format of the LOD variant asset (e.g., 'FBX', 'OBJ', 'PNG', 'DDS', 'WAV', 'OGG'). Determines compatibility with game engine import pipeline.
attributes.references: Unity Supported Formats, Unreal Engine Import Pipeline

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the LOD variant asset file in bytes. Used for download size estimation, CDN bandwidth planning, and platform certification compliance (e.g., console TRC/TCR size limits).

attributes.name: first_deployed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this LOD variant was first deployed to a production build. Null if never deployed. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: generation_method
attributes.description: Method used to create this LOD variant. Manual indicates artist-created; auto-generated indicates engine or tool-generated decimation; procedural indicates runtime generation.
attributes.references: Unity Mesh Simplification, Unreal Engine Automatic LOD Generation

attributes.name: generation_tool
attributes.description: Name and version of the tool used to generate this LOD variant (e.g., 'Simplygon 9.1', 'Unity LOD Generator 2021.3', 'Manual in Blender 3.4'). Supports asset pipeline traceability.

attributes.name: has_collision_mesh
attributes.description: Indicates whether this LOD variant includes a simplified collision mesh for physics calculations. Null for non-geometry assets.
attributes.references: Unity Mesh Collider, Unreal Engine Collision Mesh

attributes.name: is_streaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this LOD variant supports runtime streaming (progressive loading). Used for large open-world games to manage memory.
attributes.references: Unity Addressables, Unreal Engine World Partition

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this LOD variant record was last modified. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: license_restriction
attributes.description: Any third-party licensing restrictions or intellectual property constraints on this LOD variant (e.g., 'Licensed from XYZ Corp', 'Internal Use Only', 'Royalty-Free'). Confidential business information.

attributes.name: localization_variant
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code or region code if this LOD variant is specific to a localization (e.g., 'en-US', 'ja-JP', 'de-DE'). Null for language-agnostic assets.

attributes.name: lod_level_index
attributes.description: The LOD tier index (0-5) where LOD0 is highest quality and LOD5 is lowest quality. Used by the rendering engine to select the appropriate variant based on camera distance or device performance.
attributes.references: Unity LOD Group, Unreal Engine HLOD

attributes.name: material_count
attributes.description: Number of unique materials applied to this LOD variant. Null for non-geometry assets. Affects draw call count and rendering performance.
attributes.references: Unity Material System, Unreal Engine Materials

attributes.name: memory_footprint_mb
attributes.description: Estimated runtime memory footprint of this LOD variant in megabytes when loaded into GPU or system memory. Critical for platform memory budget compliance.

attributes.name: perforce_changelist
attributes.description: Perforce changelist number at which this LOD variant was last modified. Supports asset versioning and rollback.

attributes.name: perforce_path
attributes.description: Full depot path in Perforce Helix Core where this LOD variant asset file is stored (e.g., '//depot/GameAssets/Characters/Hero/LOD1/hero_lod1.fbx'). Enables version control integration.

attributes.name: platform_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of this LOD variant in platform-specific certification processes (e.g., console TRC/TCR compliance). Passed status is required for release.
attributes.references: Console TRC/TCR, Apple App Store Review Guidelines, Google Play Developer Policies

attributes.name: polygon_count
attributes.description: Number of polygons (triangles) in this geometry LOD variant. Null for non-geometry assets. Critical metric for rendering performance optimization.
attributes.references: Unity Mesh API, Unreal Engine Static Mesh

attributes.name: quality_validation_status
attributes.description: Current quality assurance status of this LOD variant. Approved variants are eligible for deployment; rejected variants require rework.

attributes.name: rendering_distance_max_meters
attributes.description: Maximum camera distance in meters at which this LOD variant should be used. Beyond this distance, the next lower LOD or culling applies. Null if distance-based LOD is not applicable.
attributes.references: Unity LOD Group, Unreal Engine HLOD

attributes.name: rendering_distance_min_meters
attributes.description: Minimum camera distance in meters at which this LOD variant should be used. Null if distance-based LOD is not applicable. Used by LOD Group components in game engines.
attributes.references: Unity LOD Group, Unreal Engine HLOD

attributes.name: target_fps_impact
attributes.description: Estimated impact of this LOD variant on target frame rate performance. Used by technical artists to balance visual quality and performance.

attributes.name: target_platform_tier
attributes.description: The device or platform performance tier this LOD variant is optimized for. Guides runtime LOD selection based on detected hardware capabilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: high|medium|low|mobile|console|pc|vr — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Unity Quality Settings, Unreal Engine Scalability Settings

attributes.name: texture_resolution
attributes.description: Resolution of the texture in pixels (e.g., '2048x2048', '1024x1024', '512x512'). Null for non-texture assets. Affects memory footprint and visual quality.
attributes.references: Unity Texture Import Settings, Unreal Engine Texture Properties

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of times this LOD variant is referenced across all game levels, scenes, and prefabs. Used for impact analysis before deprecation or modification.

attributes.name: uv_channel_count
attributes.description: Number of UV texture coordinate channels in this geometry LOD variant. Null for non-geometry assets. Supports multi-texture workflows (diffuse, lightmap, detail).
attributes.references: Unity Mesh UV Channels, Unreal Engine UV Channels

attributes.name: validated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the QA engineer or technical artist who validated this LOD variant. Supports accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: validated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this LOD variant was validated. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Quality assurance notes from the validation process. Captures issues found, approval rationale, or rework instructions.

attributes.name: variant_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this LOD variant (e.g., 'High_Detail', 'Mobile_Low', 'Console_Medium'). Used for identification in asset pipeline tools and Perforce Helix Core.

attributes.name: vertex_count
attributes.description: Number of vertices in this geometry LOD variant. Null for non-geometry assets. Complements polygon count for performance profiling.
attributes.references: Unity Mesh API, Unreal Engine Static Mesh

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the technical artist, engineer, or automated process that created this LOD variant. Supports accountability and audit trail.

products.name: localization_string
products.description: Master record for every localizable text string used in-game — UI labels, dialogue, subtitles, tutorial text, NPC speech, achievement descriptions, and store copy. Stores string key, source language text, character limit, context notes for translators, string category (UI, narrative, marketing), game title reference, feature area, and current translation status per locale. The authoritative SSOT for all in-game text content managed across the localization pipeline.

attributes.name: localization_string_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the localization string record. Primary key.

attributes.name: audio_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: Localization strings with voice-over (audio_vo_required = true) reference an audio asset. This FK links the string to its recorded VO asset, enabling asset lifecycle tracking and referential integrity

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Localization workflow management requires tracking string authorship for content ownership, approval routing, and performance attribution. Critical for multi-language game releases and localization pr

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title that this localization string belongs to. Links to the game title master record.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Strings must comply with jurisdiction-specific content laws (China censorship, Germany violence restrictions). Localization QA validates jurisdiction compliance before deployment; this link enables co

attributes.name: music_sync_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.music_sync_license. Business justification: Subtitle and lyric strings for licensed music tracks must link to sync licenses to verify territory and platform usage rights, validate content rating impacts, and ensure compliance with PRO clearance

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the localization manager or lead who approved this string for final use. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this string was approved for final use. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: audio_vo_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this string requires voice-over audio recording for localization. True for dialogue and narrative strings; false for UI labels and system messages.

attributes.name: character_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of characters allowed for this string to fit within UI constraints or subtitle timing. Null if no limit applies.

attributes.name: content_warning_flags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of content warning categories applicable to this string (e.g., 'violence,profanity,drug_reference'). Used for age rating and content filtering.

attributes.name: context_notes
attributes.description: Contextual information for translators describing where and how the string is used in the game (e.g., 'Button label on main menu', 'NPC greeting when player enters village').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this localization string record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deployment_date
attributes.description: Date when this string was deployed to production. Null if not yet deployed.

attributes.name: deployment_status
attributes.description: Current deployment lifecycle status: draft (in development), staged (ready for deployment), deployed (live in production), archived (deprecated and removed from active use).

attributes.name: deprecation_date
attributes.description: Date when this string was marked as deprecated and scheduled for removal. Null if still active.

attributes.name: esrb_rating_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) Rating Impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether this string contains content that may impact the game's ESRB rating (profanity, violence references, sexual content). Used for content compliance review.

attributes.name: feature_area
attributes.description: The specific game feature or module this string belongs to (e.g., 'Main Menu', 'Combat System', 'Inventory', 'Quest Log'). Used for organizing and filtering strings by game area.

attributes.name: gender_variant_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this string requires gender-specific variants for languages with grammatical gender (e.g., French, Spanish, German).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this string is currently active and available for use in the game (true) or has been deprecated/archived (false).

attributes.name: is_placeholder
attributes.description: Indicates whether this string is a temporary placeholder (true) or final content (false). Placeholder strings are used during development and must be replaced before release.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this string.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this localization string record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments about this string for internal team reference.

attributes.name: pegi_rating_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pan European Game Information (PEGI) Rating Impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether this string contains content that may impact the game's PEGI rating. Used for European market compliance.

attributes.name: perforce_changelist
attributes.description: Perforce changelist number associated with the most recent update to this string. Used for tracking version history and rollback.

attributes.name: perforce_path
attributes.description: File path in Perforce Helix Core version control system where this string is stored (e.g., //depot/GameTitle/Localization/Strings/UI/MainMenu.json).

attributes.name: plural_variant_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this string requires plural form variants for languages with complex plural rules (e.g., Russian, Arabic, Polish).

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Translation priority level indicating urgency and importance. Critical strings are required for core gameplay; low priority strings may be deferred to post-launch updates.

attributes.name: source_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (with optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code) for the original language of the string (e.g., en, en-US, ja-JP).

attributes.name: source_text
attributes.description: The original text content in the source language. This is the master text from which all translations are derived.

attributes.name: string_category
attributes.description: Classification of the string by functional area: UI (user interface labels), narrative (dialogue and story text), marketing (promotional copy), tutorial (instructional text), system (technical messages), achievement (achievement descriptions), store (in-game store copy), error (error messages). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ui|narrative|marketing|tutorial|system|achievement|store|error — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: string_key
attributes.description: Unique programmatic identifier for the string used by the game engine to reference this text. Typically uppercase with underscores (e.g., UI_BUTTON_START, NPC_DIALOGUE_GREETING_01).
attributes.references: Unity Localization Package, Unreal Engine Localization Dashboard

attributes.name: subtitle_timing_end
attributes.description: End time in seconds for subtitle display when this string is used as a subtitle. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: subtitle_timing_start
attributes.description: Start time in seconds for subtitle display when this string is used as a subtitle. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: supports_rich_text
attributes.description: Indicates whether this string supports rich text formatting (bold, italic, color tags) as defined by the game engine's text rendering system.
attributes.references: Unity TextMeshPro, Unreal Engine Rich Text

attributes.name: supports_variables
attributes.description: Indicates whether this string contains dynamic variables or placeholders that are replaced at runtime (e.g., {player_name}, {item_count}).

attributes.name: translation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the string in the localization workflow: not_started (no translation work begun), in_progress (being translated), translated (initial translation complete), reviewed (reviewed by linguist), approved (approved for use), rejected (needs rework), final (locked for release). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|in_progress|translated|reviewed|approved|rejected|final — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variable_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of variable names used in this string (e.g., 'player_name,item_count,gold_amount'). Null if no variables are present.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of this string (e.g., 1.0.0, 2.1.3). Incremented when the source text or translations are updated. Supports content versioning in Perforce Helix Core.

products.name: localization_translation
products.description: Translation record linking a localization string to a specific locale, capturing the translated text, translator identity (internal team or vendor), translation date, review status (pending, reviewed, approved, rejected), reviewer identity, QA flag, character count, and machine-translation flag. Supports multi-locale game releases across PEGI, ESRB, CERO, and GRAC regions. One record per string-locale pair, enabling per-locale translation workflow tracking.

attributes.name: localization_translation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the localization translation record. Primary key for the translation entity.

attributes.name: audio_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: Localization translations (locale-specific) may reference recorded audio assets for voice-over in that language. This FK links the translation to its recorded VO asset, enabling asset lifecycle tracki

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Localization translations are versioned and deployed as part of content releases. One translation is deployed in ONE content release; one content release contains MANY translations. This FK enables tr

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Translations are jurisdiction-specific deliverables; each locale maps to regulatory territory. Translation vendors deliver per-jurisdiction compliance; this link supports regulatory audit of localized

attributes.name: localization_string_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source localization string being translated. Links to the master string definition in the content management system.

attributes.name: music_sync_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.music_sync_license. Business justification: Translated lyrics and subtitles for licensed music require sync license validation per locale to confirm translation rights, territory restrictions, and cultural adaptation permissions mandated by mus

attributes.name: translator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: When translations are performed in-house (translator_type='internal'), linking to employee enables cost allocation to projects, performance tracking, and workload management. Essential for internal lo

attributes.name: character_count
attributes.description: Total number of characters in the translated text. Used for translation billing, UI layout validation, and quality assurance checks to ensure text fits within UI constraints.

attributes.name: context_notes
attributes.description: Additional context provided to translators about where and how this string is used in-game (e.g., UI button, NPC dialogue, tutorial text). Helps ensure accurate and contextually appropriate translation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this translation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and translation workflow analytics.

attributes.name: cultural_adaptation_notes
attributes.description: Documentation of cultural localization decisions made for this translation, such as idiom adaptation, humor localization, or culturally sensitive content modifications to meet regional standards (ESRB, PEGI, CERO, GRAC).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this translation version becomes active in production. Supports scheduled content drops, seasonal events, and live-ops patch deployment.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this translation version is retired or replaced. Nullable for evergreen content. Used for time-limited events and seasonal content lifecycle management.

attributes.name: glossary_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the translation adheres to the game-specific terminology glossary and style guide. True indicates compliance with brand and terminology standards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this translation record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code combined with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., en_US, ja_JP, de_DE, fr_FR, es_MX, pt_BR, ko_KR, zh_CN). Identifies the target locale for this translation.

attributes.name: machine_translation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this translation was generated by machine translation (MT) engine. True indicates machine-generated content that may require human post-editing.

attributes.name: platform_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of this translation in platform-specific certification processes (TRC/TCR for console manufacturers). Tracks compliance with first-party platform localization requirements.

attributes.name: qa_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator for translations requiring additional quality assurance attention due to complexity, cultural sensitivity, or previous issues. True indicates QA escalation needed.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for why a translation was rejected during QA review. Nullable for approved translations. Used for translator feedback and quality improvement.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the translation review was completed. Nullable for translations that have not yet been reviewed.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current state of the translation in the quality assurance workflow. Tracks progression from initial submission through review to final approval or rejection.

attributes.name: reviewer_identity
attributes.description: Identifier of the QA (Quality Assurance) reviewer or linguistic expert who evaluated this translation. Nullable until review is assigned.

attributes.name: revision_count
attributes.description: Number of times this translation has been revised and resubmitted. Used to track translation complexity and identify problematic strings requiring additional localization guidance.

attributes.name: source_text_hash
attributes.description: Hash of the original source string at the time of translation. Used to detect when source content has changed and translation needs updating.

attributes.name: translated_text
attributes.description: The translated string content in the target locale. Contains the localized text that will be displayed to players in-game or in platform interfaces.

attributes.name: translation_cost
attributes.description: Cost incurred for this translation in USD. Used for vendor billing, budget tracking, and localization ROI (Return on Investment) analysis. Nullable for internal or community translations.

attributes.name: translation_date
attributes.description: Date when the translation was completed and submitted. Used for tracking translation velocity and vendor SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

attributes.name: translation_memory_match_score
attributes.description: Percentage match score from translation memory system (0-100). Indicates how closely this translation matched existing approved translations. Used for cost optimization and consistency.

attributes.name: translator_identity
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual translator, vendor company name, or machine translation service that produced this translation. Used for quality tracking and vendor performance analysis.

attributes.name: translator_type
attributes.description: Classification of the translation source: internal localization team, external vendor agency, machine translation engine, community contributor, or hybrid (machine + human review).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this translation. Increments with each approved revision. Supports content versioning in Perforce Helix Core and live-ops content update tracking.

attributes.name: word_count
attributes.description: Total number of words in the translated text. Used for translation billing (many vendors charge per word), workload estimation, and linguistic complexity analysis.

products.name: level_map
products.description: Master record for each game level, map, zone, or world area representing a discrete playable space. Captures level name, level type (tutorial, PvP arena, PvE dungeon, open world, hub, lobby), game mode compatibility, target player count, estimated play duration, geometry complexity tier, streaming strategy (full load vs. streaming chunks), lighting model, physics configuration, navmesh complexity, associated asset bundles, and current build status (blockout, art-pass, optimization, gold). Owned by the content domain as the authoritative creative deliverable definition; distinct from game mode configuration owned by platform/title domains.
products.reference: Level / Map / Zone — Unreal World Partition / Unity Scene

attributes.name: level_map_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the level, map, zone, or world area. Primary key.

attributes.name: age_rating_cert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.age_rating_cert. Business justification: Levels are evaluated holistically for rating (violence density, fear elements). Rating submission includes level walkthroughs; this link tracks which certification covers each map for platform deploym

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Game levels and maps are released as part of content drops (new zones for DLC, seasonal event maps, expansion areas). This FK links the level to its release event. N:1 cardinality - many levels can be

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Level designers must be tracked for attribution in credits, performance reviews, IP rights documentation, and portfolio building. Essential for game development project management and talent recogniti

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Level maps using licensed middleware (Havok physics, Wwise audio) or brand partnerships (real-world locations, sponsored venues) must track IP dependencies for platform certification submissions, roya

attributes.name: perforce_changelist_id
attributes.description: Perforce Helix Core changelist identifier for the current version of this level, enabling traceability to source control commits.

attributes.name: accessibility_features
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of accessibility features implemented in this level (e.g., 'colorblind_mode,subtitle_support,reduced_motion,audio_cues').

attributes.name: asset_bundle_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of asset bundle identifiers required for this level (textures, models, audio, effects). References to packaged content in the asset pipeline.

attributes.name: audio_ambience_profile
attributes.description: Identifier for the audio ambience profile used in this level (e.g., 'forest_day', 'urban_night', 'dungeon_echo'). References audio asset configuration.

attributes.name: build_status
attributes.description: Current production status of the level: blockout (initial layout/greybox), art_pass (art assets applied), optimization (performance tuning), gold (production-ready), deprecated (no longer in use).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this level record was first created in the content management system.

attributes.name: day_night_cycle_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the level supports a dynamic day-night cycle affecting lighting and gameplay.

attributes.name: deprecated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this level was deprecated or removed from active rotation. Null if still active.

attributes.name: difficulty_rating
attributes.description: Designed difficulty level of the level: easy (beginner-friendly), normal (standard challenge), hard (experienced players), expert (advanced), nightmare (maximum difficulty).

attributes.name: estimated_play_duration_minutes

products.name: content_release
products.description: Unified live-ops content release record representing any scheduled or emergency delivery of new or updated content to live players. Covers all release types via type discrimination: seasonal events (with event theme, start/end timestamps, recurrence pattern, featured bundles, exclusive rewards, participation mechanics, eligibility rules), patches and hotfixes (with semver version string, patch type, mandatory flag, minimum client version, per-platform size, QA sign-off, gold master date, TRC/TCR certification status), battle pass seasons, DLC drops, and limited-time events. Also serves as the release calendar, capturing planned vs actual release dates, release window (soft/hard), marketing campaign alignment, and cross-functional approval status. Stores drop name, release type, scheduled go-live timestamp, actual go-live timestamp, rollback timestamp, target platforms, associated asset bundles, release notes reference, live-ops owner, and deployment status. The single operational heartbeat of GaaS content delivery — one entity to answer 'what is going live, when, and what does it contain'.

attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic region codes where this deployment was pushed (e.g., NAM, EUR, APAC, LATAM). Used for geo-specific content rollouts.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times the deployment was retried after initial failure before succeeding or being abandoned.

attributes.name: rollback_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deployment was subsequently rolled back due to issues (True) or remains active (False).

attributes.name: rollback_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or technical reason for rolling back the deployment (e.g., critical bug, performance degradation, player complaints).

attributes.name: rollback_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the deployment was rolled back, if applicable. Null if no rollback occurred.

attributes.name: target_environment
attributes.description: The environment to which the content is being deployed: dev (development), qa (quality assurance), uat (user acceptance testing), staging (pre-production), production (live), or live (player-facing).

attributes.name: target_platform_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platform codes targeted by this deployment (e.g., PC, PS5, XBOX, IOS, ANDROID, SWITCH). Represents the platforms receiving this content drop.
attributes.references: Platform certification standards (TRC/TCR - Technical Requirements Checklist/Technical Certification Requirements)

attributes.name: window_end
attributes.description: The scheduled end time of the deployment maintenance window.

attributes.name: window_start
attributes.description: The scheduled start time of the deployment maintenance window.

products.name: asset_dependency
products.description: Directed dependency record between two assets capturing the relationship type (references, requires, overrides, variant-of) used by the build pipeline to resolve asset graphs, detect missing references, and compute incremental build scopes. Stores source asset, target asset, dependency type, dependency strength (hard/soft), discovery method (static analysis, manual declaration), and validation status. Critical for build integrity checks and platform-specific asset stripping during packaging.

attributes.name: asset_dependency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset dependency record. Primary key.

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Reference to the content release or live-ops content drop that introduced or modified this dependency. Used to track dependency changes across seasonal events, patches, and hotfixes.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the studio responsible for managing this dependency relationship. Used for organizational reporting and access control.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title that owns both the source and target assets. Used to scope dependency analysis to specific titles in multi-game studios.

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Dependency graphs must track licensed middleware and IP to calculate royalty obligations (per-seat, per-title, revenue-share), validate sublicensing permissions, and enforce build-time compliance with

attributes.name: perforce_changelist_id
attributes.description: The Perforce Helix Core changelist number that introduced or last modified this dependency relationship. Used for version control traceability.

attributes.name: primary_asset_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that created this dependency record. May be a developer username, automated tool identifier, or system process name.

attributes.name: source_asset_id
attributes.description: The asset that declares or originates the dependency relationship. This is the dependent asset that requires or references the target asset.

attributes.name: target_asset_id
attributes.description: The asset that is being depended upon. This is the asset that the source asset requires, references, or overrides.

attributes.name: asset_bundle_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether both source and target assets must be included in the same asset bundle for runtime resolution. If true, the build pipeline ensures co-location.

attributes.name: build_order_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority used by the build pipeline to determine asset compilation order. Lower numbers are built first. Used to resolve dependency graphs and ensure targets are built before sources.

attributes.name: circular_dependency_chain
attributes.description: If validation_status is circular, this field contains the chain of asset IDs forming the dependency loop (e.g., A->B->C->A). Used for debugging circular reference issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dependency record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dependency_path
attributes.description: The file system or depot path expression that defines how the source asset references the target. May include relative paths, symbolic references, or Perforce depot paths.

attributes.name: dependency_strength
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependency is hard (required for build success) or soft (optional, build can proceed without it). Hard dependencies block builds if missing; soft dependencies generate warnings.

attributes.name: dependency_type
attributes.description: The nature of the dependency relationship between source and target assets. Defines how the source asset relates to the target asset in the build pipeline.

attributes.name: deprecated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency has been marked as deprecated and should be removed in future builds. Used to track technical debt and plan refactoring.

attributes.name: deprecated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dependency was marked as deprecated. Null if not deprecated.

attributes.name: discovered_by_tool
attributes.description: The name and version of the tool or system that discovered this dependency (e.g., Unity Asset Analyzer 2.1, Unreal Header Tool 5.3, Custom Dependency Scanner).

attributes.name: discovery_method
attributes.description: The method by which this dependency was identified. Static analysis scans code/assets automatically; manual declaration is explicitly defined by developers; runtime scan detects dependencies during execution.

attributes.name: incremental_build_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency participates in incremental build scope computation. If true, changes to the target asset will trigger rebuild of the source asset.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency is currently active and should be enforced by the build pipeline. Inactive dependencies are retained for historical tracking but not validated.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dependency record was last modified.

attributes.name: last_validated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dependency was last validated by the build pipeline or asset integrity checker.

attributes.name: lod_tier
attributes.description: The LOD tier for which this dependency applies, if lod_variant_dependency_flag is true. Used for platform-specific asset stripping during packaging.

attributes.name: lod_variant_dependency_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Level of Detail (LOD) Variant Dependency Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency is specific to a particular LOD (Level of Detail) variant. If true, the dependency applies only to specific quality tiers and may be stripped for lower-tier builds.

attributes.name: memory_impact_mb
attributes.description: Estimated memory footprint in megabytes when both source and target assets are loaded simultaneously. Used for memory budget planning and optimization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, technical notes, or special handling instructions related to this dependency. Used by developers and build engineers for documentation.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: If dependency_type is overrides, this field explains why the source asset overrides the target asset. Common reasons include platform-specific customization, localization variants, or performance optimization.

attributes.name: platform_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency is platform-specific (true) or applies across all platforms (false). Platform-specific dependencies are used for conditional asset stripping during packaging.

attributes.name: runtime_load_order
attributes.description: Specifies the order in which assets should be loaded at runtime to satisfy this dependency. Lower numbers load first. Used by streaming systems and level loading.

attributes.name: target_platform_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platform codes for which this dependency applies (e.g., PC, PS5, XBOX, IOS, ANDROID). Empty if dependency applies to all platforms.

attributes.name: validation_error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message if validation_status is invalid, missing-target, circular, or unresolved. Provides diagnostic information for build failures.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current validation state of the dependency. Valid means target exists and is accessible; invalid indicates broken reference; missing-target means target asset not found; circular indicates dependency loop detected.

attributes.name: version_constraint
attributes.description: Specifies version requirements for the target asset (e.g., >=2.0, ==1.5.3, ~>3.0). Used to ensure compatibility between dependent assets across versions.

attributes.name: parent_asset_dependency_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on asset_dependency (parent_asset_dependency_id)

products.name: content_pack
products.description: Master reference table for content_pack. Referenced by content_pack_id.

attributes.name: content_pack_id
attributes.description: Primary key for content_pack

attributes.name: approval_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this content pack for deployment. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or content creator who authored this content pack.

attributes.name: title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title this content pack is associated with.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the content pack was approved for deployment. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: archive_date
attributes.description: Date when the content pack was archived and moved to long-term storage. Null for active or deprecated content packs.

attributes.name: asset_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual digital assets contained within this content pack.

attributes.name: checksum_hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 checksum hash of the content pack for integrity verification during download and deployment.

attributes.name: compression_algorithm
attributes.description: Compression algorithm applied to the content pack for storage and distribution optimization.

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) content rating applicable to this content pack: E (Everyone), E10+ (Everyone 10+), T (Teen), M (Mature), AO (Adults Only).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the content pack record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dependency_pack_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of content pack IDs that this pack depends on for proper functionality. Null if no dependencies exist.

attributes.name: deployment_environment
attributes.description: Target deployment environment for this content pack: development, staging, production, or live-ops.

attributes.name: deployment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the content pack was deployed to the target environment. Null if not yet deployed.

attributes.name: deprecation_date
attributes.description: Date when the content pack was marked as deprecated and scheduled for removal. Null for active content packs.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the content pack purpose, contents, and usage notes for content teams and developers.

attributes.name: download_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this content pack has been downloaded by players or deployed to game clients.

attributes.name: error_report_count
attributes.description: Total number of error reports or bug reports associated with this content pack since deployment.

attributes.name: event_end_date
attributes.description: End date for live-ops event content availability, if applicable. Null for non-event or permanent content packs.

attributes.name: event_start_date
attributes.description: Start date for live-ops event content availability, if applicable. Null for non-event content packs.

attributes.name: live_ops_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this content pack is part of a live-ops event such as seasonal content, limited-time events, or special promotions.

attributes.name: localization_language_count
attributes.description: Number of languages supported in this content pack for localization strings and audio.

attributes.name: lod_variant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this content pack includes multiple LOD (Level of Detail) asset variants for performance optimization.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the content pack record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: pack_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the content pack, used in game manifests and deployment pipelines.

attributes.name: pack_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the content pack displayed to developers and content teams.

attributes.name: pack_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the content pack in the asset pipeline workflow.

attributes.name: pack_type
attributes.description: Classification of the content pack by asset category: art assets, audio files, localization strings, level/map data, NPC definitions, or textures.

attributes.name: patch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the content pack by deployment type: major patch, minor patch, hotfix, content drop, or expansion.

attributes.name: perforce_changelist_number
attributes.description: Perforce Helix Core changelist number tracking the version control commit for this content pack.

attributes.name: platform_target
attributes.description: Target gaming platform for which this content pack is optimized: console, PC, mobile, or cross-platform.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_status
attributes.description: Current quality assurance testing status of the content pack.

attributes.name: release_notes
attributes.description: Release notes documenting changes, new features, bug fixes, and known issues for this content pack version.

attributes.name: total_size_mb
attributes.description: Total storage size of the content pack in megabytes, including all assets and metadata.

attributes.name: ugc_moderation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this content pack contains user-generated content requiring moderation review before deployment.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the content pack following major.minor.patch convention.

attributes.name: parent_content_pack_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on content_pack (parent_content_pack_id)

domains.name: community
domains.description: Manages player community engagement including forums, UGC submissions, social features, guilds/clans, player-reported content moderation, player support ticketing (Zendesk), knowledge bases, chat support, NPS/CSAT tracking, K-Factor viral coefficient data, and player feedback channels. SSOT for community health, player satisfaction, and player care operations.

products.name: forum
products.description: Master entity representing community discussion forums and sub-forums within the gaming platform. Tracks forum identity, category, game title association, moderation settings, posting rules, visibility (public/private/members-only), language locale, post count, subscriber count, and active status. SSOT for all community forum structures across titles and platforms.

attributes.name: forum_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each community forum or sub-forum entity within the gaming platform. Primary key for all forum-related data products.

attributes.name: developer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.developer_account. Business justification: Developer accounts manage official forums for their titles. Community managers need to link forum moderation permissions, content policy enforcement, and developer portal access to developer accounts.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title this forum is associated with. Enables forum analytics to be segmented by game title for community health reporting.

attributes.name: parent_forum_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent forum when this record represents a sub-forum. Null for top-level forums. Supports hierarchical forum structures.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gaming platform (e.g., PC, console, mobile) this forum is scoped to. Supports platform-specific community segmentation.

attributes.name: allows_attachments
attributes.description: Indicates whether players are permitted to attach files, images, or media to posts in this forum. Relevant for UGC (User-Generated Content) forums and bug report forums requiring screenshots.
attributes.references: Internal Community Management Standard; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: allows_ugc_submissions
attributes.business_glossary_term: Forum Allows User-Generated Content (UGC) Submissions Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forum accepts formal User-Generated Content (UGC) submissions such as mods, maps, or fan art. Distinct from general attachments; triggers UGC review workflows.
attributes.references: Internal UGC Policy; IGDA Community Standards; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: archived_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forum was transitioned to 'archived' status. Null if the forum has never been archived. Supports community lifecycle management and data retention compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); ISO/IEC 27001; Internal Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: auto_lock_days_inactive
attributes.description: Number of days of inactivity after which threads in this forum are automatically locked. Null means threads never auto-lock. Supports community hygiene and moderation efficiency.

attributes.name: banner_image_url
attributes.description: URL to the forum's banner or header image asset hosted on the CDN (Content Delivery Network). Used for visual branding of the forum on the community portal.

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Content rating assigned to this forum based on the nature of discussions permitted, aligned with ESRB and PEGI rating systems. Determines age-gating and parental control enforcement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: E|E10+|T|M|AO|RP|PEGI_3|PEGI_7|PEGI_12|PEGI_16|PEGI_18 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board); PEGI (Pan European Game Information); USK; CERO; GRAC

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary geographic market this forum serves. Used for regional compliance (GDPR, COPPA) and localized community management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Supervisory Authorities; COPPA (FTC)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forum record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and community lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) for this forum, typically on a 1–5 scale, aggregated from player feedback. Tracks community satisfaction as part of player care operations.
attributes.references: Internal CSAT Measurement Standard; Zendesk Integration

attributes.name: dau
attributes.description: Count of unique players who engaged with this forum (viewed, posted, or reacted) on the most recent calendar day. Key community health KPI (Key Performance Indicator) aligned with platform-wide DAU tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Community Analytics Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Integration

attributes.name: depth_level
attributes.description: Integer indicating the nesting depth of this forum in the hierarchy. Level 0 is a top-level forum; level 1 is a direct sub-forum; higher values indicate deeper nesting.

attributes.name: forum_category
attributes.description: Logical grouping category for the forum used to organize forums in the community portal (e.g., 'Game Discussion', 'Technical Support', 'Esports', 'Off-Topic', 'Announcements', 'UGC Showcase'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: game_discussion|technical_support|esports|announcements|ugc_showcase|off_topic|bug_reports|feedback — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: forum_description
attributes.description: Short descriptive text explaining the purpose, scope, and posting guidelines of the forum. Displayed to players on the forum landing page.

attributes.name: forum_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the forum or sub-forum as shown to players on the community platform (e.g., 'General Discussion', 'Bug Reports', 'Esports Strategy').

attributes.name: forum_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the forum. 'active' is open for posting; 'inactive' is temporarily disabled; 'archived' is read-only historical forum; 'locked' prevents new posts but remains visible; 'pending_review' is awaiting moderation approval before going live.

attributes.name: forum_type
attributes.description: Classifies the operational purpose of the forum. 'standard' is general discussion; 'announcement' is read-heavy official news; 'support' maps to Zendesk-integrated player support; 'esports' is for competitive community; 'ugc' is for User-Generated Content (UGC) sharing; 'guild' is for guild/clan community spaces.
attributes.references: Internal Community Management Standard; Zendesk Integration Guidelines

attributes.name: icon_image_url
attributes.description: URL to the forum's icon or thumbnail image asset hosted on the CDN (Content Delivery Network). Used in forum listings and navigation menus.

attributes.name: is_age_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forum requires age verification before access, in compliance with ESRB, PEGI, and COPPA regulations for mature content communities.
attributes.references: ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board); PEGI (Pan European Game Information); COPPA (FTC); USK; CERO; GRAC

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forum is promoted as a featured community space on the platform homepage or community hub. Featured forums receive elevated visibility for player acquisition and retention.

attributes.name: is_pinned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forum is pinned to the top of its category listing. Pinned forums are prioritized in navigation to drive player engagement with key community spaces.

attributes.name: last_post_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent post made in this forum. Used to determine forum activity recency, drive auto-lock logic, and surface active forums in community portal rankings.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language-region code specifying the primary language and locale of the forum (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'ja-JP', 'ko-KR'). Supports multi-language community segmentation and localization.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; PEGI (Pan European Game Information); CERO; GRAC

attributes.name: mau
attributes.description: Count of unique players who engaged with this forum in the most recent 30-day rolling window. Used alongside DAU for community stickiness and engagement ratio analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Community Analytics Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Integration

attributes.name: max_post_length_chars
attributes.description: Maximum character count allowed per post in this forum. Enforces posting rules and prevents spam. Null means no character limit is enforced.

attributes.name: minimum_age_years
attributes.description: Minimum player age in years required to access this forum. Enforced for age-restricted forums per ESRB, PEGI, COPPA, and regional rating body requirements. Null if no age restriction applies.
attributes.references: ESRB; PEGI; COPPA (FTC); USK; CERO; GRAC

attributes.name: moderation_mode
attributes.description: Defines the content moderation approach for this forum. 'pre_moderated' requires approval before posts are visible; 'post_moderated' reviews after publishing; 'auto_moderated' uses automated tools; 'unmoderated' has no active moderation.
attributes.references: FTC (Federal Trade Commission); European Commission Digital Services Act; GDPR Supervisory Authorities; Internal Community Moderation Policy

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) for this forum, ranging from -100 to 100, derived from player satisfaction surveys. Measures community sentiment and likelihood of players recommending the forum to others.
attributes.references: Internal NPS Measurement Standard; Salesforce CRM Integration

attributes.name: post_count
attributes.description: Total cumulative number of posts ever created in this forum. Used as a community health and engagement metric. Updated by the platform's community analytics pipeline.
attributes.references: Internal Community Analytics Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Integration

attributes.name: posting_permission
attributes.description: Defines which player segments are permitted to create new posts in this forum. 'verified_only' requires email-verified accounts; 'moderators_only' restricts to community moderators; 'staff_only' is for official announcements.

attributes.name: requires_account_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether players must have a verified account (email or identity verified) to post in this forum. Supports anti-spam and COPPA compliance for age-gated communities.
attributes.references: COPPA (FTC); GDPR Article 5; Internal Identity Verification Policy

attributes.name: rules_url
attributes.description: URL linking to the official posting rules and community guidelines document for this forum. Displayed to players before posting to ensure compliance with community standards.
attributes.references: FTC (Federal Trade Commission); European Commission Digital Services Act; Internal Community Policy

attributes.name: slug
attributes.description: URL-safe, lowercase hyphenated identifier used in the forum's web address. Ensures stable, human-readable permalinks for SEO and deep-linking purposes.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric display ordering position of the forum within its parent category or parent forum. Lower values appear first in the community portal navigation.

attributes.name: subscriber_count
attributes.description: Total number of players who have subscribed to receive notifications from this forum. Indicates community reach and is used in player retention and K-Factor (Viral Coefficient) analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Community Analytics Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Integration

attributes.name: thread_count
attributes.description: Total cumulative number of discussion threads created in this forum. Distinct from post count; a thread is the parent topic while posts are replies. Key community engagement indicator.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this forum record (e.g., settings change, status update, moderation rule change). Supports audit trail and change data capture in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: visibility
attributes.description: Controls who can view the forum. 'public' is visible to all including unauthenticated visitors; 'private' is hidden from non-members; 'members_only' requires platform account; 'staff_only' is restricted to internal community team.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation); COPPA (FTC); Internal Access Control Policy

attributes.name: zendesk_group_code
attributes.description: External identifier linking this forum to its corresponding Zendesk support group for player support ticket routing. Enables seamless escalation from community forum posts to Zendesk tickets.
attributes.references: Zendesk Integration Guidelines; Internal Player Support SLA Policy

products.name: forum_thread
products.description: Transactional record of forum threads and their constituent posts within community forums. Each record represents either a thread-starting post or a reply within a thread, supporting flat and nested conversation models. Captures post title (for thread starters), body content, author player reference, parent forum reference, parent post reference for threaded replies, post depth level, pinned/locked/featured flags, view count, reply count, upvote/downvote tallies, moderation status, flair/tag labels, edit history flag, reported flag, and timestamps. Atomic unit of community forum discourse. SSOT for all forum conversation content.

attributes.name: forum_thread_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each forum thread or post record within the community forum system. Primary key for the forum_thread data product.

attributes.name: backlog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.backlog_item. Business justification: Community-driven backlog prioritization: high-visibility threads discussing bugs or feature requests spawn backlog items. Community managers link threads to track player sentiment and prioritize work.

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Community sentiment analysis aggregates forum discussion volume and sentiment by content_drop_id to measure release reception and identify issues. Marketing uses this for launch retrospectives and fut

attributes.name: forum_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent forum or sub-forum board in which this thread or post resides. Establishes the community section context (e.g., General Discussion, Bug Reports, Patch Notes).

attributes.name: gacha_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.gacha_pool. Business justification: Gacha pools generate extensive forum discussion (drop rate analysis, pull strategy, complaints about pity system). Community managers track pool-specific sentiment for monetization feedback and to ide

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game title this forum thread is associated with. Enables game-specific community analytics, moderation scoping, and cross-title engagement reporting.

attributes.name: influencer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.influencer. Business justification: Influencers host forum threads for AMAs, announcements, and community engagement as part of marketing partnerships. Direct link enables influencer engagement tracking, contractual deliverable verifica

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
