attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Threads are created for campaign announcements, influencer AMAs, and promotional events. Direct campaign attribution enables measurement of community engagement effectiveness and content performance p

attributes.name: offer_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.offer_campaign. Business justification: Players create forum threads discussing promotional offers (value analysis, eligibility questions, bugs). Community managers track campaign-related discussions for sentiment analysis and to identify o

attributes.name: primary_forum_player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who authored this thread or post. Links to the player master record for identity, account standing, and community reputation context.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.promotion. Business justification: Players discuss promotions in forums (value analysis, code sharing, eligibility bugs). Community managers track promotion-related threads for sentiment, identify configuration issues, and measure prom

attributes.name: seasonal_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.seasonal_event. Business justification: Community engagement metrics track forum activity per seasonal event for event success measurement. Live ops uses thread volume and sentiment to evaluate event reception and inform future event design

attributes.name: thread_root_forum_thread_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating thread-starter post (depth level 0) for all replies within the same conversation. Equals forum_thread_id for root posts. Enables efficient retrieval of all posts within a thread without recursive traversal.

attributes.name: author_display_name
attributes.description: The in-game or forum display name (gamertag/username) of the post author at the time of posting. Stored as a snapshot to preserve historical display context even if the player later changes their display name. Classified as confidential PII as it is a pseudonymous identifier traceable to an individual.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; COPPA; Internal Community Platform Standard

attributes.name: author_post_count_at_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Author Post Count at Time of Posting
attributes.description: Snapshot of the author's total forum post count at the time this post was submitted. Provides community seniority context for moderation decisions and trust-scoring models without requiring a join to current player stats.

attributes.name: body_content
attributes.description: Full text body of the forum post or reply, stored as plain text or lightweight markup (BBCode/Markdown). Primary content payload for community discourse, moderation review, and NLP-based sentiment analysis.

attributes.name: content_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region subtag) of the post body content (e.g., en, en-US, fr, de, ja, ko). Supports multilingual community moderation routing, localization analytics, and GDPR jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: content_rating_category
attributes.description: Community content maturity classification applied to this post, aligned with ESRB/PEGI rating vocabulary. Supports age-gating of forum content, COPPA compliance for underage players, and platform certification requirements.
attributes.references: ESRB Rating Standards; PEGI Rating Standards; COPPA; USK; CERO; GRAC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this forum_thread record was first persisted to the data platform. May differ slightly from post_timestamp due to ingestion latency. Supports data lineage and Silver layer audit requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) value (1–5) optionally collected from the post author following a community support interaction associated with this thread. Supports player care quality measurement and Zendesk integration reporting.
attributes.references: CSAT Methodology; Internal Player Satisfaction KPI Framework; Zendesk Platform Standard

attributes.name: downvote_count
attributes.description: Total number of downvotes (negative reactions) received by this post from community members. Used alongside upvote_count to compute net community sentiment score and content quality signals.

attributes.name: edit_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this post has been edited by the author or a moderator. Supports transparency indicators and moderation audit. High edit counts may signal content manipulation patterns.
attributes.references: Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 17; Internal Community Platform Standard

attributes.name: flair_label
attributes.description: Community-assigned or author-selected flair tag categorizing the thread topic (e.g., Bug Report, Feedback, Guide, Lore, Patch Discussion). Supports forum navigation, filtering, and content taxonomy analytics.

attributes.name: is_deleted
attributes.description: Soft-delete flag indicating the post has been removed from public view by the author or a moderator. Retains the record for audit, compliance, and potential restoration. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure workflows.

attributes.name: is_edited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the post body or title has been edited after initial submission. Displayed to community members as an edit indicator. Supports transparency and moderation audit requirements.
attributes.references: Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 17; Internal Community Platform Standard

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this thread has been editorially featured by community managers for promotional or highlight purposes. Featured threads may appear in community spotlights, newsletters, or homepage widgets.

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this thread has been locked by a moderator, preventing further replies. Locked threads remain visible but are closed to new community contributions. Common for resolved issues or policy-violating discussions.
attributes.references: Internal Community Platform Standard; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: is_pinned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this thread has been pinned to the top of the forum board by a moderator or community manager. Pinned threads receive elevated visibility for important announcements or community resources.

attributes.name: is_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this post has been reported by one or more community members for potential policy violations. Triggers moderation queue entry. Key signal for community health monitoring and trust-and-safety operations.
attributes.references: Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 16; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: is_ugc_submission
attributes.description: Indicates whether this post has been formally tagged as a User-Generated Content (UGC) submission (e.g., fan art showcase, mod announcement, community guide). Enables UGC pipeline routing and IP compliance review workflows.
attributes.references: IGDA Community Standards; Internal IP Compliance Policy; Digital Services Act (DSA)

attributes.name: last_edited_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent edit to this post's body or title content. Displayed to community members as the edit time indicator. Supports content freshness analytics and moderation audit.
attributes.references: Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 17; Internal Community Platform Standard

attributes.name: last_reply_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent reply posted within this thread. Applicable to thread-root posts. Used for thread sorting by recent activity, stale thread detection, and community engagement recency metrics.

attributes.name: moderation_action_type
attributes.description: Type of moderation action applied to this post by a community moderator or automated trust-and-safety system. Supports moderation audit trails, compliance reporting under DSA, and moderator performance analytics.
attributes.references: Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 17; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Internal Trust and Safety Standard

attributes.name: moderation_note
attributes.description: Internal moderator-authored note documenting the rationale for a moderation action. Not visible to community members. Supports moderation audit trails, appeals processes, and DSA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 17; Internal Trust and Safety Standard

attributes.name: moderation_status
attributes.description: Current moderation lifecycle state of the post. Controls visibility to community members. Drives moderation queue workflows and compliance audit trails for content policy enforcement.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 17; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: moderation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the most recent moderation action was applied to this post. Supports SLA tracking for moderation response times and DSA compliance reporting on content removal timelines.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) value (0–10) optionally collected from the post author via an in-forum NPS survey prompt associated with this thread interaction. Contributes to community satisfaction tracking and player sentiment analytics.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Internal Player Satisfaction KPI Framework

attributes.name: parent_post_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent post in a threaded reply chain. NULL for thread-starting posts (depth level 0). Enables nested conversation tree traversal.

attributes.name: platform_source
attributes.description: The platform or client from which this post was submitted. Enables cross-platform community engagement analysis and platform-specific moderation tooling. Aligns with Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDK platform taxonomy.
attributes.references: Steamworks SDK; Epic Games Store SDK; Apple App Store Guidelines; Google Play Developer Policies

attributes.name: post_depth_level
attributes.description: Integer indicating the nesting depth of this post within the thread hierarchy. Value 0 = thread root post; 1 = direct reply to root; 2+ = nested reply. Supports both flat and threaded conversation rendering models.

attributes.name: post_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this post or thread was originally submitted by the author. The principal business event timestamp representing when the community discourse event occurred. Distinct from system audit created_timestamp.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Internal Community Platform Standard

attributes.name: post_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this record is a thread-starting post or a reply within an existing thread. Also captures special post types such as announcements and polls. Drives rendering logic and analytics segmentation.

attributes.name: reply_count
attributes.description: Total number of direct and nested replies within this thread. Applicable to thread-root posts. Measures community engagement depth and discussion activity. Used in trending thread algorithms.

attributes.name: report_count
attributes.description: Total number of community member reports submitted against this post. Distinct from is_reported flag; provides severity signal for moderation prioritization. High report counts may trigger automated moderation actions.
attributes.references: Digital Services Act (DSA) Article 16; Internal Trust and Safety Standard

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable subject line of the thread, populated only for thread-starting posts (post_type = thread or announcement). NULL for reply posts. Displayed in forum index listings and search results.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this forum_thread record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks any field-level changes including moderation status updates, vote count refreshes, and flag changes.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: upvote_count
attributes.description: Total number of upvotes (positive reactions) received by this post from community members. Contributes to post ranking, community reputation scoring, and content quality signals.

attributes.name: view_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times this thread has been viewed by community members. Applicable primarily to thread-root posts. Key engagement metric for community health dashboards and content popularity analysis.

products.name: forum_post
products.description: Transactional record of individual replies and posts within a forum thread. Stores post body content, author player reference, parent thread reference, reply-to post reference for nested conversations, edit history flag, upvote/downvote counts, moderation action status, reported flag, and timestamps. Granular unit of community interaction below thread level.

attributes.name: forum_post_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual forum post or reply within the gaming community platform. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: forum_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the forum category or subforum this post belongs to (e.g., Bug Reports, General Discussion, Esports, Patch Notes). Used for community analytics segmentation and moderation routing.

attributes.name: forum_thread_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent forum thread that this post belongs to. Every post must be associated with exactly one thread.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game title this forum post is associated with. Enables per-title community health metrics, game-specific moderation policies, and title-level player engagement reporting.

attributes.name: guild_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guild or clan associated with this post, if posted within a guild-specific forum space. Null for general community posts. Supports guild community engagement analytics.

attributes.name: moderation_action_id
attributes.description: Reference to the moderation action record applied to this post, if any. Null if no moderation action has been taken.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: parent_post_forum_post_id
attributes.description: Reference to the post being directly replied to, enabling nested/threaded conversation structures. Null if this is a top-level post within the thread.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player account that authored this post. Links to the player master record for community engagement analytics and moderation history.

attributes.name: support_ticket_id
attributes.description: External reference to the Zendesk player support ticket created from or linked to this forum post. Populated when a forum post is escalated to a formal support case. Enables cross-system traceability between community and player support operations.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Zendesk Integration

attributes.name: author_display_name
attributes.description: The in-game or community display name (gamertag/username) of the post author at the time of posting. Denormalized from the player record for historical accuracy in case the player later changes their display name.

attributes.name: char_count
attributes.description: Total character length of the post body at the time of last save. Used for content quality analytics, spam detection heuristics, and enforcing platform post length limits.

attributes.name: contains_spoiler
attributes.description: Indicates whether the post has been tagged as containing game story or content spoilers. Enables spoiler-blur rendering in the community UI and supports community content policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: content_warning_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this post has been tagged with a content warning by the author or a moderator. Relevant for ESRB/PEGI compliance and age-gating in community spaces associated with mature-rated titles.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the forum post was originally submitted by the author. This is the principal business event timestamp representing the moment of community interaction. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: deleted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the post was soft-deleted by the author or an administrator. Null if the post has not been deleted. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure audit trails and content lifecycle reporting.

attributes.name: downvote_count
attributes.description: Total number of negative community votes (downvotes/dislikes) received by this post. Used alongside upvote_count to compute net community sentiment and identify potentially problematic content.

attributes.name: edit_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this post has been edited by the author or a moderator. Used in moderation analytics to identify posts with unusual edit patterns.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the player at the time of post submission. Used for fraud detection, ban evasion identification, and geographic compliance enforcement. May be considered PII under GDPR in EU jurisdictions. Stored in compliance with data minimization principles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; GDPR Article 5; COPPA; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: is_anonymous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the post was submitted anonymously, hiding the author's identity from other community members. Relevant for player feedback channels and GDPR data minimization compliance.

attributes.name: is_edited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the post body has been modified after initial submission. Triggers display of an edit indicator in the community UI and flags the post for audit trail review.

attributes.name: is_pinned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this post has been pinned to the top of the thread by a moderator or community manager for elevated visibility. Used for official announcements and important community notices.

attributes.name: is_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this post has been reported by one or more community members for violating community guidelines. Triggers moderation queue entry when set to true.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; Digital Services Act; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: is_solution
attributes.description: Indicates whether this post has been marked as the accepted solution to the thread's question by the original poster or a moderator. Used in player support knowledge base analytics and CSAT (Customer Satisfaction Score) tracking.

attributes.name: is_staff_post
attributes.description: Indicates whether this post was authored by a Gaming staff member, community manager, or official representative. Used to distinguish official communications from player-generated content in community analytics.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region subtag) of the post content, either author-declared or auto-detected. Used for multilingual community moderation routing and localization analytics.

attributes.name: last_edited_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the post body was most recently modified. Null if the post has never been edited. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: moderation_reason
attributes.description: Categorical reason code assigned by the moderation team when a moderation action is taken. Used for moderation analytics, policy enforcement reporting, and regulatory compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hate_speech|harassment|spam|cheating_discussion|spoiler|off_topic|misinformation|explicit_content|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; Digital Services Act; ESRB; PEGI

attributes.name: moderation_status
attributes.description: Current state of the moderation workflow for this post. 'not_reviewed' = no moderation activity; 'under_review' = assigned to a moderator; 'approved' = reviewed and cleared; 'actioned' = moderation action taken; 'escalated' = referred to senior moderation or legal team.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; Digital Services Act; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: nps_survey_triggered
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Survey Triggered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this post interaction triggered an NPS (Net Promoter Score) or CSAT (Customer Satisfaction Score) survey prompt to the author. Used in player satisfaction measurement and community feedback channel analytics.

attributes.name: platform_source
attributes.description: The platform or client interface from which the post was submitted. Used for community engagement analytics segmented by platform and for identifying platform-specific UX issues.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: post_body
attributes.description: Full text content of the forum post as authored by the player. May include game-related discussion, bug reports, feedback, or community conversation. Subject to content moderation policies and GDPR right-to-erasure obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; COPPA; FTC Guidelines; Digital Services Act

attributes.name: post_format
attributes.description: Markup or formatting type used in the post body. Determines how the content is rendered in the community UI and how it is processed during content moderation and indexing.

attributes.name: post_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this post within its parent thread, used for ordering and display. Assigned at post creation time and reflects chronological order within the thread.

attributes.name: post_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the forum post. 'active' = visible to community; 'hidden' = temporarily concealed pending review; 'removed' = taken down by moderation; 'pending_review' = flagged and awaiting moderator decision; 'locked' = no further replies allowed; 'deleted' = soft-deleted by author or admin.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; Digital Services Act; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: post_type
attributes.description: Classification of the post within the thread structure. 'original_post' = first post opening the thread; 'reply' = standard response; 'quote_reply' = reply quoting another post; 'announcement' = official staff post; 'pinned' = elevated visibility post.

attributes.name: reply_count
attributes.description: Number of direct replies to this specific post. Denormalized count maintained for performance in community engagement dashboards and thread activity metrics.

attributes.name: report_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct player reports submitted against this post. Higher counts may trigger automated moderation escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; Digital Services Act

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Automated NLP-derived sentiment score for the post body, ranging from -1.0 (most negative) to 1.0 (most positive). Used in community health dashboards, NPS (Net Promoter Score) proxy analytics, and early toxicity detection pipelines.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 22

attributes.name: toxicity_score
attributes.description: Automated ML-derived toxicity probability score for the post body, ranging from 0.0 (non-toxic) to 1.0 (highly toxic). Used to prioritize moderation queue items and support community health KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; Digital Services Act; GDPR Article 22; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: ugc_attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of media attachments (screenshots, videos, UGC assets) included in this post. Used for content moderation workload estimation and UGC (User-Generated Content) volume analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; COPPA; Digital Services Act

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when any field on this forum post record was last modified, including moderation actions, vote count updates, or content edits. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.

attributes.name: upvote_count
attributes.description: Total number of positive community votes (upvotes/likes) received by this post. Used in community health scoring, content surfacing algorithms, and player engagement analytics.

products.name: ugc_submission
products.description: Master entity for User-Generated Content (UGC) submissions including player-created maps, mods, skins, game modes, guides, and fan art. Tracks UGC type, title, description, associated game title, creator player reference, file size, asset URL, version number, download count, rating score, approval status, content rating classification, monetization eligibility flag, and submission/approval timestamps. SSOT for all UGC assets in the community domain.

attributes.name: ugc_submission_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each UGC submission record in the community domain. Primary key for the ugc_submission data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a digital asset owned and managed by the gaming platform with its own identity and lifecycle.

attributes.name: achievement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.achievement. Business justification: UGC submissions (custom maps, mods, skins) frequently unlock specific achievements in live-service games. Tracking which achievement a submission unlocks enables progression system validation, reward

attributes.name: age_rating_cert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.age_rating_cert. Business justification: UGC distributed on platforms requires age rating certification to comply with ESRB/PEGI/rating authority requirements. Platform holders mandate cert_id for UGC marketplace approval. Removes denormaliz

attributes.name: base_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: UGC moderation pipeline validates that player-created content references approved base assets. Content distribution tracks which game assets are used in UGC for licensing/IP clearance and usage analyt

attributes.name: build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.build. Business justification: UGC compatibility validation: submissions are tested against specific builds to ensure compatibility. Moderation teams need build version to reproduce issues and validate content before approval.

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Live ops tracks UGC participation by content drop (seasonal event submissions, patch-specific creations) for engagement metrics and event ROI. Essential for measuring content-driven UGC activity and c

attributes.name: dlc_bundle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific DLC product required to use this UGC submission, when requires_base_game_dlc is true. Used for entitlement checks during download and in-game loading.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; Steamworks SDK

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title this UGC submission is associated with. Links the UGC asset to the specific game for which it was created (e.g., a mod, map, or skin belongs to a specific game title).

attributes.name: influencer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.influencer. Business justification: Influencers submit UGC as part of partnership agreements (custom maps, skins, mods). Direct link enables influencer content tracking, contractual deliverable verification, and measurement of influence

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice_line. Business justification: Creator revenue recognition and payout processing requires linking UGC submissions to invoice lines for accurate revenue share calculations and tax reporting per creator agreements.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: UGC submissions have IP ownership, liability, and revenue-sharing implications. Tracking which legal entity owns/hosts the content is essential for IP rights management, creator payment processing, ta

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: UGC submissions using licensed IP (music tracks, middleware SDKs, brand assets) require tracking for IP clearance status, royalty calculation, and compliance verification. Critical for DMCA compliance

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: UGC contests and creator challenges are core marketing tactics in gaming. Tracking which campaign sourced each submission is essential for calculating campaign ROI, engagement rates, and content acqui

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.mtx_catalog. Business justification: UGC submissions showcase purchased cosmetic items (outfit showcases, build tours featuring premium items). Content creators reference catalog items in submissions - marketing tracks which items drive

attributes.name: offer_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.offer_campaign. Business justification: Promotional campaigns incentivize UGC creation (contests, themed building challenges, cosmetic showcases). Submissions tied to campaigns for eligibility verification, reward distribution, and campaign

attributes.name: platform_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.platform_sku. Business justification: UGC content (mods, maps, skins) targets specific SKUs/editions (e.g., Deluxe Edition DLC). Content compatibility validation, storefront filtering, and entitlement checks require SKU-level tracking. No

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who created and submitted this UGC asset. Establishes authorship and ownership for attribution, royalty eligibility, and community reputation tracking.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: UGC approval workflows require tracking which employee reviewed/approved submissions for IP clearance, content rating compliance, and monetization eligibility. Critical for audit trails, quality assur

attributes.name: storefront_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.storefront_order_line. Business justification: Paid UGC marketplace sales tracking requires linking creator submissions to storefront transactions for revenue share calculations, creator payouts, and sales analytics reporting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the UGC submission was approved by the moderation team and made publicly available. Used to calculate moderation SLA compliance and measure time-to-publish for community content.

attributes.name: asset_url
attributes.description: Secure HTTPS URL pointing to the hosted UGC asset package on the CDN or platform storage. Used by game clients and platform SDKs to download the UGC content. Must be a valid HTTPS endpoint.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; CDN Distribution Standards; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: comment_count
attributes.description: Total number of community comments posted on this UGC submission's page. Measures community engagement depth and is used to identify high-discussion content for editorial featuring and moderation prioritization.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics

attributes.name: creator_revenue_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of monetization revenue allocated to the UGC creator under the platform's creator economy program. Applicable only when is_monetization_eligible is true. Confidential commercial term.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: download_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times this UGC submission has been downloaded by players. Key community engagement metric used to rank popular content, inform creator reward programs, and drive workshop recommendation algorithms.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics

attributes.name: external_submission_code
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier for the UGC submission, used in platform workshop URLs, community portal deep links, and Steamworks/Epic Games Store SDK references. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Steamworks SDK; Epic Games Store SDK; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: favorite_count
attributes.description: Number of players who have added this UGC submission to their favorites or wishlist. Indicates sustained player interest beyond initial download and is used for community engagement analytics and recommendation ranking.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Total file size of the UGC asset package in bytes. Used for CDN storage capacity planning, download time estimation, platform certification size limit checks, and player-facing display. Serves as the principal MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; Steamworks SDK; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: game_engine_version
attributes.description: Version of the game engine (Unity or Unreal Engine) used to create or required to run this UGC submission. Critical for compatibility validation during the asset pipeline ingestion and platform certification process.
attributes.references: Unity Engine Documentation; Unreal Engine Documentation; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: ip_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of intellectual property rights clearance review for this UGC submission. Ensures the content does not infringe on third-party IP, trademarks, or copyrights before approval and distribution.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act; IGDA IP Guidelines; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: is_age_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UGC submission requires age verification before access, based on content rating classification. Enforces COPPA compliance for underage players and platform age-gating requirements.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); ESRB; PEGI; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: is_cross_platform_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UGC submission is certified as compatible across multiple gaming platforms (PC, console, mobile). Drives cross-platform distribution eligibility and platform certification routing.
attributes.references: Console Platform TRC/TCR Standards; Steamworks SDK; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UGC submission has been editorially selected as featured content by the community management team. Featured content receives prominent placement in workshop listings and community portals.

attributes.name: is_monetization_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UGC submission is eligible for in-game monetization programs (e.g., creator marketplace, revenue share, MTX integration). Determined by content type, approval status, and creator agreement acceptance.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; FTC Advertising Standards; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region subtag) indicating the primary language of the UGC submission's text content (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'ja'). Used for localization filtering and regional content compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; ISO 3166-1 Country Codes; GDPR Article 12 (language accessibility)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the UGC submission record, including creator-initiated version updates, moderation status changes, or metadata edits. Supports audit trail and change detection in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; ISO 8601; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Licensing terms under which the UGC submission is distributed. Governs redistribution rights, modification permissions, and commercial use eligibility for the creator's content.
attributes.references: Creative Commons License Standards; Gaming Internal Data Standards; IGDA IP Guidelines

attributes.name: moderation_flag
attributes.description: Current moderation classification flag assigned by automated or manual review processes. Drives escalation workflows, content removal actions, and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clean|flagged_violence|flagged_adult|flagged_ip_violation|flagged_spam|under_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESRB; PEGI; FTC Consumer Protection Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score collected from players who interacted with this UGC submission, on a scale of -100 to 100. Measures player satisfaction and likelihood to recommend the content. Feeds community health KPI dashboards in Tableau/Looker.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Gaming Internal Data Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude

attributes.name: platform_target
attributes.description: The gaming platform(s) for which this UGC submission is designed and compatible. Drives platform-specific certification checks, distribution routing, and compatibility filtering in workshop listings.
attributes.references: Steamworks SDK; Epic Games Store SDK; Console Platform TRC/TCR Standards; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: preview_image_url
attributes.description: Secure HTTPS URL for the thumbnail or preview image of the UGC submission displayed in community portals, workshop listings, and in-game browsing interfaces. Supports player discovery and click-through engagement.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; Steamworks SDK

attributes.name: price_virtual_currency
attributes.description: Price of the UGC submission in the game's virtual currency units (e.g., coins, gems, credits) if sold through the in-game marketplace. Zero or null indicates free content. Supports in-game monetization (MTX/IAP) analytics.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; PCI SSC (Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council); SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the UGC submission was first made publicly available to the player community. Used for date-based reporting, anniversary promotions, and community content calendars.

attributes.name: rating_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual player ratings submitted for this UGC asset. Used alongside rating_score to assess statistical confidence of the aggregate rating and prevent manipulation by low-volume outliers.

attributes.name: rating_score
attributes.description: Aggregate community rating score for the UGC submission, typically on a 0.00–5.00 scale. Computed from player ratings and used for workshop ranking, featured content selection, and creator reputation scoring.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics

attributes.name: removal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the removal of the UGC submission from public availability. Required for compliance reporting under the Digital Services Act and internal moderation audit trails. Null if not removed.
attributes.references: European Commission Digital Services Act; FTC Consumer Protection Standards; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: removed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the UGC submission was removed from public availability, either by the creator, platform moderation, or automated policy enforcement. Null if the submission has not been removed. Supports compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: report_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of player-submitted reports flagging this UGC submission for policy violations (e.g., inappropriate content, IP infringement, spam). Triggers automated moderation escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: requires_base_game_dlc
attributes.business_glossary_term: UGC Requires Base Game DLC Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UGC submission requires the player to own a specific Downloadable Content (DLC) pack in addition to the base game in order to use the content. Used for entitlement validation and player-facing compatibility warnings.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; Steamworks SDK

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the content moderation reviewer during the approval or rejection process. Documents the rationale for moderation decisions and supports appeals handling and compliance audits.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: source_platform
attributes.description: The distribution platform through which this UGC submission was originally uploaded. Used for platform-specific compliance checks, certification routing, and cross-platform availability management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam|epic_games|playstation|xbox|nintendo|mobile_ios|mobile_android|web — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks SDK; Epic Games Store SDK; Console Platform TRC/TCR Standards; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the UGC submission within the moderation and publishing workflow. Controls visibility, download availability, and monetization eligibility. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_review|approved|rejected|removed|archived — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; ESRB Content Guidelines; PEGI Content Guidelines

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the UGC submission was first submitted by the creator for review. Represents the principal business event time for this entity. Used for SLA tracking of moderation turnaround and community activity trend analysis.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of community-defined tags applied to the UGC submission for discoverability and categorization (e.g., 'horror,multiplayer,competitive'). Used for search indexing and recommendation engine inputs.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the UGC submission as provided by the creator. Used for display in community portals, workshop listings, and search indexing. Serves as the primary IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: ugc_submission_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the UGC submission as authored by the creator. Describes the content, features, installation instructions, and intended use. Used for community discovery, search indexing, and moderation review.

attributes.name: ugc_type
attributes.description: Category of UGC asset submitted by the player. Drives content moderation workflows, monetization eligibility rules, and community portal routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: map|mod|skin|game_mode|guide|fan_art|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the UGC submission (e.g., 1.0, 2.3.1). Tracks iterative updates by the creator and enables compatibility checks with game engine versions. Aligns with Perforce Helix Core versioning conventions.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Version Control Standards; Semantic Versioning (semver.org)

products.name: ugc_review
products.description: Transactional record of player reviews and ratings submitted for UGC content. Captures reviewer player reference, UGC submission reference, star rating, review text, helpful vote count, verified download flag, moderation status, and review timestamp. Enables community-driven quality signals for UGC discovery and ranking.

attributes.name: ugc_review_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each UGC review record in the Gaming platform. Primary key for the ugc_review data product.

attributes.name: backlog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.backlog_item. Business justification: UGC quality assurance: reviews reporting technical issues (crashes, compatibility problems) generate backlog items for engine or tooling fixes. Essential for maintaining UGC platform stability.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member or automated moderation system that performed the most recent moderation action on this review. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title context in which the UGC content and review exist. Enables game-level aggregation of community quality signals.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who authored this UGC review. Links to the player master record for reviewer identity and profile context.

attributes.name: storefront_listing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.storefront_listing. Business justification: Player reviews of UGC content are displayed on storefront listings. Content moderation, rating aggregation, and ASO optimization require linking reviews to specific listings. Core storefront content m

attributes.name: support_ticket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Zendesk player support ticket associated with this review, if a support case was opened in relation to a review dispute, moderation appeal, or content complaint. Enables cross-system traceability between community and player support operations.
attributes.references: Zendesk Player Support and Ticketing; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: ugc_submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the UGC submission being reviewed. Links to the ugc_submission master record for the content item under evaluation.

attributes.name: content_rating_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this review has been assessed and confirmed compliant with applicable content rating standards (ESRB, PEGI, USK, CERO, GRAC) for the target audience of the associated game title.
attributes.references: ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board); PEGI (Pan European Game Information); USK; CERO; GRAC

attributes.name: coppa_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this review is subject to COPPA restrictions because the reviewer is identified as a child under 13. COPPA-restricted reviews require parental consent verification before public display.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); FTC Enforcement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this review record was first persisted in the data platform. Distinct from submitted_timestamp which reflects the player-facing event time.

attributes.name: deleted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this review was soft-deleted. Null if the review has not been deleted. Supports GDPR erasure request audit trails and data retention compliance.

attributes.name: deletion_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the soft deletion of this review. Supports compliance audit trails for GDPR erasure requests, moderation enforcement, and account ban processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer has provided valid GDPR consent for their review content and associated personal data to be processed and publicly displayed. Required for EU-resident reviewers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: helpful_vote_count
attributes.description: Number of community players who have marked this review as helpful. Core community engagement signal used in UGC discovery ranking and review surfacing algorithms.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: is_deleted
attributes.description: Soft-delete flag indicating whether this review has been logically deleted from the platform (e.g., by player request under GDPR Right to Erasure or by moderation removal). Deleted reviews are retained for audit but excluded from community display.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); Gaming Internal Data Standards; SOC 2

attributes.name: is_edited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has edited the review text after initial submission. Edited reviews may require re-moderation per community policy.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this review has been editorially selected or algorithmically promoted as a featured review on the UGC content page. Featured reviews receive elevated visibility in community discovery.

attributes.name: is_spoiler
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer or moderation team has flagged this review as containing spoilers for the UGC content or associated game. Triggers spoiler-blur UI treatment in community displays.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: is_verified_download
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewing player has a verified download or install of the UGC content on record. Verified reviews carry higher trust weight in community ranking algorithms.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: is_verified_playtime
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewing player has logged a minimum verified playtime threshold for the UGC content before submitting the review. Reduces low-effort or fraudulent reviews.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: last_edited_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent player-initiated edit to the review content. Null if the review has never been edited. Distinct from updated_timestamp which captures any record change.

attributes.name: moderation_action_type
attributes.description: The most recent moderation action applied to this review by the community moderation team. Tracks enforcement history for compliance and appeals processes.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 17; IGDA Community Standards; Digital Services Act (EU)

attributes.name: moderation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the reason for the moderation action applied to this review (e.g., SPAM, HATE_SPEECH, SPOILER, OFF_TOPIC, FAKE_REVIEW). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SPAM|HATE_SPEECH|SPOILER|OFF_TOPIC|FAKE_REVIEW|HARASSMENT|ADULT_CONTENT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 17; IGDA Community Standards; Digital Services Act (EU)

attributes.name: moderation_status
attributes.description: Current moderation lifecycle state of the review. Controls visibility and community surfacing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|rejected|escalated|removed|under_review — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: moderation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the most recent moderation action was applied to this review. Supports SLA tracking for moderation response times and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 17; Digital Services Act (EU); SOC 2

attributes.name: not_helpful_vote_count
attributes.description: Number of community players who have marked this review as not helpful. Used alongside helpful_vote_count to compute net helpfulness score for review ranking.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: The gaming platform on which the reviewer played and experienced the UGC content. Enables platform-segmented quality analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PS5|PS4|XBOX_SERIES|XBOX_ONE|SWITCH|MOBILE_IOS|MOBILE_ANDROID — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: playtime_at_review_minutes
attributes.description: Total minutes of playtime the reviewer had accumulated on the UGC content at the time of review submission. Used to assess review credibility and weight in ranking models.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: report_count
attributes.description: Number of times this review has been reported by community players for policy violations (e.g., hate speech, spam, spoilers). Triggers moderation escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 17; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: review_body
attributes.description: Full free-text review content authored by the player describing their experience with the UGC submission. Subject to moderation and community guidelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: review_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region subtag) of the review text (e.g., en, en-US, fr, de). Supports localized moderation workflows and multilingual community analytics.

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this review (e.g., REV-0000123456). Used in player support, moderation workflows, and community reporting.

attributes.name: review_source_channel
attributes.description: The platform channel through which the player submitted this review (e.g., in-game overlay, web community portal, mobile app, Steam Workshop, Epic Games Store, console marketplace). Supports channel-level community analytics.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; AppsFlyer/Adjust; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: review_title
attributes.description: Short headline or title of the review as entered by the player. Displayed in community listings and UGC detail pages.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the review format submitted by the player. Distinguishes between written text reviews, video reviews, screenshot-based reviews, and quick star-only ratings without text.

attributes.name: reviewer_account_age_days
attributes.description: Age of the reviewer's player account in days at the time of review submission. Used in anti-fraud and fake review detection models; new accounts with reviews may be flagged for additional scrutiny.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: reviewer_total_reviews
attributes.description: Total number of UGC reviews the reviewer had submitted on the platform at the time this review was created. Contextualizes reviewer credibility and activity level for ranking models.

attributes.name: sentiment_label
attributes.description: Categorical sentiment classification derived from the sentiment_score. Used for community health dashboards, NPS/CSAT correlation analysis, and UGC quality reporting.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Normalized sentiment analysis score for the review body text, ranging from -1.0 (most negative) to 1.0 (most positive). Computed by the NLP pipeline and stored for analytics and community health monitoring.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics; Gaming Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: Numeric star rating assigned by the reviewer to the UGC content, on a 1–5 scale (1 = lowest quality, 5 = highest quality). Core community quality signal used for UGC discovery and ranking algorithms.
attributes.references: Gaming Internal Data Standards; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the player submitted this review. Principal business event timestamp for the review lifecycle.

attributes.name: total_vote_count
attributes.description: Total number of community votes (helpful + not helpful) received by this review. Indicates review engagement volume and statistical significance of helpfulness signals.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this review record was most recently modified, including moderation actions, edits, or status changes.

products.name: guild
products.description: Master entity representing player guilds, clans, and social groups within games. Tracks guild name, tag/abbreviation, associated game title, founding player reference, member capacity, current member count, guild type (casual/competitive/roleplay), recruitment status (open/invite-only/closed), region, language, description, emblem/badge asset reference, total XP/prestige points, and active status. SSOT for all guild and clan social structures.

attributes.name: guild_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the guild or clan social group. Primary key for the guild master entity in the community domain.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title with which this guild is associated. Guilds are scoped to a specific game title.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who originally created and founded this guild.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.subscription. Business justification: Guild premium features (expanded rosters, custom emblems, private servers) are monetized via guild-level subscriptions in MMOs, requiring direct linkage for billing, feature entitlement, and guild rev

attributes.name: age_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guild enforces an age restriction on membership, requiring members to be 18+ or meet a minimum age threshold. Supports COPPA and GDPR compliance for minor protection.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: banner_asset_ref
attributes.description: Reference path or URI to the guild's banner or header image asset stored in the digital asset management system. Displayed on the guild's community profile page.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Digital Asset Management Standard

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Content maturity rating applicable to this guild's activities and communications, aligned with ESRB rating categories. Used to enforce age-appropriate community access controls.
attributes.references: ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board); PEGI (Pan European Game Information)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the guild record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: disbanded_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guild was officially disbanded or dissolved. Null for active guilds. Used for historical reporting and community lifecycle analytics.

attributes.name: discord_server_code
attributes.description: External Discord server identifier linked to this guild's community communication channel. Used for cross-platform community integration and player support routing.

attributes.name: emblem_asset_ref
attributes.description: Reference path or URI to the guild's emblem or badge image asset stored in the digital asset management system (Perforce Helix Core / CDN). Used for rendering the guild icon in-game and on community portals.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Digital Asset Management Standard

attributes.name: external_website_url
attributes.description: URL of the guild's external website or community page, if maintained outside the game platform. Used for community discovery and marketing.

attributes.name: founded_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the guild was officially created and founded by the founding player. Used for guild anniversary tracking and tenure-based analytics.

attributes.name: guild_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the guild written by the guild leader, outlining the guild's goals, rules, play style, and membership expectations. Displayed on the guild profile page.

attributes.name: guild_name
attributes.description: The full display name of the guild or clan as chosen by the founder and visible to all players in-game and on community platforms.

attributes.name: guild_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the guild. Active guilds are operational; disbanded guilds have been dissolved; suspended guilds are under moderation review; pending guilds are awaiting approval.

attributes.name: guild_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the guild's primary play style and purpose. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: casual|competitive|roleplay|social|esports|pve — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: is_esports_org
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guild is formally affiliated with or operates as an esports organization participating in sanctioned leagues or tournaments.
attributes.references: Internal Esports League and Tournament Operations Standard

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guild has been officially verified by the platform or community team, typically for esports organizations or notable community groups. Verified guilds may receive special badges and visibility.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Primary language spoken within the guild, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en, fr, de, zh-CN). Used for community matching and localization.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recorded activity within the guild (e.g., member login, guild event, chat message). Used to identify inactive or dormant guilds for lifecycle management.

attributes.name: member_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of players allowed to be members of this guild simultaneously, as configured by the guild leader or constrained by game design rules.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: Current number of active members in the guild at the time of the last record update. Used for capacity management and community health reporting.

attributes.name: min_player_level
attributes.description: Minimum in-game player level required to apply for or join this guild. Used to enforce skill and progression gates for guild membership.

attributes.name: moderation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guild is currently flagged for active moderation review due to reported violations of community guidelines, toxic behavior, or policy breaches.
attributes.references: Internal Community Management Standard; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: moderation_reason
attributes.description: Categorical reason for the current moderation flag on the guild. Populated when moderation_flag is true. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: harassment|hate_speech|cheating|spam|inappropriate_content|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Community Management Standard; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) aggregated from member satisfaction surveys for this guild, ranging from -100 to 100. Used to measure community health and member loyalty within the guild.
attributes.references: Internal Community Health Analytics Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Primary gaming platform on which the guild operates. Cross-platform guilds span multiple platforms. Used for platform-specific community analytics and matchmaking.
attributes.references: Steamworks / Epic Games Store / Console SDKs Platform Standard

attributes.name: prestige_level
attributes.description: Current prestige or rank level of the guild derived from accumulated XP and achievements. Determines access to exclusive guild perks, rewards, and in-game content.

attributes.name: privacy_level
attributes.description: Visibility setting for the guild profile. Public guilds are discoverable by all players; private guilds are hidden from search; unlisted guilds are accessible only via direct link.
attributes.references: GDPR Supervisory Authorities; Internal Community Management Standard

attributes.name: pve_focus
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guild's primary activity focus is Player versus Environment (PvE) content such as raids, dungeons, and cooperative missions.

attributes.name: pvp_focus
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guild's primary activity focus is Player versus Player (PvP) content, as opposed to Player versus Environment (PvE) or social/roleplay activities.

attributes.name: recruitment_status
attributes.description: Current recruitment posture of the guild indicating whether new members may join freely (open), by invitation only (invite_only), via application (application), or not at all (closed).

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Geographic region the guild primarily operates in, used for matchmaking, server routing, and community segmentation (e.g., NA = North America, EU = Europe, APAC = Asia-Pacific).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this guild record originated (e.g., GameAnalytics, Amplitude, Salesforce CRM, or a custom in-house platform). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric abbreviation or clan tag (2–6 characters) displayed alongside player names in-game to identify guild membership (e.g., [APEX]).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the guild record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: weekly_active_members
attributes.description: Count of guild members who were active in-game during the most recent 7-day period. Key community health metric analogous to Weekly Active Users (WAU) at the guild level.

attributes.name: xp_total
attributes.description: Cumulative experience points (XP) earned by the guild through collective member activity, guild quests, and in-game events. Drives guild level progression and prestige rankings.

products.name: guild_membership
products.description: Association entity tracking player membership within guilds and clans. Records player reference, guild reference, membership role (leader/officer/member/recruit), join date, promotion history flag, contribution score, activity status, invite source, and departure date/reason when applicable. Manages the M:N relationship between players and guilds with full lifecycle data.

attributes.name: guild_membership_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each guild membership record. Serves as the primary key for the guild_membership association entity, tracking the full lifecycle of a player's participation within a guild or clan.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game title within which this guild membership exists. Guilds are scoped to individual game titles; this field enables cross-title community analytics and ensures membership records are correctly partitioned by game.

attributes.name: guild_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guild or clan that the player belongs to. Represents the guild-side of the M:N relationship between players and guilds.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who holds this guild membership. Represents the player-side of the M:N relationship between players and guilds.

attributes.name: activity_status
attributes.description: Derived classification of the member's recent engagement level within the guild context, based on login frequency and guild-specific interactions. Distinct from membership_status; used by guild leaders and community managers to identify at-risk members for retention outreach.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the player granted data processing consent for guild membership data. Required for GDPR audit trails. Null if consent has not been obtained or is not applicable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: contribution_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the player's cumulative contributions to the guild, such as donated resources, completed guild quests, or participation in guild events. Used by guild leaders to assess member value and inform promotion or removal decisions.

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: The most recent Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) rating provided by this player regarding their guild experience, typically on a 1–5 scale. Complements NPS for community health measurement and player care operations.
attributes.references: Zendesk Player Support; Internal CSAT Tracking

attributes.name: current_role_since_date
attributes.description: The date on which the player was assigned their current membership_role. Enables tenure-in-role calculations and supports promotion eligibility logic distinct from overall guild tenure.

attributes.name: data_processing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has provided explicit consent for processing of their guild membership and community interaction data. Required for GDPR compliance for players in EU jurisdictions. True when valid consent is on record.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: departure_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the player left or was removed from the guild. Null when the membership is still active. Used for churn analysis and guild stability reporting.

attributes.name: departure_reason
attributes.description: Categorical reason explaining why the player's membership ended. Supports community health analysis and guild churn root-cause reporting. Null when membership is still active.

attributes.name: guild_chat_messages_sent
attributes.description: Cumulative count of messages sent by the player in the guild chat channel since joining. A key social engagement indicator used by community managers to assess member communication activity and guild cohesion.

attributes.name: guild_events_participated
attributes.description: Cumulative count of guild-organized events (raids, tournaments, guild quests, PvP battles) in which the player has participated since joining. Used to measure event engagement and identify high-value community contributors.

attributes.name: has_promotion_history
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has ever been promoted to a higher role within this guild. True when at least one role promotion event exists in the membership history. Used as a quick filter for identifying experienced, trusted members.

attributes.name: invite_source
attributes.description: The channel or mechanism through which the player was recruited into the guild. Supports K-Factor viral coefficient analysis and community growth attribution. Examples include direct officer invite, public recruitment post, player referral, automated matchmaking, social platform import, or in-game guild search.
attributes.references: AppsFlyer/Adjust Mobile Attribution and Marketing Analytics

attributes.name: is_age_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player's age has been verified as meeting the minimum age requirement for guild participation, particularly relevant for guilds with mature content ratings. Supports COPPA compliance for guilds accessible to younger audiences.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); ESRB Rating Standards

attributes.name: is_founder
attributes.description: Indicates whether this player was one of the founding members who created the guild. Founders may retain special privileges or recognition even if their current role has changed. Used for community heritage and loyalty analytics.

attributes.name: is_muted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player's guild chat privileges have been temporarily muted by a guild officer or leader. True when the player is currently restricted from sending messages in guild channels. Used for community moderation tracking.

attributes.name: join_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the player officially joined the guild. Used for tenure calculations, retention analysis, and D1/D7/D30 guild engagement cohort reporting.

attributes.name: join_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the player's guild membership was activated. Provides sub-day precision for event sequencing, funnel analysis, and audit trails beyond what join_date alone provides.

attributes.name: last_active_date
attributes.description: The most recent calendar date on which the player performed any guild-related activity. Used to identify dormant members, trigger re-engagement campaigns, and support inactivity-based removal workflows.

attributes.name: membership_role
attributes.description: The functional role held by the player within the guild hierarchy. Determines permissions, responsibilities, and visibility within guild operations. Common roles include leader (guild owner), officer (elevated permissions), veteran (trusted long-term member), member (standard participant), and recruit (probationary new member).

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the player's guild membership. Active indicates full participation; inactive indicates the player has not engaged recently; suspended indicates a temporary restriction imposed by guild leadership; departed indicates the player has left or been removed; pending indicates an invitation or application awaiting acceptance.

attributes.name: membership_tier
attributes.description: Prestige or progression tier assigned to the player's membership within the guild, reflecting cumulative achievement and standing. Used for tiered reward distribution, exclusive content access, and community recognition programs.

attributes.name: mute_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which a temporary guild chat mute restriction is scheduled to expire. Null when is_muted is false or when the mute is permanent pending manual review. Used by community moderation workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for guild officers or community managers to record contextual notes about the membership, such as reasons for role changes, special circumstances, or moderation observations. Not displayed to the member.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response submitted by this player in the context of their guild experience, on a scale of 0–10. Used to measure guild satisfaction and community health. Null if no NPS survey has been completed.
attributes.references: IGDA Community Management Standards; Internal NPS Tracking

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: The gaming platform on which the player primarily participates in guild activities. Used for cross-platform guild analytics and to understand platform-specific community engagement patterns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PS5|PS4|XBOX|SWITCH|MOBILE|STADIA — promote to reference product if platform list grows]
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs Platform Distribution

attributes.name: previous_role
attributes.description: The membership role held by the player immediately before their current role assignment. Provides a single-step promotion/demotion audit trail without requiring a full history table query for the most recent transition.

attributes.name: pvp_wins_for_guild
attributes.business_glossary_term: Player versus Player (PvP) Wins for Guild
