attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the human support agent who handled or was assigned to the chat session. Null when the session was fully handled by a bot without human escalation.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title that provides context for the support session. Identifies which game the player was seeking help with, enabling per-title support volume and quality analytics.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Tag/Custom Field; Internal Game Title Master

attributes.name: iap_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.iap_transaction. Business justification: Real-time purchase support via live chat resolves transaction issues immediately (payment failures, missing items, receipt verification). Chat agents need transaction context to process refunds, verif

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Live chat sessions spike during campaign launches (promo code issues, event questions, new feature support). Campaign attribution enables support capacity planning, campaign quality monitoring, and me

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who initiated the chat support session. Links to the player master record for identity resolution and player-level analytics.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Visitor/Requester; Salesforce CRM — Contact

attributes.name: player_subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.player_subscription. Business justification: Subscription billing inquiries handled via live chat (cancellation requests, payment method updates, billing cycle questions). Chat sessions need subscription context to verify status, process cancell

attributes.name: support_ticket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated Zendesk support ticket created from or linked to this chat session. Enables cross-referencing between chat sessions and the broader ticket lifecycle.

attributes.name: agent_team
attributes.description: The support team or group to which the handling agent belongs (e.g., 'Tier 1 General', 'Tier 2 Technical', 'VIP Concierge', 'Esports Player Support'). Enables team-level performance benchmarking and workload distribution analysis.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The interface channel through which the player initiated the chat session. Distinguishes between web-widget (browser-based support portal), in-game (native in-game chat overlay), mobile_app (mobile support UI), and sdk_embedded (SDK-integrated chat within game client).
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Channel; SDK Integration Docs

attributes.name: coppa_minor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player associated with this chat session is identified as a minor (under 13 in the US, under 16 in the EU) subject to Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) or GDPR child data protections. True = minor player; False = adult player. Triggers special handling protocols for transcript retention, data access, and parental consent verification.
attributes.references: COPPA (FTC — Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); GDPR Article 8 (child consent); ESRB/PEGI Age Ratings

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chat session record was first captured and written to the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse — Silver Layer Audit

attributes.name: csat_comment
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative feedback provided by the player alongside the CSAT score in the post-chat survey. Contains player sentiment and specific feedback about the support experience. Classified confidential due to potentially sensitive player-expressed content.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — CSAT Comment; GDPR Article 5 (data minimisation)

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: The Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score provided by the player following the chat session, typically on a 1–5 scale (or binary Good/Bad mapped to 1/0). Null if the player did not respond to the post-chat survey. Core KPI for player support quality measurement.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — CSAT Rating; CSAT Industry Standard (1–5 scale)

attributes.name: csat_survey_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a post-chat CSAT survey was sent to the player after session close. True = survey dispatched; False = survey not sent (e.g., session abandoned, player opted out, bot-only session below threshold). Enables accurate CSAT response rate calculation.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: The reason the chat session was escalated from bot to human agent. Populated only when is_escalated_to_human is True. Enables root cause analysis of bot failure modes and escalation pattern optimization.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Escalation Reason; Bot Performance Analytics

attributes.name: first_response_time_seconds
attributes.description: The number of seconds elapsed from when the session was assigned to an agent or bot until the first message was sent to the player. Distinct from wait_time_seconds which measures queue time; this measures agent responsiveness after assignment.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — First Response Time; SLA Benchmarking

attributes.name: gdpr_data_subject_request
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chat session is associated with or triggered by a GDPR data subject request (e.g., right of access, right to erasure, data portability). True = session is linked to a DSR; False = standard support session. Enables compliance workflow tracking and audit trail for GDPR supervisory authority reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 15–22 (Data Subject Rights); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: handle_time_seconds
attributes.description: The total number of seconds from first agent/bot response to session close. Represents the active engagement duration and is a primary operational efficiency KPI for the player support team.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Handle Time; IGDA Player Support Standards

attributes.name: is_bot_handled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chat session was fully handled by an automated bot (chatbot/virtual agent) without any human agent involvement. True = bot-only session; False = human agent was involved at some point. Key metric for bot deflection rate reporting.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Bot Handling; AI/Automation Analytics

attributes.name: is_escalated_to_human
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chat session was escalated from a bot or initial automated routing to a live human support agent. True = escalation occurred; False = no escalation. Used to measure bot containment rate and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Escalation Flag; Bot Containment Rate Analytics

attributes.name: is_first_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chat session represents the player's first-ever contact with player support. True = first contact; False = returning contact. Used to measure First-Time User Experience (FTUE) support rates and new player onboarding friction.

attributes.name: is_repeat_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player contacted support again for the same issue within a defined lookback window (typically 7 days), signaling an unresolved prior interaction. True = repeat contact on same issue; False = new or unrelated contact. Key metric for First Contact Resolution (FCR) quality measurement.
attributes.references: Zendesk — Repeat Contact Detection; FCR Industry Standard

attributes.name: issue_category
attributes.description: The primary category of the player's support issue as classified by the agent or automated tagging system. Examples include account_access, billing, gameplay_bug, in_game_purchase, ban_appeal, technical_performance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: account_access|billing|gameplay_bug|in_game_purchase|ban_appeal|technical_performance|content_report|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Zendesk — Ticket Category; IGDA Player Support Taxonomy

attributes.name: issue_subcategory
attributes.description: The secondary classification of the player's support issue, providing granular detail beneath issue_category. For example, under 'billing': refund_request, charge_dispute, subscription_cancellation. Enables detailed support trend analysis and knowledge base optimization.
attributes.references: Zendesk — Ticket Subcategory; Player Support Operations

attributes.name: message_count
attributes.description: Total number of messages exchanged (both player and agent/bot) during the chat session. Indicates session complexity and engagement depth; used in workload analysis and bot deflection effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: pci_sensitive_data_shared
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player shared or attempted to share payment card or PCI-sensitive data during the chat session. True = PCI-sensitive data detected in transcript; False = no PCI data detected. Triggers mandatory transcript masking, security review, and PCI DSS compliance escalation procedures.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (PCI SSC — Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The gaming or device platform from which the player initiated the chat session. Enables platform-specific support volume analysis and agent routing optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|console_playstation|console_xbox|console_nintendo|mobile_ios|mobile_android|web — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs — Platform Identifier

attributes.name: player_account_age_days
attributes.description: The age of the player's account in days at the time the chat session was initiated. Enables segmentation of support contacts by player tenure (e.g., new player FTUE issues vs. veteran player issues) and informs retention risk analysis.

attributes.name: player_locale
attributes.description: The locale code (IETF BCP 47 format, e.g., en_US, fr_FR, de_DE, ja_JP) of the player at the time of the chat session. Drives language routing, localization of support responses, and regional support volume analysis.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; GDPR — Supervisory Authorities (regional compliance); PEGI/ESRB regional context

attributes.name: player_segment
attributes.description: The monetization segment of the player at the time of the chat session, derived from spending behavior. 'whale' = high-spending player; 'dolphin' = moderate spender; 'minnow' = low spender; 'f2p_non_payer' = Free-to-Play (F2P) non-paying; 'lapsed' = previously active, now inactive; 'new' = recently acquired. Enables prioritized support routing and VIP handling.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude — Player Segmentation; F2P Monetization Framework

attributes.name: queue_name
attributes.description: The name of the Zendesk Chat department or routing queue to which the session was assigned. Examples: 'Billing Support', 'Technical Support', 'VIP Player Care', 'Ban Appeals'. Enables queue-level performance analysis and staffing optimization.

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: The outcome resolution state of the chat session at close. 'resolved' = issue addressed to completion; 'unresolved' = issue not resolved during session; 'follow_up_required' = agent flagged need for further action; 'transferred' = session handed off to another channel or team.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Resolution Status; Player Support KPI Framework

attributes.name: satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: The binary satisfaction rating as recorded in Zendesk's native Good/Bad CSAT system, distinct from the numeric csat_score. 'good' = positive rating; 'bad' = negative rating; 'unoffered' = survey not offered. Aligns with Zendesk's native satisfaction_rating field for source system reconciliation.

attributes.name: session_date
attributes.description: The calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) on which the chat session was initiated. Derived from session_start_timestamp for partitioning, daily reporting, and date-grain analytics without requiring timestamp parsing. Used as the Databricks Silver layer partition key.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse — Silver Layer Partitioning; ISO 8601

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the chat session was closed, resolved, or abandoned. Null if the session is still active. Used in conjunction with session_start_timestamp to derive handle time.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Chat End Time; ISO 8601

attributes.name: session_key
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the chat session as assigned by Zendesk Chat. Used for cross-system referencing, audit trails, and player-facing session references.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Session Key / Chat ID

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the player initiated the chat session and entered the support queue. This is the principal business event timestamp for the session lifecycle.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Chat Start Time; ISO 8601

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the chat session. 'open' = session initiated and in queue; 'active' = agent/bot engaged; 'waiting' = awaiting player response; 'resolved' = session closed with resolution; 'abandoned' = player left before resolution; 'missed' = no agent available.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that generated this chat session record. Enables data lineage tracking and multi-source reconciliation in the Silver layer. 'zendesk_chat' = Zendesk Chat platform; 'in_game_sdk' = in-game SDK chat integration; 'mobile_sdk' = mobile SDK chat integration.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse — Silver Layer Data Lineage; Zendesk Chat; SDK Integration

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operational tags applied to the chat session in Zendesk by agents or automated rules (e.g., 'ban_appeal,high_priority,vip'). Supports flexible categorization, reporting filters, and workflow automation triggers beyond the structured issue_category field.

attributes.name: transcript_reference
attributes.description: Reference key or storage path pointing to the full chat transcript stored in the secure transcript repository (e.g., cloud object storage path or Zendesk transcript ID). The transcript itself is not stored inline; this field enables retrieval for QA, compliance, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Transcript; GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure); PCI DSS (data storage)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chat session record was last modified in the data platform, reflecting any updates from Zendesk (e.g., CSAT score received post-session, status change). Supports incremental load and change detection.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Lakehouse — Silver Layer Audit

attributes.name: wait_time_seconds
attributes.description: The number of seconds the player waited in the support queue from session initiation until an agent or bot first responded. Key metric for queue performance, staffing adequacy, and player experience benchmarking.
attributes.references: Zendesk Chat — Wait Time; CSAT/NPS Benchmarking

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.title_season. Business justification: Community events (tournaments, challenges, contests) are scheduled within title seasons in live-service games. Linking events to seasons enables seasonal event planning, rewards distribution tied to b

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for why the community event was cancelled or postponed. Populated only when event_status is 'cancelled' or 'postponed'. Used for post-mortem analysis and player communication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this community event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and governance.

attributes.name: csat_score

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Textual description of the requirements a player must meet to participate in the event (e.g., minimum account level, geographic restrictions, age requirements, game ownership). Supports COPPA and GDPR compliance for age-gated events.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the community event officially closes and participation is no longer accepted.

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the community event, used in marketing materials, URLs, and cross-system references (e.g., 'CE-SUMFAN24').

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the community event including objectives, rules, theme, and any special instructions for participants. Displayed on community portals and in-game event hubs.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Official display name of the community event as shown to players and community members (e.g., 'Summer Fan Art Contest 2024', 'Developer AMA — Season 5 Launch').

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the community event. Controls visibility, registration availability, and operational workflows. Values: upcoming (scheduled, not yet started), active (currently running), completed (ended successfully), cancelled (terminated before completion), postponed (rescheduled), draft (not yet published).

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the community event by its format and purpose. Drives eligibility rules, prize structures, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_game_challenge|fan_tournament|developer_ama|community_contest|seasonal_campaign|community_challenge|ugc_submission|charity_stream — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: external_url
attributes.description: The public-facing URL for the community event landing page, registration portal, or official announcement. Used in marketing campaigns, in-game notifications, and community portal links.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where participation is permitted or restricted. Null indicates globally open. Used for regulatory compliance and prize distribution legality (e.g., 'USA|CAN|GBR').

attributes.name: is_age_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this community event has age-based eligibility restrictions (e.g., 18+ for prize-bearing contests). Triggers additional COPPA/GDPR compliance workflows when True.

attributes.name: is_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this community event is designated as a featured or promoted event, receiving elevated visibility on community portals, in-game hubs, and marketing channels.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this community event is part of a recurring series (e.g., weekly community challenges, annual seasonal campaigns). When True, recurrence_pattern provides scheduling details.

attributes.name: k_factor_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether viral referral and K-Factor (Viral Coefficient) tracking is enabled for this community event. When True, referral attribution data is captured to measure the event's organic growth and word-of-mouth amplification.

attributes.name: max_registrations
attributes.description: The maximum number of players or teams allowed to register for this community event. Null indicates unlimited registrations. Used for capacity planning and waitlist management.

attributes.name: min_player_level
attributes.description: The minimum in-game player level or rank required to be eligible to participate in this community event. Null indicates no level restriction.

attributes.name: moderation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether player submissions or participation in this event requires human or automated content moderation review before being published or counted. Critical for UGC events and community contests.

attributes.name: nps_score

attributes.name: organizer_type

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: The total number of players or teams that actively participated in the community event (distinct from registrations, which may include no-shows). Key metric for community engagement reporting.

attributes.name: prize_description

attributes.name: prize_type

attributes.name: prize_value_usd

attributes.name: recurrence_pattern

attributes.name: referral_count

attributes.name: registration_close_timestamp

attributes.name: registration_count

attributes.name: registration_open_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when player registration for the community event opens. May precede the event start timestamp to allow advance sign-ups.

attributes.name: short_description

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the community event officially begins and becomes active for player participation.

attributes.name: submission_type

attributes.references: IGDA Community Management Standards; GDPR Article 6 (UGC consent)

attributes.name: survey_response_count
attributes.description: The total number of post-event survey responses received from participants. Provides the denominator context for interpreting NPS and CSAT scores.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this community event record was last modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit compliance.

attributes.name: voting_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether community members can vote on submissions or outcomes in this event (e.g., fan art contests with community voting). Drives the voting module configuration.

products.name: social_connection
products.description: Association entity representing social graph relationships between players including friends, followers, and blocked connections. Tracks initiating player reference, target player reference, connection type (friend/follower/blocked/muted), connection status (pending/accepted/declined/removed), connection source (in-game/forum/guild/external), and connection established/updated timestamps. SSOT for player social graph within the community domain.

attributes.name: social_connection_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each social graph relationship record between two players. Primary key for the social_connection entity.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title context in which this social connection was established, if applicable. Null for platform-level or cross-game connections.

attributes.name: guild_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guild or clan through which this social connection was established, when connection_source is 'guild'. Null for connections originating from other sources.

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing or referral campaign that drove this social connection, when applicable. Supports K-Factor viral coefficient measurement and player acquisition attribution via AppsFlyer/Adjust.
attributes.references: AppsFlyer/Adjust Marketing Attribution; K-Factor Viral Coefficient Methodology

attributes.name: primary_social_player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who originated or initiated the social connection request (the source node in the social graph). Used to determine directionality of the relationship.

attributes.name: target_player_player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who is the recipient or target of the social connection request (the destination node in the social graph). Used to determine directionality of the relationship.

attributes.name: block_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code provided by the initiating player when blocking the target player. Populated only when connection_type is 'blocked'. Supports community safety analytics and moderation reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Community Safety Policy; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: co_play_session_count
attributes.description: Number of game sessions in which both the initiating and target players participated together since the connection was established. Key metric for measuring social engagement depth and retention correlation.

attributes.name: connection_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the social relationship is unidirectional (e.g., follower, blocked, muted — only the initiating player's perspective applies) or bidirectional (e.g., mutual friend where both parties have accepted).

attributes.name: connection_label
attributes.description: Optional free-text label or nickname assigned by the initiating player to categorize or personalize this connection (e.g., 'Raid Team', 'IRL Friend', 'Clan Leader'). Supports player-defined social graph organization.

attributes.name: connection_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the social connection record, used for support, audit, and operational reference. Format: SC- followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: connection_source
attributes.description: The channel or surface through which the social connection was initiated. Supports attribution analysis for community growth and K-Factor viral coefficient measurement. Values: in_game (initiated during gameplay), forum (community forum), guild (guild/clan membership), external (external social platform import), platform (console or PC platform friend list).
attributes.references: Internal Community Analytics Standard; K-Factor Viral Coefficient Methodology

attributes.name: connection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the social connection. 'pending' means the request has been sent but not yet acted upon; 'accepted' means the connection is active; 'declined' means the target player rejected the request; 'removed' means a previously accepted connection was dissolved.

attributes.name: connection_strength_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the strength or closeness of the social connection based on interaction frequency, co-play sessions, and engagement signals. Used in community analytics, recommendation engines, and K-Factor viral coefficient modeling.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics; K-Factor Viral Coefficient Methodology

attributes.name: connection_tier
attributes.description: Player-assigned or system-inferred tier classifying the closeness of the social relationship. Used for prioritized content feeds, notification filtering, and social graph segmentation in community analytics.

attributes.name: connection_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the social relationship between the two players. 'friend' indicates a mutual bidirectional relationship; 'follower' indicates a unidirectional follow; 'blocked' indicates the initiating player has blocked the target; 'muted' indicates the initiating player has silenced the target without blocking.

attributes.name: connection_version
attributes.description: Optimistic locking version counter incremented on each update to the social connection record. Supports concurrent update conflict detection and Silver Layer SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Modeling Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Convention

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this social connection record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation event, distinct from the business event timestamps (request_sent_timestamp, established_timestamp).

attributes.name: established_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the social connection transitioned to an active/accepted state. Represents the real-world business event time of the connection being formed. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether valid GDPR consent has been obtained from both players for processing their social connection data, applicable for players in EU jurisdictions. Required for compliance with GDPR supervisory authority reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: interaction_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of social interactions (messages, co-play sessions, gift exchanges, reactions) recorded between the two players since the connection was established. Raw signal used for connection strength scoring and community engagement analytics.

attributes.name: is_cross_game
attributes.description: Indicates whether this social connection spans multiple game titles within the platform ecosystem, as opposed to being scoped to a single game title. Supports cross-title community analytics.

attributes.name: is_favorite
attributes.description: Indicates whether the initiating player has marked this connection as a favorite or best friend, enabling prioritized display and notification preferences within the social graph.

attributes.name: is_minor_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this social connection involves at least one player identified as a minor, triggering COPPA-compliant restrictions on social features, messaging, and data processing.
attributes.references: COPPA (FTC — Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); GDPR Article 8 (Child Consent)

attributes.name: is_mutual
attributes.description: Indicates whether the social connection is bidirectional and mutually acknowledged by both players. True for accepted friend relationships; False for unidirectional follower, blocked, or muted connections.

attributes.name: is_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this social connection or an interaction within it has been flagged via a player report. Links community safety monitoring to the social graph for moderation workflow prioritization.
attributes.references: Internal Community Moderation Policy; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: k_factor_contribution
attributes.description: Numeric value representing this social connection's contribution to the K-Factor (Viral Coefficient) calculation, measuring how effectively connected players invite or recruit new players. Used in player acquisition and community growth analytics.
attributes.references: K-Factor Viral Coefficient Methodology; AppsFlyer/Adjust Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: last_interaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent social interaction between the two connected players. Used to identify dormant connections, calculate connection recency, and support churn prediction models.

attributes.name: moderation_flag
attributes.description: Current moderation status of the social connection from a community safety perspective. 'clean' indicates no concerns; 'under_review' means a report is being assessed; 'escalated' means the case has been raised to senior moderation; 'actioned' means a moderation action has been applied.
attributes.references: Internal Community Moderation Policy; FTC Consumer Protection Standards; Digital Services Act (European Commission)

attributes.name: mute_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code provided by the initiating player when muting the target player. Populated only when connection_type is 'muted'. Supports community health and player experience analytics.

attributes.name: notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the initiating player has enabled activity notifications for this specific social connection (e.g., when the connected player goes online, achieves a milestone, or posts content).

attributes.name: nps_influence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this social connection was established as a result of an NPS (Net Promoter Score) promoter referral, linking community satisfaction data to social graph growth for player advocacy analytics.
attributes.references: NPS (Net Promoter Score) Methodology; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: The gaming platform on which the social connection was initiated. Supports cross-platform social graph analysis and platform-specific community health reporting. Aligned with Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDK platform identifiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PS5|PS4|XBOX|SWITCH|MOBILE|WEB — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks SDK; Epic Games Store SDK; Console Platform SDK

attributes.name: privacy_visibility
attributes.description: Privacy setting controlling who can see this social connection in the player's social graph. 'public' allows all players to see the connection; 'friends_only' restricts visibility to mutual friends; 'private' hides the connection entirely.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation); GDPR Article 25 (Privacy by Design); COPPA (FTC)

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this social connection record, used for GDPR, COPPA, and regional data protection compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|GBR|DEU|FRA|JPN|KOR|AUS|CAN|BRA|IND — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: removed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the social connection was dissolved or removed by either party. Populated only when connection_status is 'removed'. Used for social graph churn analysis and community health monitoring.

attributes.name: request_message
attributes.description: Optional personalized message submitted by the initiating player when sending a friend or follow request. Captured for community moderation review and player experience analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Community Moderation Policy; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation)

attributes.name: request_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the initiating player sent the social connection request. Captures the origination event for funnel analysis, pending request aging, and FTUE (First-Time User Experience) social onboarding analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Community Analytics Standard; FTUE Methodology

attributes.name: responded_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the target player responded to the connection request (accepted, declined, or blocked). Used to calculate request response latency and pending request conversion rates.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this social connection record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer. Aligned with operational systems including Salesforce CRM, GameAnalytics/Amplitude, and Platform SDKs.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Standard; ETL (Extract Transform Load) Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this social connection record was last modified. Tracks the most recent state change for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.

products.name: ban
products.description: Master entity representing active and historical community bans and suspensions applied to players across forums, chat, UGC, and community features. Tracks player reference, ban scope (forum/chat/ugc/all-community), ban reason, issuing moderator reference, linked moderation action reference, ban start date, ban end date (null for permanent), appeal status, appeal outcome, and reinstatement timestamp. Distinct from moderation_action as it represents the standing ban state, not the event.

attributes.name: ban_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each community ban or suspension record. Primary key for the community_ban entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: ban_appeal_reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the moderator or senior staff member who reviewed and resolved the appeal. Supports accountability and separation of duties between ban issuance and appeal review.

attributes.name: ban_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the moderator or staff member who issued this ban. Used for accountability, audit trails, and moderator performance tracking.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game title within which this ban applies, if the ban is scoped to a single title. Null for platform-wide or cross-title community bans.

attributes.name: moderation_action_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating moderation action event that triggered this ban. Distinguishes the standing ban state from the discrete moderation event.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player account subject to this community ban. Links to the player master entity.

attributes.name: player_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player report that initiated or contributed to this ban, if applicable. Enables traceability from community report through to enforcement outcome.

attributes.name: refund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.refund. Business justification: Permanent account bans trigger refund processing per consumer protection regulations and platform policies, requiring direct linkage for automated refund workflows, ban appeal financial review, and re

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening_result. Business justification: Permanent bans for fraud, money laundering, or export control violations link to sanctions screening results. Enables AML/CFT compliance by connecting enforcement actions to OFAC/sanctions list matche

attributes.name: support_ticket_id
attributes.description: External reference to the Zendesk support ticket associated with this ban, if a player support case was opened. Enables cross-system traceability between community enforcement and player support operations.

attributes.name: appeal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the appeal reviewer documenting the rationale for the appeal outcome. Supports audit trails and policy consistency reviews.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 5 (accountability)

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Final decision on the player's appeal. 'upheld' means the original ban stands; 'overturned' means the ban is reversed; 'modified' means the ban terms were changed (e.g., duration reduced); 'withdrawn' means the player withdrew the appeal before resolution.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 22

attributes.name: appeal_resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the appeal review was completed and a final outcome was recorded. Null if appeal is still pending or not submitted. Used to measure appeal resolution time and SLA adherence.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the player's appeal against this ban. 'not_appealed' means no appeal has been submitted; 'pending' means appeal submitted but not yet reviewed; 'under_review' means actively being reviewed; 'upheld' means ban confirmed; 'overturned' means ban reversed; 'withdrawn' means player withdrew the appeal.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 22 (right to contest automated decisions)

attributes.name: appeal_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player submitted their appeal against this ban. Null if no appeal has been filed. Used to track appeal SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 22

attributes.name: auto_moderation_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.0000–1.0000) assigned by the automated moderation system that triggered or contributed to this ban. Populated only when is_automated is True. Used to calibrate and audit automated enforcement thresholds.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22; Internal AI/ML Governance Standard

attributes.name: ban_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for this ban (e.g., BAN-202400012345). Used in player communications, appeal correspondence, and support tickets.

attributes.name: ban_scope
attributes.description: The community feature area(s) to which this ban applies. 'forum' restricts forum posting; 'chat' restricts in-game and community chat; 'ugc' restricts User-Generated Content (UGC) submissions; 'all_community' applies a full community ban across all features.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: ban_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the community ban. 'active' means the ban is currently enforced; 'expired' means the ban end date has passed; 'lifted' means the ban was manually removed; 'appealed' means an appeal is in progress; 'pending_review' means the ban is under internal review.

attributes.name: ban_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ban duration model. 'temporary' bans have a defined end date; 'permanent' bans have no end date (null ban_end_timestamp); 'shadow' bans restrict visibility without notifying the player, used for spam and bot suppression.

attributes.name: content_rating_concern
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation underlying this ban involved content that may affect the game's content rating classification (e.g., extreme violence, sexual content, hate speech). Flags for escalation to the content compliance team for ESRB/PEGI review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this community ban record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (storage limitation and accountability); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: The originally assigned duration of the ban in hours at the time of issuance. Null for permanent bans. Enables duration-based analytics and policy benchmarking independent of actual start/end timestamps.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ban is scheduled to expire. Null for permanent bans (ban_type = 'permanent'). When the current timestamp exceeds this value, ban_status transitions to 'expired'.

attributes.name: evidence_attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of evidence files (screenshots, chat logs, video clips) attached to this ban record to substantiate the violation. Supports audit completeness checks and appeal review.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has provided valid GDPR consent for processing of their personal data in connection with this ban record. Relevant for EU-jurisdiction players and required for lawful processing under GDPR Article 6.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Confidential free-text notes recorded by moderators for internal use only, not shared with the player. May include context about ongoing investigations, escalation history, or coordination with trust and safety teams.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: is_automated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ban was issued automatically by an automated moderation system (e.g., anti-cheat engine, spam detection, toxicity classifier) rather than by a human moderator. Supports audit of automated enforcement accuracy.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; GDPR Article 22 (automated decision-making)

attributes.name: is_minor_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the banned player is identified as a minor (under 18, or under 13 for COPPA purposes). Triggers enhanced data handling, parental notification workflows, and stricter enforcement protocols.

attributes.name: is_permanent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ban is permanent with no scheduled end date. True when ban_type is 'permanent' and ban_end_timestamp is null. Provides a direct boolean filter for permanent ban analytics and enforcement dashboards.

attributes.name: is_repeat_offender
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player was classified as a repeat offender at the time of ban issuance (prior_ban_count > 0 or per policy threshold). Drives escalated enforcement actions and permanent ban eligibility.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player was notified of this ban via the standard communication channel (in-game notification, email, or support ticket). Supports compliance with consumer protection notification requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ban notification was sent to the player. Null if notification_sent is False. Used to measure notification SLA compliance and support regulatory audit.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: The gaming platform on which this ban is enforced. 'ALL' indicates a cross-platform ban. Supports platform-specific enforcement and compliance with first-party platform certification requirements (TRC/TCR). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PS5|PS4|XBOX|SWITCH|MOBILE|ALL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: prior_ban_count
attributes.description: Number of previous community bans on record for this player at the time this ban was issued. Supports repeat offender escalation policies and ban duration calibration.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific reason for issuing this ban, as documented by the moderator. Provides context beyond the structured violation category for audit and appeal review purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; GDPR Article 5 (accountability)

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code or regional code indicating the regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this ban record (e.g., 'DEU' for Germany under USK/GDPR, 'KOR' for South Korea under GRAC). Supports jurisdiction-specific compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Supervisory Authorities; USK; GRAC; COPPA; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: reinstatement_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the player was reinstated. 'appeal_overturned' means a successful appeal; 'ban_expired' means the ban duration elapsed; 'manual_lift' means a moderator manually removed the ban; 'policy_change' means a policy update retroactively affected the ban; 'error_correction' means the ban was issued in error.

attributes.name: reinstatement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player's community access was reinstated following a ban lift, expiry, or successful appeal. Null if the ban is still active or the player has not been reinstated.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Assessed severity of the violation that triggered this ban. Drives escalation workflows, ban duration recommendations, and repeat offender policies.
attributes.references: Internal Community Operations Standard; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this ban became effective and enforcement began. Principal business event timestamp for the ban lifecycle.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this community ban record was last modified. Tracks any changes to ban status, appeal outcome, or reinstatement. Essential for Silver Layer incremental processing and audit trails.

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: Primary category of the community guideline violation that led to this ban (e.g., harassment, hate_speech, cheating, spam, inappropriate_content, impersonation, exploitation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: harassment|hate_speech|cheating|spam|inappropriate_content|impersonation|exploitation|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESRB; PEGI; FTC Consumer Protection; IGDA Community Standards

attributes.name: violation_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing more granular detail on the violation type within the primary violation_category (e.g., within 'harassment': targeted_harassment, doxxing, sexual_harassment). Supports detailed moderation analytics and policy refinement.

products.name: player_reputation
products.description: Master entity tracking player community reputation scores, trust levels, and privilege tiers earned through positive community participation. Captures player reference, reputation points, trust tier (new/basic/member/regular/leader), endorsement count, helpful contribution count, warning count, privilege set (post/upload/moderate/invite), reputation decay rate, last activity date, and tier promotion/demotion history. Drives automated moderation thresholds and community privilege gating. SSOT for player standing within the community ecosystem.

attributes.name: player_reputation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the player reputation record. Primary key for the player reputation entity.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title for which this reputation is tracked. Enables game-specific reputation systems.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player whose reputation is being tracked. Links to the player master entity.

attributes.name: auto_moderation_score
attributes.description: Machine learning-derived score indicating likelihood of future violations. Used to adjust moderation thresholds and flag high-risk content.

attributes.name: can_invite
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player can send guild or event invitations. Privilege earned through positive community standing.

attributes.name: can_moderate
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player has community moderation privileges. Reserved for leader and moderator trust tiers.

attributes.name: can_post
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player has privilege to post in community forums. Gated by trust tier and violation history.

attributes.name: can_upload_ugc
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player has privilege to upload UGC submissions. Requires minimum trust tier and clean moderation record.

attributes.name: can_vote
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player can vote on community content, polls, or UGC submissions. Basic privilege for established members.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when GDPR consent was granted. Required for regulatory compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reputation record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage.

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: Most recent CSAT score provided by the player regarding community interactions. Range 1-5. Measures player satisfaction with community features.

attributes.name: endorsement_count
attributes.description: Total number of endorsements received from other community members. Reflects peer recognition of positive contributions.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player has provided GDPR consent for community data processing and reputation tracking.

attributes.name: helpful_contribution_count
attributes.description: Number of forum posts, UGC submissions, or support responses marked as helpful by the community. Key metric for reputation advancement.

attributes.name: is_age_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player's age has been verified for compliance with age-restricted community features and content.

attributes.name: is_verified_contributor
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the player has been verified as a trusted content contributor. Verified status displayed publicly and influences trust tier.

attributes.name: k_factor_contribution
attributes.description: Player's contribution to viral growth through community referrals and invitations. Measures organic community expansion driven by this player.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the player's most recent community activity (post, vote, endorsement, etc.). Used to calculate inactivity-based reputation decay.

attributes.name: moderation_threshold_level
attributes.description: Automated moderation sensitivity level applied to this player based on trust tier and history. Higher trust tiers receive relaxed thresholds.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes for moderators and community managers regarding this player's reputation history, special circumstances, or manual adjustments.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent NPS score provided by the player regarding community experience. Range -100 to +100. Tracks community satisfaction at player level.

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: Primary platform where the player engages with the community. Enables platform-specific reputation tracking and moderation policies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PS5|PS4|XBOX_SERIES|XBOX_ONE|SWITCH|MOBILE_IOS|MOBILE_ANDROID|WEB — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: previous_trust_tier
attributes.description: The trust tier held immediately before the most recent tier change. Enables tier transition analysis and rollback scenarios.

attributes.name: referral_count
attributes.description: Total number of successful referrals made by this player that resulted in new community members. Positive reputation indicator.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the primary regulatory jurisdiction governing this player's community data. Determines applicable privacy and content regulations.

attributes.name: reputation_decay_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate at which reputation points decay due to inactivity or negative behavior. Applied periodically to maintain active community engagement.

attributes.name: reputation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the reputation record. Format: REP-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: reputation_points
attributes.description: Total accumulated reputation score based on positive community contributions, endorsements, and helpful actions. Used to calculate trust tier and privilege eligibility.

attributes.name: reputation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reputation record. Active indicates normal operation; suspended/frozen indicates temporary restriction; under_review indicates pending moderation action; banned indicates permanent revocation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this reputation record. Supports multi-system integration and data lineage.

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: Date when temporary reputation suspension expires and privileges are restored. Null for permanent bans or active reputations.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for reputation suspension or restriction. Provides context for moderation actions and player communication.

attributes.name: tier_change_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the most recent trust tier change. Supports audit trail and player communication.

attributes.name: tier_demotion_date
attributes.description: Date when the player was last demoted to a lower trust tier due to violations or inactivity. Tracks negative reputation events.

attributes.name: tier_promotion_date
attributes.description: Date when the player was last promoted to a higher trust tier. Tracks progression through the reputation system.

attributes.name: trust_tier
attributes.description: Current trust level classification earned through positive community participation. Determines privilege access and automated moderation thresholds. Values: new (new account), basic (minimal activity), member (established presence), regular (consistent positive contributor), leader (community influencer), moderator (elevated privileges).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reputation record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the player achieved verified contributor status. Null if not verified.

attributes.name: violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of confirmed community guideline violations. Impacts trust tier and may result in privilege revocation.

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: Total number of moderation warnings issued to the player. Negative indicator that may trigger reputation decay or tier demotion.

attributes.name: previous_player_reputation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on player_reputation (previous_player_reputation_id)

products.name: forum_category
products.description: Master reference table for forum_category. Referenced by forum_category_id.

attributes.name: forum_category_id
attributes.description: Primary key for forum_category

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game title this forum category is associated with. Null for general or cross-game categories.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_player_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Modified By User Player Account Id
attributes.description: Reference to the administrator or moderator user who last modified this forum category.

attributes.name: parent_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent forum category for hierarchical category structures. Null for top-level categories.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the administrator or moderator user who created this forum category.

attributes.name: active_threads
attributes.description: Current count of active, non-archived discussion threads in this forum category.

attributes.name: allowed_content_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of content types allowed in this category such as text, images, videos, polls, or attachments.

attributes.name: auto_archive_days
attributes.description: Number of days of inactivity after which threads in this category are automatically archived. Null if auto-archiving is disabled.

attributes.name: banner_image_url
attributes.description: URL path to the banner image displayed at the top of the forum category page.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the forum category used for system integration and API references.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forum category record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: custom_css_class
attributes.description: Custom CSS class name applied to this forum category for specialized styling and theming in the user interface.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the forum category explaining its purpose, scope, and the types of discussions it hosts.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of forum categories in the user interface. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: listing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the store listing. Draft = being prepared; Pending Review = submitted to platform for approval; Live = published and discoverable; Suspended = temporarily removed; Delisted = permanently removed; Archived = historical record.

attributes.name: listing_title
attributes.description: The display title of the game as it appears on the storefront. Optimized for discoverability and conversion.

attributes.name: localization_locale

attributes.name: long_description

attributes.name: marketing_url
attributes.description: URL to the games official marketing website or landing page. Used for additional promotional information and community links.

attributes.name: monetization_model

attributes.name: page_view_count
attributes.description: Total number of times users viewed the full product page for this listing. Used to calculate click-through rate (CTR) from impressions.

attributes.name: price_tier
attributes.description: The pricing tier or model for the game on this storefront (e.g., free, $0.99, $4.99, $9.99, premium). Platform-specific pricing tiers apply.

attributes.name: primary_category

attributes.name: privacy_policy_url
attributes.description: URL to the games privacy policy. Required by GDPR, COPPA, and platform policies for games that collect user data.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act), Apple App Store Review Guidelines, Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: promo_video_reference
attributes.description: Asset reference or URL for the promotional video or app preview displayed on the store listing. Platform-specific format and duration requirements apply.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines, Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: review_count
attributes.description: Total number of user reviews submitted for the game on this storefront. Review volume impacts social proof and conversion.

attributes.name: screenshot_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of asset references or URLs pointing to the promotional screenshots displayed on the store listing. Each platform has specific dimension and count requirements.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines, Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: secondary_category
attributes.description: Optional secondary category classification for the game. Not all platforms support secondary categories.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines, Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief promotional description of the game, typically displayed in search results and browse views. Character limits vary by platform.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines, Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: storefront_platform
attributes.description: The digital storefront platform where this listing is published (Apple App Store, Google Play, Steam, Epic Games Store, Microsoft Store, PlayStation Store).

attributes.name: support_url
attributes.description: URL to the player support or customer service page for the game. Required by most storefronts.

attributes.name: version_release_date
attributes.description: The date when the current version was released or went live on the storefront.

products.name: influencer
products.description: Master record for influencer and content creator partners engaged in game marketing programs. Captures influencer handle, real name, primary platform (YouTube/Twitch/TikTok/Instagram), follower count tier, content category (FPS/RPG/mobile/esports), region, language, engagement rate, preferred contact, contract status, exclusivity flag, COPPA compliance flag (for creators with under-18 audiences), and relationship manager. Owned by marketing as the authoritative influencer roster.

attributes.name: influencer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the influencer or content creator partner. Primary key for the influencer master record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing team member responsible for managing the relationship with this influencer, coordinating campaigns, and handling contract renewals.

attributes.name: affiliate_code
attributes.description: The unique affiliate tracking code or referral code assigned to the influencer for tracking sales, installs, and conversions driven by their promotional content. Used in AppsFlyer/Adjust attribution and revenue-share calculations.

attributes.name: affiliate_program_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the influencer is enrolled in the company's affiliate marketing program, earning commission on game sales or in-app purchases driven through their unique affiliate links. True means enrolled; False means not enrolled.

attributes.name: audience_age_group
attributes.description: The primary age demographic of the influencers audience. Critical for ESRB/PEGI compliance, COPPA compliance, and ensuring age-appropriate game promotion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: under-13|13-17|18-24|25-34|35-44|45-plus|mixed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESRB; PEGI; COPPA; Social Media Platform Demographics

attributes.name: audience_gender_split
attributes.description: The gender distribution of the influencers audience, typically expressed as a percentage (e.g., 60% male, 40% female). Used for targeted campaign planning and demographic alignment with game titles.

attributes.name: average_views_per_post
attributes.description: The average number of views or impressions the influencer generates per content post on their primary platform. Used for campaign reach estimation and Cost Per Mille (CPM) calculations.

attributes.name: content_category
attributes.description: The primary game genre or content category that the influencer focuses on. Used to match influencers with relevant game titles and campaigns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FPS|RPG|mobile|esports|strategy|casual|indie|AAA|multi-genre — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: content_rating_suitability
attributes.description: The ESRB content rating level that best matches the influencers typical content and audience (E=Everyone, E10+=Everyone 10+, T=Teen, M=Mature, AO=Adults Only, RP=Rating Pending). Used to ensure appropriate game-influencer matching.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the current influencer partnership contract expires. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen agreements. Used for renewal planning and budget forecasting.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the current influencer partnership contract became effective. Used for contract lifecycle management and renewal planning.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: The current status of the influencers contractual relationship with the company. Active indicates an ongoing partnership; pending indicates negotiations in progress; expired or terminated indicates no current agreement.

attributes.name: coppa_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the influencer has a significant audience under 13 years of age, requiring COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) compliance measures in campaigns. True means COPPA compliance required; False means standard compliance.

attributes.name: cpi_benchmark
attributes.description: The historical average Cost Per Install (CPI) achieved through campaigns with this influencer. Used for campaign planning, budget allocation, and influencer performance comparison.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this influencer record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and partnership lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the rate card amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency contract management and financial reporting.

attributes.name: engagement_rate
attributes.description: The average engagement rate (likes, comments, shares divided by followers) expressed as a percentage. Key metric for evaluating influencer effectiveness and campaign ROI.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the influencer is under an exclusive agreement that prohibits them from promoting competing game titles or publishers. True means exclusive partnership; False means non-exclusive.

attributes.name: follower_count
attributes.description: The current number of followers or subscribers on the influencers primary platform. Updated periodically for campaign planning and performance tracking.

attributes.name: follower_count_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the influencer based on follower count: nano (<10K), micro (10K-100K), mid-tier (100K-500K), macro (500K-1M), mega (>1M). Used for campaign targeting and rate negotiation.

attributes.name: handle
attributes.description: The public username or handle of the influencer on their primary platform (e.g., @gamerpro123). This is the primary business identifier used in campaigns and contracts.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The primary language used by the influencer in their content (e.g., English, Spanish, Japanese). Uses ISO 639-1 two-letter codes or full language names.

attributes.name: last_campaign_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent marketing campaign or content collaboration with this influencer. Used for relationship health monitoring and re-engagement planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this influencer record was last updated. Used for data freshness monitoring, audit trails, and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for relationship managers to capture important notes about the influencer, including preferences, past issues, special requirements, or strategic considerations for future campaigns.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score (NPS) rating provided by the influencer regarding their satisfaction with the partnership, on a scale of 0-10. Used to measure influencer satisfaction and identify partnership improvement opportunities.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment structure agreed upon in the influencer contract (e.g., per-post fee, per-campaign fee, monthly retainer, revenue-share, or hybrid model). Used for budget planning and payment processing.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_email
attributes.description: The primary email address for business communications, contract negotiations, and campaign coordination with the influencer.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_phone
attributes.description: The primary phone number for urgent communications with the influencer or their management team.

attributes.name: primary_platform
attributes.description: The primary social media or streaming platform where the influencer has the largest following and engagement.

attributes.name: rate_card_amount
attributes.description: The standard rate or fee paid to the influencer per the agreed payment terms (e.g., per post, per campaign, or monthly retainer). Stored in the company's base currency (USD). Used for campaign budgeting and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Contract Management Standards; Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: real_name
attributes.description: The legal or real name of the influencer for contract and payment purposes.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: The primary geographic region or country where the influencer is based and has their largest audience (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN). Uses 3-letter ISO country codes.

attributes.name: roas_benchmark
attributes.description: The historical average Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) achieved through campaigns with this influencer, expressed as a ratio (e.g., 3.5 means $3.50 revenue per $1 spent). Used for influencer selection and campaign optimization.

attributes.name: total_campaigns_completed
attributes.description: The cumulative number of marketing campaigns or content collaborations completed with this influencer since the partnership began. Used for partnership value assessment and performance trending.

Linking enables cross-channel attribution, measurement of CRM-driven monetization lift,

attributes.name: suppression_list_id

attributes.name: title_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.title_season. Business justification: CRM campaigns drive engagement for active seasons ("Season 5 ends in 3 days - claim rewards"). Retention marketing tied to seasonal content cadence. Re-engagement campaigns target lapsed players per s

attributes.description: Number of test variants in the A/B test configuration. Null if A/B testing is not enabled.

attributes.name: actual_send_timestamp

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the campaign was approved for execution by the campaign owner or marketing manager. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the campaign used in external systems and tracking URLs.

attributes.name: campaign_name

attributes.name: campaign_objective

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the campaign in its lifecycle: draft (being created), scheduled (ready to launch), active (currently running), paused (temporarily stopped), completed (finished), or cancelled (terminated).

attributes.name: campaign_type

attributes.name: communication_channel

attributes.name: completed_timestamp

attributes.name: frequency_cap_window_days
attributes.description: Time window in days over which the frequency cap limit is enforced. Null if frequency capping is not enabled.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_required

attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit GDPR consent is required from players before sending campaign messages. True for EU/EEA players under GDPR jurisdiction.

attributes.name: incentive_value

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: personalization_enabled

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency
