products.name: consent_record
products.description: Transactional record of each player's marketing-specific consent and communication preference state as captured by the marketing team for GDPR, COPPA, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM compliance in marketing communications. Captures player reference, consent type (email-marketing/push-notification/SMS/data-profiling-for-targeting/third-party-ad-sharing), consent status (granted/withdrawn/expired), consent timestamp, consent source (in-game-prompt/web-preference-center/app-store-ATT), withdrawal timestamp, age-verified flag, parental consent flag, jurisdiction, consent version, and legal basis reference. Scoped exclusively to marketing communication consent — distinct from player domain's account-level consent and platform domain's data processing agreements. Enables lawful basis documentation for all CRM sends, retargeting, and lookalike audience creation.
products.reference: GDPR Consent Record / COPPA Parental Consent

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing consent record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consent_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.consent_policy. Business justification: Each consent record implements a specific consent policy version. Direct policy enforcement link required for consent validity verification, withdrawal processing, and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: device_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the device (mobile, console, PC) from which the consent was provided. Used for cross-device consent tracking and attribution.
attributes.references: Apple IDFA Guidelines, Google AAID Policy

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game title in which the consent was collected. Enables game-specific consent tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that triggered the consent request or collection. Null if consent was collected outside of a specific campaign context.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who provided or withdrew consent. Links to the player master record.

attributes.name: player_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player segment or cohort to which this player belonged at the time of consent. Enables segment-level consent analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: tournament_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.tournament. Business justification: Consent collected during tournament registrations, watch parties, and promotional activations requires tournament context for compliance auditing, data retention policies, and GDPR/COPPA documentation

attributes.name: age_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the players age has been verified at the time of consent collection. True if age verification was completed; False otherwise. Critical for COPPA compliance.

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The mobile attribution platform or system that recorded the consent event. Relevant for consent collected during install attribution flows.
attributes.references: AppsFlyer SDK Documentation, Adjust SDK Documentation

attributes.name: consent_collection_context
attributes.description: Free-text description of the context or scenario in which consent was collected (e.g., first-time user experience, account settings update, post-purchase prompt). Provides qualitative insight for consent UX optimization.

attributes.name: consent_granularity_level
attributes.description: Defines the level of granularity at which consent was collected. All-marketing is a blanket consent; category-specific allows per-category control; channel-specific allows per-channel control; partner-specific allows per-partner control.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(2), Privacy by Design Principles

attributes.name: consent_language
attributes.description: The language in which the consent prompt or preference center was presented to the player. Uses ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: en|es|fr|de|ja|ko|pt|zh|it|ru|pl|nl|sv|tr|ar — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The user interface mechanism through which consent was captured. Explicit opt-in requires active player action; implicit opt-in assumes consent unless declined; pre-checked box is generally non-compliant under GDPR.

attributes.name: consent_proof_document_url
attributes.description: URL or reference to stored documentation proving consent was obtained (e.g., screenshot, signed form, email confirmation). Provides audit trail for regulatory inquiries.

attributes.name: consent_renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent requires periodic renewal or re-confirmation. True if renewal is required; False for perpetual consent until withdrawn.
attributes.references: Internal Consent Management Policy, GDPR Best Practices

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of the consent grant. Global applies across all games and platforms; regional applies to a specific geographic region; game-specific applies to a single title; platform-specific applies to one platform.

attributes.name: consent_source
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the player provided or modified their consent. Tracks the origin of the consent action for audit and compliance purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in-game-prompt|web-preference-center|app-store-ATT|mobile-app-onboarding|email-link|customer-support|API — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1), Apple App Tracking Transparency Framework

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current state of the consent. Granted indicates active permission; withdrawn indicates player has revoked consent; expired indicates consent has passed its validity period; pending indicates consent request awaiting player action; revoked indicates administratively cancelled consent.

attributes.name: consent_text_snapshot
attributes.description: A snapshot or reference to the exact consent language and terms that were presented to the player at the time of consent. Provides audit trail for what the player agreed to.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the player granted consent for this specific marketing communication type. Represents the principal business event time for this consent record.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The specific type of marketing communication or data processing activity for which consent is being recorded. Defines the scope of the consent grant or withdrawal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6, CCPA Section 1798.100, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent language, terms, or privacy policy that was presented to the player at the time of consent. Enables tracking of consent under different policy versions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1), Internal Consent Management Policy

attributes.name: data_retention_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days this consent record and associated player data should be retained before deletion or anonymization. Supports GDPR right to erasure and data minimization principles.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e), Internal Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent was confirmed through a double opt-in process (e.g., email confirmation link). True if double opt-in was completed; False for single opt-in.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act, Email Marketing Best Practices

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record expires and is no longer valid for marketing use. Null for consents without expiration.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the consent action was initiated. Used for fraud detection and geographic validation. May be considered PII in certain jurisdictions.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record is currently active and should be honored for marketing operations. True if active; False if superseded, archived, or invalidated.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction or country under which this consent was collected, determining applicable privacy regulations. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|GBR|DEU|FRA|JPN|KOR|CAN|AUS|BRA|MEX|ITA|ESP|NLD|SWE|POL|CHN — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 for processing the players data for this marketing activity. Typically consent for marketing communications, but may include legitimate interest for certain profiling activities.

attributes.name: parental_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental or guardian consent was obtained for players under the age of digital consent. True if parental consent was provided; False otherwise. Required for minors under COPPA and GDPR.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The gaming platform or operating system through which the consent was collected. Relevant for platform-specific consent requirements such as Apple ATT. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iOS|Android|PC|PlayStation|Xbox|Nintendo-Switch|Web|Steam|Epic-Games-Store — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Apple App Tracking Transparency, Google Play Data Safety

attributes.name: preference_center_url
attributes.description: URL of the preference center or consent management interface where the player can view or modify their consent settings. Provides transparency and easy access to consent controls.

attributes.name: privacy_policy_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privacy policy that was in effect and presented to the player at the time of consent. Tracks consent under different policy iterations.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was first created in the data system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent record was last modified. Audit field for tracking consent state changes over time.

attributes.name: salesforce_contact_reference
attributes.description: External identifier linking this consent record to the corresponding Contact record in Salesforce CRM. Enables synchronization of consent state with CRM for lifecycle campaigns.

attributes.name: third_party_processor
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the third-party data processor or advertising partner for whom consent was granted. Relevant for third-party-ad-sharing consent type.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The browser or application user agent string from which the consent was submitted. Used for technical audit and fraud detection.

attributes.name: withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the player withdrew their previously granted consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_sync_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: size

products.name: campaign_exposure
products.description: This association product represents the exposure event between player_account and campaign. It captures every instance when a player is exposed to a marketing campaign across any channel (paid social, display, search, video, influencer, CRM lifecycle). Each record links one player_account to one campaign with attributes that track exposure timing, channel, frequency, engagement (clicks), and attribution outcomes. This is the operational foundation for multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing, frequency capping, and campaign performance measurement in the marketing domain.. Existence Justification: In gaming marketing operations, players are exposed to multiple campaigns throughout their lifecycle (UA at acquisition, retargeting during dormancy, CRM campaigns during active play, re-engagement campaigns post-churn), and each campaign reaches millions of players across multiple channels. Marketing teams actively manage and query campaign exposure data as an operational entity for multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing, frequency capping enforcement, and cross-channel journey analysis. This is not an analytical correlation—exposure tracking is a core operational process in mobile attribution platforms (AppsFlyer, Adjust) and marketing analytics systems.

attributes.name: campaign_exposure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each campaign exposure event. Primary key for the campaign_exposure association.

attributes.name: creative_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific creative asset shown to the player during this exposure. Used for creative-level performance analysis and A/B testing.

attributes.name: impression_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ad impression from the attribution partner (AppsFlyer, Adjust) or ad platform. Used for reconciliation with ad platform reporting and fraud detection.

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the marketing campaign that the player was exposed to. Enables campaign-level reach, frequency, and conversion analysis.

attributes.name: placement_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the ad placement or inventory position where the creative was shown. Used for placement-level performance optimization.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the player account who was exposed to the campaign. Enables player-level campaign journey analysis and cross-campaign frequency capping.

attributes.name: attributed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exposure received attribution credit for a conversion under the current attribution model (last-touch, first-touch, linear, time-decay, or data-driven). Used for campaign ROI calculation and budget allocation decisions.

attributes.name: click_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player clicked on the campaign creative following this exposure. Nullable if exposure did not result in a click. Used for click-through rate calculation and engagement analysis.

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player completed the target conversion action (install, registration, purchase, re-engagement) attributed to this exposure. Nullable if no conversion occurred within the attribution window. Used for conversion rate and time-to-conversion analysis.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device on which the player was exposed to the campaign. Used for device-level targeting and cross-device attribution analysis.

attributes.name: exposure_channel
attributes.description: The specific marketing channel through which the player was exposed to the campaign. Used for channel-level attribution and cross-channel journey analysis.

attributes.name: exposure_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times this player has been exposed to this specific campaign up to this exposure event. Used for frequency capping enforcement and diminishing returns analysis.

attributes.name: exposure_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the player was exposed to the campaign creative. Used for time-to-conversion analysis, multi-touch attribution sequencing, and frequency capping windows.

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the player's location at the time of exposure. Used for geo-level campaign performance analysis.

products.name: creative_test_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of advertising creative assets to A/B experiment variants. It captures which creative serves as which test variant in which experiment, tracking performance allocation and test lifecycle dates. Each record links one ad_creative to one ab_experiment with attributes that exist only in the context of this experimental assignment.. Existence Justification: In gaming user acquisition, creative testing is a core operational process where marketing teams actively manage which advertising creatives serve as which variants in which A/B experiments. One creative asset can be tested across multiple experiments (different audience segments, different games, different time periods), and one experiment tests multiple creative variants simultaneously (A/B/C/D creative tests). The assignment of creative-to-variant-to-experiment is an operational record that marketing teams create, monitor, and update.

attributes.name: creative_test_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this creative-to-experiment assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ab_experiment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Creative Test Assignment - Ab Experiment Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the A/B experiment in which this creative is being tested

attributes.name: ad_creative_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Creative Test Assignment - Ad Creative Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the advertising creative asset being tested in this experiment

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: Identifier for the A/B test variant if this creative is part of a multivariate test. Null if not part of a test. Used for performance comparison and optimization. [Moved from ad_creative: This attribute currently stores the variant label for a creative, but variant assignment is specific to a particular experiment. A creative can be control in one experiment and variant_A in another. This attribute belongs in the association, not on the creative master record.]

attributes.name: assigned_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the marketing team member who assigned this creative to this experiment variant. Used for accountability and workflow tracking.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when this creative was assigned to this experiment variant in the test management system. Distinct from test_start_date (when it began serving).

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current status of this creative assignment within the experiment. Tracks whether the creative is actively serving, paused, completed testing, or removed from the test.

attributes.name: impressions_allocated
attributes.description: Number of ad impressions allocated to this creative within this experiment variant. Used for traffic allocation tracking and performance normalization.

attributes.name: is_ab_test_control
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this creative is the control variant in an A/B test. True if control, false if treatment or not part of a test. [Moved from ad_creative: This boolean flag indicates control status, but control designation is experiment-specific. The same creative can be control in one test and a treatment variant in another. This should be derived from variant_label in the association, not stored on the creative.]

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Categorical assessment of this creative's performance within the experiment (top_performer, average, underperformer, not_evaluated). Used for creative optimization decisions.

attributes.name: test_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific creative stopped serving in this experiment variant. Null if still active. Used to track creative rotation and test lifecycle.

attributes.name: test_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific creative began serving in this experiment variant. May differ from the overall experiment start date if creatives are rotated or added mid-test.

attributes.name: variant_label
attributes.description: The experiment variant identifier for this creative (e.g., control, variant_A, variant_B, treatment_1). Identifies which arm of the experiment this creative represents.

products.name: campaign_promo_distribution
products.description: This association product represents the distribution relationship between CRM lifecycle marketing campaigns and promotional discount codes. It captures which promo codes are distributed through which campaigns, enabling multi-channel distribution of the same code and multi-code distribution within a single campaign. Each record links one campaign to one promo code with distribution-specific attributes including channel, target segment, activation timing, redemption caps, and performance tier that exist only in the context of this campaign-code pairing.. Existence Justification: Gaming marketing operations distribute promotional codes through multiple CRM campaigns with channel-specific and segment-specific configurations. A single promo code (e.g., SAVE20) can be distributed via email campaign, push notification campaign, and SMS campaign simultaneously, each targeting different player segments with different redemption caps and performance tracking. Conversely, a single winback campaign may distribute multiple tier-specific promo codes (BRONZE10, SILVER20, GOLD30) to different player segments. This is an operational distribution management relationship, not an analytical correlation.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this campaign-promo code distribution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_promo_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Campaign Promo Distribution - Billing Promo Code Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the promotional discount code being distributed through this campaign

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing team member who created this campaign-promo distribution configuration.

attributes.name: crm_campaign_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Campaign Promo Distribution - Crm Campaign Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the CRM lifecycle marketing campaign that distributes this promo code

attributes.name: target_segment_id
attributes.description: The player segment targeted for this specific campaign-code pairing. Same code may target different segments when distributed through different campaigns (e.g., at-risk players in winback campaign, active players in upsell campaign).

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The date when this promo code becomes active for distribution through this specific campaign. Allows staggered activation of the same code across multiple campaigns.

attributes.name: actual_distribution_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when this promo code was distributed through this campaign. Used for performance analysis and attribution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign-promo distribution record was created.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The specific communication channel through which this promo code is distributed in this campaign. Same code may be distributed via different channels in different campaigns (e.g., SAVE20 via email in one campaign, via SMS in another).

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this campaign-code distribution. Allows independent lifecycle management of each campaign-code pairing.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: The performance or priority tier assigned to this campaign-code distribution for A/B testing, budget allocation, or VIP treatment. Same code may have different performance tiers when distributed through different campaigns.

attributes.name: redemption_cap
attributes.description: The maximum number of redemptions allocated to this campaign-code pairing. Enables budget control and performance tracking per distribution channel. Sum of all campaign-specific caps may equal or be less than the promo code's global max_redemption_count.

attributes.name: redemption_count_from_campaign
attributes.description: The number of redemptions of this promo code that are attributed to this specific campaign distribution. Enables campaign ROI measurement and channel performance comparison.

attributes.name: total_discount_attributed_usd
attributes.description: The cumulative discount amount in USD attributed to redemptions from this campaign-code distribution. Used for campaign cost tracking and ROI calculation.

attributes.name: device_platforms
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of device platforms targeted (e.g., mobile, desktop, tablet, iOS, Android).

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the ad set is scheduled to stop running. Null indicates no end date (continuous run).

attributes.name: external_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the external advertising platform (e.g., Facebook Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Unity Ads) for this ad set.

attributes.name: frequency_cap
attributes.description: Maximum number of times an individual user should see ads from this ad set within a specified time period.

attributes.name: frequency_cap_period_hours
attributes.description: Time period in hours over which the frequency cap is applied.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender targeting criteria for the ad set audience.

attributes.name: geo_locations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or JSON array of geographic locations (countries, regions, cities, postal codes) targeted by this ad set.

attributes.name: is_autobid
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic bidding is enabled for this ad set (true) or manual bidding is used (false).

attributes.name: lifetime_budget
attributes.description: Total maximum amount allocated to be spent over the entire lifetime of this ad set in the campaign currency.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the ad set for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this ad set for internal team reference and documentation.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Primary marketing objective that this ad set is optimized to achieve (e.g., app installs, brand awareness, conversions).

attributes.name: optimization_goal
attributes.description: Specific metric or event that the ad delivery algorithm is optimizing for (e.g., install, click, impression, ROAS, value).

attributes.name: pacing_type
attributes.description: Strategy for how the ad set budget is spent over time (standard pacing spreads budget evenly, accelerated spends as quickly as possible).

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether ad placements are automatically optimized by the platform or manually selected.

attributes.name: placements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or JSON array of specific ad placement positions (e.g., feed, stories, in-stream, audience network, rewarded video).

attributes.name: promoted_object_reference
attributes.description: External identifier of the specific object being promoted (e.g., app store ID, Facebook page ID, event ID).

attributes.name: promoted_object_type
attributes.description: Type of object being promoted by this ad set (e.g., app, page, event, product catalog, offer).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the ad set is scheduled to begin running and serving ads.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the ad set in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: targeting_spec
attributes.description: JSON or structured text representation of audience targeting criteria including demographics, interests, behaviors, and custom audiences.

attributes.name: tracking_url_template
attributes.description: Template URL with macros for third-party tracking and attribution (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch) to measure campaign performance.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the marketing team member who last updated this ad set.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad set record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the marketing team member who created this ad set.

attributes.name: parent_ad_set_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ad_set (parent_ad_set_id)

products.name: message_template
products.description: Master reference table for message_template. Referenced by message_template_id.

attributes.name: message_template_id
attributes.description: Primary key for message_template

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this template for production use in marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing user or system account that created this message template.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title that this message template is associated with. Links to the game product catalog.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Modified By User Employee Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing user or system account that last modified this message template.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: Variant identifier for A/B or multivariate testing, indicating which version of the template this represents (e.g., control, variant_a, variant_b).

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this message template was approved for use in production campaigns.

attributes.name: body_content
attributes.description: Main message body content including text, HTML markup, and personalization tokens. Contains the core message delivered to the player.

attributes.name: call_to_action_text
attributes.description: Text displayed on the primary call-to-action button or link within the message template.

attributes.name: call_to_action_url
attributes.description: Target URL or deep link for the primary call-to-action, directing players to specific game features, store pages, or promotional content.

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Type of marketing campaign this template is designed for (user acquisition, retention, monetization, event promotion, seasonal, lifecycle).

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the template was last reviewed for compliance with applicable regulations and marketing standards.

attributes.name: compliance_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the template has been reviewed and approved by legal/compliance teams for regulatory adherence (GDPR, COPPA, CAN-SPAM).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this message template record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this template should no longer be used for new campaigns, typically for time-sensitive promotional content.

attributes.name: frequency_cap_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours that must elapse between sending this template to the same player to prevent message fatigue.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (with optional ISO 3166-1 country code) indicating the language of the template content (e.g., en, en-US, ja-JP).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this message template record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Player lifecycle stage that this template targets (onboarding, active, at-risk, churned, dormant, VIP).

attributes.name: localization_key
attributes.description: Reference key used to link this template to localized versions in other languages for multi-language campaign support.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments about the template usage, performance observations, or special instructions for campaign managers.

attributes.name: personalization_tokens
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of personalization tokens used in the template (e.g., player_name, level, currency_balance) for dynamic content insertion.

attributes.name: preheader_text
attributes.description: Preview text displayed in email clients before the message is opened, used to increase open rates.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level of the message template used for send queue ordering and delivery scheduling (low, medium, high, critical).

attributes.name: reply_to_email
attributes.description: Email address where player replies will be directed. May differ from sender email for support routing.

attributes.name: send_time_optimization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether send-time optimization is enabled for this template to deliver messages at optimal engagement times per player.

attributes.name: sender_email
attributes.description: Email address used as the from address for email templates. Must be a verified sending domain.

attributes.name: sender_name
attributes.description: Display name shown as the sender of the message (e.g., game title, studio name, or character name).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the message template indicating whether it is available for use in campaigns.

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: Subject line text for email templates or title text for push notifications. May contain personalization tokens.

attributes.name: target_platform
attributes.description: Gaming platform that this template is optimized for (iOS, Android, web, console, PC, or cross-platform).

attributes.name: template_category
attributes.description: Marketing category classification indicating the primary business purpose of the template (acquisition, retention, reactivation, monetization, engagement, transactional).

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the message template, used for external references and API integrations.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the message template used for identification and selection in campaign management systems.

attributes.name: template_type
attributes.description: Classification of the message template by delivery channel (email, push notification, in-app message, SMS, web push, direct mail).

attributes.name: tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether open tracking, click tracking, and conversion tracking are enabled for messages sent using this template.

attributes.name: unsubscribe_link_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an unsubscribe link must be included in messages sent using this template for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: UTM campaign parameter value appended to links in the template for attribution tracking in analytics platforms.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: UTM medium parameter value identifying the marketing medium (e.g., lifecycle, promotional, transactional) for attribution tracking.

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: UTM source parameter value identifying the traffic source (e.g., email, push, sms) for attribution tracking.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the template, incremented with each modification to maintain template history and rollback capability.

attributes.name: derived_from_message_template_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on message_template (derived_from_message_template_id)

products.name: suppression_list
products.description: Master reference table for suppression_list. Referenced by suppression_list_id.

attributes.name: suppression_list_id
attributes.description: Primary key for suppression_list

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific marketing campaign from which this player is suppressed. Nullable if suppression applies globally.

attributes.name: device_id
attributes.description: Mobile device identifier (IDFA, GAID, or other device fingerprint) to be suppressed from in-app and mobile advertising.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that created this suppression entry.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific game title for which this suppression applies. Nullable if suppression is cross-game or portfolio-wide.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Modified By User Employee Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that last modified this suppression entry.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the player being suppressed from marketing communications.

attributes.name: advertising_identifier
attributes.description: Platform-specific advertising identifier (Apple IDFA, Google AAID) used for attribution and suppression in paid user acquisition campaigns.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Marketing channel to which this suppression applies (email, SMS, push notification, in-app message, display ads, social media, video ads, search ads, affiliate, influencer).

attributes.name: consent_withdrawn_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the player withdrew marketing consent, triggering this suppression entry.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this suppression list entry was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this suppression list expires or is no longer enforced. Nullable for open-ended suppression.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this suppression list becomes active and begins blocking marketing communications.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the player to be suppressed from email marketing campaigns.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market to which this suppression applies (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'JPN'). Uses 3-letter ISO country codes. Nullable if suppression is global.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this suppression entry is currently active and being enforced in marketing systems.

attributes.name: is_permanent
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this suppression is permanent (true) or temporary/time-bound (false).

attributes.name: last_contact_attempt_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the last marketing contact attempt before suppression was applied.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this suppression list entry was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: Legal or regulatory basis for the suppression (GDPR Article 21 right to object, CCPA opt-out, CAN-SPAM, TCPA, CASL, LGPD, or other jurisdiction-specific regulation).

attributes.name: list_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code or identifier for this suppression list, used for integration with marketing automation platforms (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Salesforce).

attributes.name: list_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for this suppression list (e.g., 'Unsubscribed Users', 'GDPR Opt-Out', 'High-Value VIP Exclusion').

attributes.name: list_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the suppression list purpose (opt-out, unsubscribe, regulatory compliance, internal exclusion, VIP exclusion, fraud prevention, test account).

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile phone number to be suppressed from SMS and push notification campaigns.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about this suppression entry (e.g., customer service ticket reference, special handling instructions).

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Gaming platform to which this suppression applies (iOS, Android, web, console, PC, or all platforms).

attributes.name: reactivation_eligible_date
attributes.description: Date when the player becomes eligible for re-engagement or reactivation campaigns, if applicable. Nullable for permanent suppressions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the suppression list (active, inactive, archived, pending activation).

attributes.name: suppression_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for this suppression rule when multiple rules conflict (higher number = higher priority). Used for rule resolution in marketing automation systems.

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for adding this entry to the suppression list (user request, regulatory compliance, fraud prevention, internal policy, VIP exclusion, test account, data quality issue).

attributes.name: suppression_scope
attributes.description: Scope of the suppression rule (global across all marketing, game-specific, campaign-specific, or channel-specific).

attributes.name: suppression_source
attributes.description: System or channel through which the suppression request originated (Salesforce CRM, AppsFlyer, Adjust, manual entry, API, batch import, player self-service portal).

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of identity or contact verification for this suppression entry (verified, pending verification, unverified, or bounced/invalid contact).

attributes.name: parent_suppression_list_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on suppression_list (parent_suppression_list_id)

domains.name: licensing
domains.description: Manages IP licensing, game engine technology licensing (Unity/Unreal SDK deals), third-party middleware agreements, music/art asset licensing, franchise/brand partnership contracts, royalty calculation schedules, licensee entitlements, and compliance with IP ownership terms and rating board requirements. Supports both outbound engine licensing revenue and inbound licensed IP usage.

products.name: iap_transaction
products.description: Core transactional record of every In-App Purchase (IAP) event executed by a player across all platforms (iOS, Android, console, PC storefronts). Captures SKU purchased (FK to mtx_catalog), gross/net revenue, storefront, payment method, currency, exchange rate, platform fee, net proceeds, refund eligibility window, receipt token, transaction status, and offer attribution (offer_campaign_id, discount applied, F2P conversion flag). The authoritative SSOT for individual IAP revenue events — distinct from billing domain payment processing records. Feeds ARPU, ARPPU, DAP, and offer conversion rate calculations.

attributes.name: iap_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each In-App Purchase (IAP) transaction event recorded in the monetization platform. Globally unique across all platforms and storefronts. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.build. Business justification: IAP transactions occur within specific game builds. Tracking build version at purchase time is critical for fraud detection (exploit identification by build), A/B test attribution, platform certificat

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: IAP transactions post to specific GL accounts defined in chart of accounts. GL posting requirement for revenue account mapping.

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Track which content version was live during purchase for customer support, refund handling, and version-specific entitlement issues. Critical for troubleshooting IAP problems post-patch.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: IAP transactions attributed to cost centers by game title/platform/studio for P&L analysis. Management accounting requirement for profitability tracking.

attributes.name: finance_tax_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_tax_record. Business justification: IAP transactions generate tax obligations by jurisdiction. Tax compliance requirement for VAT/sales tax calculation and remittance.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title within which the IAP transaction was executed. Enables per-title revenue reporting and cross-title monetization analysis.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Every IAP transaction must post to general ledger for revenue recognition and financial reporting. Core accounting requirement for ASC 606/IFRS 15 compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: granted_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: Direct asset purchases (character skins, weapon skins) via IAP require linking transaction to granted content for entitlement tracking, refund processing, and inventory management.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: IAP transactions generate invoices for revenue recognition, tax compliance, and financial reporting. Gaming companies must reconcile IAP revenue with invoices for audit trails and regulatory filings (

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: IAP transactions generate journal entries for revenue posting. Standard accounting flow linking monetization events to financial records for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Every IAP transaction occurs in a specific regulatory jurisdiction determining tax treatment, age restrictions, loot box regulations, and revenue recognition rules. Essential for regional compliance r

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: IAP transactions booked to specific legal entities based on storefront/jurisdiction. Legal entity accounting requirement for multi-entity revenue recognition.

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: IAP transactions for licensed content (Marvel characters, Star Wars items) require IP attribution for royalty calculation and revenue reporting to licensors. Critical for automated royalty accrual in

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the MTX catalog entry representing the SKU purchased (e.g., virtual currency pack, DLC, battle pass, loot box, cosmetic item). Authoritative link to the item definition and pricing.

attributes.name: network_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.network_region. Business justification: Revenue reporting by geographic region, tax jurisdiction compliance (VAT, sales tax), regional pricing strategy analysis, and infrastructure cost allocation require linking purchases to network region

attributes.name: offer_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional offer or marketing campaign that was active at the time of purchase. Used to measure offer conversion rates and discount attribution. Nullable when no campaign was applied.
attributes.references: Internal Campaign Management Standard; AppsFlyer/Adjust Attribution

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment. Business justification: Every IAP transaction has a corresponding payment record for settlement reconciliation, chargeback disputes, and refund processing. Payment gateway integration requires linking transactions to payment

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the player who executed the IAP transaction. Links to the player master record. Supports ARPU, ARPPU, DAP, LTV, and whale segmentation analytics. PARTY_REFERENCE category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; COPPA (FTC); Internal Player Identity Standard

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: IAP revenue must be attributed to profit centers for segment reporting. Core management accounting and financial reporting requirement.

attributes.name: royalty_accrual_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.royalty_accrual. Business justification: IAP transactions on licensed IP generate royalty obligations. Royalty accounting requirement for IP licensing agreements and payment processing.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the active game session during which the IAP transaction was initiated. Links purchase behavior to session context (session length, game mode, progression state) for behavioral monetization analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Player Behavior Analytics Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude

attributes.name: tournament_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.tournament. Business justification: Players purchase items during tournament viewing/participation. Tournament-driven IAP spikes are tracked for revenue attribution, promotional effectiveness analysis, and esports ROI measurement. Real

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The marketing channel or campaign source attributed to this IAP transaction by the mobile attribution platform (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust). Used for ROAS and CPI-to-LTV analysis. Examples: 'facebook_ads', 'google_uac', 'organic', 'influencer'. Null for non-attributed transactions.
attributes.references: AppsFlyer/Adjust Attribution Standard; Internal Marketing Analytics Standard

attributes.name: bonus_virtual_currency
attributes.description: Additional virtual currency awarded as a promotional bonus on top of the base virtual_currency_awarded (e.g., first-purchase bonus, limited-time offer bonus). Null when no bonus applies. Supports offer effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Management Standard; Internal Offer Management Standard

attributes.name: coppa_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Age Verification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player's age was verified as meeting the minimum age requirement (13+ in the US) prior to this IAP transaction, per COPPA compliance requirements. True = age verification passed. Critical for regulatory compliance and audit trails involving minor players.
attributes.references: COPPA (FTC); GDPR Article 8 (Children's Consent); Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IAP transaction record was first ingested into the Silver layer data platform. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. May differ from purchased_at due to pipeline latency.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the currency in which the player was charged (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET currency component. Enables multi-currency revenue reporting and FX analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used by the player to execute the IAP transaction. Supports device-mix revenue analysis and platform-specific monetization strategy.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of any promotional discount or offer reduction applied to the gross amount at the time of purchase. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Zero when no discount was applied.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the gross price for this transaction (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.20 for 20% off). Derived from the offer campaign. Zero when no discount was applied. Supports offer ROI and conversion rate analysis.

attributes.name: entitlement_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the purchased item or virtual currency has been successfully delivered and credited to the player's account. True = entitlement fulfilled; False = pending or failed delivery. Critical for player support and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Internal Entitlement Management Standard; Zendesk Player Support

attributes.name: entitlement_granted_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchased item or virtual currency was successfully delivered to the player's account. Enables latency measurement between payment confirmation and entitlement fulfillment. Null if entitlement has not yet been granted.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied at the time of transaction to convert the transaction currency to the company's functional reporting currency (USD). Enables consistent cross-currency revenue aggregation and FX impact analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates); SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The full retail price charged to the player before any platform fees, taxes, or discounts are applied. Expressed in the transaction currency. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used as the basis for gross revenue reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 (Revenue Recognition); SAP S/4HANA SD Module; PCI DSS

attributes.name: is_f2p_conversion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IAP transaction represents the player's first-ever purchase, converting them from a Free-to-Play (F2P) non-payer to a paying player. True = first purchase / F2P conversion event. Critical for F2P conversion rate KPI and funnel analysis.
attributes.references: Internal F2P Monetization Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Funnel Analytics

attributes.name: is_first_purchase
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the player's first IAP transaction within this specific game title (distinct from is_f2p_conversion which is cross-title). Supports per-title FTUE monetization analysis and first-purchase offer effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: is_whale
attributes.description: Indicates whether the purchasing player was classified as a 'whale' (high-spending player segment) at the time of this transaction, based on the company's LTV and spend segmentation model. Supports whale retention analysis and high-value player monetization reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Player Segmentation Standard; Internal LTV Model

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchased item by monetization category. Drives revenue mix reporting, P2W analysis, and regulatory compliance (e.g., loot box disclosure requirements). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: virtual_currency|dlc|battle_pass|loot_box|cosmetic|subscription|season_pass|consumable|durable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; PEGI; FTC Consumer Protection; Internal MTX Classification Standard

attributes.name: loot_box_regulatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IAP transaction involved a loot box or gacha mechanic subject to regulatory disclosure requirements (e.g., ESRB loot box labeling, Belgium/Netherlands gambling regulations). True = disclosure was presented to the player prior to purchase. Required for regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; PEGI; European Commission Digital Services Act; FTC Consumer Protection; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: net_proceeds_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue amount received by the publisher after deducting platform fees, taxes, and discounts from the gross amount. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET net total component. Primary metric for ARPU and ARPPU net revenue calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Internal Revenue Recognition Policy

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used by the player to complete the IAP (e.g., credit card, PayPal, platform wallet, gift card). Distinct from payment_channel. Used for payment mix analysis and fraud detection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay|platform_wallet|gift_card|bank_transfer — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The digital distribution platform or storefront through which the IAP was executed. Drives platform-specific revenue reporting, fee calculation, and certification compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ios|android|pc_steam|pc_epic|playstation|xbox|nintendo_switch|web — promote to reference product if additional platforms are added]
attributes.references: Steamworks SDK; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Console SDK TRC/TCR Standards

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee retained by the platform storefront (e.g., Apple 30%, Google 15-30%, Steam 30%) deducted from gross revenue. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Critical for net proceeds and margin calculations.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Steamworks SDK; IFRS 15

attributes.name: platform_fee_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.30 for 30%) charged by the platform storefront on this transaction. Varies by platform, developer tier, and subscription program (e.g., Apple Small Business Program at 15%). Enables fee rate variance analysis.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Steamworks SDK

attributes.name: player_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the player's registered billing country at the time of transaction. Used for geo-revenue reporting, tax jurisdiction determination, and regulatory compliance (GDPR, COPPA). Captured at transaction time to preserve historical accuracy.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 4; COPPA (FTC); PEGI; ESRB; Internal Tax Compliance Policy

attributes.name: player_level_at_purchase
attributes.description: The player's in-game progression level at the time of the IAP transaction. Enables purchase propensity analysis by progression stage and informs level-gated offer targeting strategies.

attributes.name: purchased_at
attributes.description: The precise real-world timestamp when the player initiated and confirmed the IAP purchase event on the storefront. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Primary time dimension for ARPU, ARPPU, and DAP calculations.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU purchased in this transaction. Typically 1 for most IAP events but may be greater for bundle purchases or multi-unit virtual currency packs.

attributes.name: receipt_token
attributes.description: Cryptographic receipt or validation token issued by the platform storefront to verify the authenticity of the IAP transaction (e.g., Apple App Store receipt, Google Play purchase token). Used for server-side receipt validation to prevent fraud and unauthorized entitlement grants.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; PCI DSS; Internal Anti-Fraud Standard

attributes.name: refund_eligible_until
attributes.description: The timestamp until which the player is eligible to request a refund for this IAP transaction, per platform policy and applicable consumer protection regulations. After this timestamp, refund requests may be declined. Null if the item is non-refundable.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; EU Consumer Rights Directive; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for the refund when transaction_status is 'refunded'. Supports refund root-cause analysis and fraud detection. Null when no refund has been issued.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; FTC Consumer Protection; Internal Refund Policy

attributes.name: refunded_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when a refund was processed for this IAP transaction. Null if no refund has been issued. Used for refund rate tracking, revenue reversal accounting, and chargeback analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; PCI DSS

attributes.name: reporting_currency_amount
attributes.description: Net proceeds amount converted to the company's functional reporting currency (USD) using the exchange_rate at transaction time. Enables standardized global revenue aggregation for ARPU, ARPPU, and LTV calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Internal FX Policy

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The platform-specific SKU identifier for the purchased item as registered in the storefront (e.g., Apple App Store product ID, Google Play SKU, Steam item ID). Complements mtx_catalog_id with the external storefront identifier for reconciliation.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Steamworks SDK; Internal MTX Catalog Standard

attributes.name: storefront_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The externally-known transaction identifier issued by the platform storefront (e.g., Apple App Store order ID, Google Play order ID, Steam transaction ID, PlayStation Store transaction ID). BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for receipt validation, dispute resolution, and platform reconciliation.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Steamworks SDK; PCI DSS

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax component (VAT, GST, sales tax) included in or added to the gross purchase amount, as applicable by jurisdiction. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component. Required for financial reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; EU VAT Directive; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the IAP transaction. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. 'completed' = payment confirmed and entitlement granted; 'pending' = awaiting payment confirmation; 'failed' = payment declined or error; 'refunded' = reversal processed; 'disputed' = chargeback or player dispute raised; 'cancelled' = voided before completion.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this IAP transaction record (e.g., status change from pending to completed, refund processing). RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_awarded
attributes.description: The amount of in-game virtual currency (e.g., gems, coins, gold) credited to the player's account as a result of this IAP. Null for non-currency item purchases. Essential for virtual economy balance tracking and sink/source analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Management Standard; FTC Consumer Protection

products.name: virtual_currency_account
products.description: Master ledger account tracking a player's virtual currency balances across all in-game economies (hard currency, soft currency, premium tokens, event coins). Stores current balance, lifetime earned/spent totals, last transaction timestamp, currency type, game title scope, and account status. The SSOT for a player's virtual wallet state — distinct from real-money payment records in billing. Balances are reconcilable against virtual_currency_ledger entries.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the virtual currency account record. Primary key for the master ledger account tracking a player's virtual currency wallet state.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Player billing accounts track payment methods, fraud scores, and dunning status for virtual currency purchases. Linking VC accounts to billing accounts enables payment instrument management and fraud

attributes.name: economy_config_id
attributes.description: Reference to the virtual economy configuration that governs this account's currency rules, earn rates, spend caps, and exchange rates. Allows multiple economy configurations per game title (e.g., standard vs. event economy).

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title that scopes this virtual currency account. A player may hold separate accounts per game title (e.g., separate wallets for different games in the portfolio).

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who owns this virtual currency account. Links the wallet to the player master record.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution platform (e.g., PlayStation, Xbox, Steam, iOS, Android) on which this virtual currency account is registered. Platform scope determines applicable store policies, IAP processing rules, and certification requirements.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this virtual currency account was permanently closed or deactivated. Null for active accounts. Populated upon player account deletion, GDPR erasure request, or game title sunset.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); Internal Monetization Standards

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the virtual currency account, used in player-facing support, reconciliation, and audit workflows. Distinct from the surrogate primary key.

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this virtual currency account was first created, typically coinciding with the player's first login or registration for the associated game title. Used as the effective start date for the account lifecycle.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation)

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the virtual currency account. Active accounts allow normal earn/spend operations. Suspended accounts are temporarily blocked (e.g., fraud investigation). Frozen accounts are locked by compliance or legal hold. Closed accounts are permanently deactivated. Pending review accounts are under fraud or abuse assessment.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: balance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current virtual currency balance (or a portion thereof) expires if unused. Applicable for event coins, promotional currencies, and time-limited battle pass tokens. Null for non-expiring currencies.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: conversion_status
attributes.description: Tracks whether the player has ever converted from Free-to-Play (F2P) to a paying user via IAP on this account. Supports F2P conversion funnel analytics and re-engagement campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Funnel Analytics; AppsFlyer/Adjust Attribution

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this virtual currency account record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for the Silver Layer lakehouse record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Short uppercase alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the virtual currency denomination within the game economy (e.g., 'GEM', 'GOLD', 'BTKN'). Used in ledger entries and API payloads.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Event Schema

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the virtual currency as shown to players in-game (e.g., 'Gems', 'Gold Coins', 'Battle Tokens'). Used for player-facing UI and reporting.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the virtual currency held in this account. Hard currency is typically purchased with real money (e.g., gems, coins bought via IAP). Soft currency is earned through gameplay (e.g., gold, XP coins). Premium tokens are tied to specific premium content. Event coins are limited-time event currencies. Battle pass tokens are entitlement-linked currencies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hard_currency|soft_currency|premium_token|event_coin|battle_pass_token|season_pass_token|loyalty_point — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The real-time current balance of virtual currency units held in this account. This is the authoritative SSOT for the player's wallet state and must be reconcilable against the virtual_currency_ledger. Stored with 4 decimal places to support fractional currency economies.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: data_residency_region
attributes.description: Geographic region where this account's data must be stored and processed to comply with data sovereignty and residency regulations (e.g., GDPR requires EU data to remain in EU). Drives lakehouse partition and storage routing decisions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44 (Data Transfers); European Commission Digital Services Act; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: earn_cap_daily
attributes.description: Maximum virtual currency units that can be credited to this account within a single calendar day from gameplay rewards. Prevents exploit-based economy inflation and bot farming abuse.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Standards

attributes.name: first_purchase_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the player's first real-money In-App Purchase (IAP) that credited this virtual currency account. Null for F2P accounts that have never converted. Key metric for FTUE-to-purchase funnel analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Funnel Analytics

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator set to True when this account has been flagged for confirmed or suspected fraudulent activity (e.g., chargeback abuse, currency duplication, bot farming). Triggers account suspension workflow.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Prevention Policy; PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score (0.00–100.00) assigned to this account by the fraud detection system, reflecting the likelihood of fraudulent activity such as chargebacks, bot farming, or currency duplication exploits. Higher scores trigger manual review or automated suspension.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Prevention Policy; PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: gdpr_erasure_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether a GDPR Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten) request has been submitted for the player associated with this account. When True, the account must be scheduled for anonymization or deletion per GDPR Article 17 timelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: is_purchasable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency type can be acquired via real-money IAP. True for hard currencies; typically false for soft currencies earned through gameplay.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; Apple App Store Review Guidelines

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the virtual currency in this account is eligible for real-money refund upon player request or chargeback. Governs refund policy enforcement and PCI DSS chargeback handling.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; FTC Consumer Protection Standards; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the virtual currency in this account can be transferred to another player's account. Hard currencies purchased via IAP are typically non-transferable to prevent money laundering and P2W exploitation.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Standards; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: last_earn_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent credit (earn) event on this account, whether from IAP, gameplay reward, or promotion. Supports earn-vs-spend behavioral segmentation.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Event Schema

attributes.name: last_spend_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent debit (spend) event on this account. Used to identify high-frequency spenders (whales), compute time-to-first-purchase, and support MTX funnel analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Event Schema

attributes.name: last_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent credit or debit transaction applied to this virtual currency account. Used for dormancy detection, churn analysis, and D1/D7/D30 retention reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Event Schema

attributes.name: lifetime_earned
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all virtual currency units ever credited to this account since inception, including IAP purchases, gameplay rewards, promotions, and refunds. Used for LTV analysis and whale segmentation.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Cohort Analytics

attributes.name: lifetime_spent
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all virtual currency units ever debited from this account since inception, including MTX purchases, gacha pulls, DLC unlocks, and cosmetic purchases. Used for ARPPU and conversion rate analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Cohort Analytics

attributes.name: max_balance_cap
attributes.description: Maximum virtual currency units allowed to be held in this account at any point in time. Enforces economy balance controls and prevents hoarding that could destabilize the virtual economy.

attributes.name: minor_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder is classified as a minor (under 18, or under 13 for COPPA jurisdictions). Drives spend cap enforcement, parental consent requirements, and loot box/gacha access restrictions.
attributes.references: COPPA (FTC); GDPR Article 8; PEGI Age Rating Standards; ESRB Rating Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes entered by player support agents or compliance teams regarding this virtual currency account (e.g., manual balance adjustments, fraud investigation notes, legal hold reasons). Classified confidential due to potential sensitivity of support context.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; Zendesk Player Support Integration

attributes.name: parental_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental controls are active on this account, restricting IAP and spend capabilities. Required for COPPA compliance for accounts associated with minor players.
attributes.references: COPPA (FTC); GDPR Article 8 (Children's Consent); Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: pending_balance
attributes.description: Virtual currency units that have been credited but are not yet available for spending, typically due to IAP payment processing delays, chargeback hold periods, or promotional vesting schedules.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: player_segment
attributes.description: Monetization segment classification of the account holder based on spending behavior. F2P (Free-to-Play) players have never purchased. Minnow/Dolphin/Whale tiers reflect increasing spend levels. Used for ARPPU, DAP, and LTV segmentation analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Cohort Analytics

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version counter for this virtual currency account record, incremented on each update. Supports optimistic concurrency control and Silver Layer SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Delta Lake Standards

attributes.name: reserved_balance
attributes.description: Virtual currency units currently locked/reserved for in-progress transactions (e.g., a gacha pull in flight, a marketplace listing, or an auction bid). Prevents double-spend scenarios in concurrent transaction environments.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this virtual currency account record (e.g., 'GAMEANALYTICS', 'AMPLITUDE', 'SAP_S4', 'INTERNAL_WALLET'). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit trails.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GameAnalytics/Amplitude

attributes.name: spend_cap_daily
