attributes.description: Maximum virtual currency units that can be spent from this account within a single calendar day. Used for responsible gaming controls, fraud prevention, and COPPA-compliant spending limits for minor accounts.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; COPPA (FTC); European Commission Digital Services Act; GDPR Article 25 (Privacy by Design)

attributes.name: total_iap_purchase_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of real-money In-App Purchase (IAP) transactions that have credited this virtual currency account since inception. Used for purchase frequency analysis and whale identification.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standards; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Event Analytics

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this virtual currency account record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2

products.name: virtual_currency_ledger
products.description: Immutable transactional ledger recording every credit and debit to a player's virtual currency account. Each entry captures the currency type, delta amount, running balance, transaction source (IAP, reward, quest completion, gacha spend, battle pass grant), reference transaction ID, and timestamp. Enables full virtual economy audit trail and reconciliation of soft/hard currency flows.
products.reference: Virtual Currency Ledger / In-Game Economy Ledger

attributes.name: virtual_currency_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each immutable ledger entry recording a virtual currency credit or debit event for a player account.

attributes.name: achievement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the in-game quest or mission whose completion triggered this virtual currency reward credit. Null for non-quest-sourced entries. Enables quest economy reward analysis and player progression correlation.

attributes.name: battle_pass_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the battle pass season associated with this ledger entry when the transaction source is a battle pass grant or battle pass purchase. Enables battle pass economy contribution analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standard; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.build. Business justification: Virtual currency grants/spends occur within specific builds. Tracking build version supports economy balance analysis (currency flow by build), exploit detection (abnormal currency generation in speci

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Virtual currency movements may post to specific GL accounts. Accounting integration for virtual economy liability account mapping.

attributes.name: gacha_pool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the gacha or loot box pool that was activated when this ledger entry represents a gacha spend debit. Enables gacha economy spend analysis, pity counter tracking, and regulatory disclosure reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standard; ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines; PEGI; FTC

attributes.name: game_server_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution platform (e.g., PC, console, mobile) on which the virtual currency transaction occurred. Supports platform-level economy reporting.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title within whose virtual economy this ledger entry was recorded. Enables per-title currency economy analysis.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Virtual currency movements have accounting implications for deferred revenue recognition and liability tracking. Required for financial statement accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: iap_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating In-App Purchase (IAP) transaction record when this ledger entry was funded by a real-money purchase. Null for non-IAP sources.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Virtual currency movements may generate journal entries for liability adjustments. Accounting integration for virtual economy balance sheet impact.

attributes.name: offer_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional offer, bundle, or limited-time deal associated with this ledger entry. Enables offer performance analysis, conversion rate tracking, and bonus currency grant attribution.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standard; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment. Business justification: Virtual currency purchases via real money require payment linkage for refund processing, chargeback handling, and financial reconciliation. Ledger entries for paid VC must trace to payment records for

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the player whose virtual currency account is affected by this ledger entry. Links to the player master record.

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.promotion. Business justification: Promotions can grant virtual currency as rewards. The ledger should track when currency is awarded via promotional campaigns. Currently virtual_currency_ledger tracks offer_campaign_id but not promoti

attributes.name: reversal_reference_virtual_currency_ledger_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original ledger entry that this entry reverses, or to the reversal entry that corrects this entry. Null for non-reversal entries. Enables full audit chain reconstruction for refunds and administrative corrections.

attributes.name: reward_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: Currency ledger entries granting assets (quest rewards, achievement unlocks) need direct asset reference for reward delivery, player inventory updates, and economy balance tracking.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the player game session during which this virtual currency transaction occurred. Enables session-level economy analysis, session length correlation with spend, and fraud detection based on session anomalies.

attributes.name: title_sku_id
attributes.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) identifier of the in-game store item or bundle that was purchased or consumed in this transaction. Applicable for IAP-funded credits and MTX spend debits. Null for non-store transactions.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: tournament_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.tournament. Business justification: Tracks virtual currency earned/spent during tournament events (watch rewards, participation bonuses, tournament-themed purchases). Essential for tournament engagement economy analysis and reward distr

attributes.name: virtual_currency_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.virtual_currency_account. Business justification: Critical missing FK: Every virtual currency ledger entry MUST belong to a specific virtual currency account. The ledger records all credits/debits to accounts. Currently ledger has player_account_id,

attributes.name: balance_after
attributes.description: The player's running virtual currency balance for this currency code immediately after this ledger entry was applied. The authoritative post-transaction balance used for reconciliation and fraud detection.

attributes.name: balance_before
attributes.description: The player's virtual currency balance for this currency code immediately before this ledger entry was applied. Enables full audit trail reconstruction and balance reconciliation.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: The additional virtual currency units granted as a promotional bonus on top of the base delta_amount for this credit entry (e.g., 'Buy 1000 gems, get 200 free'). Null or zero for non-promotional entries. Enables bonus economy impact analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standard; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the player's registered or detected location at the time of the transaction. Used for geo-segmented economy analysis, regulatory compliance (GDPR, COPPA), and regional pricing strategy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this ledger record was first written to the data platform. Distinct from transaction_timestamp; used for data pipeline audit, SLA monitoring, and ingestion latency measurement.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the specific virtual currency denomination within the game (e.g., GEMS, GOLD, CRYSTALS, TOKENS). Enables multi-currency economy tracking within a single game title.

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the virtual currency as shown to players in-game (e.g., 'Gems', 'Gold Coins', 'Battle Tokens'). Used for player-facing reporting and support communications.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the virtual currency involved in this ledger entry. Hard currency is typically purchased with real money (e.g., gems, coins bought via IAP); soft currency is earned through gameplay (e.g., gold, XP tokens); premium currency bridges both; event and loyalty currencies are time-limited or reward-based.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Standard; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system or service that generated this ledger entry record. Enables data lineage tracking, source system reconciliation, and pipeline audit. Aligns with GameAnalytics, Amplitude, internal economy microservices, platform SDKs, or manual administrative entry.

attributes.name: delta_amount
attributes.description: The absolute change in virtual currency units for this ledger entry. Always a positive value; the entry_type field determines whether this is an addition or subtraction. Enables precise virtual economy flow analysis.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The category of device on which the player was playing when this virtual currency transaction occurred. Enables device-level economy analysis and cross-platform spend behavior reporting.

attributes.name: entry_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this ledger entry, used for audit trail reconciliation, player support lookups, and cross-system tracing. Sourced from the originating transaction system.

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ledger entry is a credit (addition of virtual currency to the player account) or a debit (deduction of virtual currency from the player account). Fundamental to double-entry virtual economy accounting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_to_usd
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the real_money_amount to USD at the time of the transaction. Used for normalized global revenue reporting and ARPU/ARPPU calculations in a common currency.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) at which the virtual currency units credited in this entry will expire and be removed from the player's balance, if applicable. Used for time-limited event currencies and promotional grants. Null for non-expiring currencies.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Standard; GDPR Article 5; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ledger entry has been flagged by the fraud detection system as potentially fraudulent (True) or clean (False). Flagged entries may be subject to manual review or automatic reversal. Supports virtual economy integrity monitoring.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; ISO/IEC 27001; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: fraud_review_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the fraud review process for this ledger entry. Not_reviewed: no review initiated; Under_review: active investigation; Cleared: reviewed and confirmed legitimate; Confirmed_fraud: verified fraudulent transaction requiring reversal and potential account action.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; ISO/IEC 27001; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: is_first_purchase
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ledger entry represents the player's first-ever real-money virtual currency purchase (True) or a repeat purchase (False). Critical for F2P conversion funnel analysis and first-purchase conversion rate reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Conversion Funnel

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ledger entry is a reversal of a previously posted entry (True) or an original transaction (False). Used to filter reversals from net economy flow calculations and to identify correction patterns.

attributes.name: ledger_entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this ledger entry. Posted entries are confirmed and applied to the player balance. Reversed entries have been corrected by a corresponding offsetting entry. Pending entries are awaiting confirmation. Failed entries did not complete. Voided entries were cancelled before posting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes added by a game operations administrator or automated system to provide additional context for this ledger entry, particularly for administrative adjustments, manual corrections, or escalated player support resolutions.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Zendesk Player Support

attributes.name: player_level_at_transaction
attributes.description: The player's in-game progression level at the time this virtual currency transaction occurred. Enables economy analysis segmented by player progression stage, supporting game balance tuning and monetization funnel optimization.

attributes.name: player_segment
attributes.description: Monetization segment of the player at the time of this transaction, based on historical spend behavior. Whale: top spenders; Dolphin: mid-tier payers; Minnow: low-spend payers; F2P Non-Payer: free-to-play players who have never paid; Lapsed Payer: previously paying players who have not spent recently. Supports ARPPU and LTV segmentation.

attributes.name: real_money_amount
attributes.description: The real-world fiat currency amount paid by the player to fund this virtual currency credit, applicable only for IAP-sourced entries. Used for ARPU, ARPPU, and LTV calculations and for revenue reconciliation against payment processor records.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: real_money_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter fiat currency code of the real-money amount paid for this IAP-funded virtual currency credit (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for non-IAP entries. Required for multi-currency revenue reporting and FX reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; PCI DSS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date (UTC) on which the virtual currency transaction occurred, derived from transaction_timestamp. Used as a partition key and for day-level aggregations including DAU spend analysis and D1/D7/D30 retention cohort currency flows.

attributes.name: transaction_source
attributes.description: The originating business event or mechanism that triggered this ledger entry. Classifies the economic source of every credit or debit for virtual economy analytics, monetization reporting, and fraud detection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iap|reward|quest_completion|gacha_spend|battle_pass_grant|daily_login|achievement|refund|admin_adjustment|season_pass|dlc_grant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Standard; FTC Advertising Guidelines; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: transaction_source_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the transaction source for roll-up analytics and reporting. Monetization covers IAP and real-money-funded events; gameplay_reward covers quest, achievement, and daily login grants; promotional covers battle pass and season pass grants; administrative covers manual adjustments; refund covers reversals.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Standard; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise real-world date and time (UTC) at which the virtual currency credit or debit event occurred in the game system. This is the principal business event time, distinct from the record ingestion timestamp. Conforms to yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; ISO/IEC 27001; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Event Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this ledger record was last modified in the data platform. For an immutable ledger, updates should be rare and limited to administrative corrections; tracked for audit compliance.

attributes.name: virtual_to_real_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Virtual Currency to Real Money Ratio
attributes.description: The conversion ratio between virtual currency units and real-world fiat currency at the time of this transaction (e.g., 100 gems = $0.99 USD). Captures the effective price per virtual currency unit for economy valuation and regulatory disclosure.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Standard; FTC Advertising Guidelines; ESRB

products.name: mtx_catalog
products.description: Master catalog of all microtransaction (MTX) offerings available for purchase across all game titles, including individual items, bundles, currency packs, DLC SKUs, loot box keys, and promo/gift code redeemable items. Defines each purchasable offering: SKU code, display name, item type (cosmetic, consumable, booster, currency_pack, loot_box_key, dlc, expansion, promo_code), base price, regional price overrides (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, KRW), platform fee percentage, promotional discount rules, effective pricing date ranges, currency rounding policy, platform availability flags, sale eligibility, content rating restrictions (ESRB/PEGI), release date, retirement date, and lifecycle status (active, deprecated, seasonal, delisted). The SSOT for what can be purchased and at what price — distinct from actual purchase transactions and distinct from virtual item definitions in the content domain.

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each microtransaction catalog entry in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the mtx_catalog product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a purchasable offering (product/SKU) the business sells to players.

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: MTX items launch with content drops for release coordination. Essential for SKU availability timing, version compatibility, and synchronized store/content updates in live service games.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: MTX catalog items attributed to cost centers for profitability analysis. Product costing requirement for margin analysis and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.dev_project. Business justification: MTX items are designed and versioned within development projects. Product managers track which project/build introduced each SKU for content pipeline management, revenue attribution to dev teams, and

attributes.name: display_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: MTX catalog items require visual assets (icons, 3D models, preview images) for storefront display. Essential for store UI rendering and player purchase decisions in live game economy.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.game_studio. Business justification: MTX items are created by specific studios (especially in multi-studio publishers). Tracking studio ownership supports royalty calculations (revenue share per studio), content attribution, and studio-l

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title to which this MTX offering belongs. Links the catalog entry to the specific game product in the Game Title domain, enabling per-title revenue analysis, ARPU/ARPPU segmentation, and title-level monetization reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Game Title Master Data; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Hierarchy

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Catalog items based on licensed IP (character skins, branded weapons) must track IP source for royalty rate application, marketing approval workflows, and content rating compliance per license terms.

attributes.name: name_localization_string_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.localization_string. Business justification: Store items require localized names/descriptions for international storefronts. Mandatory for global operations, regional compliance, and player-facing store UI in multiple languages.

attributes.name: age_restriction_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum player age in years required to purchase this MTX offering, derived from content_rating_esrb and content_rating_pegi classifications. Enforced at checkout for COPPA compliance (under-13 restrictions in USA) and GDPR child data protection requirements in EU (under-16 in some jurisdictions).
attributes.references: COPPA Enforcement (FTC); GDPR Article 8; ESRB Rating Standards; PEGI Rating Standards

attributes.name: base_price_usd
attributes.description: Canonical base retail price of the MTX offering denominated in US Dollars (USD). Serves as the reference price from which regional overrides and promotional discounts are derived. Used in ARPU, ARPPU, and LTV calculations. Maps to MASTER_RESOURCE category: MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE. Source of truth for SAP S/4HANA FI revenue recognition.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 USD; SAP S/4HANA FI Pricing; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: bundle_parent_sku_code
attributes.description: SKU code of the parent bundle offering if this item is a component of a larger bundle package. Null for standalone items. Enables bundle composition analysis, bundle vs. individual item revenue attribution, and bundle discount effectiveness reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Bill of Materials

attributes.name: content_rating_esrb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) Content Rating
attributes.description: ESRB content rating applicable to this MTX offering, restricting purchase eligibility for underage players in North American markets. Critical for COPPA compliance — items rated M or AO must enforce age-gate purchase restrictions. Sourced from ESRB rating submission records.
attributes.references: ESRB Rating Standards; COPPA Enforcement (FTC); Apple App Store Review Guidelines

attributes.name: content_rating_pegi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pan European Game Information (PEGI) Content Rating
attributes.description: PEGI content rating applicable to this MTX offering for European markets. Restricts purchase eligibility for underage players in EU/EEA jurisdictions. Items with PEGI 18 rating require age verification enforcement per GDPR and national consumer protection laws.
attributes.references: PEGI Rating Standards; GDPR Supervisory Authorities; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MTX catalog entry was first created in the system, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements, catalog versioning, and data lineage tracking in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Requirements; SOC 2 Type II Controls; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_rounding_policy
attributes.description: Defines the mathematical rounding rule applied when converting base_price_usd to regional currencies or when applying promotional discounts that result in fractional currency amounts. Ensures consistent pricing presentation across storefronts and compliance with local consumer protection pricing laws.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-1 Rounding; SAP S/4HANA FI Rounding Configuration

attributes.name: drm_protection_type
attributes.description: Type of Digital Rights Management (DRM) protection applied to this MTX offering to prevent unauthorized duplication or transfer of entitlements. 'platform_native' = Steam/PSN/Xbox DRM; 'entitlement_server' = proprietary server-side entitlement validation; 'none' = no DRM (e.g., promo codes).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; Internal DRM Policy; Steamworks DRM Documentation

attributes.name: drop_rate_disclosed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the probability/drop rate for randomized rewards within this MTX offering (e.g., loot box, gacha pull) has been publicly disclosed to players. Required for compliance with ESRB loot box disclosure policy, Chinese Ministry of Culture gacha regulations, and Apple App Store Review Guidelines Section 3.1.1.
attributes.references: ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Policy; Apple App Store Review Guidelines 3.1.1; Chinese Ministry of Culture Gacha Regulations

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this MTX catalog entry becomes available for purchase on storefronts. Defines the start of the offering's active pricing window. Used in time-series revenue analysis, seasonal campaign planning, and live operations (GaaS) scheduling.
attributes.references: Internal Live Operations Calendar; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Date

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this MTX catalog entry is no longer available for purchase. Null indicates the offering has no planned end date (evergreen). Drives storefront availability logic, seasonal item retirement workflows, and battle pass expiry enforcement.
attributes.references: Internal Live Operations Calendar; Apple App Store Review Guidelines

attributes.name: image_asset_path
attributes.description: CDN-relative path or URI to the primary promotional image asset for this MTX offering as displayed in the in-game store (e.g., '/assets/mtx/skins/dragon_pack_thumb.png'). Managed via Perforce Helix Core digital asset management. Used by storefront rendering pipeline.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Digital Asset Management; Internal CDN Asset Standards

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal business notes for monetization team use, capturing context about pricing decisions, promotional strategy rationale, or platform negotiation notes. Not exposed to players. Classified confidential as it may contain commercially sensitive pricing strategy information.

attributes.name: is_giftable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MTX offering can be purchased by one player and gifted to another player. Relevant for viral K-Factor mechanics and social gifting features. False for account-bound items, consumables with immediate activation, or items restricted by platform gifting policies.
attributes.references: Steamworks Gift API; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; COPPA Enforcement (FTC)

attributes.name: is_promo_code_redeemable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MTX offering can be obtained via promotional or gift code redemption (distinct from direct purchase). Supports marketing campaign attribution in AppsFlyer/Adjust and tracks promo code distribution economics separately from paid IAP revenue.
attributes.references: Internal Marketing Attribution Policy; AppsFlyer Promo Code Tracking

attributes.name: is_sale_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MTX offering is eligible to be included in promotional sale events (e.g., seasonal sales, platform-wide discount events). False for items with fixed pricing agreements (e.g., certain DLC with publisher pricing floors) or newly released items under launch price protection windows.
attributes.references: Internal Promotional Pricing Policy; Steamworks Partner Agreement

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed player-facing description of the MTX offering explaining its contents, benefits, and any restrictions. Used in storefront listings, player support knowledge base (Zendesk), and community management communications. Must comply with FTC truth-in-advertising standards.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Marketing Guidelines; Zendesk Knowledge Base Standards

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the purchasable offering defining its functional nature within the game economy. Drives monetization analytics segmentation (e.g., cosmetic vs. pay-to-win analysis), ESRB/PEGI disclosure requirements for loot boxes, and revenue recognition rules. Maps to MASTER_RESOURCE category: CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cosmetic|consumable|booster|currency_pack|loot_box_key|dlc|expansion|promo_code — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Policy; PEGI Interactive Elements; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the MTX catalog entry governing whether it is purchasable by players. 'active' = currently available for purchase; 'deprecated' = no longer sold but entitlements honored; 'seasonal' = available only during defined seasonal windows; 'delisted' = permanently removed from all storefronts. Maps to MASTER_RESOURCE category: LIFECYCLE_STATUS. Drives storefront availability logic and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Governance Policy; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: localization_key
attributes.description: Unique string key used to look up localized display_name and item_description translations in the game's localization system (e.g., 'mtx.skin.dragon.name'). Enables multi-language storefront support across global markets without duplicating catalog entries per locale.
attributes.references: Internal Localization Standards; Unity/Unreal Engine Localization Pipeline

attributes.name: loot_box_disclosure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MTX offering requires explicit loot box / randomized reward disclosure to players prior to purchase, as mandated by ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Policy, PEGI Interactive Elements labeling, and various national gambling regulations. True for item_type = loot_box_key or gacha mechanics.
attributes.references: ESRB Loot Box Disclosure Policy; PEGI Interactive Elements; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Belgian Gaming Commission

attributes.name: max_purchase_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single player account can purchase this MTX offering (e.g., limited edition items capped at 1 per account, or promotional packs capped at 3). Null indicates unlimited purchases. Enforced at transaction time to prevent abuse and maintain virtual economy balance.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Governance Policy; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: platform_availability
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of platform identifiers on which this MTX offering is available for purchase (e.g., 'steam|epic|psn|xbox|ios|android|switch'). Drives storefront availability logic across Steamworks, Epic Games Store, Console SDKs, and mobile app stores. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam|epic|psn|xbox|ios|android|switch|gog|amazon — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs Platform Distribution; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: platform_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the retail price retained by the distribution platform (e.g., Steam 30%, Epic Games Store 12%, Apple App Store 30%, Google Play 15-30%) as a marketplace commission. Used in net revenue calculations, ARPPU analysis, and SAP S/4HANA CO profitability reporting. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 30.00 = 30%).
attributes.references: Steamworks Partner Agreement; Epic Games Store Developer Agreement; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: price_eur
attributes.description: Regional retail price override for the European market denominated in Euros (EUR). Accounts for VAT obligations, PEGI market requirements, and purchasing power parity adjustments. Null indicates base_price_usd converted at current exchange rate applies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 EUR; European Commission Digital Services Act; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: price_gbp
attributes.description: Regional retail price override for the United Kingdom market denominated in British Pounds Sterling (GBP). Reflects UK post-Brexit pricing strategy and VAT requirements. Null indicates base_price_usd converted at current exchange rate applies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 GBP; UK Competition and Markets Authority Guidelines

attributes.name: price_jpy
attributes.description: Regional retail price override for the Japanese market denominated in Japanese Yen (JPY). JPY has no decimal subdivision; stored as whole yen. Reflects CERO market requirements and local consumer pricing norms. Null indicates base_price_usd converted at current exchange rate applies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 JPY; CERO Rating Standards; Japan Consumer Affairs Agency

attributes.name: price_krw
attributes.description: Regional retail price override for the South Korean market denominated in Korean Won (KRW). KRW has no decimal subdivision; stored as whole won. Reflects GRAC rating market requirements and local pricing strategy. Null indicates base_price_usd converted at current exchange rate applies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 KRW; GRAC Game Rating and Administration Committee Standards

attributes.name: promo_discount_pct
attributes.description: Current or default promotional discount percentage applied to the base price during sale events (e.g., 25.00 = 25% off). Drives sale pricing calculations in the storefront. Null or 0 indicates no active promotional discount. Used in conversion rate analysis and F2P monetization funnel reporting.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Marketing Guidelines; Apple App Store Review Guidelines

attributes.name: promo_discount_type
attributes.description: Defines the mechanism by which the promotional discount is applied: 'percentage' = percentage reduction from base price; 'fixed_amount' = fixed currency amount deducted; 'bundle_override' = price is overridden by a bundle-level price; 'free' = item is granted at no charge (e.g., F2P promotional giveaway).
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Internal Monetization Governance Policy

attributes.name: quantity_in_bundle
attributes.description: Number of units of this item included when purchased as part of a bundle or currency pack (e.g., a '1000 Gold Pack' has quantity_in_bundle = 1000 for the gold currency item). Null or 1 for single-unit items. Supports virtual economy sink analysis and bundle value proposition reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Design Standards; GameAnalytics Event Schema

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date on which this MTX offering was first made publicly available for purchase across any platform. Distinct from effective_from_date which governs pricing windows. Used for cohort analysis, D1/D7/D30 revenue attribution, and new content launch performance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Game Release Management Policy; Steamworks Release Management

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this MTX offering was permanently retired and delisted from all storefronts. Null indicates the offering has not been retired. Used for catalog lifecycle management, legacy entitlement support tracking, and revenue sunset analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Governance Policy; Consumer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI revenue recognition classification code governing how and when revenue from this MTX offering is recognized (e.g., immediate recognition for consumables, deferred recognition for battle passes/subscriptions over the service period). Ensures compliance with ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; ASC 606 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; IFRS 15

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this purchasable offering across all platforms and storefronts (e.g., SKIN_DRAGON_001, CURRPACK_1000G). Serves as the canonical business identifier used in platform SDKs, SAP S/4HANA SD module, and Steamworks/Epic Games Store product listings. Maps to MASTER_RESOURCE category: BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Material Master; Steamworks Partner API

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code used in SAP S/4HANA FI for VAT/GST/sales tax determination on this MTX offering. Different item types (DLC, virtual currency, subscription) may attract different tax treatment across jurisdictions. Drives automated tax calculation in the payment processing pipeline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; IRS Digital Goods Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this MTX catalog entry, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect pricing changes, status transitions, and catalog updates for downstream ETL incremental loads and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Requirements; SOC 2 Type II Controls; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: virtual_currency_cost
attributes.description: The in-game virtual currency amount required to purchase this offering through the in-game soft or hard currency economy (e.g., 500 Gold, 200 Gems). Null if the item is only purchasable with real money. Supports virtual economy balance analysis and P2W mechanics assessment.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Design Standards; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: virtual_currency_type
attributes.description: The specific in-game virtual currency denomination used for virtual_currency_cost (e.g., 'gold', 'gems', 'credits', 'tokens'). Null if item is real-money only. Supports multi-currency virtual economy modeling and sink/source balance reporting in GameAnalytics/Amplitude.
attributes.references: Internal Virtual Economy Design Standards; GameAnalytics Event Schema

products.name: battle_pass
products.description: Master definition of pass-based monetization products per game title and season, encompassing both progression-tiered battle passes and content-access season passes. Captures pass name, pass type (progression_tiered, content_access, hybrid), season identifier, start/end dates, tier count (if applicable), free vs. premium track structure, premium price, XP-per-tier thresholds, reward schedule reference, content entitlements included, max purchasable tier skips, upgrade paths, platform availability, and active status. The SSOT for all pass product definitions — distinct from individual player entitlements.

attributes.name: battle_pass_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a battle pass or season pass product definition record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: Battle pass content development may be capitalized as part of game development. Capitalization policy requirement for intangible asset tracking.

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Battle passes launch as part of major content releases (seasons, expansions). Critical for live ops planning, marketing coordination, and ensuring content/monetization version alignment.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Battle passes are cost center activities for studio P&L tracking. Management accounting for content development cost attribution.

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.dev_project. Business justification: Battle passes are content deliverables created by dev teams. Linking to dev_project enables content pipeline tracking, resource allocation analysis, live-ops planning coordination, and attribution of

attributes.name: featured_reward_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.asset. Business justification: Battle passes feature hero cosmetic assets as tier rewards. Links reward content to pass definition for marketing materials, reward fulfillment, and player progression UI display.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Battle pass seasons have development and marketing budgets tracked. Project budget management for content development and launch campaigns.

attributes.name: gaas_live_ops_cycle_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gaas Live Ops Cycle Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.live_ops_cycle. Business justification: Battle passes ARE live-ops content cycles in GaaS titles. Many studios model battle pass seasons as live_ops_cycles with MTX tie-ins. This link enables unified live-ops planning, content-to-revenue at

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.game_studio. Business justification: Battle passes are designed by specific studios. Tracking studio ownership supports revenue share calculations (studio gets % of battle pass revenue), content pipeline management, and studio-level P&L

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title for which this battle pass is defined. Links the pass product to its parent game.

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Battle passes featuring licensed IP (Fortnite Marvel season) require IP tracking for revenue share calculation, content approval, and regulatory disclosure. Essential for season-based royalty reportin

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Battle passes are major seasonal content releases requiring dedicated marketing campaigns for launch promotion, player acquisition, and conversion tracking. Essential for measuring battle pass marketi

attributes.name: name_localization_string_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.localization_string. Business justification: Battle pass UI, tier names, and reward descriptions need localization for international player base. Essential for global live service operations and regional marketing.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Battle passes are profit center products for segment reporting. Financial reporting requirement for product line P&L.

attributes.name: royalty_accrual_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.royalty_accrual. Business justification: Battle passes featuring licensed content generate royalty obligations. IP licensing accounting for third-party content in seasonal content.

attributes.name: seasonal_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.seasonal_event. Business justification: Battle passes align with seasonal events (Halloween, Winter, Anniversary) for thematic content coordination. Essential for live ops planning, marketing campaigns, and player engagement timing.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the business approver (e.g., Monetization Lead, Live Ops Director) who authorized this battle pass product definition for release. Supports governance and release gate compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Release Gate Policy; Jira (Release Planning)

attributes.name: contains_loot_box
attributes.description: Indicates whether this battle pass includes any randomized reward mechanics (loot boxes or gacha elements). Critical for regulatory compliance disclosures under FTC, European Commission Digital Services Act, and PEGI/ESRB loot box disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; European Commission Digital Services Act; ESRB; PEGI

attributes.name: content_entitlements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or reference to DLC (Downloadable Content) packs, cosmetic bundles, or game content items included as flat entitlements with this pass (primarily for 'content_access' and 'hybrid' types). Supports entitlement management and player support.

attributes.name: coppa_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this battle pass is restricted from purchase or display to players identified as under 13 years of age, in compliance with COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) requirements.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); FTC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this battle pass product definition record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Total number of days the battle pass is active, derived from start and end dates. Used for season length planning and player engagement benchmarking.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the battle pass expires and is no longer purchasable or progressable. Marks the end of the associated season.

attributes.name: esrb_rating
attributes.description: ESRB content rating applicable to this battle pass and its associated content (e.g., 'T' for Teen). Required for North American regulatory compliance and storefront listing.

attributes.name: free_tier_count
attributes.description: Number of tiers accessible on the free track without purchasing the premium pass. Supports F2P (Free-to-Play) conversion funnel analysis by quantifying the free value proposition.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_processing_note
attributes.description: Free-text note documenting any GDPR-relevant data processing activities associated with this pass product (e.g., behavioral tracking for progression analytics). Supports GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing Activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing Activities); GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: has_free_track
attributes.description: Indicates whether this battle pass includes a free progression track accessible to all players without purchase. Core F2P design flag used in conversion funnel and monetization analysis.

attributes.name: has_premium_plus
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pass offers a higher-tier premium upgrade (e.g., 'Battle Pass Bundle' or 'Premium+') that includes additional rewards or tier skips beyond the base premium pass.

attributes.name: is_cross_platform
attributes.description: Indicates whether progress and entitlements from this battle pass are shared across multiple platforms (cross-progression). Relevant for platform certification and player experience consistency.

attributes.name: jira_epic_key
attributes.description: Jira Epic key linking this battle pass product definition to its corresponding live-ops planning epic in the project management system (e.g., 'LIVEOPS-421'). Enables traceability from product definition to development and QA work.

attributes.name: launch_region
attributes.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes identifying the geographic regions where this battle pass is available for sale. Supports regional pricing, compliance, and marketing segmentation.

attributes.name: loot_box_disclosure_url
attributes.description: URL to the publicly accessible odds disclosure page for any randomized reward mechanics included in this pass. Required for regulatory compliance in jurisdictions mandating loot box transparency (FTC, EU DSA). Null when contains_loot_box is false.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: max_tier_skips
attributes.description: Maximum number of tiers a player may purchase to skip (advance instantly) within this battle pass. Governs the pay-to-progress ceiling and P2W (Pay-to-Win) mechanics compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Monetization Fairness Policy; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: pass_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code or SKU that uniquely identifies this pass product across distribution platforms (e.g., Steamworks, console SDKs, app stores). Used in platform certification and store listings.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; ISO 15459 (Item Identification)

attributes.name: pass_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the battle pass product definition. 'draft' = in design; 'scheduled' = approved and awaiting season start; 'active' = currently purchasable and progressing; 'expired' = season ended, no longer purchasable; 'retired' = permanently removed from catalog.

attributes.name: pass_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pass monetization model. 'progression_tiered' = XP-gated tier unlock system; 'content_access' = flat subscription-style content entitlement (season pass); 'hybrid' = combines both tier progression and flat content access.

attributes.name: pegi_rating
attributes.description: PEGI content rating applicable to this battle pass and its associated content (e.g., '12'). Required for European regulatory compliance and storefront listing.

attributes.name: platform_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platforms on which this battle pass is available for purchase (e.g., 'PC,PS5,XBOX,MOBILE,SWITCH'). Drives platform-specific store listing and certification via Steamworks/Console SDKs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PS5|XBOX|MOBILE|SWITCH|STADIA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: premium_plus_price_usd
attributes.description: Retail price in USD for the premium-plus or bundle upgrade tier of the battle pass, if applicable. Null when has_premium_plus is false.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: premium_price_usd
attributes.description: Base retail price of the premium battle pass in US Dollars. The principal quantitative monetary value of this pass product. Used for ARPU, ARPPU, and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: premium_price_virtual_currency
attributes.description: Price of the premium battle pass denominated in the game's primary virtual currency (e.g., V-Bucks, Coins). Supports virtual economy pricing analysis and IAP (In-App Purchase) conversion tracking.

attributes.name: premium_tier_count
attributes.description: Number of tiers exclusively accessible on the premium (paid) track. Represents the incremental value proposition of the premium pass purchase.

attributes.name: reward_schedule_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document path pointing to the reward schedule definition for this battle pass (e.g., a Jira Epic key, Perforce asset path, or content management system ID). Links to the detailed tier-by-tier reward manifest.

attributes.name: season_label
attributes.description: Branded or thematic label for the season associated with this pass (e.g., 'Season of the Void', 'Chapter 4 Season 2'). Used in marketing and player-facing UI.

attributes.name: season_number
attributes.description: Ordinal number of the game season associated with this pass (e.g., Season 7). Used for chronological ordering and player-facing season labeling.

attributes.name: soft_launch_date
attributes.description: Date on which the battle pass was made available in a limited set of markets or platforms prior to full global launch. Used for staged rollout tracking and pre-launch performance analysis.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the battle pass becomes active and purchasable by players. Aligns with the season launch date in the live-ops calendar.

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Total number of progression tiers available in this battle pass. Applicable to 'progression_tiered' and 'hybrid' pass types. Null for pure 'content_access' passes.

attributes.name: tier_skip_price_usd
attributes.description: Price in USD to purchase a single tier skip within this battle pass. Used for MTX (Microtransaction) revenue modeling and P2W analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this battle pass product definition record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing.

attributes.name: upgrade_path_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the upgrade path available for this pass (e.g., free-to-premium, premium-to-premium-plus). Defines the upsell funnel structure for conversion rate analysis.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this battle pass product definition record, supporting change management and audit trail for pass configuration updates (e.g., price changes, tier adjustments).
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core (Version Control); Internal Change Management Policy

attributes.name: virtual_currency_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the in-game virtual currency used for the virtual currency price (e.g., 'VBUCKS', 'COINS', 'GEMS'). Required for multi-currency virtual economy management.

attributes.name: xp_per_tier
attributes.description: Amount of XP (Experience Points) required to advance one tier in the battle pass progression system. Governs the grind curve and player engagement pacing.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the person or process that created this battle pass product definition. Supports audit trail and accountability for monetization product configuration.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2; Internal Data Governance Policy

products.name: battle_pass_entitlement
products.description: Transactional record of a player's ownership and progression state for a specific battle pass. Tracks player reference, battle pass reference, purchase timestamp, tier unlocked (free and premium), current XP, premium track activated flag, tier skip purchases, expiry date, and completion status. Enables entitlement enforcement and reward grant eligibility checks at runtime.
products.reference: Battle Pass Entitlement / Season Pass Ownership Record

attributes.name: battle_pass_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a player's battle pass entitlement record. Primary key for this transactional entity.

attributes.name: ab_experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.ab_experiment. Business justification: Battle pass pricing, tier structure, XP requirements, and reward schedules are commonly A/B tested. Linking entitlements to experiments enables conversion rate analysis and revenue impact measurement

attributes.name: battle_pass_id
attributes.description: Reference to the battle pass product definition (season, name, tier structure, reward catalog) that this entitlement is for.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Battle pass entitlements tracked by cost center for revenue attribution. Management accounting for seasonal content revenue tracking.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.deferred_revenue. Business justification: Battle pass purchases create contract liabilities recognized over season duration. Direct ASC 606 requirement for performance obligation tracking and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title under which this battle pass is operated. Supports multi-title monetization reporting.

attributes.name: iap_transaction_id
attributes.description: The platform-issued transaction identifier from the app store or console SDK for the premium battle pass purchase (e.g., Apple App Store receipt ID, Google Play order ID, PSN transaction ID). Used for receipt validation and refund processing.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; PCI DSS

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Premium battle pass purchases generate invoices for revenue recognition and tax reporting. Gaming companies must link entitlements to invoices for financial compliance and refund processing workflows.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.ip_agreement. Business justification: Player entitlements to licensed battle pass content require agreement reference for territory restrictions validation, platform rights verification, and automated compliance checks against license ter

attributes.name: league_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.league. Business justification: Battle passes themed around esports leagues (e.g., 'Championship Series Pass'). Common monetization model linking premium content to competitive seasons. Tracks league-specific battle pass sales and e

attributes.name: primary_battle_player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player who owns this battle pass entitlement. Core party reference linking entitlement to the player account.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform (console, PC, mobile) on which the battle pass was purchased and is being progressed.

attributes.name: acquisition_channel
attributes.description: The marketing or distribution channel through which the player acquired this battle pass entitlement. Supports CPI, ROAS, and conversion funnel analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic|paid_ua|influencer|bundle|gifted|promotional_code|loyalty_reward — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: age_gate_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player passed the required age verification check prior to purchasing this battle pass. Required for COPPA compliance for players in applicable jurisdictions.
attributes.references: COPPA Enforcement (FTC); GDPR Supervisory Authorities; ESRB; PEGI

attributes.name: auto_renew_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has opted into automatic renewal of the battle pass subscription at the start of the next season. Supports subscription retention and churn rate analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Subscription Management Standards; FTC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the player's registered region at the time of entitlement creation. Used for regional revenue reporting, tax compliance, and GDPR/COPPA jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Supervisory Authorities; COPPA Enforcement (FTC); ESRB; PEGI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this entitlement record was first created in the system, which may precede the purchase timestamp for free-track entitlements granted at season start.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the real-money amounts recorded on this entitlement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency monetization reporting.

attributes.name: current_tier
attributes.description: The highest tier the player has currently unlocked on the battle pass, spanning both free and premium tracks. Used for reward grant eligibility checks at runtime.

attributes.name: current_xp
attributes.description: The player's current accumulated experience points (XP) within this battle pass season. XP determines tier progression and is the primary progression currency.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary discount applied to the battle pass purchase (e.g., promotional discount, loyalty reward, bundle discount). Zero if no discount was applied.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Internal Promotions Policy

attributes.name: entitlement_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-visible alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this entitlement record. Used in player support, receipts, and entitlement enforcement lookups.

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the battle pass entitlement. Controls whether the player can access premium rewards and progress tiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|expired|suspended|refunded|pending|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this battle pass entitlement expires and the player can no longer earn or claim rewards. Typically aligned to the end of the game season.

attributes.name: free_tier_unlocked
attributes.description: The highest tier unlocked on the free reward track. Tracked separately from premium tier to support free-vs-paid conversion analytics and reward grant logic.

attributes.name: is_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has reached the maximum tier and fully completed the battle pass. Used for completion reward grants and engagement analytics.

attributes.name: is_gifted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this battle pass entitlement was received as a gift from another player rather than self-purchased. Supports gifting revenue segmentation.

attributes.name: is_premium_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player has activated the premium battle pass track. True means the player paid for premium access; False means free track only. Core entitlement enforcement flag.

attributes.name: last_progression_timestamp
attributes.description: The most recent timestamp at which the player earned XP or advanced a tier on this battle pass. Used for engagement monitoring, lapsed-player identification, and re-engagement campaign targeting.

attributes.name: max_tier
attributes.description: The total number of tiers available in this battle pass. Used to calculate completion percentage and determine if the player has fully completed the pass.

attributes.name: net_purchase_amount
attributes.description: The net real-money amount charged to the player after discounts (purchase_price_amount minus discount_amount). Used for revenue recognition and ARPU/ARPPU reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: parental_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether verifiable parental consent was obtained before granting this battle pass entitlement to a minor player. Mandatory for COPPA-regulated accounts.

attributes.name: player_level_at_purchase
attributes.description: The player's account level at the time of battle pass premium track purchase. Used for conversion funnel segmentation and LTV modeling by player maturity cohort.

attributes.name: premium_tier_unlocked
attributes.description: The highest tier unlocked on the premium reward track. Null or zero if the player has not activated the premium track. Drives premium reward grant eligibility.

attributes.name: promotional_code
attributes.description: The promotional or discount code applied at the time of battle pass purchase, if any. Used for campaign attribution and promotional effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: purchase_price_amount
attributes.description: The gross real-money price paid by the player to activate the premium battle pass track, in the currency indicated by currency_code. Null for free-track-only entitlements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: purchase_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the player purchased or activated the premium battle pass track. Null for free-track-only entitlements. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current refund state for this battle pass entitlement purchase. Tracks whether a refund has been requested, processed, or denied. Supports financial reconciliation and player support workflows.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; FTC Consumer Protection; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when a refund was processed for this battle pass entitlement. Null if no refund has been issued. Used for financial reconciliation and chargeback tracking.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: rewards_claimed_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual tier rewards the player has claimed from this battle pass entitlement. Used to measure reward engagement and identify players who earn but do not claim.

attributes.name: season_number
attributes.description: The sequential season number associated with this battle pass entitlement. Enables cross-season analytics and cohort comparisons.

attributes.name: tier_skip_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total real-money or virtual currency equivalent amount spent on tier skips for this entitlement. Contributes to ARPPU and LTV calculations for the monetization domain.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: tier_skips_purchased
attributes.description: The total number of tier skip purchases made by the player on this battle pass entitlement. Each skip advances the player one tier without earning XP. Key microtransaction (MTX) revenue signal.

attributes.name: track_type
attributes.description: Indicates which reward track(s) the player has access to: free (default), premium (paid upgrade), or premium_plus (deluxe tier with bonus rewards). Drives reward grant eligibility at runtime.

attributes.name: unclaimed_rewards_count
attributes.description: The number of rewards the player has unlocked but not yet claimed from this battle pass. High unclaimed counts may indicate engagement drop-off and trigger re-engagement nudges.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this entitlement record, including tier progression, XP updates, tier skips, or status changes.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_cost
attributes.description: The amount of in-game virtual currency (e.g., V-Bucks, Coins, Gems) spent to purchase the premium battle pass track, if applicable. Null for real-money-only purchases.

attributes.name: xp_to_next_tier
attributes.description: The remaining XP required for the player to advance to the next battle pass tier. Supports real-time progression display and engagement nudge triggers.

products.name: gacha_pull
products.description: Transactional record of every loot box or gacha pull event executed by a player. Captures game title, gacha pool reference, pull timestamp, currency type and amount spent, pity counter at time of pull, outcome item(s) granted, rarity tier of outcome, guaranteed drop flag (pity triggered), and regulatory jurisdiction. Supports loot box disclosure compliance (Belgium, Netherlands, ESRB loot box labeling) and gacha economy balancing.

attributes.name: gacha_pull_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gacha pull transaction. Primary key for this event log entity.

attributes.name: ab_experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.ab_experiment. Business justification: Gacha mechanics (drop rates, pity thresholds, pricing, multi-pull discounts) are heavily A/B tested in F2P games. Experiment attribution is critical for measuring revenue impact and player satisfactio

attributes.name: build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.build. Business justification: Gacha pulls occur within specific builds. Tracking build version is essential for regulatory compliance (disclosed drop rates must match build version), exploit detection (abnormal pull outcomes in sp

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Gacha pulls tracked by cost center for revenue attribution. Revenue tracking for gacha monetization by game/feature.

attributes.name: gacha_pool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific gacha pool or banner from which the pull was executed. Links to the gacha pool configuration entity.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title in which this gacha pull occurred. Links to the game title master entity.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Gacha pulls are revenue events that must post to GL. Some jurisdictions require specific gacha revenue tracking for regulatory compliance and disclosure.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Gacha pulls must track jurisdiction for loot box disclosure compliance, drop-rate transparency requirements, and age-gate enforcement. Critical for regulatory filings in jurisdictions with loot box re

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Individual gacha pulls yielding licensed items require IP attribution for per-transaction royalty calculation, regulatory reporting in jurisdictions requiring loot box disclosure, and revenue attribut

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional campaign or limited-time event associated with this gacha pull, if applicable. Null for standard pulls.

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary item granted as the outcome of this gacha pull. Links to the in-game item catalog.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the player who executed this gacha pull. Links to the player master entity.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the player session during which this gacha pull occurred. Used for session-level analytics and fraud detection.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the platform on which this gacha pull was executed (iOS, Android, PC, Console). Links to the platform master entity.

attributes.name: tournament_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to esports.tournament. Business justification: Gacha events timed with tournaments (limited-time tournament-themed pools). Real business pattern for promotional gacha during esports events. Tracks tournament-driven gacha revenue and player engagem

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier generated by the game server for this gacha pull. Used for reconciliation, auditing, and player support investigations.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: Identifier of the A/B test variant or experiment group the player was assigned to at the time of this gacha pull. Used for conversion rate optimization and feature testing.

attributes.name: age_gate_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the player passed age verification requirements for gacha participation in their jurisdiction. True if verified, false otherwise.
attributes.references: COPPA, GDPR Article 8, Regional Age Verification Laws

attributes.name: bonus_items_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether additional bonus items were granted alongside the primary outcome (e.g., first-time bonuses, promotional extras). True if bonuses granted.

attributes.name: client_version
attributes.description: Version number of the game client software used to execute this gacha pull. Used for version-specific analytics and bug tracking.

attributes.name: conversion_currency_amount
attributes.description: Amount of conversion currency (e.g., duplicate shards, exchange tokens) granted if the outcome was a duplicate. Null if not a duplicate.

attributes.name: currency_amount
attributes.description: Amount of virtual currency spent on this gacha pull. Denominated in the currency_type specified.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Type of virtual currency used for this gacha pull: premium (paid), soft (earned), free (promotional), or event-specific currency.

attributes.name: days_since_install
attributes.description: Number of days elapsed between the players initial game install and this gacha pull. Used for cohort analysis and LTV modeling.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to execute the gacha pull: mobile phone, tablet, PC, or console. Used for device-specific analytics.

attributes.name: disclosed_drop_rate_pct
attributes.description: The publicly disclosed drop rate percentage for the rarity tier of the outcome item at the time of pull. Required for regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ESRB Loot Box Disclosure, Apple App Store Guidelines 3.1.1, Google Play Odds Disclosure, China MOFCOM Regulation

attributes.name: duplicate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outcome item was a duplicate of an item the player already owned. True if duplicate, false if new acquisition.

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Automated fraud detection score assigned to this gacha pull transaction at the time of execution. Higher scores indicate higher fraud risk. Range 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: PCI DSS, Internal Fraud Prevention Policy

attributes.name: lifetime_gacha_spend_usd
attributes.description: Cumulative real-money equivalent amount the player has spent on gacha pulls across all time, up to and including this transaction. Used for whale segmentation and LTV analysis.

attributes.name: outcome_item_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the primary outcome item granted to the player. Typically 1 for character/weapon pulls, may be higher for consumables.

attributes.name: outcome_rarity_tier
attributes.description: Rarity classification of the primary item granted: common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary, or mythic. Determines drop rate and player value perception.

attributes.name: pity_counter_after
attributes.description: Value of the players pity counter immediately after this pull was executed. Reset to zero if pity was triggered.

attributes.name: pity_counter_before
attributes.description: Value of the players pity counter immediately before this pull was executed. Tracks cumulative pulls without a guaranteed drop.

attributes.name: pity_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pity mechanism was triggered for this pull, guaranteeing a high-rarity item. True if pity activated, false otherwise.

attributes.name: player_level_at_pull
attributes.description: The players in-game level at the time this gacha pull was executed. Used for progression-based analytics and monetization funnel analysis.

attributes.name: pull_quantity
attributes.description: Number of items pulled in this single transaction. Typically 1 for single pulls, 10 for multi-pulls.

attributes.name: pull_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the gacha pull was executed by the player. Primary business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: pull_type
attributes.description: Type of gacha pull executed: single pull, multi-pull (10x), free pull, premium pull, or discounted pull. Affects cost and pity mechanics.

attributes.name: real_money_equivalent_usd
attributes.description: Equivalent real-world monetary value of the currency spent, converted to USD. Used for revenue recognition and ARPU calculations.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gacha pull record was first written to the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: refund_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the currency spent on this gacha pull was subsequently refunded to the player. True if refunded, false otherwise.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was processed for this gacha pull, if applicable. Null if no refund occurred.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the regulatory jurisdiction of the player at the time of pull. Used for loot box disclosure compliance (Belgium, Netherlands, Japan, China).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, ESRB Loot Box Guidelines, PEGI, CERO, GRAC

attributes.name: server_region
attributes.description: Geographic region of the game server that processed this gacha pull (e.g., NA-EAST, EU-WEST, ASIA-PACIFIC). Used for latency analysis and regional performance tracking.

The SSOT for gacha pool configurations.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Gacha pools containing licensed characters (Genshin Impact collaborations) must track IP for drop rate disclosure compliance, royalty attribution per pull, and licensor approval of probability mechani
