products.name: ip_agreement
products.description: Master record for all intellectual property licensing agreements, covering outbound engine/technology licensing, inbound licensed IP usage, third-party middleware agreements (physics engines, audio middleware, anti-cheat SDKs, analytics), music synchronization licenses, and brand/franchise partnership deals. Captures agreement type (outbound engine, inbound brand/franchise, music sync, middleware, art, brand partnership), licensor and licensee identities, territory scope, exclusivity terms, effective and expiry dates, governing law jurisdiction, agreement status, licensed IP asset reference, renewal tracking (expiry date, renewal notice deadline, renewal negotiation status, assigned account manager), and agreement-type-specific metadata including: for middleware — vendor, product version, license type (per-title, per-seat, revenue-share), usage scope; for music sync — track title, composer/publisher, PRO clearance status, media usage rights; for brand partnerships — brand owner, partnership type, co-marketing obligations, brand usage guidelines. This is the single source of truth for ALL licensing contracts in the gaming domain regardless of IP type or commercial structure.

attributes.name: ip_name
attributes.description: The official name or title of the intellectual property asset (e.g., 'Unreal Engine 5', 'Fortnite Brand', 'Epic Soundtrack Collection').
attributes.references: WIPO (World Intellectual Property Organization) Naming Standards

attributes.name: ip_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IP asset type. Determines licensing model and royalty structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: game_engine|franchise_brand|game_title|character|music_composition|art_asset_library|middleware_library|rating_approved_content_package — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_licensed_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent licensing agreement for this IP asset was executed. Null if never licensed.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this IP asset record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP asset record was last updated in the licensing catalog system.

attributes.name: license_model
attributes.description: Primary licensing business model applied to this IP asset (royalty percentage, fixed fee, subscription, revenue share, hybrid, or not applicable for internal-only IP).

attributes.name: licensing_availability_status
attributes.description: Current availability status of the IP asset for new licensing agreements. Indicates whether the IP can be licensed out and under what terms.

attributes.name: marketing_tagline
attributes.description: Official marketing tagline or slogan associated with the IP asset, used in licensing promotional materials and partner communications.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Standard minimum guarantee amount (in USD) required from licensees for this IP asset. Null if no minimum guarantee applies.

attributes.name: monetization_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any restrictions on how licensees can monetize products built with this IP (e.g., 'No Pay-to-Win mechanics allowed', 'In-App Purchases (IAP) permitted', 'Ad-supported only'). Null if no restrictions.
attributes.references: Internal Licensing Policy, FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: ownership_entity
attributes.description: The legal entity or studio that owns the intellectual property rights (e.g., 'Epic Games Inc.', 'Subsidiary Studio LLC').

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Nature of ownership rights held by the business (wholly owned, joint ownership with partner, licensed from third party, or acquired through M&A).

attributes.name: pegi_rating
attributes.description: PEGI content rating classification for Europe (3, 7, 12, 16, 18, or Not Rated).
attributes.references: PEGI (Pan European Game Information) Rating Standards

attributes.name: platform_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of gaming platforms or operating systems this IP asset supports or is compatible with (e.g., 'PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android'). Applicable primarily to game engines and middleware.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the intellectual property was officially registered with the governing authority.

attributes.name: registration_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction or territory where the IP is registered (e.g., 'USA', 'EUR', 'JPN', 'Global'). Uses 3-letter country codes or regional identifiers.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or patent number assigned by governing IP authority (USPTO, EPO, WIPO, copyright office). May include trademark, patent, or copyright registration identifiers.
attributes.references: USPTO (United States Patent and Trademark Office), EPO (European Patent Office), WIPO

attributes.name: sdk_version
attributes.description: Current version number of the SDK or game engine technology if this IP is a licensable technology platform (e.g., 'UE5.3', 'Unity 2023.1'). Null for non-technology IP.

attributes.name: standard_royalty_rate
attributes.description: Default royalty rate (as decimal, e.g., 0.0500 for 5%) applied to licensees for this IP asset. Actual rates may vary by agreement. Null if not royalty-based.

attributes.name: territory_restrictions
attributes.description: Geographic territories where licensing of this IP is restricted or prohibited due to legal, regulatory, or contractual constraints. Comma-separated list of 3-letter country codes or 'None' if unrestricted.

attributes.name: third_party_dependencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of third-party middleware, libraries, or licensed components embedded within this IP asset that licensees must also comply with (e.g., 'Havok Physics', 'Wwise Audio', 'SpeedTree').

attributes.name: total_revenue_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative licensing revenue (in USD) generated from this IP asset since inception. Includes royalties, fixed fees, and minimum guarantees.

attributes.name: ugc_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP asset supports or allows user-generated content creation and distribution by licensees or end users.

attributes.name: usk_rating
attributes.description: USK content rating classification for Germany (0, 6, 12, 16, 18, or Not Rated).

products.name: commercial_term
products.description: Detailed commercial and legal terms attached to each IP agreement, including royalty rate structures, minimum guarantee amounts, advance payment schedules, audit rights clauses, sublicensing permissions, derivative works rights, platform exclusivity windows, territory expansion options, renewal options, and termination-for-cause conditions. One agreement may have multiple versioned term sets reflecting amendments over time.

attributes.name: commercial_term_id
attributes.description: Primary key for commercial_term

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IP licensing agreement to which these commercial terms apply.

attributes.name: advance_payment_amount
attributes.description: Upfront payment made by licensee, typically recoupable against future royalties.

attributes.name: advance_recoupment_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms describing how advance payments are recouped from future royalty payments (e.g., 100% recoupment, cross-collateralization rules).

attributes.name: audit_frequency_limit
attributes.description: Maximum frequency at which licensor may conduct audits (e.g., once per calendar year, twice per contract term).

attributes.name: audit_rights_clause
attributes.description: Text describing licensors rights to audit licensees books and records to verify royalty calculations and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commercial term record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this term set (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: derivative_works_rights
attributes.description: Specifies licensees rights to create derivative works based on the licensed IP (e.g., sequels, spin-offs, adaptations).

attributes.name: exclusivity_window_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for which platform or territory exclusivity applies before rights expand.

attributes.name: indemnification_terms
attributes.description: Detailed indemnification obligations of each party, including scope of liability, defense obligations, and limitations.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Percentage penalty rate applied to overdue payments, typically expressed as annual percentage rate (APR).

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability amount either party may be held responsible for under the agreement, excluding certain carve-outs.

attributes.name: marketing_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether licensee must obtain licensor approval for marketing materials, promotional campaigns, and brand usage.

attributes.name: marketing_spend_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum marketing spend amount licensee commits to invest in promoting the licensed IP or product.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed payment amount that licensee must pay regardless of actual royalty calculations. Common in IP licensing deals.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commercial term record was last modified.

attributes.name: payment_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days after period end or invoice date by which payment must be received.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which royalty or license fee payments are due (e.g., quarterly, annually).

attributes.name: performance_milestone_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms describing performance milestones that trigger payments, bonuses, or rights adjustments (e.g., sales thresholds, user acquisition targets).

attributes.name: platform_exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement grants exclusive rights to specific gaming platforms (console, PC, mobile).

attributes.name: platform_exclusivity_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platforms covered by exclusivity (e.g., PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, PC, iOS, Android).

attributes.name: quality_assurance_requirements
attributes.description: Quality standards and certification requirements licensee must meet, including ESRB, PEGI, or platform Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC) compliance.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to expiration by which licensee must provide notice to exercise renewal option.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether licensee has the option to renew the agreement under predefined terms.

attributes.name: renewal_option_periods
attributes.description: Number of renewal periods available to licensee (e.g., two 2-year renewal options).

attributes.name: revenue_reporting_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days after period end by which revenue reports must be submitted to licensor.

attributes.name: revenue_reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which licensee must provide revenue and usage reports to licensor for royalty calculation.

attributes.name: royalty_basis
attributes.description: The financial or usage metric upon which royalty calculations are based (e.g., net revenue, gross revenue, units sold).

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to revenue or units to calculate royalty payments owed to licensor. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: sublicensing_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether licensee is permitted to sublicense the IP or technology to third parties.

attributes.name: sublicensing_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms governing sublicensing arrangements, including revenue sharing, approval requirements, and restrictions.

attributes.name: term_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of commercial terms becomes binding and enforceable.

attributes.name: term_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of commercial terms ceases to be effective. Nullable for open-ended terms.

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this commercial term version.

attributes.name: term_version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this term set. Agreements may have multiple versioned term sets reflecting amendments over time.

attributes.name: termination_cure_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the breaching party has to cure a breach before termination becomes effective.

attributes.name: termination_for_cause_conditions
attributes.description: Detailed conditions under which either party may terminate the agreement for cause (e.g., material breach, bankruptcy, failure to meet minimum guarantees).

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required for termination, either for cause or for convenience.

attributes.name: territory_expansion_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether licensee has the option to expand into additional territories under predefined terms.

attributes.name: territory_expansion_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms governing territory expansion options, including pricing, approval process, and timing.

attributes.name: territory_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of countries or regions where license rights apply, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.

products.name: royalty_schedule
products.description: Defines the royalty calculation rules and rate tiers for each IP agreement — including royalty basis (net revenue, gross revenue, units sold, DAU-based, MAU-based), tiered rate breakpoints, currency, reporting period cadence (monthly, quarterly), applicable platform deductions, and effective date ranges. Supports both outbound engine licensing royalties collected from licensees and inbound royalties owed to IP rights holders.

attributes.name: royalty_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the royalty schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent licensing agreement or contract that this royalty schedule governs.

attributes.name: superseded_by_schedule_royalty_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the royalty_schedule_id that supersedes this schedule when a new version is activated. Null if this is the current active schedule.

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months
attributes.description: The frequency in months at which audits are required (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for biennial). Null if audit_required_flag is False.

attributes.name: audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty schedule requires periodic third-party audit of reported figures (True/False).

attributes.name: base_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The baseline royalty rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.0000 for 5%). Applicable when royalty_basis is revenue-based.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this royalty schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which royalty amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this royalty schedule ceases to be active. Null for open-ended schedules.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this royalty schedule becomes active and applicable to the agreement.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty schedule is tied to an exclusive licensing arrangement (True) or non-exclusive (False).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this royalty schedule record was last updated.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: The penalty rate (as a percentage per period) applied to overdue royalty payments. Null if no penalty applies.

attributes.name: maximum_cap_amount
attributes.description: The maximum royalty payment cap per reporting period. Null if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: The minimum royalty payment guaranteed per reporting period, regardless of actual usage or revenue. Null if no minimum guarantee applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, special terms, exceptions, or clarifications related to this royalty schedule.

attributes.name: payment_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the end of the reporting period by which royalty payment is due (e.g., 30 days, 60 days).

attributes.name: platform_deduction_rule
attributes.description: Specifies whether platform fees (e.g., Apple App Store 30%, Steam 30%, console first-party fees) are deducted before or after calculating royalties.

attributes.name: platform_scope
attributes.description: The gaming platforms or distribution channels to which this royalty schedule applies (e.g., 'Console', 'PC', 'Mobile', 'All Platforms', 'Steam', 'Epic Games Store', 'PlayStation', 'Xbox', 'Nintendo Switch').

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: The specific game titles, SKUs (Stock Keeping Units), or product lines covered by this royalty schedule. May reference specific game IPs (Intellectual Property) or engine versions.

attributes.name: rate_structure
attributes.description: Describes how the royalty rate is applied: flat (single rate), tiered (different rates at different breakpoints), progressive (rate increases with volume), regressive (rate decreases with volume), or custom formula.

attributes.name: recoupment_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance payments or minimum guarantees can be recouped against future royalty earnings (True/False).

attributes.name: reporting_period_cadence
attributes.description: The frequency at which royalty calculations and payments are reported and settled (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annually).

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to recognize royalty revenue or expense (accrual, cash basis, milestone-based, or usage-based).

attributes.name: royalty_basis
attributes.description: The fundamental metric or basis upon which royalty amounts are calculated (e.g., net revenue after platform fees, gross revenue, units sold, Daily Active Users (DAU), Monthly Active Users (MAU), or fixed periodic fee). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_revenue|gross_revenue|units_sold|dau_based|mau_based|fixed_fee|hybrid — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: royalty_schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the royalty schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or label for this royalty schedule (e.g., 'Unity Pro Tier 1', 'Unreal Engine Standard', 'IP License Q1 2024').

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty schedule based on the nature of the licensing arrangement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: outbound_engine_licensing|inbound_ip_licensing|middleware_licensing|music_licensing|art_asset_licensing|franchise_partnership|technology_sdk — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic territories or regions to which this royalty schedule applies (e.g., 'Worldwide', 'North America', 'EMEA', 'APAC', or specific country codes).

attributes.name: tier_1_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The royalty rate percentage applicable to revenue or units within the first tier. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: tier_1_threshold
attributes.description: The upper boundary value for the first royalty rate tier. Null if rate structure is flat or only one tier exists.

attributes.name: tier_2_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The royalty rate percentage applicable to revenue or units within the second tier. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: tier_2_threshold
attributes.description: The upper boundary value for the second royalty rate tier. Null if fewer than two tiers exist.

attributes.name: tier_3_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The royalty rate percentage applicable to revenue or units within the third tier. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: tier_3_threshold
attributes.description: The upper boundary value for the third royalty rate tier. Null if fewer than three tiers exist.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this royalty schedule, incremented with each amendment or revision to the terms.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of royalty payment subject to withholding tax, if applicable under the jurisdiction of the licensee or licensor. Null if no withholding applies.

products.name: royalty_report
products.description: Periodic royalty reporting records submitted by licensees or generated internally for outbound agreements. Captures reporting period, reported gross and net revenue, reported unit sales, applicable royalty rate tier applied, calculated royalty amount due, currency, submission date, submission method, and report status (submitted, under review, accepted, disputed). Feeds into royalty invoice generation and audit workflows.

attributes.name: royalty_report_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the royalty report record. Primary key.

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.dev_project. Business justification: Royalty reports for licensed IP usage (middleware, music, brands) are calculated per-project for revenue attribution and payment reconciliation. Essential for financial reporting and budget variance a

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user or team responsible for reviewing and validating this royalty report.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to title.game_title. Business justification: Royalty reports track revenue per title for licensed IP (engine royalties, music sync fees). Essential for accurate royalty calculation and licensor reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice generated from this royalty report. Links the report to the billing and accounts receivable process.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensing agreement under which this royalty report is submitted. Links to the master license agreement entity.

attributes.name: kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_definition. Business justification: Royalty metrics (royalty per user, IP conversion rate, royalty yield) are tracked as business KPIs. Links licensing financial reporting to analytics KPI framework for executive dashboards and performa

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Royalty reports should track which specific licensed IP asset generated the revenue. Currently uses product_line (STRING) which is ambiguous. Adding licensed_ip_id FK enables precise IP-level revenue

attributes.name: licensee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (studio, publisher, or third-party developer) submitting or subject to this royalty report.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Royalty reports may trigger regulatory filings (revenue disclosures, tax withholding reports, cross-border payment notifications). Real process: finance-to-compliance handoff for jurisdictions requiri

attributes.name: applicable_royalty_rate
attributes.description: The royalty rate percentage applied to the net revenue for this reporting period. May vary based on tiered thresholds, product type, or territory as defined in the license agreement.

attributes.name: attachment_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to supporting documentation attached to this royalty report (e.g., detailed sales breakdowns, platform reports, reconciliation files).

attributes.name: audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty report has been flagged for audit or detailed review due to discrepancies, thresholds, or compliance requirements.

attributes.name: calculated_royalty_amount
attributes.description: The royalty amount due to the licensor, calculated by applying the applicable royalty rate to the reported net revenue. This is the amount subject to invoicing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty report record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this report (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or categorization of any dispute raised regarding this royalty report. Populated when report status is disputed or under review.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert foreign currency revenue to the reporting currency, if applicable. Used for multi-currency licensing agreements.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_credit
attributes.description: Amount of minimum guarantee advance recouped or credited against this royalty payment. Tracks progress toward recoupment of upfront payments.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty report record was last modified. Tracks updates, amendments, or status changes.

attributes.name: net_royalty_payable
attributes.description: The net royalty amount payable after applying minimum guarantee credits and any other adjustments. This is the actual payment due to the licensor.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or context provided by the licensee or internal reviewers regarding this royalty report.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the calculated royalty payment is due to the licensor, as specified in the license agreement terms.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Gaming platform or distribution channel for which revenue is being reported (e.g., PlayStation, Xbox, Steam, mobile app stores, PC).

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the royalty report, typically assigned by the licensee or licensing system. Used for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the royalty report. Tracks progression from submission through review, acceptance, or dispute resolution.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty report based on reporting frequency or purpose (e.g., quarterly, monthly, annual, ad-hoc, final settlement).

attributes.name: reported_deductions
attributes.description: Total deductions applied to gross revenue as permitted by the license agreement (e.g., platform fees, returns, refunds, taxes). Reduces the royalty base.

attributes.name: reported_gross_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue reported by the licensee for the reporting period, before any deductions or adjustments. Basis for royalty calculation.

attributes.name: reported_net_revenue
attributes.description: Net revenue after deductions, representing the royalty-bearing revenue base. Calculated as gross revenue minus deductions.

attributes.name: reported_unit_sales
attributes.description: Total number of units sold or distributed during the reporting period, as reported by the licensee. May include game copies, DLC, or licensed content units.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the period covered by this royalty report. Defines the end of the revenue or usage window being reported.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the period covered by this royalty report. Defines the beginning of the revenue or usage window being reported.

attributes.name: review_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the internal review of this royalty report was completed and a status decision (accepted, disputed, rejected) was made.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the licensee submitted this royalty report to the licensor. Used to track timeliness and compliance with reporting deadlines.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The channel or mechanism through which the royalty report was submitted (e.g., licensing portal, email, API integration, manual upload, FTP/SFTP).

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Geographic territory or region covered by this royalty report. May be a country code, regional grouping, or worldwide indicator as defined in the license agreement.

products.name: royalty_payment
products.description: Records of actual royalty payments made or received against royalty reports. Captures payment direction (inbound from licensee, outbound to rights holder), payment amount, currency, exchange rate applied, payment date, payment method, bank reference, reconciliation status against the originating royalty report, and linkage to the governing IP agreement. This is the SSOT for royalty-specific cash flows within the licensing domain — distinct from the billing domain's general payment processing records. Supports royalty reconciliation, cash flow forecasting, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: royalty_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the royalty payment record. Primary key for the royalty payment entity.

attributes.name: iap_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.iap_transaction. Business justification: Royalty payments for revenue-based licenses require direct linkage to source IAP transactions for audit trail, dispute resolution, and reconciliation between reported revenue in royalty_report and act

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing IP licensing agreement under which this royalty payment is made. Links to the master licensing contract that defines royalty terms, rates, and obligations.

attributes.name: payee_licensee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensee. Business justification: Royalty payment payees are licensees (either receiving royalties for outbound licenses or paying royalties for inbound licenses). Currently tracked as payee_name (STRING) and payee_identifier (STRING)

attributes.name: royalty_report_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating royalty report that calculated the amounts due. This payment reconciles against the report's calculated royalty obligation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval workflow status for the royalty payment. Indicates whether the payment has been reviewed and authorized by appropriate stakeholders before execution.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved this royalty payment for execution. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the royalty payment was approved for execution. Part of the audit trail for payment authorization workflow.

attributes.name: bank_reference
attributes.description: Bank transaction reference or confirmation number provided by the financial institution. Used for payment tracing and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this royalty payment record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the payment amount to the reporting currency, if applicable. Null if payment currency matches reporting currency.

attributes.name: late_payment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this payment was made after the contractual due date. True indicates late payment, which may trigger penalty clauses or interest charges per the licensing agreement.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Additional penalty or interest amount charged or owed due to late payment, as defined in the licensing agreement. Null if payment was on time or no penalty applies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this royalty payment record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount paid or received after applying withholding taxes, fees, and any other adjustments. This is the actual cash flow amount.

attributes.name: payee_identifier
attributes.description: External identifier for the payee party, such as a vendor number, licensee code, or partner ID. Used for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the royalty payment in the original transaction currency, before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: payment_amount_reporting_currency
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to the enterprise's standard reporting currency using the applied exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: payment_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Represents the currency in which the payment was originally denominated.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the royalty payment was executed or received. This is the business event date for cash flow recognition, distinct from audit timestamps.

attributes.name: payment_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an inbound payment (received from a licensee for use of our IP or game engine technology) or an outbound payment (paid to a rights holder for licensed content, music, art assets, or third-party IP).

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which this royalty payment was required to be made or received, as defined in the governing IP agreement. Used to track payment timeliness and late payment penalties.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute the royalty payment (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check, PayPal, platform payout system).

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this royalty payment. May include special instructions, explanations of adjustments, or contextual information for finance and legal teams.

attributes.name: payment_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the reporting period covered by this royalty payment. Defines the conclusion of the usage or revenue period for which royalties are being settled.

attributes.name: payment_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the reporting period covered by this royalty payment. Defines the beginning of the usage or revenue period for which royalties are being settled.

attributes.name: payment_processor_fee
attributes.description: Transaction fee charged by the payment processor or financial institution for executing the royalty payment. Deducted from the gross payment amount.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference number or transaction identifier used for tracking and reconciliation. May be a bank transaction ID, wire transfer reference, or payment processor confirmation number.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the royalty payment. Tracks progression from initiation through clearing and reconciliation against the originating royalty report.

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining reconciliation variances, disputes, adjustments, or special circumstances related to this payment. Used for audit trail and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of reconciliation between this payment record and the originating royalty report. Indicates whether the payment amount matches the calculated royalty obligation or if discrepancies exist.

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between the payment amount and the expected amount per the royalty report. Positive values indicate overpayment, negative values indicate underpayment. Null if fully reconciled.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax withheld from the royalty payment as required by applicable tax jurisdiction regulations. Common for cross-border royalty payments.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate of withholding tax applied to this royalty payment, as mandated by tax treaty or local tax law. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%).

attributes.references: ESRB Interactive Elements, PEGI Online Notice

attributes.name: ip_ownership_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submitter has confirmed ownership or licensing rights to all intellectual property (IP) contained in the game, including third-party assets, music, art, and franchise elements. Required for compliance with IP licensing terms.

attributes.name: modification_compliance_date
attributes.description: The date by which mandated content modifications must be completed and verified. Null if no modifications required.

attributes.name: modification_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of content modifications mandated by the rating board. Includes specific scenes, dialogue, imagery, or gameplay elements that must be altered or removed. Null if no modifications required.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rating submission record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the submission fee was paid. Null if payment not yet received.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Status of the submission fee payment. Pending (awaiting payment), paid (payment received), overdue (payment past due), waived (fee exempted), refunded (payment returned).

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Target gaming platform(s) for which the rating is being requested. May include console (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo), PC, mobile (iOS, Android), or multi-platform designations.

attributes.name: rating_board
attributes.description: The rating board organization to which this submission was made. ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board - North America), PEGI (Pan European Game Information - Europe), USK (Germany), CERO (Japan), GRAC (South Korea), ACB (Australia), DJCTQ (Brazil). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ESRB|PEGI|USK|CERO|GRAC|ACB|DJCTQ — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESRB, PEGI, USK, CERO, GRAC, ACB, DJCTQ

attributes.name: rating_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or registration number issued by the rating board upon successful rating assignment. Used for compliance verification and platform certification.

attributes.name: rating_decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rating board issued its rating decision. Null if rating not yet assigned.

attributes.name: rating_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the assigned rating becomes valid and can be used in marketing and distribution. Typically the same as or shortly after the rating decision date.

attributes.name: rating_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rating expires and must be renewed, if applicable. Some rating boards require periodic re-certification for live-service games. Null for ratings with no expiry.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rating submission materials were formally submitted to the rating board. This is the principal business event timestamp for the submission lifecycle.

attributes.name: submission_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee charged by the rating board for processing this submission. Amount varies by rating board, submission type, and title complexity.
attributes.references: ESRB Fee Schedule, PEGI Fee Schedule

attributes.name: submission_fee_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the submission fee (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for this rating submission, typically assigned by the submitting organization or rating board tracking system.
attributes.references: ESRB Submission Guidelines, PEGI Submission Process

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rating submission. Draft (being prepared), submitted (sent to board), under_review (board reviewing), pending_info (awaiting additional information), rated (rating assigned), rejected (submission denied), withdrawn (voluntarily pulled), expired (rating validity ended). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|pending_info|rated|rejected|withdrawn|expired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Type of rating submission. Initial (first-time rating for new title), re-rating (resubmission after content changes), DLC (Downloadable Content rating), patch (content update rating), update (revised submission), appeal (challenge to assigned rating).
attributes.references: ESRB Submission Guidelines, PEGI Submission Process

attributes.name: submitter_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact for this rating submission. Used for rating board correspondence and notifications.

attributes.name: submitter_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organization that submitted the rating application on behalf of the licensee or publisher.

attributes.name: submitter_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact for this rating submission.

attributes.name: third_party_content_disclosed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submission disclosed the use of third-party licensed content (music, art assets, middleware, game engine components). Required for rating board transparency and IP compliance.

attributes.name: title_name
attributes.description: The name of the game title or DLC being submitted for rating as it will appear on the rating certificate and in public-facing materials.

products.name: ip_dispute
products.description: Tracks IP ownership disputes, infringement claims, and licensing violation cases — capturing dispute type (infringement claim, royalty underpayment, unauthorized territory use, unlicensed derivative work), claimant identity, respondent identity, disputed IP asset, claim amount, legal counsel assigned, dispute status (open, in mediation, settled, litigated), resolution date, and settlement terms. Supports legal and compliance oversight of the IP portfolio.

attributes.name: ip_dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IP dispute record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the license agreement related to this dispute, if applicable.

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific IP asset (game title, engine technology, trademark, patent, or licensed content) that is the subject of the dispute.

attributes.name: primary_ip_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal legal counsel or external law firm assigned to manage this dispute on behalf of the company.

attributes.name: primary_ip_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the party (individual or organization) filing the IP dispute claim.

attributes.name: actual_legal_cost
attributes.description: Actual total legal and administrative costs incurred in managing and resolving this IP dispute.

attributes.name: alleged_violation_date
attributes.description: Date when the alleged IP infringement or violation is claimed to have occurred or begun.

attributes.name: claim_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount claimed by the claimant as damages or compensation for the alleged IP violation.

attributes.name: claimant_legal_counsel
attributes.description: Name of the law firm or attorney representing the claimant in this dispute.

attributes.name: claimant_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the claimant party filing the IP dispute.

attributes.name: confidentiality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute and its resolution are subject to confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP dispute record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the claim amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the IP dispute, including the nature of the alleged infringement or violation and supporting facts.

attributes.name: dispute_number
attributes.description: Externally-known case number or reference code assigned to this IP dispute for tracking and legal correspondence.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the IP dispute case indicating its progression through resolution stages.

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IP dispute indicating the nature of the claim or violation.

attributes.name: disputed_ip_asset_name
attributes.description: Name or title of the IP asset under dispute (e.g., game title, engine SDK, franchise brand).

attributes.name: document_repository_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the secure repository containing all legal documents, correspondence, and evidence related to this IP dispute.

attributes.name: estimated_legal_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total legal and administrative costs associated with managing and resolving this IP dispute.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the IP dispute claim was formally filed or initiated.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and commentary from legal, compliance, or business teams regarding the dispute strategy, risks, and progress.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction or court system under which the IP dispute is being adjudicated (e.g., US Federal Court, UK High Court, arbitration panel).

attributes.name: litigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when formal litigation or court proceedings were initiated, if the dispute escalated beyond mediation.

attributes.name: mediation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when formal mediation or alternative dispute resolution proceedings began, if applicable.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP dispute record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next internal review or status update meeting regarding this IP dispute.

attributes.name: precedent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dispute case sets a legal or business precedent that may impact future IP licensing or dispute handling.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this dispute based on financial impact, strategic importance, and reputational risk.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the IP dispute was formally resolved, settled, or dismissed.

attributes.name: resolution_method
attributes.description: Method by which the IP dispute was resolved (e.g., out-of-court settlement, court judgment, arbitration).

attributes.name: respondent_legal_counsel
attributes.description: Name of the law firm or attorney representing the respondent in this dispute.

attributes.name: respondent_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the respondent party defending against the IP dispute.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Primary risk category associated with this IP dispute (e.g., financial loss, brand reputation damage, operational disruption).

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount agreed upon or awarded as part of the dispute resolution or settlement.

attributes.name: settlement_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms and conditions of the settlement agreement, including non-monetary provisions such as licensing adjustments, territory restrictions, or future royalty modifications.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the geographic territory where the alleged IP violation occurred.

products.name: sublicense
products.description: Tracks sublicensing arrangements where a primary licensee grants downstream rights to third parties under sublicensing permissions in their IP agreement. Captures sublicensee identity, parent agreement reference, sublicensed IP scope, territory restrictions, revenue share pass-through terms, sublicense effective/expiry dates, approval status, and compliance monitoring requirements. Critical for gaming engine licensing where studios sublicense SDK access to contractors or co-development partners.

attributes.name: sublicense_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sublicense arrangement. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee or team responsible for managing and monitoring this sublicense arrangement.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary IP agreement that grants sublicensing permissions to the licensee.

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific IP asset being sublicensed (game engine SDK, middleware, franchise IP, etc.).

attributes.name: primary_licensee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original licensee who is granting sublicense rights to the sublicensee under their master agreement.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the sublicense arrangement was formally approved by all required parties (primary licensee and original licensor).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the sublicense request, indicating whether the primary licensee and/or original licensor have granted permission.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role who granted final approval for this sublicense arrangement.

attributes.name: audit_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary licensee or original licensor retains the right to audit the sublicensee's usage and revenue reporting.

attributes.name: compliance_monitoring_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sublicensee must submit regular compliance reports or undergo audits to verify adherence to sublicense terms.

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference to the signed sublicense agreement and related legal documents.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sublicense record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this sublicense arrangement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the sublicense arrangement expires or terminates, after which the sublicensee no longer has rights to the licensed IP.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the sublicense arrangement becomes legally binding and the sublicensee may begin exercising granted rights.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sublicensee has exclusive rights within their territory/platform scope, preventing the primary licensee from granting additional sublicenses.

attributes.name: fixed_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time or recurring fixed payment amount for the sublicense, independent of usage or revenue.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sublicense record was most recently updated in the system.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Minimum payment amount the sublicensee must pay regardless of actual usage or revenue generated from the sublicensed IP.

attributes.name: modification_rights
attributes.description: Level of permission granted to the sublicensee to modify, adapt, or create derivative works from the sublicensed IP.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special conditions, or internal observations about this sublicense arrangement.

attributes.name: pass_through_royalty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of sublicense revenue that the primary licensee must pass through to the original licensor as per the parent agreement terms.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the sublicensee must remit royalty or fixed fee payments to the primary licensee.

attributes.name: platform_scope
attributes.description: Permitted gaming platforms and distribution channels for the sublicensed IP (console, PC, mobile, cloud gaming, etc.).

attributes.name: post_termination_obligations
attributes.description: Requirements the sublicensee must fulfill after sublicense termination, such as ceasing use, destroying copies, or completing sell-off periods.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the sublicensee organization for sublicense communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary business contact at the sublicensee organization responsible for managing this sublicense relationship.

attributes.name: rating_board_compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Specific content rating obligations the sublicensee must meet (ESRB, PEGI, CERO, etc.) when using the sublicensed IP in their products.
attributes.references: ESRB, PEGI, CERO, GRAC Rating Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the sublicense request was rejected, if applicable, including specific terms or conditions that were not acceptable.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the sublicensee must submit usage reports, revenue reports, or compliance documentation to the primary licensee.

attributes.name: revenue_share_model
attributes.description: Financial structure governing how sublicense revenue is shared between the primary licensee, sublicensee, and original licensor.

attributes.name: source_code_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sublicensee is granted access to source code of the sublicensed SDK or game engine technology.

attributes.name: sublicense_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this sublicense arrangement, used in contracts and communications.

attributes.name: sublicense_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sublicense arrangement indicating whether it is pending approval, active, suspended, expired, terminated, or revoked.

attributes.name: sublicense_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sublicensing arrangement based on the nature of rights granted (SDK access for contractors, co-development partnerships, distribution rights, etc.).

attributes.name: sublicensed_ip_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific IP assets, SDK components, game engine features, or technology elements covered under this sublicense.

attributes.name: sublicensee_royalty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of revenue that the sublicensee must pay to the primary licensee for use of the sublicensed IP.

attributes.name: sublicensing_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sublicensee is allowed to further sublicense the IP to additional downstream parties (cascading sublicense).

attributes.name: termination_conditions
attributes.description: Specific circumstances under which the sublicense may be terminated early by either party, including breach conditions and cure periods.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the sublicense arrangement.

attributes.name: territory_restrictions
attributes.description: Specific geographic limitations or exclusions where the sublicensee is prohibited from using the sublicensed IP, even if broader territories are granted.

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic territories where the sublicensee is permitted to exercise sublicensed rights, specified as comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional descriptors.

attributes.name: usage_restrictions
attributes.description: Specific limitations on how the sublicensee may use the IP, including prohibited use cases, content restrictions, or technical constraints.

attributes.name: parent_sublicense_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sublicense (parent_sublicense_id)

products.name: economy_config
products.description: Virtual economy configuration parameters per game title defining currency exchange rates, earn rates, sink rates, inflation controls, and economy health thresholds.

attributes.name: economy_config_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the virtual economy configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ab_experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.ab_experiment. Business justification: Virtual economy parameters (earn rates, sink rates, exchange rates, balance caps) are commonly A/B tested for game balance. Experiment attribution enables economy health analysis and monetization impa

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.dev_project. Business justification: Economy configurations are versioned game design artifacts managed within dev projects. Tracking provenance supports balance iteration analysis, regulatory audit trails (economy changes per release),

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user (game designer, economy manager) who approved this configuration for production use.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.game_studio. Business justification: Economy configs are designed by specific studios. Tracking studio ownership supports multi-studio publishers managing different economy models per studio, studio-level economy health monitoring, and a

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title for which this economy configuration applies.

attributes.name: network_region_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gaming platform (console, PC, mobile) for which this economy configuration applies. Null if configuration is cross-platform.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Business justification: Economy configurations must comply with policies governing virtual currency regulations, anti-money laundering controls, and minor spending protections. Required for economy design approval, regulator

attributes.name: title_season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game season or content release period associated with this economy configuration. Null for non-seasonal configurations.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: Identifier for the A/B test variant this economy configuration represents. Used for experimentation and optimization. Null for non-test configurations.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this economy configuration was approved for production deployment.

attributes.name: base_earn_rate_primary
attributes.description: Default rate at which players earn primary currency per unit of gameplay activity (e.g., per match, per hour, per quest completion).

attributes.name: base_earn_rate_secondary
attributes.description: Default rate at which players earn secondary currency per unit of gameplay activity. Typically lower than primary currency earn rate.

attributes.name: config_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for this economy configuration, used for external reference and integration.

attributes.name: config_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this economy configuration (e.g., 'Season 5 Premium Economy', 'Launch Week Economy').

attributes.name: config_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the business rationale, design decisions, or special considerations for this economy configuration.

attributes.name: config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this economy configuration. Draft configurations are under development, active configurations are live in-game, suspended configurations are temporarily disabled, and archived configurations are historical records.

attributes.name: config_version
attributes.description: Semantic version number of this economy configuration (e.g., 1.0.0, 2.1.3). Used for tracking configuration changes and rollbacks.

attributes.name: conversion_fee_pct
attributes.description: Percentage fee charged when players convert between primary and secondary currencies. Creates friction and currency sink.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this economy configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_expiry_days
attributes.description: Number of days after which unspent currency expires and is removed from player accounts. Only applicable when currency_expiry_enabled is true.

attributes.name: currency_expiry_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether currency balances have expiration dates. When true, unspent currency may expire after a defined period.

attributes.name: daily_earn_cap_primary
attributes.description: Maximum amount of primary currency a player can earn in a single day through gameplay. Prevents exploitation and maintains economy health.

attributes.name: daily_earn_cap_secondary
attributes.description: Maximum amount of secondary currency a player can earn in a single day through gameplay. Typically lower than primary currency cap.

attributes.name: deflation_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable deflation rate (as percentage) before automated controls trigger. Measured as rate of currency sink exceeding earn rate.

attributes.name: economy_health_score_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable economy health score (0-100 scale) before alerts are triggered. Health score measures balance between earn and sink rates, inflation, and player engagement.

attributes.name: economy_health_score_target
attributes.description: Target economy health score (0-100 scale) that represents optimal economy balance. Used for monitoring and automated adjustment decisions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this economy configuration expires and is no longer active. Null for open-ended configurations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this economy configuration becomes active and begins governing in-game economy behavior.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_primary_to_secondary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchange Rate Primary to Secondary Currency
attributes.description: Conversion rate from primary currency to secondary currency (e.g., 100 gold = 1 gem would be 0.01). Used for in-game currency conversion mechanics.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_secondary_to_primary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchange Rate Secondary to Primary Currency
attributes.description: Conversion rate from secondary currency to primary currency. May differ from inverse of primary-to-secondary rate to create conversion friction.

attributes.name: inflation_control_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated inflation control mechanisms are active for this economy configuration. When true, system may dynamically adjust earn/sink rates.

attributes.name: inflation_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable inflation rate (as percentage) before automated controls trigger. Measured as rate of currency supply growth exceeding sink rate.

attributes.name: max_balance_cap_primary
attributes.description: Maximum amount of primary currency a single player account can hold. Prevents hoarding and maintains economy balance.

attributes.name: max_balance_cap_secondary
attributes.description: Maximum amount of secondary currency a single player account can hold. Typically higher than primary currency cap for premium currency.

attributes.name: primary_currency_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary virtual currency governed by this configuration (e.g., 'GOLD', 'GEMS', 'VBUCKS').

attributes.name: real_money_to_primary_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Money to Primary Currency Rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate from real-world currency (USD) to primary virtual currency for IAP (In-App Purchase) transactions. Used for monetization calculations.

attributes.name: real_money_to_secondary_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Real Money to Secondary Currency Rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate from real-world currency (USD) to secondary virtual currency for IAP transactions. Typically more favorable than primary currency rate.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country or region code where this economy configuration applies (e.g., USA, EUR, JPN). Null for global configurations.

attributes.name: secondary_currency_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the secondary or premium virtual currency governed by this configuration. Null if only one currency is used.

attributes.name: sink_rate_target_primary
attributes.description: Target rate at which primary currency should be removed from the economy through player spending (e.g., per player per day). Used for economy health monitoring.

attributes.name: sink_rate_target_secondary
attributes.description: Target rate at which secondary currency should be removed from the economy through player spending. Used for economy health monitoring.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this economy configuration record was last modified.

attributes.name: superseded_economy_config_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on economy_config (superseded_economy_config_id)

attributes.description: Internal free-text notes and comments about the promotion for business users. May include rationale, performance observations, or operational instructions.

attributes.name: platform_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platform codes where this promotion is available (e.g., iOS, Android, Steam, PlayStation, Xbox). Empty indicates all platforms.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the promotion used in marketing materials and player-facing interfaces. Externally visible promotion reference.

attributes.name: promotion_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the promotional event shown to players in storefront and marketing channels.

attributes.name: promotion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotion indicating whether it is in planning, running, or concluded.

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional event type indicating the nature and structure of the offer.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_player
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single player can use this promotion. Nullable for unlimited redemptions.

attributes.name: requires_first_purchase
