attributes.name: stackable_with_other_promos
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion can be combined with other active promotions in a single transaction.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the promotion becomes active and eligible purchases can receive the discount. Represents the business event time when the promotional pricing takes effect.

attributes.name: target_player_segment
attributes.description: Player segmentation criteria defining which players are eligible to see and redeem this promotion. May reference LTV segments, behavioral cohorts, or geographic regions.

attributes.name: total_discount_given
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value of all discounts applied through this promotion. Represents the revenue foregone to drive conversion.

attributes.name: total_impressions
attributes.description: Cumulative count of how many times this promotion was displayed to players across all channels and sessions.

attributes.name: total_redemption_cap
attributes.description: Maximum number of total redemptions allowed across all players before the promotion automatically ends. Nullable for uncapped promotions.

attributes.name: total_redemptions
attributes.description: Cumulative count of how many times players successfully used this promotion to complete a purchase.

attributes.name: total_revenue_generated
attributes.description: Cumulative gross revenue (before discount) from all transactions that used this promotion. Measured in USD for reporting consistency.

attributes.name: superseded_promotion_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on promotion (superseded_promotion_id)

products.name: catalog_offer
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of specific MTX catalog items within time-limited monetization offer campaigns. It captures the operational relationship between purchasable offerings and targeted promotional campaigns. Each record links one MTX catalog item to one offer campaign with campaign-specific pricing, display priority, and performance tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this campaign-item pairing. This enables dynamic campaign composition, A/B testing of item selection, and per-item performance analytics within campaigns.. Existence Justification: In F2P gaming monetization, offer campaigns routinely feature multiple catalog items (bundles, currency packs, cosmetics) to maximize conversion across player segments, and individual catalog items appear in multiple campaigns over time (seasonal sales, whale retention offers, new player promotions). The business actively manages campaign composition by adding/removing items, testing different item mixes via A/B testing, and tracking per-item performance metrics (impressions, conversions, revenue) within each campaign to optimize future campaign design.

attributes.name: catalog_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this catalog-offer association record. Primary key.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user who added this catalog item to the campaign. Supports audit trail and campaign management accountability.

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the MTX catalog item included in this offer campaign

attributes.name: offer_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the offer campaign featuring this catalog item

attributes.name: ab_test_variant_assignment
attributes.description: A/B test variant identifier for this specific catalog item within the campaign. Enables testing different item selections or pricing strategies within the same campaign framework. May differ from the campaign-level ab_test_variant when testing item-level variations.

attributes.name: added_to_campaign_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this catalog item was added to the campaign. Supports dynamic campaign composition where items are added/removed during the campaign lifecycle.

attributes.name: campaign_specific_discount_value
attributes.description: The discount or bonus value applied to this specific catalog item within this campaign. May override the catalog item's default promo_discount_pct for campaign-specific pricing strategies. Interpretation depends on the campaign's discount_type.

attributes.name: conversion_rate_for_item
attributes.description: Calculated conversion rate (redemption_count / impression_count) for this catalog item within this campaign. Tracks item-level performance to optimize future campaign composition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this catalog-offer association record was created in the system.

attributes.name: display_priority_in_campaign
attributes.description: Ranking priority for displaying this catalog item within the campaign's offer UI. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used when campaigns feature multiple items and need to control presentation order.

attributes.name: impression_count_for_item
attributes.description: Cumulative count of how many times this specific catalog item was displayed to players as part of this campaign. Used for campaign performance analytics and A/B testing evaluation.

attributes.name: is_featured_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog item is featured or highlighted within the campaign's promotional materials. Featured items receive premium placement and visual emphasis.

attributes.name: redemption_count_for_item
attributes.description: Cumulative count of how many times this specific catalog item was purchased by players through this campaign. Core metric for campaign effectiveness and item performance within campaigns.

attributes.name: removed_from_campaign_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this catalog item was removed from the campaign. Null if the item is still active in the campaign. Supports dynamic campaign management and performance-based item rotation.

attributes.name: revenue_generated_for_item
attributes.description: Total revenue generated from purchases of this catalog item through this campaign. Denominated in the campaign's currency_code. Used for ROI analysis and campaign optimization.

products.name: ip_compliance_obligation
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between licensed intellectual property assets and regulatory obligations. It captures the specific compliance requirements, audit history, risk assessment, and implementation status for each IP-obligation pairing. Each record links one licensed IP asset to one regulatory obligation with attributes that track compliance posture, deadlines, and enforcement actions specific to that combination.. Existence Justification: In gaming operations, a single licensed IP asset (e.g., a game engine SDK) is subject to multiple regulatory obligations across jurisdictions (GDPR for EU players, COPPA for US children, PEGI rating requirements for Europe, loot box disclosure laws). Conversely, a single regulatory obligation (e.g., GDPR Article 30 record-keeping) applies to multiple IP assets (all engines with telemetry, all games with user accounts). Compliance teams actively manage a compliance matrix mapping each IP to applicable obligations, tracking compliance status, audit dates, risk levels, and remediation plans for each IP-obligation pair.

attributes.name: ip_compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this IP-obligation compliance relationship record. Primary key.

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ip Compliance Obligation - Licensed Ip Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the licensed intellectual property asset subject to this compliance obligation

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ip Compliance Obligation - Regulatory Obligation Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulatory obligation that applies to this IP asset

attributes.name: audit_findings
attributes.description: Summary of findings from the most recent audit of this IP-obligation pair. Documents specific compliance gaps, control weaknesses, or validation results.

attributes.name: compliance_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or team responsible for ensuring this specific IP asset complies with this specific obligation. Assigns accountability at the IP-obligation level.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of this specific IP asset with respect to this specific obligation. Tracks whether the IP meets the regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP-obligation compliance relationship record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this regulatory obligation became applicable to this specific IP asset. May differ from the obligation's general effective date based on IP release date or territory expansion.

attributes.name: exemption_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the exemption expires and the IP must achieve full compliance. NULL if no exemption or exemption is permanent.

attributes.name: exemption_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP asset has been granted an exemption from this obligation by the governing body or internal compliance authority.

attributes.name: implementation_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline by which this IP asset must achieve compliance with this obligation. May be driven by regulation enforcement date, IP launch date, or remediation plan.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit conducted for this IP-obligation pair. Tracks audit history at the granular IP-obligation level.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this compliance relationship record. Tracks when status, audit results, or other attributes were modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit of this IP asset against this obligation. Drives compliance calendar and audit scheduling.

attributes.name: remediation_plan_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the remediation plan document for addressing non-compliance of this IP with this obligation. NULL if compliant or no plan exists.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed risk level for non-compliance of this specific IP with this specific obligation. Risk varies by IP-obligation combination based on IP revenue, territory exposure, and obligation severity.

products.name: catalog_promotion_eligibility
products.description: This association product represents the promotional eligibility relationship between MTX catalog items and promotional campaigns. It captures which purchasable offerings are included in which time-limited promotional events, along with item-specific promotional performance metrics and display configuration. Each record links one MTX catalog entry to one promotion with attributes that track the effectiveness and presentation of that specific item within that specific promotional context.. Existence Justification: In gaming monetization, promotional campaigns are actively managed business events where merchandising teams strategically select which MTX catalog items to include in which promotions, track performance metrics per item-promotion combination, and adjust promotional mix based on conversion data. A single catalog item (e.g., a legendary skin) participates in multiple promotions over time (flash sale, seasonal event, bundle discount), and each promotion includes multiple catalog items with item-specific discount rates, display priority, and performance tracking. This is an operational M:N relationship with its own lifecycle and relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: catalog_promotion_eligibility_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each catalog item-promotion eligibility record

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog Promotion Eligibility - Mtx Catalog Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the MTX catalog entry that is eligible for this promotion

attributes.name: promotion_id

attributes.name: added_to_promotion_timestamp

attributes.name: display_order_in_promotion

attributes.name: effective_discount_percentage

attributes.name: featured_flag

attributes.name: item_specific_redemption_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of how many times this specific catalog item was purchased using this specific promotion, enabling item-level promotional performance analysis

attributes.name: item_specific_revenue_generated
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated from purchases of this catalog item through this promotion, tracking the revenue contribution of each item-promotion combination

attributes.name: promotion_priority_rank

attributes.name: removed_from_promotion_timestamp

products.name: team_brand_license
products.description: This association product represents the licensing contract between an esports team and a microtransaction catalog item. It captures the commercial agreement where a team licenses their brand (logo, name, colors, identity) to be featured in purchasable MTX items such as team skins, emotes, banners, or bundles. Each record links one MTX catalog item to one esports team with attributes that govern the revenue sharing, royalty payments, licensing period, and sales performance tracking that exist only in the context of this commercial relationship.. Existence Justification: In the gaming industry, esports teams license their brand identity (logos, names, colors) to be featured in purchasable microtransaction items such as team skins, weapon wraps, emotes, banners, and all-star bundles. A single MTX item can feature multiple teams (e.g., an all-star bundle with skins for 5 different championship teams), and a single team's brand appears across multiple MTX items (team skin pack, team emote, team banner, seasonal variants). The business actively manages these licensing relationships with negotiated royalty percentages, revenue tracking per team-item pair, licensing periods, exclusivity clauses, and approval workflows.

attributes.name: team_brand_license_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each team brand licensing agreement record

attributes.name: mtx_catalog_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Team Brand License - Mtx Catalog Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the microtransaction catalog item that features the licensed team brand

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Team Brand License - Esports Team Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the esports team whose brand is licensed for this MTX item

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the brand licensing agreement. Teams must approve the use of their brand in MTX items before they can be sold.

attributes.name: contract_reference_code
attributes.description: External reference to the legal contract document or master licensing agreement that governs the terms of this team brand license.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this team brand license record was created in the system.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this licensing agreement grants exclusive rights to feature this team in this item category or time period, preventing other teams from being featured in similar items during the exclusivity window.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this team brand license record was last modified, including sales count or revenue share updates.

attributes.name: licensing_end_date
attributes.description: The expiration or termination date of the brand licensing agreement for this MTX item. Sales after this date do not accrue royalties unless the agreement is renewed.

attributes.name: licensing_start_date

attributes.name: revenue_share_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative revenue share amount (in USD) paid or owed to the esports team for this specific MTX item under this licensing agreement. Calculated as sales revenue × royalty_percentage.

attributes.name: royalty_percentage

attributes.name: sales_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of units sold for this specific MTX item attributed to this team brand license. Used for performance tracking and royalty calculation verification.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Single source of truth for all financial transactions, payment processing, invoices, refunds, chargebacks, and revenue recognition across storefronts (Steam, Epic, console first-party, mobile app stores). Owns PCI DSS-compliant payment instrument records, payout settlements with platform holders, and subscription billing cycles. Distinct from monetization: monetization owns virtual economy design; billing owns the real-money settlement layer.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Master billing document representing a formal request for payment issued to a player or platform partner. Captures invoice number, billing period, total amount, currency, tax breakdown, storefront origin, invoice status (draft, issued, paid, void, disputed), due date, payment terms, and embedded line-item detail (SKU reference, product type, quantity, unit price, line total, tax amount, discount applied, revenue recognition category). SSOT for all real-money billing documents and their granular line breakdowns across storefronts and subscription cycles.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the invoice. Primary key for the invoice entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue invoices are attributed to cost centers (studio/title) for internal P&L reporting and budget variance analysis. Gaming finance teams track revenue by cost center to measure title profitability

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Manual invoice creation (credits, adjustments, enterprise billing) requires audit trail of the billing operations employee who created it for SOX compliance, dispute resolution, and internal controls.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.ip_agreement. Business justification: Royalty invoices are issued under specific IP licensing agreements. Links invoice to governing agreement terms for royalty billing, reconciliation, and audit. Essential for royalty revenue recognition

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Invoices must track tax jurisdiction for VAT/sales tax filing and audit compliance. Gaming platforms operate globally with complex tax nexus rules. Replaces denormalized tax_jurisdiction_code with pro

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Invoices must be issued by a legal entity for tax compliance, VAT/sales tax reporting, and consolidated financial statements. Gaming companies operate multiple legal entities across jurisdictions; inv

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: External payment processor transaction identifier linking this invoice to the actual payment settlement. Used for payment reconciliation and chargeback tracking. Null if invoice is unpaid.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the player to whom this invoice is issued. Links to the player master for customer billing and payment history.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address for the invoice recipient. Required for tax jurisdiction determination and payment processing compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, PCI DSS Cardholder Data

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional address component for complete billing address capture.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, PCI DSS Cardholder Data

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City component of the billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination and geographic revenue reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, PCI DSS Cardholder Data

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this invoice. Defines the close of the billing cycle for subscription and recurring charges.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this invoice. Used for subscription billing cycles and recurring revenue recognition.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination and payment fraud detection.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, PCI DSS Cardholder Data

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province component of the billing address. Critical for US state sales tax and Canadian provincial tax calculations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, PCI DSS Cardholder Data

attributes.name: chargeback_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice was subject to a payment chargeback initiated by the cardholder or payment processor. True if chargeback occurred; false otherwise. Critical for fraud detection and payment risk management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the billing system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice. Critical for multi-currency revenue reporting and foreign exchange reconciliation.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to this invoice, including promotional discounts, volume discounts, early payment discounts, or platform-specific adjustments. Reduces the net amount due.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for invoice dispute if status is disputed (e.g., unauthorized charge, service not delivered, billing error, pricing discrepancy). Null if no dispute. Used for customer service escalation and fraud pattern analysis.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is expected per the agreed payment terms. Used for accounts receivable aging and overdue invoice identification.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was formally issued to the customer or platform partner. Serves as the baseline for payment terms and aging calculations.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique invoice number issued to the player or platform partner. Human-readable business identifier used for customer service, accounting reconciliation, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Invoice Document Standard

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, payment, or dispute resolution. Critical for accounts receivable aging and revenue recognition workflows.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of invoice document type. Standard invoices represent normal sales; credit memos represent refunds or adjustments; debit memos represent additional charges; proforma invoices are estimates; recurring invoices are for subscription billing cycles.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this invoice. May include special billing instructions, customer service annotations, or accounting adjustments. Used for audit trail and customer communication context.

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was fully paid. Null if invoice is unpaid or partially paid. Used for cash flow analysis and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculations.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Interface or channel through which the payment was initiated. Distinct from payment method; tracks the user experience touchpoint for conversion funnel analysis and channel-specific revenue attribution.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument type used or expected for this invoice. Identifies the financial instrument (credit card, PayPal, bank transfer, platform wallet, etc.) for PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) compliance tracking and payment processing reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|paypal|bank_transfer|platform_wallet|gift_card|cryptocurrency — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms defining the period within which payment is due. Immediate means payment on receipt; net_X means payment due X days after invoice date.

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total platform commission or distribution fee charged by the storefront (e.g., 30% Apple App Store fee, 12% Epic Games Store fee). Deducted from gross revenue to calculate net payout to the studio.

attributes.name: platform_partner_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the platform partner (Steam, Epic, console first-party, mobile app store) for B2B invoices related to revenue share settlements and payout reconciliation. Null for direct player invoices.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded to the customer if this invoice was partially or fully refunded. Zero if no refund issued. Tracked separately from credit memos for chargeback and dispute analysis.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_category
attributes.description: Accounting classification determining when and how revenue from this invoice is recognized per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 standards. Immediate for one-time purchases; deferred for DLC (Downloadable Content) or season passes; subscription for recurring GaaS (Game as a Service) revenue; usage-based for consumption models; milestone for performance-based contracts.

attributes.name: storefront_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the digital storefront or distribution channel where the transaction originated. Critical for revenue attribution and platform-specific reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STEAM|EPIC|PSN|XBOX|NINTENDO|APPLE|GOOGLE|DIRECT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes, fees, and discounts. Base amount for revenue recognition calculations.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to this invoice, including sales tax, VAT (Value-Added Tax), GST (Goods and Services Tax), or other jurisdiction-specific taxes. Sum of all line-level tax amounts.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_code
attributes.description: Code indicating tax exemption status if applicable (e.g., non-profit organization, educational institution, tax-exempt jurisdiction). Null if no exemption applies.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Effective tax rate percentage applied to this invoice. Composite rate if multiple tax types apply (e.g., state + local sales tax, or VAT).

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final invoice total after applying subtotal, taxes, discounts, and fees. This is the net amount due from the customer or platform partner. Used for payment reconciliation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was last modified. Tracks changes to invoice status, amounts, or payment information for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: voided_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this invoice was voided (e.g., billing error, duplicate invoice, customer cancellation, fraud). Null if invoice has not been voided. Required for financial audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice was voided or cancelled. Null if invoice has not been voided. Used for audit trail and revenue reversal tracking.

products.name: invoice_line
products.description: Individual line items on a billing invoice, representing discrete chargeable units such as a game title purchase, DLC pack, season pass, subscription period, or IAP bundle. Captures SKU reference, quantity, unit price, line total, tax amount, discount applied, and revenue recognition category. Enables granular revenue breakdown per storefront transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the invoice line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: content_release_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_release. Business justification: Invoice lines track which content drop/DLC release a purchase belongs to. Critical for launch revenue tracking, content drop P&L reporting, and measuring commercial success of major content releases a

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the development studio responsible for the product sold on this line. Used for studio-level revenue attribution and royalty calculations.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title or Intellectual Property (IP) this line item is associated with. Used for title-level revenue reporting and Profit and Loss (P&L) analysis.

attributes.name: iap_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to monetization.iap_transaction. Business justification: Invoice lines for IAP purchases need transaction linkage for refund reconciliation, entitlement revocation, and chargeback dispute resolution. Financial operations require tracing invoice lines to ori

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent invoice header that contains this line item. Links this line to the overall billing transaction.

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: Invoice lines itemize specific licensed IP usage (engine licenses, middleware components, music tracks, brand assets). Enables IP-specific revenue recognition, royalty calculation, and usage-based bil

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that drove this purchase. Used to calculate Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) and campaign effectiveness. Null if purchase was organic.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the player who made this purchase. Links billing transactions to player behavior analytics and Lifetime Value (LTV) calculations.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to platform.storefront. Business justification: Invoice lines itemize sales per storefront for multi-platform publishers. Required for storefront-specific revenue attribution, platform fee reconciliation, and regional tax compliance reporting.

attributes.name: storefront_order_id
attributes.description: External transaction identifier provided by the platform or storefront (Steam order ID, Epic transaction ID, Apple receipt ID, Google order token). Used for reconciliation with platform payout reports.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Amount reversed due to chargeback initiated by the payment card issuer. Zero if no chargeback has occurred. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: chargeback_date
attributes.description: Date when the chargeback was processed against this line item. Null if no chargeback has occurred.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was first created in the billing system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item, including promotional discounts, coupon redemptions, loyalty rewards, or platform sale pricing. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: Promotional code, coupon identifier, or campaign code applied to this line item. Null if no discount code was used.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice, used for ordering and referencing individual line items on the invoice document.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current status of this invoice line item: active (valid charge), refunded (fully refunded), partially_refunded (partial refund issued), disputed (under dispute), or chargeback (payment reversed by card issuer).

attributes.name: line_total
attributes.description: Final total for this line item including all discounts and taxes: subtotal + tax_amount. This is the amount recognized for this line. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Original catalog or storefront list price per unit before promotional discounts. Used to calculate discount percentage and promotional effectiveness.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was last modified. Updated when refunds, chargebacks, or status changes occur. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: Net revenue after platform fees: line_total - platform_fee_amount. This is the amount the studio receives after platform revenue share. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the distribution platform or storefront (e.g., 30% Apple/Google fee, Steam revenue share). Deducted from gross revenue to calculate net payout. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: platform_fee_rate
attributes.description: Platform fee rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 for 30% platform fee). Used for financial modeling and payout reconciliation.

attributes.description: Total amount refunded for this line item. Zero if no refund has been issued. Expressed in the invoice currency.

attributes.description: Date when the refund was processed for this line item. Null if no refund has been issued.

attributes.name: refund_eligible_flag

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_category
attributes.description: Accounting treatment for revenue recognition: immediate (one-time purchase), deferred (season pass, pre-order), subscription (recurring), or usage-based (consumable virtual currency).

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_end_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue recognition ends for this line item. Null for immediate recognition. For subscriptions or deferred items, marks the end of the recognition period.

attributes.description: Date when revenue recognition begins for this line item. For immediate recognition, equals the invoice date. For deferred or subscription items, marks the start of the recognition period.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Product identifier representing the specific item sold: game title, Downloadable Content (DLC) pack, season pass, subscription tier, In-App Purchase (IAP) bundle, or virtual currency package.

attributes.name: subscription_period_start_date

attributes.description: Geographic tax jurisdiction code or name where the tax was assessed (e.g., state, province, country). Required for multi-jurisdiction tax reporting.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per single unit of the Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) before any discounts or taxes. Expressed in the invoice currency.

Enables tracking of every billing cycle execution and retry logic for GaaS subscription management.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.description: Reference identifier for the financial settlement batch or payout that includes this billing cycle. Used for reconciliation with platform holders and payment processors.

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: line_number

attributes.name: line_subtotal
attributes.description: Total amount for this line before taxes. Calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price minus discount amount.

attributes.name: line_total
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item including all discounts and taxes. Represents the actual revenue recognized for this SKU.

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Original catalog list price for the SKU before promotional discounts. Used to calculate discount percentage and promotional effectiveness.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this order line record was last modified. Tracks updates to fulfillment status, refunds, or corrections.

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: Net revenue received by the publisher after platform fees and taxes. Used for financial reporting and revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the distribution platform for this line item. Deducted from gross revenue to calculate net payout. Business-confidential commercial terms.

attributes.name: platform_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of line total retained by the platform as commission. Varies by platform, product type, and commercial agreement. Business-confidential.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Display name of the product or SKU as shown to the player at time of purchase. Captured for historical accuracy even if product name changes later.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the product being purchased. Distinguishes between base games, downloadable content, virtual currency packs, cosmetic items, and other monetization SKUs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_game|dlc|expansion|season_pass|virtual_currency|cosmetic_bundle|loot_box|battle_pass — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of this SKU purchased in this line item. Typically 1 for digital goods, but may be higher for virtual currency packs or bundles.

attributes.name: refund_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is eligible for refund based on platform policies, time since purchase, and usage. Used for customer support workflows.

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if this line item was refunded. Captured for chargeback analysis and product quality monitoring.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line item was refunded. Used for revenue reversal and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue for this line item is recognized for financial reporting purposes. May differ from purchase date for deferred revenue items like season passes.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_status
attributes.description: Current status of revenue recognition for this line item. Tracks whether revenue has been recognized immediately or is being deferred over time.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on this line item. Includes sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes based on player location and platform requirements.
attributes.references: OECD International VAT/GST Guidelines, US Sales Tax regulations

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Tax rate applied to this line item expressed as decimal. Used for tax reporting and reconciliation with platform remittances.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per single unit of the SKU before any discounts or taxes. Denominated in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: virtual_currency_amount
attributes.description: Quantity of virtual currency granted if this line item is a virtual currency pack. Null for non-currency SKUs.

products.name: platform_payout
products.description: Record of revenue settlement payments received from first-party platform holders and digital storefronts (Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo, Valve, Epic, Apple, Google). Captures payout period, gross revenue, platform revenue share percentage, net payout amount, currency, payout date, settlement reference, platform identifier, reconciliation status, and embedded per-title/SKU line-item breakdown (title reference, SKU type, units sold, gross revenue, returns/refunds deducted, net revenue, platform fee rate, net payout line amount). SSOT for all platform holder revenue share settlements, payout reconciliation, and per-title revenue attribution.

attributes.name: platform_payout_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the platform payout settlement record.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the bank account that received this payout settlement.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the finance user who approved and reconciled this payout settlement.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the journal entry in the general ledger that records this payout settlement.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the receiving legal entity within the gaming business that received this payout settlement.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the first-party platform holder or digital storefront (Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo, Valve, Epic, Apple, Google) that issued this payout.

attributes.name: adjustments_amount
attributes.description: Net adjustments applied by the platform holder (e.g., prior period corrections, promotional credits, dispute resolutions).

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payout settlement was approved by the finance team.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payout settlement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payout settlement (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied by the platform holder for currency conversion, if applicable.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter to which this payout settlement is attributed for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this payout settlement is attributed for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date when this payout settlement was posted to the general ledger in the ERP system.

attributes.name: gl_posting_status
attributes.description: Status of the general ledger posting for this payout settlement in the ERP system.

attributes.name: gross_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated across all titles and SKUs during the payout period before platform fees, returns, and refunds.

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Number of per-title or per-SKU line items included in this payout settlement breakdown.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payout settlement record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_payout_amount
attributes.description: Net settlement amount paid to the gaming business after platform fees, returns, refunds, and adjustments.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used by the platform holder to transfer the payout funds.

attributes.name: payout_date
attributes.description: Date when the platform holder transferred the settlement funds to the gaming business.

attributes.name: payout_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the sales period covered by this payout settlement.

attributes.name: payout_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the sales period covered by this payout settlement.

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total platform revenue share fee deducted by the platform holder from gross revenue.

attributes.name: platform_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Platform revenue share percentage applied to gross revenue (e.g., 30.00 for 30% platform fee).

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when this payout settlement was reconciled and approved by the finance team.

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes
attributes.description: Notes and comments from the finance team regarding reconciliation findings, discrepancies, or resolutions.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current reconciliation status of this payout settlement against internal revenue records.

attributes.name: returns_refunds_amount
attributes.description: Total amount deducted for returns, refunds, and chargebacks during the payout period.

attributes.name: settlement_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier provided by the platform holder for this payout settlement, used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: statement_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed payout statement document provided by the platform holder.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter country code representing the tax jurisdiction where tax was withheld.

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount withheld by the platform holder for jurisdictional tax compliance (e.g., VAT, sales tax, withholding tax).

attributes.name: units_sold_total
attributes.description: Total number of units (game copies, DLC, MTX, subscriptions) sold across all titles during the payout period.

products.name: payout_line
products.description: Granular line-item breakdown of a platform payout settlement, detailing revenue contribution per game title, SKU, or product category within a payout period. Captures title reference, SKU type, units sold, gross revenue, returns/refunds deducted, net revenue, platform fee rate, and net payout line amount. Enables per-title revenue reconciliation against platform holder statements.

attributes.name: payout_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payout line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the development studio responsible for the game title, used for revenue attribution and royalty calculations.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title that generated the revenue for this payout line. Links to the game title master entity.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Payout lines track region_code for tax/regulatory treatment per jurisdiction. Gaming platforms must allocate revenue by jurisdiction for tax filing and regional compliance reporting. Replaces denormal

attributes.name: platform_payout_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payout settlement batch that this line item belongs to. Links to the payout header entity.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution platform that processed the transactions for this payout line (Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, Apple App Store, Google Play).

attributes.name: title_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU or product variant that contributed to this payout line (e.g., base game, DLC, season pass, in-game currency pack).

attributes.name: adjustments_amount
attributes.description: Other revenue adjustments applied by the platform holder (e.g., promotional credits, pricing corrections, currency adjustments).

attributes.name: chargebacks_amount
attributes.description: Total value of payment chargebacks for this SKU during the payout period, deducted from gross revenue.
attributes.references: PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code associated with this payout line for internal cost allocation and profitability analysis (SAP S/4HANA CO module).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payout line record was first created in the billing system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payout line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason for dispute if reconciliation status is disputed (e.g., unit count mismatch, fee rate discrepancy, missing transactions, incorrect SKU mapping).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this payout line revenue is posted in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA FI module).

attributes.name: gross_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated by this SKU before any deductions (returns, refunds, chargebacks, platform fees). Reported in the payout currency.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the payout settlement, used for ordering and reference purposes.

attributes.name: net_payout_amount
attributes.description: Final net payout amount for this line item after all deductions and platform fees. This is the amount remitted to the publisher.

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Net revenue after deducting returns, refunds, chargebacks, and adjustments from gross revenue. This is the amount subject to platform fee calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this payout line, used for documenting reconciliation issues, adjustments, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total platform fee deducted by the platform holder, calculated as net revenue multiplied by platform fee rate.

attributes.name: platform_fee_rate
attributes.description: Platform holder commission rate applied to net revenue, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 for 30%, 0.1200 for 12%). Rate varies by platform, title, and contractual terms.

attributes.name: platform_name
attributes.description: Name of the distribution platform, denormalized for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: platform_statement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier from the platform holders settlement statement that corresponds to this payout line, used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current reconciliation status of this payout line against internal sales records: pending initial review, reconciled and matched, disputed with platform, adjusted after dispute resolution, or approved for revenue recognition.

attributes.name: refunds_amount
attributes.description: Total value of refunds issued for this SKU during the payout period, deducted from gross revenue.

attributes.name: returns_amount
attributes.description: Total value of product returns for this SKU during the payout period, deducted from gross revenue.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue from this payout line was recognized in the general ledger for financial reporting purposes, per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 guidance.

attributes.name: sales_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the sales period covered by this payout line item.

attributes.name: sales_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the sales period covered by this payout line item.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Platform-specific SKU code or product identifier as reported by the platform holder (Steam, Epic, PlayStation, Xbox, App Store, Google Play).

attributes.name: sku_type
attributes.description: Category of the SKU: base game, downloadable content (DLC), season pass, expansion, microtransaction (MTX), in-app purchase (IAP), or subscription. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_game|dlc|season_pass|expansion|mtx|iap|subscription — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount collected or withheld for this payout line, including VAT, sales tax, or withholding tax as applicable by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Effective tax rate applied to this payout line, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 for 20% VAT).

attributes.name: units_sold
attributes.description: Number of units sold for this SKU during the payout period. For consumable MTX or IAP, represents transaction count.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payout line record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: billing_tax_record
products.description: Transactional record of tax calculated, collected, and remitted on a billing transaction. Captures tax jurisdiction (country, state/province, municipality), tax type (VAT, GST, sales tax, digital services tax, withholding tax), tax rate applied, taxable amount, tax amount collected, tax exemption flag, exemption certificate reference, remittance status, and filing period reference. Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance for global digital game sales including EU VAT MOSS, US state nexus rules, and platform-specific tax collection responsibilities across Steam, console, and mobile storefronts.

attributes.name: billing_tax_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing tax record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Tax records are calculated on billing transactions, primarily invoices. The billing_tax_record.billing_transaction_id is a generic reference, but the primary use case is tax calculation on invoices. A

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Tax records must tie to the legal entity responsible for tax remittance and filing. Gaming companies file VAT/sales tax returns by legal entity; this link enables tax compliance reporting and audit de

attributes.name: reviewed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Complex tax jurisdictions (VAT MOSS, digital services tax, nexus determinations) require manual review by finance/tax team before filing. Reviewer tracking is mandatory for compliance audit trails, ta

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this tax record to detailed audit logs, supporting documentation, or compliance evidence. Used for tax authority audits and internal compliance reviews.

attributes.name: billing_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the parent billing transaction for which this tax was calculated and collected. Links this tax record to the underlying purchase, refund, or chargeback event.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax record was first created in the billing system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the taxable_amount and tax_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: customer_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is a business entity (True) or a consumer (False). Affects tax treatment (e.g., B2B reverse charge vs B2C standard VAT).

attributes.name: customer_tax_identifier
attributes.description: The customers tax identification number (e.g., VAT number for B2B transactions, EIN, TIN) if provided and relevant for tax reporting. Nullable for B2C transactions. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: filing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the tax filing period (month, quarter, or year) to which this tax record belongs. Used for aggregating tax liability for periodic filings.

attributes.name: filing_period_reference
attributes.description: Human-readable reference for the filing period (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-03, 2024-Annual). Used for reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: filing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the tax filing period (month, quarter, or year) to which this tax record belongs. Used for aggregating tax liability for periodic filings.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax record was last updated. Audit field for tracking changes to remittance status, disputes, or corrections.

attributes.name: nexus_determination_basis
attributes.description: The legal or business basis for establishing tax nexus in this jurisdiction (e.g., physical presence, economic nexus threshold, marketplace facilitator law, customer location). Critical for US state sales tax compliance.
attributes.references: US Supreme Court South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018)

attributes.name: platform_holder
attributes.description: The digital storefront or platform through which the transaction was processed. Determines tax collection responsibility under platform-specific agreements (e.g., Steam collects VAT in EU, Apple collects sales tax in US). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam|epic|playstation|xbox|nintendo|apple|google — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: platform_tax_collection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the platform holder (e.g., Steam, Apple) collected and will remit the tax on behalf of the publisher (True), or whether the publisher is responsible for collection and remittance (False).

attributes.name: product_taxability_category
attributes.description: Classification of the product or service for tax purposes (e.g., electronically supplied services, digital content, tangible personal property, software-as-a-service). Determines applicable tax rules.

attributes.name: reverse_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reverse charge mechanism applies (True) or not (False). Under reverse charge, the customer (not the seller) is responsible for remitting VAT. Common in B2B cross-border EU transactions.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The actual tax amount calculated and collected from the player, in the transaction currency. Equals taxable_amount multiplied by tax_rate, subject to rounding rules.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the government tax authority to which the tax is owed (e.g., HM Revenue & Customs, IRS, California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, Bundeszentralamt für Steuern).

attributes.name: tax_authority_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or transaction identifier assigned by the tax authority for this remittance or filing. Nullable if not yet assigned.

attributes.name: tax_calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the tax was calculated for this transaction. Captures the moment the tax engine determined the applicable rate and amount.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Internal or external tax code representing the tax treatment category for this transaction (e.g., digital goods, software license, in-game currency). Maps to tax engine product taxability rules.

attributes.name: tax_engine_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the tax calculation engine or service used to determine the tax (e.g., Avalara, Vertex, TaxJar, internal tax engine). Supports audit and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: tax_engine_version
attributes.description: Version number of the tax calculation engine or tax rate database used at the time of calculation. Supports reproducibility and audit.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the tax exemption certificate on file, if the exemption was granted based on a certificate provided by the customer. Nullable if no certificate applies.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction qualified for a tax exemption. True if exempt, False if tax was applied normally.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or regulatory basis for the tax exemption, if applicable (e.g., educational institution, government entity, below de minimis threshold, reverse charge mechanism). Nullable if no exemption applies.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive Article 44, US Sales Tax Exemption Certificates

attributes.name: tax_invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number on which this tax was reported to the customer. Links the tax record to the customer-facing invoice document. Nullable if no formal invoice was issued.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country-level tax jurisdiction where the tax obligation arises (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, JPN).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_municipality
attributes.description: City, county, or local municipality name where the tax obligation arises. Nullable for jurisdictions without municipal-level tax.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or first-level administrative subdivision code where the tax obligation arises (e.g., CA for California, ON for Ontario). Nullable for countries without state-level tax.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The tax rate applied to the taxable amount, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.200000 for 20% VAT, 0.0875 for 8.75% sales tax). Supports up to six decimal places for precision in complex jurisdictions.

attributes.name: tax_remittance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collected tax was (or will be) remitted to the tax authority. Nullable if remittance has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: tax_remittance_status
attributes.description: Current status of tax remittance to the tax authority. Pending: collected but not yet remitted; Remitted: paid to authority; Deferred: scheduled for future remittance; Disputed: under audit or dispute; Refunded: returned to customer.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Type of tax applied to the transaction. VAT (Value-Added Tax) for EU and other jurisdictions, GST (Goods and Services Tax) for Canada/Australia/India, sales_tax for US state/local, digital_services_tax for DST regimes, withholding_tax for cross-border payments, consumption_tax for Japan.
attributes.references: OECD Tax Policy Framework, EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The base amount subject to tax, in the transaction currency. This is the pre-tax subtotal on which the tax rate is applied. For VAT, this is the net amount; for sales tax, this is the gross sale amount.

attributes.name: vat_moss_scheme_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: VAT (Value-Added Tax) MOSS (Mini One Stop Shop) Scheme Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction was reported under the EU VAT Mini One Stop Shop scheme (True) or through standard VAT registration in each member state (False). MOSS simplifies VAT compliance for digital services sold to EU consumers.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive, Council Regulation (EU) No 967/2012

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: The VAT registration number of the entity responsible for remitting the tax (either the publisher or the platform holder). Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., GB123456789, DE123456789). Nullable if not applicable.

products.name: revenue_recognition
products.description: Transactional record capturing the recognition of deferred or earned revenue per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 accounting standards. Captures recognition date, recognized amount, deferred amount, recognition method (point-in-time vs. over-time), performance obligation reference, contract modification flag, and accounting period. Enables compliant revenue recognition for game sales, DLC, season passes, and GaaS subscriptions where revenue may be deferred over service periods.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: Primary key for revenue_recognition

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue recognition must be attributed to cost centers for title/studio P&L reporting. Gaming finance tracks recognized revenue by cost center to measure performance against budget and allocate develo

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title (product) for which revenue is being recognized. Links to the specific game, DLC, or season pass.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 2: Identify the performance obligations

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice that triggered this revenue recognition event. Links to the billing invoice that contains the underlying transaction.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Revenue recognition events generate GL journal entries; this link provides audit trail from billing transactions to financial statements. Required for ASC 606/IFRS 15 compliance and external audit sup

attributes.name: original_recognition_event_revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original revenue recognition event being reversed, if reversal_flag is True. Null for non-reversal events.

attributes.name: performance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific performance obligation being satisfied. Relevant for contracts with multiple deliverables (e.g., game + season pass + in-game currency).
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 2: Identify the performance obligations in the contract

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player (customer) for whom revenue is being recognized. The counterparty in the revenue transaction.

attributes.name: primary_revenue_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this revenue recognition record. Supports audit and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue recognition drives profit center reporting for title performance analysis and portfolio management. Gaming companies use profit centers to track title-level profitability and make investment d

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution platform (Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, App Store, Google Play) where the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: storefront_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying financial transaction (purchase, subscription charge, DLC sale, MTX) that generated revenue to be recognized.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player contract or subscription agreement under which this revenue is recognized. Relevant for GaaS and subscription-based revenue streams.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 1: Identify the contract with a customer

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (YYYY-MM or YYYY-QX) to which this revenue recognition is allocated. Used for period-end close and financial reporting.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate transaction price to multiple performance obligations. Standalone_selling_price for observable prices; residual for unobservable prices; adjusted_market_assessment for market-based estimates.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 4: Allocate the transaction price to the performance obligations

attributes.name: contract_modification_date
attributes.description: Date the contract was modified, if contract_modification_flag is True. Null for unmodified contracts.

attributes.name: contract_modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recognition event resulted from a contract modification (e.g., subscription upgrade, refund, chargeback, price adjustment). True if modified; False if original contract terms.

attributes.name: contract_modification_reason
attributes.description: Reason for contract modification (e.g., 'Player upgraded subscription tier', 'Refund issued', 'Chargeback processed', 'Price adjustment applied').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: deferred_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue deferred to future periods. Represents unearned revenue for services not yet delivered (e.g., remaining months of a subscription, unreleased DLC in a season pass).

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to reporting currency at the time of recognition. Used for multi-currency revenue consolidation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this revenue is recognized. Supports multi-year revenue recognition for long-term GaaS contracts.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this revenue is posted. Links to the chart of accounts for financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context for this revenue recognition event (e.g., special accounting treatment, manual adjustments, auditor comments).

attributes.name: performance_obligation_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the performance obligation being satisfied (e.g., 'Deliver base game', 'Provide 12 months of live service', 'Grant access to DLC content').

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue was recognized in the general ledger. The principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Step 5: Recognize revenue when (or as) the entity satisfies a performance obligation

attributes.name: recognition_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for this revenue recognition event. Format: RRE-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: The method used to recognize revenue per ASC 606. Point-in-time for one-time purchases (game sales, DLC); over-time for subscriptions and GaaS; proportional for bundled offerings; milestone for performance-based contracts; usage-based for consumption models.

attributes.name: recognition_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total transaction amount recognized in this event. Used for proportional and milestone-based recognition. Range: 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the revenue recognition event. Tracks whether revenue has been recognized, is still deferred, or has been adjusted.

attributes.name: recognized_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue recognized in this event. For point-in-time recognition, equals total_transaction_amount. For over-time, represents the portion recognized in this period.

attributes.name: remaining_deferred_balance
attributes.description: The cumulative deferred revenue balance remaining after this recognition event. Tracks the liability for unearned revenue.

attributes.name: revenue_category
