[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam|epic|psn|xbox|nintendo|ios|android|web — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: player_response_action
attributes.description: Action taken by the player in response to the dunning notification (updated payment method, contacted support, ignored notification, cancelled subscription, or no action).

attributes.name: processor_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processor for this dunning attempt.

attributes.name: recovery_offer_presented
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a special retention offer (discount, free period) was presented to the player during this dunning event.

attributes.name: resolution_method
attributes.description: Method by which the dunning event was resolved (automatic retry succeeded, manual payment by player, player updated payment method, subscription cancelled, or written off as uncollectible).

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dunning event was resolved (payment succeeded or subscription cancelled). Null if still active.

attributes.name: retry_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days between this attempt and the next scheduled retry.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dunning event record was last modified.

products.name: credit_memo
products.description: Formal financial document issued to a player or platform partner representing a credit against a billing account (e.g., goodwill credit, billing error correction, partial refund as store credit). Captures credit amount, currency, credit reason, originating invoice reference, expiry date, credit status (issued, applied, expired, voided), and applying agent. Distinct from a refund (cash back) — a credit memo applies value to the billing account for future purchases.

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit memo. Primary key.

attributes.name: defect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.defect. Business justification: Credit memos issued for bug-related compensation track defect_id for quality cost accounting, defect impact measurement, and to report cost of quality (COQ) to finance and executive teams for quality

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific game title associated with this credit memo, if the credit is game-specific (e.g., in-game currency credit). Null if credit is account-wide.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Credit memos generate GL journal entries for revenue reversals and customer credits; audit trail requirement. Gaming companies must link credit memos to GL for financial statement accuracy and revenue

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing or promotional campaign that generated this credit memo, if applicable. Null if not campaign-related.

attributes.name: originating_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice that this credit memo is correcting or crediting against. Null if the credit is not tied to a specific invoice (e.g., goodwill credit).

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player account to which this credit memo is issued. Null if issued to a platform partner account instead.

attributes.name: primary_credit_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service agent, finance team member, or automated system process that authorized and issued this credit memo.

attributes.name: storefront_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment transaction that triggered this credit memo (e.g., a refund request, chargeback event). Null if not transaction-specific.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.subscription. Business justification: Credit memos are issued for subscription billing issues (e.g., failed auto-renewal, service outage credits, prorated cancellations). While credit_memo already links to invoice and storefront_order, ma

attributes.name: support_ticket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer support ticket that resulted in this credit memo being issued. Null if not ticket-driven.

attributes.name: tertiary_credit_voided_by_agent_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent who voided or cancelled this credit memo. Null if not voided.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the credit that has been consumed (applied to purchases). Zero if not yet used.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code responsible for the financial impact of this credit memo (e.g., customer service department, marketing department).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit memo record was first created in the billing system.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the credit issued, in the specified currency. This is the gross credit before any application or expiry.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the credit memo, typically formatted as CM-XXXXXXXXXX for customer and platform partner reference.

attributes.name: credit_memo_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit memo: issued (active and available for use), applied (fully consumed against purchases), partially_applied (some balance remaining), expired (past expiry date and no longer usable), voided (cancelled by issuing agent), pending (awaiting approval or system processing).

attributes.name: credit_memo_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit memo indicating the business reason category: goodwill (customer service gesture), billing_error_correction (invoice mistake), partial_refund (store credit instead of cash refund), promotional (marketing campaign credit), chargeback_reversal (chargeback won and credit issued), platform_adjustment (platform partner settlement correction).

attributes.name: credit_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized internal code representing the specific reason for issuing the credit (e.g., BILLING_ERROR, GOODWILL_GESTURE, PROMO_CAMPAIGN, CHARGEBACK_WON). Used for reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: credit_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the credit memo was issued, providing business context and details for audit and customer service reference.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this credit memo record is eligible for archival or deletion per data retention policies and regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, tax law retention periods).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 / Internal Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit memo expires and any remaining balance becomes unusable. Null if the credit has no expiration.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External system identifier or reference number from the platform partner or payment processor related to this credit memo (e.g., Steam transaction ID, Epic order ID). Used for reconciliation.

attributes.name: fully_applied_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit memo balance was fully consumed (remaining_balance reached zero). Null if not yet fully applied.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Consent Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the player provided consent for processing their personal data in relation to this credit memo, if applicable under GDPR. Null if not subject to GDPR or consent not required.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this credit memo is posted for financial reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit memo was officially issued and became available for use by the player or platform partner.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional internal notes, comments, or context about this credit memo for audit trail and customer service reference.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit memo record is within PCI DSS compliance scope: IN_SCOPE (contains or references cardholder data), OUT_OF_SCOPE (no cardholder data), NOT_APPLICABLE (non-card transaction).

attributes.name: platform_partner_code
attributes.description: Reference to the platform partner (Steam, Epic, console first-party, mobile app store) to which this credit memo is issued. Null if issued to a player account instead.

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Current available credit balance (credit_amount minus applied_amount). This is the amount still available for future purchases.

attributes.name: revenue_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this credit memo triggers a revenue reversal in the general ledger (True) or is treated as a marketing expense (False).

attributes.name: storefront_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the digital storefront or platform where the original transaction occurred and where this credit will be applied (Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, Nintendo eShop, Apple App Store, Google Play, Direct Web Store). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STEAM|EPIC|PSN|XBOX|NINTENDO|APPLE|GOOGLE|DIRECT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction applicable to this credit memo (e.g., US-CA for California, GB for United Kingdom, EU-VAT for EU VAT area).

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Code indicating how this credit memo is treated for tax purposes: TAXABLE (credit includes tax component), NON_TAXABLE (credit is pre-tax), TAX_EXEMPT (recipient is tax-exempt), REVERSE_CHARGE (VAT reverse charge applies).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit memo record was last modified (status change, balance update, etc.).

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit memo was voided or cancelled. Null if not voided.

products.name: payment_hold
products.description: Transactional record of a payment authorization hold placed during fraud review or high-value purchase verification. Captures hold amount, currency, hold reason (fraud score threshold, velocity check, geo-mismatch, first-purchase, high-value), authorization reference, hold status (pending_review, approved_for_capture, declined, expired, escalated), review agent or automated rule reference, hold creation timestamp, expiry timestamp, resolution timestamp, and capture/void outcome. Critical for managing the gap between payment authorization and settlement in gaming where digital goods fraud rates are elevated.

attributes.name: payment_hold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment hold record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fraud analyst or automated system agent assigned to review this payment hold. Null for unassigned holds.

attributes.name: fraud_rule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific fraud prevention rule or model that triggered the hold. Enables rule performance analysis and optimization.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment transaction that is subject to this hold. Links to the payment record under review.

attributes.name: payment_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_instrument. Business justification: Payment holds are placed on specific payment instruments during fraud review or high-value purchase verification. The hold is instrument-specific (e.g., a specific credit card is flagged). This FK ena

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the player whose payment is being held for review. Enables player-level fraud analysis and velocity checks.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening_result. Business justification: Payment holds often result from sanctions screening hits (OFAC, export control). Gaming companies must link holds to screening results for AML compliance and hold resolution workflows. Critical for re

attributes.name: storefront_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storefront order associated with this payment hold. Links the hold to the original purchase transaction.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor when the hold was placed. Used to reference the authorization during capture or void operations.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code of the billing address associated with the payment method. Used for geo-mismatch fraud detection.

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the held payment authorization was captured and settled. Null if the hold was declined, voided, or expired.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment hold record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the held payment amount. Essential for multi-currency fraud analysis and settlement.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason the payment hold was declined and voided. Used for fraud pattern analysis and player communication.

attributes.name: decline_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the payment hold was declined. Provides context for player support and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: device_fingerprint
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the device used to initiate the payment. Used for device-based fraud detection and velocity checks.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment hold was escalated to senior fraud analysts or management for additional review. True if escalated.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the payment hold required escalation beyond standard fraud review procedures.

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment hold was escalated for senior review. Null if never escalated.

attributes.name: fraud_rule_version
attributes.description: Version number of the fraud rule or model that was active when the hold was triggered. Critical for audit trails and rule effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned to the payment at the time of hold. Higher scores indicate greater fraud risk. Typically ranges from 0 to 100.

attributes.name: fraud_score_threshold
attributes.description: The fraud score threshold that was exceeded, triggering the payment hold. Used to evaluate and tune fraud prevention rules.

attributes.name: gateway_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway for this authorization hold. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: hold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the payment authorization that is being held pending fraud review. Represents the value at risk.

attributes.name: hold_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment hold was initially placed. Marks the start of the authorization hold period.

attributes.name: hold_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment authorization hold will expire if not captured or voided. Typically 7-30 days from creation depending on card network rules.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique identifier for the payment hold, used for tracking and reference in fraud review workflows and customer support interactions.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason the payment was placed on hold. Used for categorization and reporting of fraud prevention triggers.

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of why the payment was placed on hold. Provides context for fraud analysts and support agents reviewing the case.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment hold in the fraud review and settlement workflow. Tracks progression from initial hold through final resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending_review|approved_for_capture|declined|expired|escalated|cancelled|captured|voided — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hold_trigger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fraud prevention mechanism that triggered the hold. Distinguishes between automated rules, ML models, and manual interventions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fraud_score_threshold|velocity_check|geo_mismatch|first_purchase|high_value|card_verification_failure|suspicious_device|manual_review|rule_engine|machine_learning_model — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the payment transaction originated. Used for geo-location analysis and fraud pattern detection.

attributes.name: payment_processor
attributes.description: Name of the payment gateway or processor handling this authorization hold. Critical for routing capture and void requests.

attributes.name: player_contact_attempted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fraud team attempted to contact the player to verify the transaction. True if contact was attempted.

attributes.name: player_contact_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraud team attempted to contact the player for transaction verification. Null if no contact attempted.

attributes.name: player_verification_status
attributes.description: Outcome of player identity and transaction verification attempts during fraud review. Indicates whether the player confirmed the purchase.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the payment hold after review. Indicates whether the payment was ultimately captured, voided, or allowed to expire.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment hold was resolved with a final decision (approved, declined, expired). Marks the end of the review process.

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by fraud analysts during the review process. Documents investigation findings and decision rationale.

attributes.name: review_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the hold review based on fraud risk, transaction value, and player history. Determines review queue ordering.

attributes.name: review_started_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when fraud review of the held payment began. Used to measure review queue wait times and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: transaction_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code derived from the IP address or device location at transaction time. Used for geo-mismatch analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment hold record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: void_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the held payment authorization was voided and released. Null if the hold was captured or expired.

attributes.name: original_payment_hold_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payment_hold (original_payment_hold_id)

products.name: dunning_cycle
products.description: Master reference table for dunning_cycle. Referenced by dunning_cycle_id.

attributes.name: dunning_cycle_id
attributes.description: Primary key for dunning_cycle

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that created this dunning cycle configuration.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that last modified this dunning cycle configuration.

attributes.name: platform_holder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform holder (Steam, Epic, Sony, Microsoft, Apple, Google) for platform-specific dunning cycles that comply with first-party billing policies.

attributes.name: auto_update_payment_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dunning cycle includes automatic payment method update attempts via account updater services (Visa Account Updater, Mastercard Automatic Billing Updater).

attributes.name: cancellation_threshold
attributes.description: Number of failed attempts after which subscription or service is automatically cancelled if payment is not resolved.

attributes.name: chargeback_protection_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dunning cycle includes chargeback prevention measures such as pre-dispute notifications or representment workflows.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory or compliance framework this dunning cycle adheres to (e.g., PCI DSS, GDPR, CCPA, regional consumer protection laws).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dunning cycle configuration was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for dunning cycles that are currency-specific due to payment processor or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the dunning cycle, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the dunning cycle (e.g., Standard Retry, Aggressive Recovery, Soft Reminder).

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dunning cycle strategy (standard, aggressive, soft, custom, platform_specific for console/mobile stores, regulatory for compliance-driven cycles).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the dunning cycle strategy, business rationale, and intended use cases.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this dunning cycle configuration expires or is superseded. Null for open-ended cycles.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this dunning cycle configuration becomes active and applicable to payment retry logic.

attributes.name: escalation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether failed payments in this cycle are escalated to collections, account management, or alternative recovery processes.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market this dunning cycle applies to, allowing region-specific retry strategies based on local payment behaviors and regulations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NAM|EUR|APAC|LATAM|MEA|CHN|JPN|KOR — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the first retry attempt is initiated after initial payment failure, allowing customer self-resolution.

attributes.name: hard_decline_action
attributes.description: Action taken when a hard decline (permanent failure like stolen card, closed account) occurs: immediate suspension, notification only, request new payment method, or escalate to support.

attributes.name: max_retry_attempts
attributes.description: Maximum number of payment retry attempts allowed within this dunning cycle before escalation or account suspension.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dunning cycle configuration was last modified.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel used for dunning notifications to customers (email, SMS, push notification, in-app message, or multi-channel).

attributes.name: notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated customer notifications (email, SMS, in-app) are sent during this dunning cycle.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument this dunning cycle applies to. Specific cycles may be configured for different payment methods due to varying retry success rates.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this dunning cycle for resource allocation and processing queue management.

attributes.name: retry_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days between consecutive payment retry attempts in this dunning cycle.

attributes.name: revenue_recovery_rate_target
attributes.description: Target percentage of failed payment revenue this dunning cycle aims to recover, used for performance measurement and optimization.

attributes.name: soft_decline_retry_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether soft declines (temporary failures like insufficient funds, issuer timeout) trigger immediate retry attempts within this cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dunning cycle configuration.

attributes.name: subscription_tier
attributes.description: Subscription tier this dunning cycle applies to, enabling differentiated retry strategies for high-value vs. low-value customers.

attributes.name: suspension_threshold
attributes.description: Number of failed attempts after which account or subscription is automatically suspended pending payment resolution.

attributes.name: previous_dunning_cycle_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on dunning_cycle (previous_dunning_cycle_id)

products.name: fraud_rule
products.description: Master reference table for fraud_rule. Referenced by fraud_rule_id.

attributes.name: fraud_rule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fraud_rule

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Automated action taken when the rule is triggered: block transaction, route to manual review, flag for investigation, challenge user with additional authentication, or notify fraud team.

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit logging is enabled for this rule (true) or not (false). Required for high-severity rules and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory or compliance framework this rule supports (e.g., PCI DSS, GDPR, CCPA, regional gaming regulations). Multiple frameworks separated by commas.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fraud rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the fraud pattern this rule detects and the rationale for its configuration.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this rule was deactivated or deprecated. Null for currently active rules.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this rule became active in the fraud detection system.

attributes.name: execution_order
attributes.description: Sequence order in which this rule is evaluated in the fraud detection pipeline. Lower numbers execute first. Used to optimize performance and dependency management.

attributes.name: false_positive_rate
attributes.description: Historical false positive rate (0.0000 to 1.0000) for this rule, calculated as the ratio of incorrectly flagged legitimate transactions to total flagged transactions. Used for rule tuning.

attributes.name: is_machine_learning_based
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule uses machine learning models (true) or deterministic logic (false) for fraud detection.

attributes.name: last_tuned_date
attributes.description: Date when the rule parameters (thresholds, weights, logic) were last adjusted based on performance analysis.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the machine learning model or rule logic (semantic versioning format: major.minor.patch). Null for non-ML rules.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this fraud rule.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fraud rule record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, tuning history, or special considerations related to this fraud rule.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel used for fraud alerts when this rule is triggered: email, SMS, Slack, PagerDuty, or webhook integration.

attributes.name: notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time notifications are sent to the fraud team when this rule is triggered (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: owner_team
attributes.description: Name of the business team or department responsible for maintaining and tuning this fraud rule (e.g., Fraud Operations, Risk Management, Payment Security).

attributes.name: payment_method_filter
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment method types (credit_card, debit_card, paypal, wallet, bank_transfer) to which this rule applies. Null indicates all payment methods.

attributes.name: region_filter
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes to which this rule applies. Null indicates all regions.

attributes.name: risk_score_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight (0.00 to 100.00) assigned to this rule in the composite fraud risk scoring model. Higher weights indicate greater fraud risk contribution.

attributes.name: rule_category
attributes.description: Business category of fraud the rule is designed to detect: payment fraud, account takeover, chargeback fraud, refund abuse, bonus abuse, or identity theft.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the fraud rule, used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: rule_logic_expression
attributes.description: Technical expression or pseudocode defining the rule logic. May reference transaction attributes, user behavior patterns, or external data sources. Confidential to prevent fraud circumvention.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fraud detection rule.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fraud rule by detection methodology: velocity-based, threshold-based, pattern matching, geolocation analysis, device fingerprinting, or behavioral analysis.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Application scope of the rule: global (all transactions), storefront-specific (Steam, Epic, console), region-specific, payment method-specific, or user segment-specific.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of fraud events detected by this rule, determining response priority and escalation path.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fraud rule: active (in production), inactive (disabled), testing (pilot phase), deprecated (scheduled for removal), or suspended (temporarily disabled).

attributes.name: storefront_filter
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of storefront codes (Steam, Epic, PSN, Xbox, AppStore, GooglePlay) to which this rule applies. Null indicates all storefronts.

attributes.name: threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the threshold value: currency (USD, EUR), transaction count, percentage, or velocity rate (per hour, per day).

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value that triggers the rule. Interpretation depends on threshold_unit (e.g., dollar amount, transaction count, velocity rate).

attributes.name: time_window_minutes
attributes.description: Time window in minutes over which the rule evaluates activity. Used for velocity and pattern-based rules (e.g., 5 transactions in 60 minutes).

attributes.name: true_positive_rate
attributes.description: Historical true positive rate (0.0000 to 1.0000) for this rule, calculated as the ratio of correctly identified fraudulent transactions to total actual fraud cases. Measures rule effectiveness.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version number of this rule configuration. Incremented with each modification to support change tracking and rollback.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this fraud rule.

attributes.name: superseded_fraud_rule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fraud_rule (superseded_fraud_rule_id)

attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity. True if flagged, False otherwise.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: The International Bank Account Number used for international transactions, primarily in Europe and other regions. Up to 34 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: is_payout_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account is enabled for receiving payouts (e.g., tournament winnings, creator revenue share). True if enabled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary bank account for the player for payouts and refunds. True if primary, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_refund_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account is enabled for receiving refunds. True if enabled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_four_digits
attributes.description: The last four digits of the bank account number, used for display and identification purposes without exposing the full account number.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bank account record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_used_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank account was last used for a transaction (payout, refund, or withdrawal). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes, comments, or special instructions related to this bank account (e.g., manual review notes, customer service remarks).

attributes.name: payment_token
attributes.description: The tokenized representation of the bank account provided by the payment gateway (e.g., Stripe bank account token, PayPal billing agreement ID). Used for PCI DSS compliance to avoid storing raw account details.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.description: The PCI DSS compliance level applicable to this bank account record based on transaction volume and risk assessment.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: A calculated risk score (0.00 to 100.00) for this bank account based on fraud detection algorithms, transaction history, and verification status.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The routing transit number (RTN) or sort code used to identify the financial institution. Format varies by country (e.g., ABA routing number in USA, sort code in UK).

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: The SWIFT/BIC code identifying the bank for international wire transfers. 8 or 11 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the bank account (e.g., micro-deposit, instant verification via third-party service like Plaid, manual review).

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The status of the bank account verification process (micro-deposit verification, instant verification via Plaid/Stripe, etc.).

attributes.name: verified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bank account was successfully verified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: primary_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bank_account (primary_bank_account_id)

products.name: settlement_batch
products.description: Master reference table for settlement_batch. Referenced by settlement_batch_id.

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Primary key for settlement_batch

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gaming platform or storefront that originated this settlement batch (Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, Apple App Store, Google Play Store).

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total value of manual adjustments, corrections, or promotional credits applied to the settlement batch.

attributes.name: batch_generated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the platform holder generated this settlement batch report.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the settlement batch, used for reconciliation with platform holders and payment processors.

attributes.name: batch_received_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the settlement batch was received and ingested into the billing system.

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the settlement batch in the payment processing workflow.

attributes.name: batch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the settlement batch indicating the nature of transactions included.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Total value of chargebacks disputed by customers during the settlement period, reducing net settlement amount.

attributes.name: chargeback_count
attributes.description: Total number of chargeback disputes recorded in this settlement batch.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this settlement batch record was first created in the billing system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this settlement batch.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement batch is currently under dispute with the platform holder due to discrepancies or contractual disagreements.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the settlement batch is disputed, including specific transaction IDs or calculation errors identified.

attributes.name: gross_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total gross revenue from all transactions in this settlement batch before platform fees, taxes, and adjustments.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this settlement batch record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount payable to the publisher after all fees, taxes, refunds, chargebacks, and adjustments have been applied.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional context, special circumstances, or operational notes related to this settlement batch.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used by the platform holder to transfer the settlement amount.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment transaction reference or wire transfer confirmation number provided by the platform holder or bank.

attributes.name: platform_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total platform holder commission or revenue share deducted from gross revenue (e.g., 30% Steam fee, 12% Epic fee).

attributes.name: platform_report_url
attributes.description: Secure URL link to the original settlement report document provided by the platform holder, stored in document management system.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the settlement batch amounts match internal transaction records or if discrepancies exist.

attributes.name: reconciliation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the settlement batch was successfully reconciled against internal transaction records.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total value of refunds processed during the settlement period, reducing net settlement amount.

attributes.name: refund_count
attributes.description: Total number of refund transactions processed in this settlement batch.

attributes.name: settlement_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the platform holder is obligated to transfer the net settlement amount.

attributes.name: settlement_paid_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the net settlement amount was received in the publisher's bank account.

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the transaction period covered by this settlement batch.

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the transaction period covered by this settlement batch.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount withheld or collected across all transactions in the settlement batch (VAT, sales tax, digital services tax).

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual transactions included in this settlement batch.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between expected settlement amount and actual settlement amount, if a reconciliation discrepancy exists.

attributes.name: previous_settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on settlement_batch (previous_settlement_batch_id)

products.name: performance_obligation
products.description: Master reference table for performance_obligation. Referenced by performance_obligation_id.

attributes.name: performance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for performance_obligation

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Reference to a bundle product if this performance obligation is part of a multi-item bundle requiring transaction price allocation across multiple obligations.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent contract or agreement that contains this performance obligation.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice that billed this performance obligation to the customer.

attributes.name: parent_obligation_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent performance obligation if this is a child obligation (e.g., individual season pass content drops linked to the season pass purchase).

attributes.name: platform_holder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform holder (Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, Apple App Store, Google Play) through which this obligation was sold.

attributes.name: player_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who purchased this performance obligation.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game, DLC, or virtual item product associated with this performance obligation.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific digital storefront where the transaction originated.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating financial transaction that created this performance obligation.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM or YYYY-QN format) in which this performance obligation was initially recorded.

attributes.name: allocated_transaction_price
attributes.description: The portion of the total contract transaction price allocated to this specific performance obligation based on relative standalone selling prices.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance obligation record was first created in the billing system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this performance obligation.

attributes.name: is_distinct
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation is distinct and separately identifiable from other promises in the contract per ASC 606 criteria.

attributes.name: is_material_right
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation represents a material right granted to the customer (e.g., loyalty points, future purchase discounts) that must be accounted for separately.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation is part of a recurring revenue stream (e.g., subscription, season pass with periodic content drops).

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The net amount payable to the publisher after platform holder fees are deducted from the allocated transaction price.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special handling instructions, or accounting notes related to this performance obligation.

attributes.name: obligation_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code identifying this performance obligation for external reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the goods or services promised to the customer under this performance obligation.

attributes.name: obligation_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the performance obligation (e.g., 'Base Game License', 'Season Pass Content', 'In-Game Currency Bundle').

attributes.name: obligation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the performance obligation indicating whether it has been fulfilled or is still outstanding.

attributes.name: obligation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance obligation based on the nature of the deliverable in the gaming context.

attributes.name: platform_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the transaction price retained by the platform holder as their distribution fee (e.g., 30% for most console/mobile stores, 12% for Epic).

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The number of units of this performance obligation purchased (typically 1 for game licenses, may be higher for virtual currency bundles).

attributes.name: recognition_end_date
attributes.description: The date when revenue recognition is expected to be complete for this performance obligation. Null for point-in-time recognition.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: The method used to recognize revenue for this performance obligation (point in time for game licenses, over time for subscriptions and live service content).

attributes.name: recognition_start_date
attributes.description: The date when revenue recognition begins for this performance obligation, typically when control transfers to the customer.

attributes.name: refund_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation is eligible for refund based on platform policies and time elapsed since purchase.

attributes.name: refund_window_end_date
attributes.description: The last date on which the customer can request a refund for this performance obligation per platform refund policies.

attributes.name: remaining_deferred_revenue
attributes.description: Amount of allocated transaction price not yet recognized as revenue, representing future performance obligations.

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: High-level revenue stream classification for financial reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: revenue_recognized_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of revenue recognized for this performance obligation as of the current reporting period.

attributes.name: satisfaction_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the performance obligation was fully satisfied and control transferred to the customer.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Platform-specific SKU or product identifier for the item associated with this performance obligation.

attributes.name: standalone_selling_price
attributes.description: The price at which the entity would sell the promised good or service separately to a customer, used for transaction price allocation.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that last modified this performance obligation record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance obligation record was last modified.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that created this performance obligation record.

attributes.name: parent_performance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on performance_obligation (parent_performance_obligation_id)

products.name: payment_provider
products.description: Master reference table for payment_provider. Referenced by payment_provider_id.

attributes.name: payment_provider_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_provider

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment provider was first activated and made available for processing transactions in the billing system.

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Base URL for the payment provider's API endpoint used for transaction processing, refunds, and status queries. Confidential integration detail.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Version of the payment provider API currently integrated (e.g., v1, v2, 2023-10-16). Critical for maintaining compatibility and planning upgrades.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract with the payment provider automatically renews at the end of the term. True if auto-renewal is enabled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: average_authorization_time_ms
attributes.description: Average time in milliseconds for the payment provider to authorize a transaction. Key performance indicator for checkout experience optimization.

attributes.name: chargeback_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed fee charged by the payment provider per chargeback dispute (e.g., 15.00 USD). Critical for chargeback cost tracking and fraud prevention ROI analysis.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for contacting the payment provider's account management or technical support team. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for contacting the payment provider's support team. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current contract or service agreement with the payment provider. Null for evergreen contracts. Used for renewal planning and vendor management.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current contract or service agreement with the payment provider. Used for contract lifecycle management and renewal planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment provider record was first created in the billing system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment provider was deactivated or deprecated. Null for currently active providers.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment provider record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: merchant_account_id
attributes.description: The merchant account identifier or merchant ID assigned by the payment provider to the gaming company. Used for reconciliation and settlement tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about the payment provider, including special configuration details, known issues, integration quirks, or historical context. Used by billing operations and engineering teams.

attributes.name: pci_certification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent PCI DSS compliance certification for this payment provider. Must be renewed annually per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: pci_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current PCI DSS compliance certification. Providers must be recertified before this date to maintain active status.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance level of the provider. Level 1 is the highest (processing over 6M transactions annually), Level 4 is the lowest (under 1M transactions). Critical for security and audit requirements.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking for routing transactions when multiple providers support the same payment method and region (1 = highest priority). Used in payment routing logic to optimize for cost, performance, or approval rates.

attributes.name: provider_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used internally to identify the payment provider in transaction records and system integrations.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the payment service provider (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Xsolla, Braintree).

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment provider based on service model: payment gateway (Stripe, Adyen), payment processor (Worldpay), digital wallet (PayPal, Apple Pay), bank transfer (ACH, SEPA), mobile payment (Google Pay, Samsung Pay), or console first-party (PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, Nintendo eShop).

attributes.name: refund_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the payment provider for processing refunds. Some providers refund the original transaction fee, others charge a separate refund fee.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Internal risk assessment score for the payment provider (0-100 scale, higher = higher risk). Based on chargeback rates, downtime history, compliance issues, and financial stability. Used for provider selection and monitoring.

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the payment provider settles funds to the merchant account (e.g., USD, EUR). May differ from transaction currency.

attributes.name: settlement_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days between transaction authorization and funds settlement to the merchant account (e.g., 2 for T+2 settlement). Critical for cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the payment provider in the billing system. Active providers are available for new transactions; inactive or deprecated providers may only process refunds or chargebacks for historical transactions.

attributes.name: supported_currencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes that this payment provider supports (e.g., USD,EUR,GBP,JPY,KRW). Used to route transactions to appropriate providers based on player currency.

attributes.name: supported_payment_methods
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment methods supported by this provider (e.g., credit_card, debit_card, paypal, apple_pay, google_pay, bank_transfer, gift_card, cryptocurrency). Used for payment method routing logic.

attributes.name: supported_regions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region codes where this payment provider is available (e.g., USA,CAN,GBR,DEU,JPN,KOR,BRA). Used for geographic routing of payment transactions.

attributes.name: supports_3ds
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment provider supports 3D Secure authentication (3DS 1.0 or 3DS 2.0) for fraud prevention and liability shift. Required in many European markets under PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication.

attributes.name: supports_recurring_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment provider supports recurring billing for subscriptions (e.g., monthly game pass, season pass auto-renewal). True if supported, False otherwise.

attributes.name: supports_tokenization
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment provider supports tokenization of payment instruments for secure storage and reuse. Critical for PCI DSS compliance and one-click checkout.

attributes.name: three_ds_version
attributes.description: Version of 3D Secure protocol supported by the payment provider. 3DS 2.x provides better mobile experience and lower friction than 1.0.

attributes.name: transaction_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the fixed transaction fee (e.g., USD, EUR). Used for multi-currency fee reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_fee_fixed_amount
attributes.description: Fixed per-transaction fee charged by the payment provider in the provider's base currency (e.g., 0.30 USD). Combined with percentage fee for total cost calculation.

attributes.name: transaction_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage-based transaction fee charged by the payment provider (e.g., 0.0290 for 2.90%). Used for revenue recognition and cost allocation calculations.

attributes.name: uptime_percentage
attributes.description: Rolling 30-day uptime percentage for the payment provider's API (e.g., 99.95). Tracked for SLA compliance and provider performance evaluation.

attributes.name: webhook_url
attributes.description: URL endpoint where the payment provider sends asynchronous notifications for transaction events (payment completed, refund processed, chargeback initiated). Used for real-time payment status updates.

attributes.name: parent_payment_provider_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payment_provider (parent_payment_provider_id)

products.name: contract
products.description: Master reference table for contract. Referenced by contract_id.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Primary key for contract

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of formal amendments or addendums executed against this contract since its original signature.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews at the end of its term unless explicitly terminated.

attributes.name: chargeback_liability_party
attributes.description: Specifies which party bears financial responsibility for payment chargebacks and disputes under this contract.

attributes.name: confidentiality_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years after contract termination during which confidentiality obligations remain in effect.

attributes.name: contract_document_url
attributes.description: Secure storage location or reference path to the digitally signed contract document for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the contract, used in communications with platform holders and partners.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract indicating its operational validity and enforceability.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract based on its commercial structure and payment model.

attributes.name: contract_value_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total monetary value of the contract over its full term, used for financial planning and forecasting. Nullable for open-ended or variable contracts.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this contract record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was first created in the billing system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this contract.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving disputes between parties.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms expire or are no longer binding. Nullable for open-ended contracts.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms become legally binding and enforceable.

attributes.name: excluded_territories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes explicitly excluded from this contract. Used for regional licensing restrictions.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this contract.

attributes.name: included_territories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this contract is valid. Nullable if territory_scope is global.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment to the contract. Nullable if no amendments have been executed.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed payment amount that the platform holder commits to pay regardless of actual sales performance. Nullable if no minimum guarantee exists.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this contract record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was last updated in the billing system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special terms, or operational notes relevant to contract administration.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which settlement payments are processed and disbursed to the publisher under this contract.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the end of a billing period within which payment must be remitted. Common values are 30, 45, or 60 days.

attributes.name: pci_compliance_level
attributes.description: PCI DSS compliance tier required for this contract based on transaction volume and payment processing responsibilities.

attributes.name: platform_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of gross revenue retained by the platform holder as commission for distribution and payment processing services.

attributes.name: platform_holder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the platform holder or storefront partner (Steam, Epic, Sony, Microsoft, Apple, Google) with whom this contract is established.

attributes.name: publisher_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game publisher entity that is party to this contract.

attributes.name: refund_policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the refund policy governing transactions under this contract.

attributes.name: refund_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days after purchase during which customers may request a refund under the contract terms. Nullable if refund_policy_type is no_refunds.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to contract expiration that either party must provide notice to prevent automatic renewal. Nullable if auto_renewal_flag is false.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of gross revenue retained by the publisher after platform fees. Typically ranges from 70% to 88% depending on platform and volume tiers.

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when all parties executed the contract, establishing legal agreement. May differ from effective_start_date.

attributes.name: signed_by_platform
attributes.description: Name and title of the authorized signatory who executed the contract on behalf of the platform holder.

attributes.name: signed_by_publisher
attributes.description: Name and title of the authorized signatory who executed the contract on behalf of the publisher.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary tax jurisdiction governing this contract for withholding and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the contract before its natural expiration.

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of the contract defining where the agreement terms apply.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of payment withheld by the platform holder for tax remittance to applicable jurisdictions. Varies by publisher domicile and tax treaties.

attributes.name: master_contract_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on contract (master_contract_id)

products.name: product
products.description: Master reference table for product. Referenced by product_id.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.description: Primary key for product

attributes.name: age_rating
attributes.description: ESRB age rating classification for the product (E=Everyone, E10+=Everyone 10+, T=Teen, M=Mature 17+, AO=Adults Only 18+, RP=Rating Pending).

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: Standard retail price for the product before any discounts, promotions, or regional adjustments. Expressed in the default currency (USD).

attributes.name: bundle_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is a bundle containing multiple sub-products sold as a single SKU.

attributes.name: content_descriptor
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ESRB content descriptors (e.g., Violence, Blood, Strong Language) that describe content elements in the product.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was first created in the billing system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base price.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed marketing description of the product, including features, gameplay, and content overview.

attributes.name: developer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the development studio that created this product.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was delisted or removed from sale. Null for active products.

attributes.name: early_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is currently in early access or pre-release state.

attributes.name: genre
attributes.description: Primary game genre classification (e.g., Action, RPG, Strategy, Sports, Simulation).

attributes.name: is_refundable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is eligible for customer refunds per platform and internal refund policies.

attributes.name: is_subscription
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is sold as a recurring subscription (true) or one-time purchase (false).

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this product record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was last updated in the billing system.

attributes.name: parent_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent base game product for DLC, expansions, and season passes. Null for standalone products.

attributes.name: pci_dss_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions for this product involve payment card data and fall under PCI DSS compliance scope.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Target gaming platform or device ecosystem for which this product is available.

attributes.name: platform_revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of gross revenue retained by the platform holder (e.g., 30% for Steam, 12% for Epic). Used for payout settlement calculations.

attributes.name: pre_order_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is available for pre-order purchase before the official release date.

attributes.name: pre_order_bonus_description
attributes.description: Description of exclusive content or bonuses provided to customers who pre-order this product. Null if no pre-order bonus exists.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the product offering type within the gaming ecosystem.

attributes.name: publisher_id
attributes.description: Reference to the publishing entity responsible for this product.

attributes.name: refund_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase during which a refund can be requested. Null if product is not refundable.

attributes.name: regional_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this product is available for sale. Empty indicates global availability.

attributes.name: regional_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this product is explicitly blocked or restricted from sale due to regulatory or licensing constraints.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Official public release date of the product on the specified platform.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_model
attributes.description: Accounting treatment model for revenue recognition per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 standards.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief summary description of the product used in storefront listings and search results (typically 100-200 characters).

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Externally-known unique product code used across storefronts (Steam, Epic, console first-party, mobile app stores) for catalog identification and inventory tracking.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the product in the catalog and billing system.

attributes.name: storefront_id

products.name: infrastructure_test_execution
products.description: This association product represents the execution event between game_server and test_case. It captures the operational record of running a specific test case against a specific game server instance. Each record links one game_server to one test_case with execution-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this test run.. Existence Justification: In gaming QA operations, test cases are executed against multiple game server instances (different regions, configurations, OS versions, build versions) to validate functionality across the fleet. Each game server hosts executions of multiple test cases as part of regression, performance, and certification testing. The business actively manages test execution records as operational QA artifacts.

attributes.name: alert_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the monitoring alert, describing the condition being monitored.

attributes.description: Classification of the alert based on the monitoring condition: threshold (metric exceeds limit), anomaly (unusual pattern detected), availability (service up/down), performance (latency/throughput degradation), security (threat detected), capacity (resource exhaustion).

attributes.description: The name or identifier of the specific engineer or responder currently assigned to investigate and resolve the alert.

attributes.name: assigned_team

attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the alert was automatically resolved by the monitoring system (true) or required manual intervention (false). Used to measure self-healing infrastructure effectiveness.

attributes.name: availability_zone
attributes.description: The cloud provider availability zone or data center identifier where the resource is deployed. Used for fault domain analysis and capacity planning.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the alert incident was formally closed after verification and post-incident review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this monitoring alert record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: environment
attributes.description: The deployment environment where the monitored resource is running: production (live player-facing), staging (pre-production testing), development (active development), qa (quality assurance), disaster_recovery (failover standby).

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The current escalation tier for the alert (0 = initial on-call team, 1 = senior engineer, 2 = engineering manager, 3 = director/VP, 4 = executive). Increments based on time-to-acknowledge and severity.

attributes.name: evaluation_window_seconds
attributes.description: The time window in seconds over which the metric is evaluated before triggering the alert. Prevents false positives from transient spikes.

attributes.name: game_title
attributes.description: The specific game title or franchise affected by the alert. Critical for prioritizing alerts based on player base and revenue impact.

attributes.name: metric_name
attributes.description: The name of the performance or health metric being monitored (e.g., cpu_utilization_percent, network_latency_ms, active_player_count, server_response_time_ms).

attributes.description: The unit of measurement for the metric value (e.g., percent, milliseconds, requests_per_second, concurrent_users, gigabytes).

attributes.name: metric_value
attributes.description: The observed value of the monitored metric at the time the alert was triggered. This is the principal quantitative fact that caused the alert condition.

attributes.name: notification_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of notification channels used to alert responders (e.g., pagerduty, slack, email, sms, webhook). Tracks how the alert was communicated.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: The gaming platform affected by the alert: pc (Windows/Mac/Linux), console (PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo), mobile (iOS/Android), cross_platform (multi-platform service).

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Operational priority for alert response: P1 (immediate response required), P2 (urgent), P3 (normal), P4 (low), P5 (planning). Derived from severity and business impact.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Three-letter geographic region code where the monitored resource is deployed (e.g., USE for US East, EUW for EU West, APS for Asia Pacific South). Critical for regional SLA tracking and player experience monitoring.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the investigation process, root cause findings, remediation actions taken, and any follow-up tasks. Populated after alert resolution for knowledge management.

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the underlying condition was resolved and the alert was cleared.

attributes.name: resource_identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the specific resource instance being monitored (e.g., server hostname, instance ID, service endpoint, IP address).

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: The type of infrastructure resource being monitored: game_server (dedicated or cloud game server instance), matchmaking_service (player matchmaking backend), cdn_node (content delivery network edge node), database (persistent data store), load_balancer (traffic distribution), network_device (router/switch), storage_volume (disk/SAN).

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: The high-level category of the identified root cause after investigation (e.g., hardware_failure, software_bug, capacity_limit, network_issue, configuration_error, third_party_dependency, ddos_attack). Populated after resolution for trend analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hardware_failure|software_bug|capacity_limit|network_issue|configuration_error|third_party_dependency|ddos_attack|player_surge|deployment_issue|database_contention — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: service_name
attributes.description: The name of the game service or application component affected by the alert (e.g., player-authentication, game-session-manager, leaderboard-api, voice-chat-service).

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Business impact severity of the alert: critical (service outage, immediate action required), high (major degradation), medium (minor impact), low (potential issue), informational (FYI only).

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this alert represents a breach of defined service level agreement thresholds (e.g., uptime SLA, latency SLA, availability SLA). True indicates SLA breach.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The monitoring or observability system that generated the alert (e.g., Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch, Grafana).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the alert: active (triggered, awaiting acknowledgment), acknowledged (team notified), investigating (root cause analysis in progress), resolved (condition cleared), closed (incident closed), suppressed (muted by rule).

attributes.name: threshold_operator
attributes.description: The comparison operator used to evaluate the metric against the threshold (e.g., greater_than for high-water marks, less_than for low-water marks).

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: The configured threshold value that, when exceeded or breached, triggers the alert. Used for threshold-type alerts.

attributes.name: triggered_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the monitoring condition was first detected and the alert was triggered. This is the principal business event timestamp for the alert lifecycle.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this monitoring alert record was last modified. Tracks changes to alert status, assignments, and resolution details.

attributes.name: parent_monitoring_alert_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on monitoring_alert (parent_monitoring_alert_id)
