attributes.name: affected_session_count
attributes.description: The number of distinct game sessions impacted by this crash signature. Distinct from occurrence_count; a single session may produce multiple crash events. Used for session-level crash rate calculation.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude Analytics Standard; Internal QA KPI Standard

attributes.name: build_configuration
attributes.description: The compilation configuration of the game build that crashed. Debug builds include additional logging; Development builds are pre-release with some optimizations; Release builds are production-optimized; Gold Master is the final certified release candidate.
attributes.references: Unity/Unreal Engine Build Pipeline Standard; Internal QA Process Standard

attributes.name: build_version
attributes.description: Human-readable semantic version string of the game build at the time of the crash (e.g., 1.4.2.1023). Complements build_id for display in QA dashboards and certification reports. Sourced from Perforce Helix Core build metadata.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Version Control Standard; Semantic Versioning (SemVer) Specification

attributes.name: cpu_model
attributes.description: The CPU model identifier on the device where the crash occurred (e.g., Apple M3, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Intel Core i9-14900K). Used for CPU-specific crash pattern analysis and performance testing correlation.

attributes.name: crash_signature_hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 hash of the normalized crash stack trace, used as a unique fingerprint to group and deduplicate crash reports with the same root cause. Enables crash clustering, frequency analysis, and regression detection across builds.
attributes.references: Internal QA Crash Deduplication Standard; ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security

attributes.name: crash_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) when the crash event occurred on the device. This is the principal real-world event time used for crash rate trending, session correlation, and stability regression detection.

attributes.name: crash_type
attributes.description: Classification of the crash event by failure mode. Hard crash = process termination; Soft crash = handled exception with recovery; ANR (Application Not Responding) = UI thread timeout; Freeze = unresponsive state without termination; Out of Memory = memory allocation failure; Watchdog Timeout = system-level process kill. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hard_crash|soft_crash|anr|freeze|out_of_memory|watchdog_timeout — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Google Play Developer Program Policies; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Internal QA Classification Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crash report record was first ingested into the data platform. Distinct from crash_timestamp; used for data pipeline auditing and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: device_manufacturer
attributes.description: The manufacturer of the hardware device on which the crash occurred (e.g., Apple, Samsung, Sony, Microsoft). Enables manufacturer-level crash rate analysis for hardware compatibility reporting.

attributes.name: device_model
attributes.description: The hardware model identifier of the device on which the crash occurred (e.g., iPhone 15 Pro, Samsung Galaxy S24, ASUS ROG Phone 8). Used for device-specific crash clustering and hardware compatibility analysis.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Internal QA Standard

attributes.name: environment
attributes.description: The operational environment in which the crash was captured. QA = internal quality assurance; Playtesting = external or internal playtest sessions; UAT (User Acceptance Testing) = pre-release validation; Live = production/live operations; Staging = pre-production mirror; Certification = platform certification submission build.
attributes.references: Internal QA Process Standard; Steamworks/Console SDK Certification Guidelines

attributes.name: faulting_module
attributes.description: The name of the game engine module, DLL, or shared library where the crash originated (e.g., UnrealEngine-Core, libgame.so, GameplayAbilitySystem). Used to attribute crashes to specific engine or game code components.
attributes.references: Unity/Unreal Engine Asset Pipeline Standard; Internal QA Standard

attributes.name: fps_at_crash
attributes.description: The Frames Per Second (FPS) rendering rate recorded immediately before the crash event. Used to correlate performance degradation with crash onset and identify freeze/ANR patterns linked to frame rate drops.
attributes.references: Internal QA Performance Testing Standard; Platform Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC)

attributes.name: game_mode
attributes.description: The game mode active at the time of the crash (e.g., PvP, PvE, Campaign, Tutorial, Lobby, Matchmaking, Spectator). Enables crash analysis by gameplay context to isolate mode-specific stability issues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pvp|pve|campaign|tutorial|lobby|matchmaking|spectator|co_op|battle_royale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Game Design Standard; Internal QA Standard

attributes.name: gpu_model
attributes.description: The GPU model identifier on the device where the crash occurred (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, Apple GPU M3, Adreno 750). Critical for graphics-related crash analysis, Level of Detail (LOD) rendering issues, and Frames Per Second (FPS) stability investigations.
attributes.references: Unity/Unreal Engine Rendering Standard; Internal QA Hardware Compatibility Standard

attributes.name: is_certification_blocker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crash is classified as a blocker for platform certification submission (TRC/TCR compliance). Certification blockers must be resolved before a Gold Master build can be submitted to first-party platform holders.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Console SDK Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC); Technical Certification Requirements (TCR); Internal Release Quality Gate Standard

attributes.name: is_first_session
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash occurred during the player's very first game session (First-Time User Experience / FTUE). FTUE crashes have disproportionate impact on Day 1 (D1) retention and player acquisition metrics.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude FTUE Analytics Standard; Internal Player Retention KPI Standard

attributes.name: is_regression
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crash represents a regression — a defect that was previously resolved but has reappeared in a newer build. Regression flags trigger escalated QA review and block release quality gates.
attributes.references: Internal QA Regression Testing Standard; Jira Bug Tracking Standard

attributes.name: map_level_name
attributes.description: The name of the in-game map, level, or scene that was loaded at the time of the crash. Used to identify level-specific asset loading or streaming issues contributing to crashes.
attributes.references: Unity/Unreal Engine Asset Pipeline Standard; Internal QA Standard

attributes.name: memory_usage_mb
attributes.description: Total memory consumption (in megabytes) of the game process at the moment of the crash. Key quantitative metric for diagnosing out-of-memory crashes and validating memory budget compliance against platform Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC).
attributes.references: Platform Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC); Internal QA Performance Testing Standard

attributes.name: network_condition
attributes.description: The network connectivity state of the device at the time of the crash. Used to isolate network-dependent crashes in online multiplayer (MMO, PvP) and Game-as-a-Service (GaaS) live operations contexts.
attributes.references: Internal QA Network Testing Standard; Internal Live Operations Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for QA engineers to record reproduction steps, workarounds, environmental observations, or additional context not captured in structured fields. Supports root cause analysis and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: occurrence_count
attributes.description: The number of times this specific crash signature (crash_signature_hash) has been observed across all sessions within the reporting window. Used for crash rate trending and identifying high-frequency stability regressions.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude Player Behavior Analytics Standard; Internal QA KPI Standard

attributes.name: os_version
attributes.description: The operating system version string on the device where the crash occurred (e.g., Windows 11 23H2, Android 14, iOS 17.4). Critical for identifying OS-specific regression patterns and platform certification compliance.
attributes.references: Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; Internal QA Standard

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Fix priority assigned by the QA or development team, reflecting urgency relative to release schedule. P1 = immediate fix required; P2 = fix before next milestone; P3 = fix in upcoming sprint; P4 = backlog. Aligned with Jira priority taxonomy.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management Standard; Internal QA Process Standard

attributes.name: ram_gb
attributes.description: Total RAM (in gigabytes) available on the device at the time of the crash. Used to identify out-of-memory crash patterns and minimum hardware specification compliance.
attributes.references: Internal QA Hardware Compatibility Standard; Platform Technical Requirements Checklist (TRC)

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for the crash report, formatted as CR-{YYYY}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in QA communications, Jira ticket references, and platform certification submissions.

attributes.name: reported_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the QA tester, automated crash reporter system, or live operations monitoring agent that first reported this crash. Distinguishes manual QA reports from automated telemetry ingestion.
attributes.references: Jira Bug Tracking Standard; GameAnalytics/Amplitude Crash Reporting Standard

attributes.name: reproduction_frequency
attributes.description: QA-assessed reproducibility of the crash: Always = 100% reproducible; Often = >50% of attempts; Sometimes = 10-50%; Rarely = <10%; Once = single occurrence, not reproduced. Informs defect prioritization and release quality gate decisions.
attributes.references: Internal QA Defect Classification Standard; IGDA QA Best Practices

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the crash report in the defect management lifecycle. Drives QA release quality gate decisions and Jira backlog prioritization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|in_progress|resolved|closed|wont_fix|duplicate — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]

attributes.name: resolved_in_build_version
attributes.description: The build version string in which the crash was confirmed as fixed. Enables fix verification tracking and regression detection if the crash reappears in subsequent builds.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core Version Control Standard; Internal QA Fix Verification Standard

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the crash was marked as resolved in the defect management workflow. Used to calculate mean time to resolution (MTTR) for QA KPI reporting and release quality gate tracking.
attributes.references: Internal QA KPI Standard; Jira Bug Tracking Standard

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The length of the game session in seconds at the point of crash. Used to identify early-session crashes (First-Time User Experience / FTUE impact) versus late-session crashes, and to correlate with memory leak patterns.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude Session Analytics Standard; Internal QA Standard

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Business impact severity of the crash, aligned with QA defect severity taxonomy. Critical = game-breaking, blocks release; High = major feature impaired; Medium = partial feature impaired; Low = cosmetic or rare edge case. Drives release quality gate decisions.
attributes.references: Internal QA Severity Classification Standard; IGDA Quality Assurance Best Practices

attributes.name: stack_trace_summary
attributes.description: Truncated or summarized top-of-stack trace text identifying the faulting module, function, and line number. Provides human-readable crash context for QA engineers without storing the full raw stack trace in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Unity/Unreal Engine Crash Reporter Standard; Internal QA Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crash report record was last modified, such as when resolution status, severity, or defect linkage was updated by the QA team.

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp

attributes.name: session_status

attributes.references: ESRB; PEGI; USK; CERO; GRAC; FTC (Loot Box Disclosure Guidelines)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance test result record was first created in the system. Audit trail field required for data lineage and regulatory evidence integrity.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2); ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: evidence_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the compliance evidence artifact (e.g., screenshot, log file, test report, video capture) stored in the digital asset management system (Perforce Helix Core) or document repository. Required for platform submissions and legal audits.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core; GDPR Article 5(2); PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: evidence_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compliance evidence artifact type. Indicates whether the evidence is a screenshot, video recording, log file, formal test report, document, or automated scan output. Supports evidence management and audit readiness.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; PCI DSS v4.0; GDPR Article 5(2); SOC 2

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the compliance finding, including what was observed, how it deviates from the requirement, and the specific game feature or content area affected. Required for remediation teams and regulatory auditors.
attributes.references: GDPR; COPPA; PCI DSS v4.0; WCAG 2.1; ESRB; PEGI; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: framework_version
attributes.description: The specific version or edition of the compliance framework applied during testing (e.g., WCAG 2.1, PCI DSS v4.0, GDPR 2018). Ensures test results are traceable to the exact standard revision in force at the time of testing.
attributes.references: ESRB; PEGI; GDPR; PCI DSS v4.0; WCAG 2.1; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: jira_issue_key
attributes.description: The Jira issue key (e.g., COMP-4521) associated with this compliance test result. Links the compliance finding to the defect or task tracked in Jira for remediation workflow management. Sourced from Jira (Project Management and Bug Tracking).
attributes.references: Jira Project Management; Internal QA Governance

attributes.name: privacy_data_category
attributes.description: Classification of the personal data category involved in this privacy compliance test. Populated for GDPR and COPPA tests to identify whether the test covers general personal data, children's data (under 13/16), payment data, behavioral/analytics data, or biometric data. Null for non-privacy frameworks.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; COPPA; FTC; GDPR Supervisory Authorities

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Geographic region for which this compliance test applies. Regulatory requirements differ by region (e.g., ESRB for North America, PEGI for Europe, CERO for Japan, GRAC for South Korea). Drives which framework and rating body governs the test.
attributes.references: ESRB; PEGI; USK; CERO; GRAC; GDPR; COPPA

attributes.name: release_gate_blocking
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance test result (specifically a fail or unresolved finding) is currently blocking the release gate for the associated game title and platform. True means the title cannot proceed to platform submission or launch until this finding is resolved.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; Platform Certification Requirements; ESRB; PEGI

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the compliance finding must be remediated. Drives escalation workflows and release gate decisions. Typically aligned with the platform submission deadline or regulatory reporting deadline.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; PCI DSS v4.0; GDPR Article 33; Platform Certification Timelines

attributes.name: remediation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the remediation approach, actions taken, or rationale for waiver. Provides context for re-test verification and audit review.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; ISO/IEC 27001; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation activity for a compliance finding. Not_required applies to passing tests; open indicates a new unaddressed finding; in_progress indicates active remediation; resolved indicates the fix has been implemented; verified indicates the fix has been re-tested and confirmed; waived indicates a formal risk acceptance has been granted.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 33

attributes.name: requirement_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the specific compliance requirement or control being tested. Provides context for auditors and reviewers without requiring reference to the external standard document.
attributes.references: GDPR; COPPA; PCI DSS v4.0; WCAG 2.1; ESRB; PEGI

attributes.name: result_code
attributes.description: Externally referenceable business identifier for this compliance test result record, formatted as CTR-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX. Used in audit trails, platform submissions, and legal correspondence.

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance retest was or is scheduled to be performed following remediation. Null if retest has not yet been scheduled or is not required.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; Platform Certification Requirements

attributes.name: retest_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance finding requires a formal retest after remediation before the release gate can be cleared. True for all fail and conditional_pass results that are not waived.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; Platform Certification Requirements

attributes.name: retest_result_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the compliance retest performed after remediation. Null if no retest has been conducted. Pass confirms the finding is resolved; fail indicates the remediation was insufficient and further action is required.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the compliance finding when the test result is a fail or conditional pass. Critical findings block platform submission; major findings require remediation before release; minor findings are tracked but may not block release; informational findings are advisory only.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: sign_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance test result was formally signed off by the QA lead or compliance officer. Required for platform submission packages and regulatory audit evidence.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: sign_off_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the compliance test result by the designated QA lead or compliance officer. Pending indicates awaiting review; approved indicates the result has been formally accepted; rejected indicates the result requires rework; escalated indicates the finding has been raised to senior management or legal.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: test_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of compliance test performed. Supports filtering and dashboard segmentation across age rating (ESRB/PEGI/USK/CERO/GRAC), data privacy (GDPR/COPPA), payment security (PCI DSS), accessibility (WCAG), platform certification (TRC/TCR), and content compliance testing.
attributes.references: ESRB; PEGI; GDPR; COPPA; PCI DSS v4.0; WCAG 2.1; Steamworks TRC; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the compliance test was executed. Principal real-world event date for this compliance test result, used for audit trail and regulatory submission timelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2); PCI DSS v4.0; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: test_environment
attributes.description: The environment in which the compliance test was executed. Cert (certification) environment is the standard for platform submission compliance tests; staging is used for pre-cert validation; production tests may be required for live service compliance audits.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; Platform Certification Requirements; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: test_result_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the compliance test execution. Pass indicates full compliance; fail indicates a violation requiring remediation; conditional_pass indicates compliance with noted caveats; not_applicable indicates the requirement does not apply to this title/platform; blocked indicates testing could not be completed; in_review indicates result is pending sign-off.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; ISO/IEC 27001; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: test_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the compliance test was executed. Provides sub-day precision for audit logs and automated testing pipelines.

attributes.name: test_tool
attributes.description: Name and version of the tool or framework used to execute this compliance test (e.g., OWASP ZAP 2.14, axe-core 4.7, custom PCI scanner, manual). Supports reproducibility and audit evidence quality assessment.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; WCAG 2.1; ISO/IEC 27001; Internal QA Governance

attributes.name: tester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the QA tester or compliance analyst who executed this compliance test. Retained for audit trail readability without requiring a join to the employee table.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance test result record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2); ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wcag_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) Conformance Level
attributes.description: The WCAG conformance level targeted by this accessibility compliance test (A, AA, or AAA). Populated only for WCAG accessibility tests. Null for non-accessibility frameworks. AA is the standard target for most gaming platforms.
attributes.references: WCAG 2.1; European Commission Digital Services Act; Apple App Store Review Guidelines

products.name: defect_waiver

Captures waiver request date, associated defect or cert finding, waiver justification, risk assessment, approver identity, approval date, waiver expiry date, post-launch monitoring commitment, and waiver status (pending, approved, rejected, expired). Provides the governance audit trail for risk-accepted quality exceptions at release gates.

attributes.name: defect_waiver_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each defect waiver record. Primary key for the defect_waiver data product in the quality domain.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: Waivers allowing known defects to ship affect capitalization and impairment decisions. Finance assesses whether waived defects indicate impairment of capitalized development costs or create contingent

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.cert_finding. Business justification: Defect waivers can be granted for certification findings. defect_waiver has cert_finding_reference (STRING) but no FK to cert_finding. Waivers allow known cert findings to ship. Cardinality: N defect_

attributes.name: defect_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific defect or quality issue record for which this waiver is being requested. Links to the defect management system of record.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game title for which this defect waiver is granted. Links the waiver to the specific game product under quality governance.

attributes.name: ip_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.ip_agreement. Business justification: Defect waivers for licensed content issues (middleware bugs, brand usage violations) require licensor approval and are tracked against specific IP agreements. Real approval workflow for risk managemen

attributes.name: milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to studio.milestone. Business justification: Defect waivers granted for specific milestones when fix cannot be completed in time; studios track waiver expiry by milestone. Milestone ship decisions require waiver approval. Creating milestone_id.

attributes.name: primary_defect_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (QA lead, producer, or executive) who formally approved or rejected this waiver. Provides the governance audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: release_gate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the release quality gate at which this waiver was evaluated and applied. Ties the waiver to a specific milestone or certification checkpoint.

attributes.name: approval_conditions
attributes.description: Any conditions or stipulations attached to the waiver approval by the approver (e.g., mandatory hotfix within 30 days, player communication required, specific monitoring thresholds must be met). Null for unconditional approvals or rejected waivers.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the waiver was formally approved or rejected by the designated approver. Null until a decision is made. Used for governance audit trail and approval cycle time reporting.

attributes.name: build_version
attributes.description: The specific game build version in which the defect was identified and against which the waiver is being granted. Provides traceability to the exact code state at the time of waiver request.
attributes.references: Perforce Helix Core; Jira Release Planning

attributes.name: coppa_compliance_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Compliance Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waived defect could impact COPPA compliance, particularly for games with under-13 player populations. True requires legal review before waiver approval.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the defect waiver record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for governance and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOC 2; ISO/IEC 27001; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: escalation_threshold
attributes.description: Defined threshold value for the monitoring KPI that, if exceeded post-launch, triggers mandatory escalation and emergency patch consideration (e.g., crash rate > 0.5%, support tickets > 500/day). Expressed as a string to accommodate varied metric formats.

attributes.name: esrb_compliance_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) Compliance Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waived defect has any potential impact on ESRB rating compliance (e.g., unintended content exposure, age-gating bypass). True requires ESRB notification review before waiver approval.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved waiver expires. After this date, the waiver is no longer valid and the defect must be re-evaluated. Typically aligned with the fix_target_date or a specific post-launch patch milestone.

attributes.name: fix_target_date
attributes.description: Planned calendar date by which the waived defect is committed to be resolved in a post-launch patch or update. Used to track remediation SLA compliance and waiver expiry alignment.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Internal QA Governance

attributes.name: fix_target_version
attributes.description: The planned game build version or patch release in which the waived defect is scheduled to be resolved post-launch. Establishes the post-launch remediation commitment tied to the waiver approval.
attributes.references: Jira Release Planning; Internal QA Governance

attributes.name: gdpr_compliance_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Compliance Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waived defect could impact GDPR compliance, such as data exposure, consent mechanism failure, or player data handling issues. True requires Data Protection Officer review before waiver approval.
attributes.references: GDPR Supervisory Authorities; European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: is_cert_blocking
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waived defect was originally classified as a platform certification blocker (TRC/TCR blocking finding). True signals that platform holder approval or exception was required in addition to internal waiver approval.
attributes.references: TRC (Technical Requirements Checklist); TCR (Technical Certification Requirements); Steamworks/Console SDKs

attributes.name: jira_issue_key
attributes.description: The Jira ticket key (e.g., QA-1234) corresponding to the defect or certification finding for which this waiver is granted. Provides direct traceability to the bug tracking system of record.
attributes.references: Jira Project Management and Bug Tracking

attributes.name: monitoring_kpi
attributes.description: Specific KPI or telemetry metric used to monitor the waived defect post-launch (e.g., crash rate threshold, defect reproduction rate per session, support ticket volume). Triggers escalation if breached.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude; Internal QA Governance; KPI Framework

attributes.name: pegi_compliance_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pan European Game Information (PEGI) Compliance Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the waived defect has any potential impact on PEGI rating compliance in European markets. True requires PEGI authority review before waiver approval.
attributes.references: PEGI (Pan European Game Information); European Commission Digital Services Act

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: The target platform(s) on which the waived defect is present and accepted for release. Aligns with platform certification bodies (Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo) and distribution channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PC|PS5|PS4|XBSX|XBONE|NSW|IOS|ANDROID|STADIA|LUNA|VR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Steamworks/Epic Games Store/Console SDKs; TRC; TCR

attributes.name: platform_holder_acknowledgment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relevant platform holder (Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo, Apple, Google) has formally acknowledged or accepted the certification finding waiver. Required for cert-blocking issues before release approval.
attributes.references: Steamworks/Console SDKs; Apple App Store Review Guidelines; Google Play Developer Program Policies; TRC; TCR

attributes.name: player_impact_scope
attributes.description: Estimated breadth of player population affected by the waived defect. Informs risk level and post-launch monitoring intensity. Ranges from all players (systemic issue) to single player (isolated edge case).
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; ESRB; PEGI; COPPA Enforcement

attributes.name: post_launch_monitoring_plan
attributes.description: Description of the monitoring commitment made as a condition of waiver approval. Specifies telemetry signals, crash reporting thresholds, player support ticket triggers, and escalation criteria that will be tracked post-launch via GameAnalytics/Amplitude and Zendesk.
attributes.references: GameAnalytics/Amplitude; Zendesk; Internal QA Governance; SOC 2

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Formal explanation provided by the approver when a waiver request is rejected. Documents the rationale for denial and any conditions under which a revised waiver request may be resubmitted. Null for approved or pending waivers.

attributes.name: release_version
attributes.description: The planned release version (e.g., v1.0.0, v2.3.1) in which the waived defect will ship to players. Used to scope the waiver to a specific product release and track post-launch remediation.

attributes.name: reproduction_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage rate at which the defect can be reproduced under standard test conditions (0.00–100.00). Low reproduction rates strengthen the waiver justification; high rates require stronger risk mitigation commitments.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the defect waiver was formally submitted by the requestor. Marks the start of the waiver review process and is used to measure approval cycle time.

attributes.name: risk_assessment
attributes.description: Formal risk assessment narrative documenting the potential player impact, business impact, and probability of the defect manifesting in production. Includes assessment of affected player population, reproduction rate, and workaround availability.
attributes.references: Internal QA Risk Framework; ISO/IEC 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Categorical risk rating assigned to the waiver based on the formal risk assessment. Determines the approval authority level required (QA Lead for low/medium, Studio Head for high, Executive for critical).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the defect waiver record. Tracks changes to waiver status, approval decisions, conditions, and monitoring commitments for audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SOC 2; ISO/IEC 27001; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: waiver_category
attributes.description: Functional area of the game affected by the waived defect. Used for trend analysis and quality reporting across release gates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gameplay|audio|visual|performance|stability|ui_ux|network|security|accessibility|localization|monetization — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: waiver_code
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable unique code for this waiver (e.g., WVR-2024-0042). Used in Jira comments, release notes, and certification submissions to cross-reference the formal waiver document.
attributes.references: Internal QA Governance; Steamworks/Console SDK Certification

attributes.name: waiver_justification
attributes.description: Formal written justification provided by the requestor explaining why the defect cannot be resolved before release and why the risk is acceptable. This is the primary governance narrative for the waiver and must address business impact, technical constraints, and mitigation plans.

attributes.name: waiver_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the defect waiver. Drives release gate decisions and audit reporting. Pending = awaiting approval decision; Approved = risk accepted and waiver granted; Rejected = waiver denied, defect must be resolved; Expired = waiver approval window has passed; Withdrawn = requestor cancelled the waiver before decision.
attributes.references: Internal QA Release Gate Framework; SOC 2

attributes.name: waiver_type
attributes.description: Classification of the waiver by the nature of the quality exception being accepted. Distinguishes between defect waivers, platform certification finding waivers (TRC/TCR), performance benchmark waivers, compliance waivers, and regression waivers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: defect_waiver|cert_finding_waiver|performance_waiver|compliance_waiver|regression_waiver|uat_waiver — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TRC (Technical Requirements Checklist); TCR (Technical Certification Requirements); ESRB; PEGI; Internal QA Governance

attributes.name: workaround_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a player-facing or internal workaround exists for the waived defect. A documented workaround reduces risk level and strengthens the waiver justification.

attributes.name: workaround_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the available workaround for the waived defect, if one exists. May be communicated to players via support knowledge base or patch notes. Null when workaround_available is false.
attributes.references: Zendesk Player Support; Internal QA Governance

attributes.description: Reference to a parent test suite if this suite is a sub-suite or component of a larger testing hierarchy.

attributes.name: automation_level

attributes.name: blocking_for_release
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure of this test suite blocks game release or deployment to production.

attributes.name: build_version_target
attributes.description: Target game build version or version range that this test suite is designed to validate (e.g., '1.2.0', '2.0.x', 'Release Candidate 3').

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the external certification authority or platform holder that requires this test suite (e.g., 'Sony Interactive Entertainment', 'Microsoft Xbox', 'Nintendo', 'ESRB', 'PEGI').

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test suite is required for platform certification or regulatory compliance approval.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory or industry compliance framework that this test suite addresses (e.g., 'COPPA', 'GDPR', 'WCAG 2.1', 'Platform TRC').

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this test suite record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the test suite purpose, scope, coverage areas, and testing objectives.

attributes.name: documentation_url
attributes.description: URL link to detailed documentation, test plans, or wiki pages for this test suite.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date when this test suite became or will become active and available for execution in the QA pipeline.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date when this test suite is scheduled to be deprecated or retired. Null for suites with indefinite lifecycle.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Expected time in minutes required to complete full execution of all tests in the suite.

attributes.name: execution_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled or triggered frequency at which this test suite should be executed in the QA pipeline.

attributes.name: is_baseline
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test suite represents a baseline or master suite used as a reference for quality benchmarking.

attributes.name: jira_project_key
attributes.description: Jira project key where test cases and defects related to this suite are tracked.

attributes.name: last_executed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent execution of this test suite.

attributes.name: last_execution_result
attributes.description: Overall result status of the most recent test suite execution.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this test suite record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the test suite execution, maintenance, or known issues.

attributes.name: pass_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of test cases that must pass for the suite execution to be considered successful and meet release quality gates.

attributes.name: platform_target
attributes.description: Target gaming platform(s) for which this test suite is designed (e.g., 'PlayStation 5', 'Xbox Series X', 'PC', 'Mobile iOS', 'Nintendo Switch', 'Cross-Platform').

attributes.name: prerequisites
attributes.description: Required setup, configurations, data, or environmental conditions that must be in place before executing this test suite.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the test suite indicating its importance in the overall QA strategy and release gates.

attributes.name: suite_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the test suite used across QA systems and reporting (e.g., 'TS-MP-001', 'CERT-PS5-2024').

attributes.name: suite_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the test suite (e.g., 'Multiplayer Stress Test', 'UI Regression Suite', 'Platform Certification Suite').

attributes.name: suite_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the test suite indicating its operational state and availability for execution.

attributes.name: suite_type
attributes.description: Classification of the test suite by testing methodology (functional, regression, performance, security, compliance, certification).

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of tags or labels for categorization, filtering, and organization of test suites (e.g., 'multiplayer, stress-test, critical-path').

attributes.name: test_category
attributes.description: Testing level category indicating the scope and granularity of tests within the suite (unit, integration, system, acceptance, smoke, sanity).

attributes.name: test_environment
attributes.description: Target execution environment for the test suite indicating where tests should be run.

attributes.name: test_framework
attributes.description: Testing framework or tool used to implement and execute the test suite (e.g., 'Selenium', 'Unity Test Framework', 'Unreal Automation Tool', 'Custom Framework').

attributes.name: test_scope
attributes.description: Specific game features, systems, or components covered by this test suite (e.g., 'Multiplayer Matchmaking', 'In-Game Economy', 'Graphics Rendering', 'Audio System').

attributes.name: total_test_cases
attributes.description: Total number of individual test cases included in this test suite.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the test suite indicating revisions and updates to test coverage or methodology (e.g., '1.0', '2.3.1').

attributes.name: parent_test_suite_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on test_suite (parent_test_suite_id)

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Manages all employee, contractor, and studio talent data including headcount planning, organizational structure, compensation, benefits, performance management, developer skill matrices, and HR records sourced from SAP S/4HANA HR module. Supports studio capacity planning for game development production scheduling and IGDA workforce standards compliance.

products.name: employee
products.description: Master record for all full-time and part-time employees across all studios and corporate functions. Captures personal details, employment status, hire date, termination date, employment type, work location, studio assignment, job family, seniority level, IGDA membership status, and GDPR/COPPA consent flags. Single source of truth for employee identity across the gaming enterprise. Primary source system: SAP S/4HANA HR.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee record. Primary key sourced from SAP S/4HANA HR module personnel number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Personnel Number Standard

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game studio to which the employee is assigned. Links to the studio master data for organizational hierarchy, project assignment, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: Employee is classified under a standardized job profile. Job profile is the master definition of role family, competencies, and career track. Removing job_family from employee as it is defined in job_

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the direct manager or supervisor. Establishes reporting hierarchy for organizational structure, performance management, and approval workflows.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Employee occupies an authorized position. Position is the headcount slot; employee is the person filling it. This is a fundamental HR relationship. FK will be nullable (employee may be between positio

attributes.name: annual_salary
attributes.description: Base annual salary for the employee in local currency. Used for payroll processing, compensation analysis, and budget planning. Excludes bonuses and equity.

attributes.name: compensation_grade
attributes.description: Internal compensation band or grade level assigned to the employee. Used for salary benchmarking, promotion planning, and pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which the employee's compensation and expenses are allocated. Used for budgeting, financial reporting, and project cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Cost Center Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the employee record was first created in the HR system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee record is eligible for archival or deletion per data retention policies. Calculated based on termination date and regulatory retention requirements.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the employee. Used for age verification, benefits eligibility, retirement planning, and COPPA compliance for employees under 18.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department to which the employee belongs (e.g., Game Development, Live Operations, Platform Engineering, Player Support). Used for cost center allocation and organizational reporting.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Corporate email address assigned to the employee. Primary communication channel for internal collaboration, project management in Jira, and business correspondence.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee's designated emergency contact person. Used for critical incident response and employee safety protocols.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Guidelines

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the employee's designated emergency contact. Used for critical incident response and employee safety protocols.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Guidelines

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the employee within the organization. Determines access rights, payroll processing, and benefits eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Employment Status Standard

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of employment arrangement. Determines benefits eligibility, work hour expectations, and compensation structure. Supports studio capacity planning for game development production scheduling.
attributes.references: IGDA Workforce Standards, SAP S/4HANA HR Employment Type

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the employee as recorded in HR system. Used for payroll, benefits administration, and official communications.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Date
attributes.description: Date when the employee provided GDPR consent. Used for consent audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has provided explicit consent for processing of personal data under GDPR requirements. Required for EU-based employees and data processing compliance.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the employee officially started employment with the organization. Used for tenure calculations, benefits vesting, anniversary recognition, and retention analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Hire Date Standard

attributes.name: igda_member
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Game Developers Association (IGDA) Member Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is a member of the International Game Developers Association. Used for professional development tracking and industry engagement metrics.

attributes.name: is_remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's role is eligible for remote work arrangements. Used for workforce planning, office space allocation, and flexible work policy administration.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the employee as recorded in HR system. Reflects role, seniority, and functional area (e.g., Senior Game Designer, Lead Programmer, QA Tester).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Job Title Standard

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the employee record. Used for audit trail and change accountability.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail Standard, SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the employee record was last updated. Used for change tracking, data freshness assessment, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) of the employee as recorded in HR system. Used for payroll, benefits administration, and official communications.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review. Used to track review cycles and ensure timely performance management processes.

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in USA, National Insurance Number in UK). Used for tax reporting, payroll processing, and legal compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, IRS Publication 15, HMRC Guidelines

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: Physical office or campus location where the employee is based (e.g., Seattle HQ, Tokyo Studio, London Office). Used for facilities management, travel planning, and regional workforce analytics.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent annual performance review rating. Used for merit increase decisions, promotion eligibility, performance improvement plans, and talent management.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the employee. Used for emergency contact, business communication, and HR outreach.

attributes.name: primary_skill
attributes.description: The employee's primary area of expertise or specialization (e.g., Gameplay Programming, Character Art, Level Design, QA Testing). Used for resource allocation and project matching.

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the employee's salary. Supports multi-currency payroll processing for global workforce. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CAD|AUD|KRW|CNY — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: seniority_level
attributes.description: Career level indicating experience, responsibility, and decision-making authority. Used for compensation bands, reporting structure, and succession planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: junior|mid|senior|lead|principal|director|vp|c_level — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IGDA Workforce Standards, SAP S/4HANA HR Career Level

attributes.name: skill_tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of technical and functional skills possessed by the employee (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine, C++, Game Design, QA Automation). Used for developer skill matrices, project staffing, and talent pool analysis.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's employment ended. Null for active employees. Used for offboarding, final payroll processing, benefits termination, and turnover analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Termination Date Standard

attributes.name: work_location
attributes.description: Primary work arrangement indicating where the employee performs their duties. Used for facilities planning, collaboration tool provisioning, and workforce distribution analytics.

attributes.name: work_permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the employee's work permit or visa. Null for citizens and permanent residents. Used for proactive renewal management and compliance risk mitigation.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (USA), UK Immigration Rules

attributes.name: work_permit_status
attributes.description: Legal work authorization status for the employee in their work location country. Used for compliance tracking, visa renewal management, and international mobility planning.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (USA), UK Immigration Rules, EU Blue Card Directive

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of professional experience in the gaming industry. Used for seniority assessment, compensation benchmarking, and skill level estimation.

products.name: contractor
products.description: Master record for external contractors, freelancers, and contingent workers engaged by studios for game development, QA playtesting, art production, and live operations. Tracks engagement type, contracting agency, statement-of-work reference, clearance level, studio assignment, skill specialization, and contract period. Distinct from employee as contractors have no benefits eligibility and follow different compliance obligations (IR35, 1099 classification).
products.reference: SAP HCM External Staff / Contingent Worker

attributes.name: contractor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contractor record. Primary key.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game studio to which this contractor is currently assigned.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: Contractor engagement is based on a job profile defining the role requirements and competencies. Skill_specialization on contractor is kept as it may be more specific than job_profile technical_skills

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the full-time employee who serves as the contractor's direct manager or project lead.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Contractor is assigned to an organizational unit within the studio. Contractors work within org units just like employees. No columns removed as contractor table doesn't have redundant org unit fields

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Contractor can fill an authorized position when position.is_contractor_eligible = true. This links the contractor engagement to the formal headcount position they are filling. FK will be nullable (not

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of background verification process for the contractor, if required by studio policy or project sensitivity.

attributes.name: benefits_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor is eligible for any company benefits. Typically false for contractors, distinguishing them from employees.

attributes.name: clearance_level
attributes.description: Security clearance level granted to the contractor for access to confidential game development assets, source code, and unreleased content.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the contractor engagement is scheduled to end. May be extended through contract amendments.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contractor engagement officially begins and the contractor is authorized to perform work.

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the contractor engagement for fixed-price or capped contracts.

attributes.name: contracting_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the staffing agency or contracting firm providing the contractor, if applicable. Null for direct freelancers.

attributes.name: contractor_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the contractor, typically assigned by HR or procurement systems. Format: CTR-########.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Personnel Number Standard

attributes.name: contractor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contractor engagement. Active contractors have system access and can be assigned to projects.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contractor record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for contractor payment (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: daily_rate
attributes.description: Daily billing rate for the contractor in the contract currency. Used for day-rate engagements.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for contractor communication and system access provisioning.

attributes.name: engagement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractor engagement model. Determines compliance obligations and payment processing rules.
attributes.references: IRS 1099 Classification Guidelines, IR35 UK Tax Legislation

attributes.name: equipment_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether company equipment (laptop, development kit, peripherals) has been issued to the contractor.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the contractor as it appears on contracts and tax documents.

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: Hourly billing rate for the contractor in the contract currency. Used for time-and-materials engagements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contractor record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: nda_signed_date
attributes.description: Date when the contractor signed the non-disclosure agreement protecting confidential game development information and unreleased content.

attributes.name: onboarding_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the contractor completed all onboarding requirements including training, compliance certifications, and system access setup.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment schedule and terms for the contractor (e.g., Net 30, Bi-Weekly, Monthly, Upon Milestone Completion).

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent performance assessment rating for the contractor, used for contract renewal and future engagement decisions.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the contractor.

attributes.name: rehire_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor is eligible for future re-engagement based on past performance and conduct.

attributes.name: remote_work_location
attributes.description: Geographic location from which the contractor performs work, if remote. Used for tax nexus and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: skill_specialization
attributes.description: Primary skill area or discipline for which the contractor was engaged (e.g., 3D Artist, QA Tester, Level Designer, Gameplay Programmer, Audio Engineer, Localization Specialist).

attributes.name: statement_of_work_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the statement of work document governing this contractor engagement.

attributes.name: system_access_provisioned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor has been granted access to required development systems, tools, and platforms (Perforce, Jira, game engines, SDKs).

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: Tax treatment classification for the contractor determining withholding and reporting obligations.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number for the contractor (SSN, EIN, VAT number, or equivalent based on jurisdiction).

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for contractor engagement termination, if applicable (e.g., contract completion, project cancellation, performance issues, policy violation).

attributes.name: time_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor must submit timesheets for billing and project cost tracking purposes.

attributes.name: work_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the contractor performs work. Determines labor law compliance requirements.

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Organizational unit hierarchy representing studios, departments, teams, and squads within the gaming enterprise. Captures unit name, unit type (studio, department, squad, pod), parent unit, cost center reference, studio location, headcount budget, and effective dates. Supports organizational structure reporting, capacity planning for game development production scheduling, and studio-level headcount analytics.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organizational unit. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center associated with this organizational unit for financial tracking and budget allocation.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game studio entity if this organizational unit is a studio or belongs to a studio. Null for corporate or non-studio units.

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent organizational unit in the hierarchy. Null for top-level units (e.g., corporate headquarters).

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total annual operating budget allocated to this organizational unit in the enterprise's base currency. Includes compensation, benefits, tools, and operational expenses. Used for financial planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the annual budget amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_headcount
attributes.description: Current number of active employees and contractors assigned to this organizational unit. Updated regularly for capacity planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: development_methodology
attributes.description: Primary software development or project management methodology used by this organizational unit. Null for non-development units. Used for process standardization and productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit ceased or will cease operations. Null for currently active units. Used for historical organizational structure analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit became or will become operational. Used for historical organizational structure reporting and workforce planning.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Primary functional discipline or business area this organizational unit supports. Aligns with core business processes and enables cross-studio functional reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: game_development|engineering|art|design|qa|live_ops|publishing|marketing|finance|hr|legal|it|operations|esports|community — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: headcount_budget
attributes.description: Approved headcount capacity for this organizational unit. Used for workforce planning, hiring targets, and studio capacity analysis for game development production scheduling.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit's time and costs are directly billable to game development projects (true) or represents overhead/support functions (false). Used for project costing and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: is_remote_first
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates primarily as a remote/distributed team (true) or requires physical presence at a studio location (false). Impacts workforce planning and collaboration tooling.

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: Primary city where this organizational unit is physically located. Null for fully remote or virtual units.

attributes.name: location_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary location of this organizational unit (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR, JPN). Null for fully remote or virtual units.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: org_unit_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the organizational unit's purpose, responsibilities, and scope. Used for onboarding, organizational charts, and internal documentation.

attributes.name: primary_game_engine
attributes.description: Primary game engine technology this organizational unit specializes in or uses for development. Null for non-development units. Used for skill matrix planning and technology stack reporting.

attributes.name: sprint_length_weeks
attributes.description: Standard sprint or iteration length in weeks for agile teams. Null for non-agile units. Used for capacity planning and velocity tracking in Jira.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the organizational unit's primary location (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles', 'Europe/London'). Used for scheduling, capacity planning, and cross-studio collaboration.

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the organizational unit across the enterprise. Used in HR systems, financial reporting, and project management tools.

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the organizational unit (e.g., 'Core Engine Team', 'Seattle Studio', 'Live Operations Department').

attributes.name: unit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit. Active = operational; Inactive = temporarily suspended; Planned = approved but not yet operational; Dissolved = permanently closed; Restructuring = undergoing organizational change.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit within the hierarchy. Studio = top-level game development studio; Department = functional area within studio or corporate; Team = cross-functional group; Squad = agile delivery unit; Pod = small specialized group; Division = corporate business unit.

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized headcount positions within the organizational structure, representing approved roles that can be filled by employees or contractors. Captures position title, job family, discipline (engineering, art, design, QA, production, marketing), seniority band, studio assignment, org unit, FTE allocation, position status (open, filled, frozen), and requisition linkage. Enables headcount planning and studio capacity management for game development production scheduling.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the authorized headcount position within the organizational structure.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game studio or development center where this position is located.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: Position is defined by a job profile template. Job profile contains the standardized role definition, competencies, and requirements. Removing job_family, discipline, and seniority_band from position

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the organizational unit (department, team, division) to which this position belongs.

attributes.name: reports_to_position_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the position to which this position reports in the organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for the position creation or modification request.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive or manager who approved the position for headcount planning.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was approved for inclusion in the authorized headcount plan.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code for budget allocation and expense tracking associated with this position.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the position record was first created in the HR system.

attributes.name: education_requirement

attributes.name: effective_end_date
