attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the position becomes active and available for hiring or assignment.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Type of employment relationship expected for this position (full-time, part-time, contract, temporary, internship).

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent allocation for the position. 1.0 represents full-time, 0.5 represents half-time. Used for headcount planning and capacity management.

attributes.name: is_bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for performance-based bonus compensation.

attributes.name: is_contractor_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position can be filled by a contractor or contingent worker rather than a full-time employee.

attributes.name: is_equity_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for equity compensation (stock options, RSUs).

attributes.name: is_remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for remote or distributed work arrangements.

attributes.name: job_grade
attributes.description: Internal compensation grade level assigned to the position for salary band determination and career progression.

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: City where the position is physically located or based.

attributes.name: location_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the position is based.

attributes.name: min_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant industry experience required for the position.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the HR administrator or manager who last modified the position record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the position record was last modified in the HR system.

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the position used in HR systems and organizational charts. Typically follows company-specific coding scheme.

attributes.name: position_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the position responsibilities, accountabilities, and key deliverables.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the position indicating whether it is available for hiring, currently occupied, or temporarily frozen.

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for salary range values.

attributes.name: salary_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum annual salary for the position in local currency. Used for compensation planning and pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: salary_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum annual salary for the position in local currency. Used for compensation planning and pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: skill_profile
attributes.description: Required technical and functional skills for the position (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine, C++, Maya, Substance Painter, Jira, Agile methodologies).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official job title for the position as it appears in organizational structure and job postings.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the HR administrator or manager who created the position record.

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Catalog of standardized job roles and job families used across all studios and corporate functions. Defines job title, job family (engineering, art, design, QA, production, esports operations, community management), career track, IGDA-aligned discipline classification, required certifications, and pay grade band. Serves as the reference taxonomy for position creation, skill matrix alignment, and compensation benchmarking.
products.reference: SAP HCM Job (Infotype 1005) / IGDA Career Framework

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job profile. Primary key for the job profile catalog.

attributes.name: reports_to_job_profile_id
attributes.description: Job profile identifier of the direct manager role for this position. Defines the standard reporting relationship in the organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: career_level
attributes.description: Seniority level within the career track. Defines experience expectations, scope of responsibility, and position in organizational hierarchy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entry|junior|mid|senior|lead|principal|director|vp|c_level — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: career_track
attributes.description: Career progression path for this job profile. Individual Contributor focuses on technical or creative depth; Management focuses on people leadership; Executive focuses on strategic leadership.

attributes.name: core_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of essential skills, technical proficiencies, and behavioral competencies required for success in this job profile. Examples: C++ programming, Unreal Engine, 3D modeling, Agile methodology, player empathy, cross-functional collaboration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile is retired or deprecated. Null for currently active profiles with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile becomes active and available for use in position creation and workforce planning.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Standard employment relationship type for this job profile. Defines benefits eligibility, contract terms, and workforce planning categorization.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: US Fair Labor Standards Act classification determining overtime eligibility. Exempt employees are salaried and not eligible for overtime; non-exempt employees are eligible for overtime pay.
attributes.references: US Department of Labor FLSA Regulations

attributes.name: igda_discipline_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Game Developers Association (IGDA) Discipline Classification
attributes.description: IGDA-aligned discipline classification for standardized industry benchmarking and workforce reporting. Enables cross-studio and cross-company talent comparisons.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this job profile across all studios and corporate functions. Used for position requisition, compensation benchmarking, and HR system integration.

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive narrative description of the job profile including purpose, key responsibilities, deliverables, and success criteria. Used for job postings, performance management, and organizational design.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: High-level functional grouping of the job role. Defines the primary discipline or business function to which this job belongs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering|art|design|qa|production|esports_operations|community_management|marketing|finance|hr|legal|it|operations|executive — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: job_profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile. Active profiles are available for position creation; inactive profiles are retired; draft profiles are under development.

attributes.name: job_sub_family
attributes.description: Specialized sub-category within the job family. Examples: Gameplay Engineering, Character Art, Level Design, Automation QA, Live Operations Production, Tournament Operations.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title as it appears in employment contracts, organizational charts, and external job postings. Examples: Senior Game Designer, Lead Graphics Engineer, Community Manager, Esports Operations Coordinator.
attributes.references: IGDA Developer Satisfaction Survey Job Title Taxonomy

attributes.name: key_responsibilities
attributes.description: Structured list of primary duties and accountabilities for this job profile. Used for performance evaluation, role clarity, and workload planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this job profile was last reviewed and validated by HR and business leadership. Used for compliance audits and ensuring profile currency.

attributes.name: minimum_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum formal education level required for this job profile. Used for candidate screening and job posting requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for this job profile. Used for candidate screening and compensation benchmarking.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this job profile. Used for proactive profile maintenance and alignment with evolving business needs.

attributes.name: pay_grade_band
attributes.description: Compensation band code defining the salary range for this job profile. Used for compensation benchmarking, budget planning, and offer letter generation.

attributes.name: physical_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical demands and working conditions for this job profile. Examples: prolonged sitting, repetitive motion, ability to lift equipment, extended screen time. Used for ADA compliance and workplace accommodation planning.

attributes.name: preferred_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of professional certifications or licenses that are preferred but not required. Used for candidate evaluation and professional development planning.

attributes.name: preferred_education_level
attributes.description: Preferred formal education level for optimal candidate fit. Used for candidate evaluation and talent pipeline development.

attributes.name: preferred_years_experience
attributes.description: Preferred number of years of relevant professional experience for optimal candidate fit. Used for candidate evaluation and talent pipeline development.

attributes.name: remote_work_eligibility
attributes.description: Remote work policy applicable to this job profile. Defines whether the role can be performed remotely, requires hybrid presence, or must be on-site.

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of professional certifications or licenses required for this job profile. Examples: PMP, Certified Scrum Master, Unity Certified Developer, AWS Solutions Architect.

attributes.name: security_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile requires background checks or security clearance due to access to sensitive IP, financial data, or player data.

attributes.name: span_of_control_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of direct reports expected for this job profile if it is a management role. Used for organizational design and capacity planning.

attributes.name: span_of_control_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of direct reports expected for this job profile if it is a management role. Used for organizational design and capacity planning.

attributes.name: technical_skills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific technical tools, platforms, programming languages, or software applications required for this job profile. Examples: Unity, Perforce, Jira, Maya, Substance Painter, Python, SQL.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Expected percentage of work time requiring business travel. Used for candidate expectations, expense budgeting, and work-life balance planning.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this job profile definition. Incremented when significant changes are made to responsibilities, requirements, or compensation bands.

products.name: skill_matrix
products.description: Developer and studio talent capability inventory capturing individual proficiency ratings, certifications, learning program enrollments, and training completions across technical and creative disciplines. Tracks employee or contractor, skill category (game engine proficiency, programming language, art discipline, QA methodology, platform SDK knowledge), specific skill (Unity, Unreal Engine, C++, Python, HLSL), proficiency level, assessment date, and assessor. Includes learning records: course/certification name, provider, enrollment date, completion date, pass/fail status, CEU credits, cost, and learning type (mandatory compliance vs voluntary development). Mandatory compliance training tracked: GDPR, COPPA, PCI DSS, harassment prevention. Single source of truth for workforce capabilities and professional development. Critical for studio capacity planning, sprint team assembly, skill gap analysis, and compliance training audit.
products.reference: IGDA Developer Skill Framework / SAP HCM Qualifications (Infotype 0024)

attributes.name: skill_matrix_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the skill matrix record. Primary key for the skill matrix data product.

attributes.name: contractor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.contractor. Business justification: The product description states 'Developer and studio talent capability inventory' - contractors are talent. Studios track contractor skills for project staffing decisions (which contractor has Unreal

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the game development project where this skill was most recently applied or is currently being used. Links to project master data. Used for project-specific skill gap analysis and team composition planning.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the game development studio or organizational unit where the employee is assigned. Used for studio-level skill inventory and capacity planning. Links to studio master data.

attributes.name: primary_skill_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee or contractor whose skill is being tracked. Links to the workforce employee master data.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the skill proficiency was last assessed or validated. Critical for tracking skill currency and identifying when reassessment is needed.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification was earned or awarded. Used to track certification currency and identify when recertification may be required.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification expires and requires renewal or recertification. Nullable for certifications that do not expire.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Name of the professional certification or credential earned for this skill, if applicable. Examples include Unity Certified Developer, Unreal Engine Certified Instructor, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or platform-specific certifications.

attributes.name: certification_provider
attributes.description: Organization or institution that issued the certification. Examples include Unity Technologies, Epic Games, Scrum Alliance, Microsoft, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or platform holders (Sony, Microsoft, Nintendo).

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current validity status of the certification. Active indicates the certification is current and valid, expired indicates it has lapsed, pending renewal indicates recertification is in progress, and revoked indicates the certification was withdrawn by the issuing body.

attributes.name: ceu_credits
attributes.description: Number of continuing education unit credits earned upon successful completion of the learning program. Used for professional development tracking and certification maintenance requirements.
attributes.references: International Association for Continuing Education and Training (IACET)

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee successfully completed the learning program or training course. Nullable if the program is still in progress or was not completed.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employees progress in the learning program. Completed indicates successful finish, in progress indicates active participation, not started indicates enrollment without activity, failed indicates unsuccessful completion, and withdrawn indicates the employee dropped out.

attributes.name: compliance_training_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this learning program is mandatory compliance training required by law, regulation, or company policy. True indicates mandatory compliance training (GDPR, COPPA, PCI DSS, harassment prevention, security awareness). False indicates non-compliance training. Critical for audit trail and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 32, COPPA, PCI DSS Requirement 12.6

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this skill matrix record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: endorsement_count
attributes.description: Number of peer or manager endorsements received for this skill. Endorsements provide social validation of skill proficiency and are used to supplement formal assessments. Similar to LinkedIn skill endorsements but internal to the organization.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee enrolled in the learning program or training course. Used to track learning journey timelines and program participation rates.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this skill matrix record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when the employee actively used this skill in a project, sprint, or work assignment. Used to identify skill currency and detect skill atrophy. Sourced from project management systems (Jira) or time tracking systems.

attributes.name: learning_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the training course, workshop, or learning program the employee is enrolled in or has completed to develop this skill. Examples include internal onboarding programs, vendor training (Unity Learn, Unreal Online Learning), or third-party courses (Coursera, Udemy, LinkedIn Learning).

attributes.name: learning_provider
attributes.description: Organization or platform providing the training or learning program. Examples include internal HR/L&D teams, Unity Technologies, Epic Games, Coursera, Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, or specialized game development training providers.

attributes.name: learning_type
attributes.description: Classification of the learning program purpose. Mandatory compliance indicates required training for regulatory or policy adherence (General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Childrens Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), harassment prevention). Voluntary development indicates employee-initiated professional growth. Onboarding indicates new hire orientation. Upskilling indicates deepening existing skills. Reskilling indicates learning new skills for role transition.

attributes.name: manager_assessment_score
attributes.description: Managers rated proficiency score for this skill on a scale of 1 to 10. Provides objective assessment to complement self-assessment. Used for performance reviews, promotion decisions, and skill gap analysis.

attributes.name: next_assessment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next skill proficiency assessment or review. Used to ensure regular skill validation and maintain skill inventory currency. Typically scheduled annually or bi-annually depending on skill criticality.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, or comments about the skill assessment, learning progress, or development plan. Used by managers and HR to capture qualitative insights that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the learning program assessment or examination. Pass indicates successful completion of all requirements, fail indicates unsuccessful completion, and not applicable indicates the program does not have a pass/fail assessment.

attributes.name: proficiency_level
attributes.description: Current proficiency rating for the employee in this specific skill. Levels range from beginner (basic familiarity) to master (industry-recognized expert, can mentor others and define best practices).

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this skill matrix record. Active indicates the record is current and valid. Inactive indicates the skill is no longer tracked for this employee (e.g., employee left or skill is no longer relevant). Archived indicates historical record retained for compliance or analytics.

attributes.name: self_assessment_score
attributes.description: Employees self-rated proficiency score for this skill on a scale of 1 to 10. Used to compare self-perception with manager assessment and identify confidence gaps or Dunning-Kruger effects. Supports career development conversations.

attributes.name: skill_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the skill domain. Categories include game engine proficiency, programming language, art discipline (3D modeling, animation, concept art), quality assurance (QA) methodology, platform software development kit (SDK) knowledge, and design discipline (level design, systems design, narrative design).

attributes.name: skill_gap_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this skill represents a gap between current proficiency and required proficiency for the employees role or career path. True indicates a development need. False indicates proficiency meets or exceeds requirements. Used to prioritize learning and development investments.

attributes.name: skill_name
attributes.description: Specific name of the skill or competency being assessed. Examples include Unity, Unreal Engine, C++, Python, High-Level Shading Language (HLSL), Maya, Blender, Substance Painter, Perforce, Jira, Agile QA, platform-specific SDKs (Steamworks, PlayStation SDK, Xbox GDK).

attributes.name: skill_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this skill based on current and future project needs. Critical indicates the skill is essential for current production and in high demand. High indicates strong business need. Medium indicates moderate need. Low indicates nice-to-have or surplus capacity. Used for learning and development investment prioritization.

attributes.name: skill_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the skill in the employees capability portfolio. Active indicates the skill is currently used and maintained. Dormant indicates the skill is not currently used but remains valid. Deprecated indicates the skill is obsolete or no longer relevant to the business. Target indicates the skill is a development goal not yet achieved.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this skill matrix record originated. Examples include SAP S/4HANA HR, internal learning management system (LMS), or talent management platform. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: target_proficiency_level
attributes.description: Desired proficiency level for this skill based on the employees role requirements or career development plan. Used to measure skill gap and track progress toward development goals.

attributes.name: training_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for the learning program, including tuition, materials, and any associated fees. Denominated in the companys reporting currency. Used for learning and development budget tracking and return on investment (ROI) analysis.

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of professional experience the employee has with this specific skill, including work at previous employers. Used for capacity planning and team composition analysis.

products.name: headcount_plan
products.description: Studio, department, and project-level workforce capacity planning records capturing approved FTE targets, contractor budget allocations, hiring forecasts, and discipline breakdowns by sprint, milestone, quarter, and fiscal year. Tracks org unit, planning period, approved headcount by discipline (engineering, art, design, QA, production), current filled count, open requisition count, contractor FTE equivalent, available vs allocated FTE, utilization rates, capacity gaps, and plan status (draft, approved, locked). Single source of truth for all workforce capacity planning. Directly supports game development production scheduling, studio capacity planning, GaaS live operations staffing, and project-level resource allocation.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA HR Headcount Planning / Workforce Planning

attributes.name: headcount_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the headcount plan record. Primary key for workforce capacity planning entries.

attributes.name: dev_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the game development project this headcount plan supports. Nullable for studio-wide or department-level plans not tied to a specific project.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (typically HR director, studio head, or finance executive) who approved this headcount plan.

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Headcount planning is directly tied to approved budget versions for workforce cost forecasting. Finance and HR jointly manage headcount budgets; requisition approvals depend on budget availability. Ga

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit (studio, department, division) for which this headcount plan applies.

attributes.name: approved_fte_art
attributes.description: Approved headcount target for art discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Includes concept artists, 3D modelers, animators, VFX artists, and UI/UX designers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Headcount Planning, IGDA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: approved_fte_design
attributes.description: Approved headcount target for design discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Includes game designers, level designers, systems designers, narrative designers, and economy designers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Headcount Planning, IGDA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: approved_fte_engineering
attributes.description: Approved headcount target for engineering discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Includes software engineers, technical artists, engine programmers, and technical designers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Headcount Planning, IGDA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: approved_fte_other
attributes.description: Approved headcount target for other disciplines not categorized above (e.g., audio, localization, analytics, DevOps, IT support) expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units.

attributes.name: approved_fte_production
attributes.description: Approved headcount target for production discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Includes producers, project managers, scrum masters, and program managers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Headcount Planning, IGDA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: approved_fte_qa
attributes.description: Approved headcount target for Quality Assurance (QA) discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Includes QA testers, automation engineers, and compliance testers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Headcount Planning, IGDA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: approved_fte_total
attributes.description: Total approved headcount target across all disciplines expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Sum of all discipline-specific FTE targets.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this headcount plan was approved. Nullable for plans still in draft or submitted status.

attributes.name: capacity_gap_fte
attributes.description: The difference between approved FTE total and current filled FTE total. Positive values indicate unfilled capacity; negative values indicate over-staffing relative to plan.

attributes.name: contractor_fte_actual
attributes.description: Current actual contractor and temporary workforce expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Reflects engaged contractors as of the snapshot date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Contingent Workforce Management

attributes.name: contractor_fte_budget
attributes.description: Approved budget allocation for contractor and temporary workforce expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Supports flexible capacity planning for project peaks and specialized skills.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Contingent Workforce Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this headcount plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_filled_fte_art
attributes.description: Current actual headcount for art discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Reflects filled positions as of the snapshot date.

attributes.name: current_filled_fte_design
attributes.description: Current actual headcount for design discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Reflects filled positions as of the snapshot date.

attributes.name: current_filled_fte_engineering
attributes.description: Current actual headcount for engineering discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Reflects filled positions as of the snapshot date.

attributes.name: current_filled_fte_other
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Filled Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) Other Disciplines
attributes.description: Current actual headcount for other disciplines expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Reflects filled positions as of the snapshot date.

attributes.name: current_filled_fte_production
attributes.description: Current actual headcount for production discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Reflects filled positions as of the snapshot date.

attributes.name: current_filled_fte_qa
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Filled Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) Quality Assurance (QA)
attributes.description: Current actual headcount for Quality Assurance (QA) discipline expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Reflects filled positions as of the snapshot date.

attributes.name: current_filled_fte_total
attributes.description: Total current actual headcount across all disciplines expressed in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) units. Sum of all discipline-specific filled FTE counts.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter this headcount plan belongs to (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). Nullable for plans spanning multiple quarters or non-quarterly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year this headcount plan belongs to (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this headcount plan record was last modified. Updated with each revision or status change.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about this headcount plan. May include assumptions, constraints, hiring priorities, or special considerations.

attributes.name: open_requisition_count_art
attributes.description: Number of open job requisitions for art discipline. Represents active hiring demand.

attributes.name: open_requisition_count_design
attributes.description: Number of open job requisitions for design discipline. Represents active hiring demand.

attributes.name: open_requisition_count_engineering
attributes.description: Number of open job requisitions for engineering discipline. Represents active hiring demand.

attributes.name: open_requisition_count_other
attributes.description: Number of open job requisitions for other disciplines. Represents active hiring demand.

attributes.name: open_requisition_count_production
attributes.description: Number of open job requisitions for production discipline. Represents active hiring demand.

attributes.name: open_requisition_count_qa
attributes.description: Number of open job requisitions for Quality Assurance (QA) discipline. Represents active hiring demand.

attributes.name: open_requisition_count_total
attributes.description: Total number of open job requisitions across all disciplines. Sum of all discipline-specific open requisition counts.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or identifier for this headcount plan (e.g., 'Q1 2024 Studio A Expansion', 'Project Phoenix Ramp-Up').

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the headcount plan: draft (in preparation), submitted (pending approval), approved (finalized and active), locked (frozen for reporting), archived (historical record).

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version number of this headcount plan. Increments with each revision to support change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning period covered by this headcount plan.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning period covered by this headcount plan.

attributes.name: planning_period_type
attributes.description: The granularity or type of planning period this headcount plan covers: sprint (agile iteration), milestone (game development phase), quarter (business quarter), fiscal year, or annual.
attributes.references: Jira Sprint Planning, Internal Workforce Planning Standard

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the current filled FTE and contractor FTE actual values were captured. Supports point-in-time workforce capacity reporting.

attributes.name: utilization_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of approved FTE capacity that is currently filled. Calculated as (current_filled_fte_total / approved_fte_total) * 100. Measures staffing efficiency and capacity utilization.

products.name: compensation
products.description: Employee compensation records capturing base salary, bonus target, equity grants, pay grade, pay frequency, currency, effective date, and compensation review cycle. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll and Compensation Management modules. Tracks compensation history per employee, compensation type (base, bonus, equity, allowance), and approval status. Supports IGDA workforce standards compliance and pay equity analysis.

attributes.name: compensation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compensation record. Primary key for the compensation data product.

attributes.name: compensation_approved_by_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the manager who approved this compensation change. Links to employee master data for approval audit trail.

attributes.name: compensation_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee receiving this compensation. Links to the employee master data in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Compensation planning and approval workflows require cost center assignment for budget validation and headcount cost forecasting. Finance teams use this for annual planning, merit increase cycles, and

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the game studio or organizational unit where the employee is assigned. Links to studio master data for studio-level compensation reporting.

attributes.name: previous_compensation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior compensation record for this employee. Creates a historical chain of compensation changes for audit and analysis. Null for initial compensation record.

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of additional allowances (housing, transportation, relocation, etc.) included in this compensation record. Business-confidential financial data.

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: Category of allowance provided to the employee. Distinguishes between housing, transportation, relocation, remote work stipends, and education allowances.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval and lifecycle status of the compensation record. Tracks workflow from draft through approval to active status.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this compensation record was approved. Part of the approval audit trail for compliance and governance.

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: Annual base salary amount for the employee. Excludes bonuses, equity, and other variable compensation. Business-confidential financial data.

attributes.name: bonus_target_amount
attributes.description: Target annual bonus amount for the employee based on performance objectives and company performance. Actual bonus may vary. Business-confidential financial data.

attributes.name: bonus_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target bonus expressed as a percentage of base salary. Used for calculating variable compensation eligibility. Business-confidential classification data.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for this compensation change. Distinguishes between new hires, promotions, merit increases, market adjustments, cost-of-living adjustments, retention actions, demotions, and transfers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_hire|promotion|merit_increase|market_adjustment|cost_of_living|retention|demotion|transfer — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commission_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Commission rate as a percentage of sales or revenue for commission-eligible roles. Used to calculate variable compensation for sales and business development roles. Business-confidential classification data.

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: Category of compensation payment. Distinguishes between base salary, performance bonus, equity grants, commissions, allowances, and overtime pay.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this compensation record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this compensation record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this compensation arrangement ends or is superseded by a new compensation record. Null for current active compensation.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this compensation arrangement becomes effective. Marks the beginning of the compensation period for this record.

attributes.name: equity_grant_quantity
attributes.description: Number of equity units (stock options, RSUs, or shares) granted to the employee. Business-confidential financial data.

attributes.name: equity_grant_type
attributes.description: Type of equity compensation granted. Includes stock options, Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), restricted stock, or performance shares. Business-confidential classification data.

attributes.name: equity_vesting_schedule
attributes.description: Vesting schedule for equity grants describing when equity becomes exercisable or transferable (e.g., 4-year vest with 1-year cliff, monthly vesting). Business-confidential terms.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Job title or position associated with this compensation record at the time of the compensation event. Captures title for historical compensation analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this compensation record was last updated. Part of the audit trail for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: market_benchmark_percentile
attributes.description: Percentile position of this compensation relative to market benchmark data for the role and geography. Used for competitive compensation analysis. Business-confidential analytical data.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context for this compensation record. May include special terms, conditions, or explanations for non-standard compensation arrangements.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for overtime pay under labor regulations and company policy. True for non-exempt employees, false for exempt employees.

attributes.name: total_compensation_amount

products.name: benefit_enrollment

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id

attributes.name: annual_election_amount

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation

attributes.name: cobra_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act) End Date

attributes.name: cobra_start_date

attributes.name: contribution_election_percentage

attributes.name: contribution_frequency

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected indicating who is covered under the benefit plan: employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or full family coverage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under this benefit enrollment. Zero for employee-only coverage, one or more for family coverage tiers.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount the employee contributes per pay period toward the benefit premium or cost. Represents employee share of benefit cost deducted from payroll.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount the employer contributes per pay period toward the benefit premium or cost. Represents employer subsidy or match for the benefit.

attributes.name: employer_match_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of employee contribution that the employer matches for retirement or savings plans. Represents employer matching formula for 401k or similar plans.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted or completed the benefit enrollment election. Distinct from effective date as enrollment may occur before coverage begins.

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit coverage begins and becomes active for the employee. Critical for determining coverage periods and premium calculations.

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date

attributes.name: enrollment_number

attributes.name: enrollment_period_type

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the benefit enrollment was submitted. Tracks whether employee self-enrolled via portal, HR entered on behalf, paper form was processed, or automatic enrollment occurred.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. attributes.name: group_number

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: plan_type

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date

attributes.name: policy_number

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date

attributes.name: qualifying_event_type

attributes.name: total_premium_amount

attributes.name: vesting_schedule

Immediate means fully vested, cliff means vesting occurs at specific year, graded means incremental vesting over years. attributes.name: waiver_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the employee actively waived or declined this benefit plan. True if waived, false if enrolled. Used to track voluntary declinations for compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: waiver_reason

products.name: performance_review

Feeds into compensation review and career development planning.

attributes.name: performance_review_id

attributes.name: game_studio_id

attributes.name: review_cycle_id

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee conducting the review (typically direct manager or supervisor).

attributes.name: calibration_committee_notes
attributes.description: Confidential notes and rationale from the calibration committee regarding rating adjustments or validation. Used to ensure fairness and consistency in performance ratings across the organization.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the review has been through calibration committee review to ensure rating consistency across teams and studios. attributes.name: collaboration_rating
attributes.description: Rating for collaboration, teamwork, and cross-functional communication skills. Critical for game development teams working in agile sprints and cross-discipline collaboration.
attributes.references: IGDA Workforce Standards; SAP S/4HANA HR Performance Management

attributes.name: collaboration_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for collaboration rating on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00 to 5.00).

attributes.name: compensation_increase_percentage
attributes.description: Recommended percentage increase in base compensation based on performance rating (e.g., 5.50 represents a 5.5% salary increase). Confidential field used for compensation planning and budgeting.

attributes.name: compensation_increase_recommended
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the reviewer recommends a compensation increase (salary raise, bonus, equity grant) based on performance. True if increase is recommended, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: development_plan_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a formal development plan or Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) is required based on the review outcome. True if development plan is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee acknowledged receipt and review of their performance evaluation. Indicates the employee has been informed of the review outcome.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_signature
attributes.description: Digital signature or acknowledgement token confirming the employee has reviewed and acknowledged the performance review. Used for compliance and record-keeping.

attributes.name: employee_self_assessment
attributes.description: Employee's self-assessment narrative describing their own performance, accomplishments, challenges, and development goals for the review period. Submitted prior to manager review.

attributes.name: goal_achievement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of individual goals and objectives (OKRs) achieved during the review period (e.g., 85.50 represents 85.5% goal achievement). Calculated from individual goal tracking aligned to game development milestones.

attributes.name: goals_met_count
attributes.description: Number of individual goals fully achieved during the review period.

attributes.name: goals_total_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual goals set for the employee during the review period.

attributes.name: innovation_rating
attributes.description: Rating for innovation, creativity, and problem-solving abilities. Particularly important for game designers, artists, and engineers developing new gameplay mechanics and features.

attributes.name: innovation_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for innovation rating on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00 to 5.00).

attributes.name: leadership_rating
attributes.description: Rating for leadership capabilities including mentoring, decision-making, and team management. Applicable to lead developers, producers, directors, and managers. Set to not_applicable for individual contributor roles without leadership responsibilities.

attributes.name: leadership_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for leadership rating on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00 to 5.00). Null if not applicable to role.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the review is changed. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Overall performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period. attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Performance Management; IGDA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the overall performance rating on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00 to 5.00, where 5.00 is outstanding). Used for compensation calculations and talent analytics.

attributes.name: promotion_readiness_level

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Career and Succession Planning

attributes.name: promotion_recommended
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the reviewer recommends the employee for promotion based on performance during the review period. True if promotion is recommended, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Career and Succession Planning

attributes.name: review_approval_date

attributes.name: review_completion_date

attributes.name: review_period_end_date

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance period being evaluated (e.g., 2024-01-01 for annual review covering calendar year 2024).

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the performance review: draft (in progress by reviewer), submitted (awaiting manager approval), manager_review (under manager evaluation), calibration (in calibration committee review), approved (finalized and approved), completed (delivered to employee), cancelled (review cancelled). attributes.name: review_submission_date

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of performance review: annual (yearly comprehensive review), mid_year (semi-annual checkpoint), probation (new hire evaluation), project_end (post-project assessment), promotion (evaluation for advancement), pip (Performance Improvement Plan review).

attributes.name: reviewer_comments

attributes.name: technical_competency_rating

attributes.name: technical_competency_score

products.name: recruitment_requisition
products.description: Headcount requisition and talent acquisition records managing the end-to-end hiring pipeline from requisition approval through candidate management to offer acceptance. Requisition details: requisition number, position reference, job profile, hiring manager, recruiter, studio location, target start date, status, sourcing channels, time-to-fill. Candidate records: candidate name, contact details, source channel (referral, job board, campus, esports talent pipeline), application date, pipeline stage (applied, screened, interviewed, offered, hired, rejected), portfolio URL, discipline, interview scores, and GDPR consent for data retention. Single source of truth for all talent acquisition activity. Supports hiring velocity reporting, source channel effectiveness, and diversity pipeline analytics for game development and esports operations roles.

products.name: payroll_run
products.description: Payroll processing and payment records capturing run-level execution events and individual employee pay details (payslips). Run-level: payroll period, pay group, run type (regular, off-cycle, bonus), run status, total gross/net pay, total deductions, employer contributions, currency, and GL posting date. Employee-level (payslip): individual gross pay, net pay, itemized earnings (base, overtime, bonus, allowances), itemized deductions (tax, benefits, garnishments, 401k), payment method, pay period dates, and payslip document reference. Single source of truth for all payroll and employee pay data. Supports payroll audit, finance reconciliation, labor cost reporting, employee self-service pay statements, and statutory reporting (W-2, P60). Primary source system: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the payroll run, typically a sequential or formatted code used for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payroll run: draft (prepared but not executed), in-progress (currently processing), completed (calculation finished), posted (posted to General Ledger), cancelled (run voided), or failed (processing error).

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Type of payroll run execution: regular (scheduled periodic payroll), off-cycle (unscheduled mid-period run), bonus (special bonus payment run), correction (adjustment run), final (termination payroll), or advance (early payment).

attributes.name: total_employee_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all employee-side deductions (income tax, social security, benefits, garnishments, 401k contributions) withheld from gross pay in this payroll run.

attributes.name: total_employees_processed
attributes.description: Count of employees included in this payroll run. Used for reconciliation and validation that all expected employees were paid.

attributes.name: total_employer_contributions
attributes.description: Sum of all employer-side contributions (employer portion of social security, health insurance, retirement matching, payroll taxes) for this payroll run. Represents additional labor cost beyond gross pay.

attributes.name: total_gross_pay
attributes.description: Sum of all gross earnings (base salary, overtime, bonuses, allowances) for all employees in this payroll run before any deductions. Key metric for labor cost reporting.

attributes.name: total_net_pay
attributes.description: Sum of all net pay (gross pay minus all deductions) for all employees in this payroll run. Represents the total cash disbursement amount.

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Sum of all tax withholdings (federal, state, local income tax, social security, Medicare) for all employees in this payroll run. Used for tax remittance and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: Number of warnings generated during payroll run processing. Warnings indicate potential issues that did not prevent processing but require review.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who initiated this payroll run. Part of audit trail for payroll governance and segregation of duties.

products.name: payslip

Sourced from SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll. Supports employee self-service, payroll audit, and statutory reporting (W-2, P60).

attributes.name: allowances_total

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payslip was approved for payment.

attributes.name: bank_account_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the employee's bank account number used for direct deposit, for verification and audit purposes.

attributes.name: base_salary
attributes.description: The regular base salary or wage amount earned by the employee during the pay period before any additions or deductions.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus payment included in this payslip.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Sales commission or incentive payment earned during the pay period.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this payslip are denominated.

attributes.name: dental_insurance_deduction
attributes.description: Employee contribution toward dental insurance premiums deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: employer_401k_match
attributes.description: Employer's matching contribution to the employee's 401(k) retirement plan for this pay period.

attributes.name: employer_health_insurance_contribution
attributes.description: Employer's contribution toward the employee's health insurance premiums for this pay period.

attributes.name: employer_medicare_contribution
attributes.description: Employer's matching contribution to Medicare tax for this pay period.

attributes.name: employer_social_security_contribution
attributes.description: Employer's matching contribution to social security tax for this pay period.

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: garnishment_deduction
attributes.description: Court-ordered wage garnishment amount deducted from gross pay for child support, alimony, tax levies, or other legal obligations.

attributes.name: generated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payslip record was generated by the payroll system.

attributes.name: gross_pay
attributes.description: Total earnings before any deductions, calculated as the sum of base salary, overtime, bonuses, commissions, and allowances.

attributes.name: health_insurance_deduction
attributes.description: Employee contribution toward health insurance premiums deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: local_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of local or municipal income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: medicare_tax
attributes.description: Employee portion of Medicare tax (FICA) withheld from gross pay.

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: The final take-home pay amount disbursed to the employee after all deductions, calculated as gross pay minus total deductions.

attributes.name: other_deductions_total
attributes.description: Sum of all other miscellaneous deductions not categorized above, such as union dues, charitable contributions, or loan repayments.

attributes.name: overtime_pay
attributes.description: Additional compensation for hours worked beyond the standard work schedule during the pay period.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, or monthly).

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the pay period covered by this payslip.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the pay period covered by this payslip.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net pay was or will be disbursed to the employee.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee (direct deposit, physical check, cash, or wire transfer).

attributes.name: payslip_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique payslip document number assigned by the payroll system for reference and audit purposes.

attributes.name: payslip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payslip record indicating whether it is in draft, approved for payment, paid, voided, or corrected.

attributes.name: retirement_401k_deduction
attributes.description: Employee contribution to 401(k) retirement plan deducted from gross pay on a pre-tax or post-tax basis.

attributes.name: social_security_tax
attributes.description: Employee portion of social security tax (FICA) withheld from gross pay.

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of state income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions including taxes, benefits, retirement contributions, garnishments, and other withholdings.

attributes.name: vision_insurance_deduction
attributes.description: Employee contribution toward vision insurance premiums deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: year_to_date_401k_contribution
attributes.description: Cumulative employee 401(k) contributions from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through the end of this pay period.

attributes.name: year_to_date_federal_tax
attributes.description: Cumulative federal income tax withheld from the employee's pay from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through the end of this pay period.

attributes.name: year_to_date_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay earned by the employee from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through the end of this pay period.

attributes.name: year_to_date_net_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative net pay received by the employee from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through the end of this pay period.

attributes.name: year_to_date_state_tax
attributes.description: Cumulative state income tax withheld from the employee's pay from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through the end of this pay period.

products.name: workforce_event
products.description: HR lifecycle event records capturing significant employment status changes for employees and contractors. Event types include hire, rehire, transfer, promotion, demotion, role change, studio transfer, leave of absence, return from leave, termination (voluntary/involuntary), and retirement. Captures event type, effective date, previous state, new state, initiating manager, HR business partner, and approval chain. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA HR Actions (Infotype 0000). Provides full employment history audit trail.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Employee and contractor time management records capturing hours worked, project allocations, and all absence/leave periods. For worked time: hours per day, project or title allocation, cost center, activity type (development, QA, playtesting, live ops, meetings, training), overtime hours, and approval status. For absences and leave: leave type (PTO, sick leave, parental leave, FMLA, bereavement, crunch recovery leave), start/end dates, duration, approval status, approver, and return-to-work date. Single source of truth for all employee time and availability data. Supports project cost allocation, studio capacity utilization tracking, overtime compliance monitoring during crunch periods, FMLA/statutory leave compliance, and developer availability for sprint planning. products.name: project_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of employees to capital expenditure projects for game development, engine technology investments, and infrastructure build-outs. It captures the allocation percentage, time period, role, and billable rate for each employee-project assignment. Each record links one employee to one capex_project with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship. Critical for capitalization accounting under ASC 350-40 and IAS 38, as labor costs must be tracked by project and capitalization phase.. Existence Justification: In gaming studios, employees work on multiple capital projects simultaneously (e.g., a senior engine engineer may allocate 60% to Unreal Engine 5 migration and 40% to a new game title), and capital projects require multiple employees across disciplines (engineering, art, design, production). Studios actively manage these allocations with specific percentages, time periods, roles, and billable rates for GAAP/IFRS capitalization accounting (ASC 350-40, IAS 38). This is a core operational process tracked in project management and financial systems.

products.name: job_policy_training_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the mandatory compliance training requirements between job profiles and compliance policies. It captures role-specific training obligations, certification requirements, and training schedules that exist only in the context of a specific job profile being subject to a specific compliance policy. Each record links one job profile to one compliance policy with training metadata that belongs to neither entity alone.. Existence Justification: Gaming studios operate under a matrix of compliance obligations where each job profile has role-specific training requirements across multiple policies, and each policy applies to multiple job profiles with varying training intensity. For example, engineers require data protection policy training due to PII access, monetization designers require loot box disclosure policy training due to in-game economy design, and QA testers require age rating compliance training due to content evaluation responsibilities. The compliance team actively manages these training requirements as a distinct operational entity, tracking certification status, training schedules, and recertification cycles for each job-policy combination.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of why this specific policy training is required for this specific job profile. Examples: Engineers need data protection training due to access to player PII; Monetization designers need loot box disclosure training due to in-game economy design responsibilities.
