attributes.description: The deadline by which all managers must complete feedback delivery sessions with their direct reports. Required for cycle closure.

attributes.name: feedback_delivery_start_date
attributes.description: The date when managers can begin scheduling and conducting one-on-one feedback sessions with employees to discuss review results.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter associated with this review cycle (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). Relevant for quarterly and mid-year review cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this review cycle belongs (e.g., 2024, 2025). Used for multi-year trend analysis and compensation planning alignment.

attributes.name: forced_distribution_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether forced ranking or distribution curves are applied during calibration. True means a percentage of employees must be rated in each performance tier; false means ratings are not constrained by distribution requirements.

attributes.name: goal_setting_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether goal-setting functionality is enabled for this review cycle. True means employees and managers can set performance goals; false means this cycle focuses only on retrospective evaluation.

attributes.name: job_level_scope
attributes.description: Defines which job levels or career bands are included in this review cycle (e.g., 'individual_contributor', 'manager', 'senior_leader'). Used to segment review processes by organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: manager_review_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which managers must complete all performance reviews for their direct reports. Required for calibration session scheduling.

attributes.name: manager_review_start_date
attributes.description: The date when managers can begin conducting performance reviews and providing ratings for their direct reports.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this review cycle record was last modified. Updated whenever any cycle configuration changes are made.

attributes.name: peer_feedback_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether peer feedback collection is enabled for this review cycle. True means employees can nominate peers and receive 360-degree feedback; false means reviews are manager-only.

attributes.name: promotion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees can be nominated for promotion during this review cycle. True means promotion recommendations are accepted; false means this cycle does not include promotion decisions.

attributes.name: rating_scale_type
attributes.description: The performance rating scale used for this review cycle. Five-point scales typically range from 'Does Not Meet' to 'Exceptional'; four-point scales eliminate the middle option; three-point scales use 'Below/Meets/Exceeds'; narrative-only cycles do not use numeric ratings; meets-expectations scales use binary pass/fail assessment.

attributes.name: review_template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the review form template used for this cycle, defining the questions, competencies, and rating criteria employees and managers will use.

attributes.name: self_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which employees must complete and submit their self-assessment forms. Late submissions may require manager approval.

attributes.name: self_assessment_start_date
attributes.description: The date when employees can begin submitting their self-assessment forms for this review cycle.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the review cycle officially begins and employees can start self-assessments and goal-setting activities.

attributes.name: studio_scope
attributes.description: Defines the organizational scope of the review cycle. Global cycles apply to all studios and locations; regional cycles target specific geographic regions; studio-specific cycles apply to individual game development studios; project-team cycles focus on specific game title development teams.

attributes.name: target_participation_rate
attributes.description: The target percentage of eligible employees who should complete the review cycle (e.g., 95.00 means 95% participation target). Used for compliance tracking and HR analytics.

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether managers and employees must complete training before participating in this review cycle. True means training completion is tracked and enforced; false means training is optional or not required.

attributes.name: upward_feedback_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether upward feedback (employee feedback on managers) is enabled for this review cycle. True means direct reports can provide anonymous feedback on their managers; false means no upward feedback is collected.

attributes.name: previous_review_cycle_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on review_cycle (previous_review_cycle_id)

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Owns enterprise financial reporting, general ledger, cost center management, budgeting, EBITDA/ROI reporting sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO modules, studio P&L, title-level profitability, royalty accruals, and regulatory financial disclosures. Distinct from billing: billing owns transactional payment records; finance owns the consolidated accounting and reporting layer.

products.name: general_ledger
products.description: The authoritative SAP S/4HANA FI general ledger for Gaming, capturing all posted accounting entries across company codes, fiscal periods, and posting keys, along with the enterprise chart of accounts defining all GL account codes, account descriptions, account types (P&L, balance sheet), account groups, and applicable company codes. Includes gaming-industry-specific accounts for deferred revenue (GaaS subscriptions, season passes), game development cost capitalization, virtual currency liability, platform fee expense, and esports prize pool accruals. Serves as the enterprise-wide SSOT for all financial balances, account structure, and period-end closing. Supports GAAP, IFRS, and local statutory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger entry. Primary key for the general ledger data product.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: general_ledger has gl_account_code and gl_account_description (STRING) referencing chart of accounts. Normalize by adding chart_of_accounts_id FK to chart_of_accounts.chart_of_accounts_id and removing

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: general_ledger has cost_center (STRING) for cost allocation. Normalize by adding cost_center_id FK to cost_center.cost_center_id and removing cost_center string.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: general_ledger postings originate from journal entries. general_ledger.document_number (STRING) references journal_entry.document_number. Normalize by adding journal_entry_id FK to journal_entry.journ

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: general_ledger has company_code (STRING) identifying the legal entity for the GL posting. Normalize by adding legal_entity_id FK to legal_entity.legal_entity_id and removing company_code string.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: general_ledger has profit_center (STRING) for P&L allocation. Normalize by adding profit_center_id FK to profit_center.profit_center_id and removing profit_center string.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the GL account into financial statement categories: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense.

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-text field used for grouping related entries for clearing, reconciliation, or reporting purposes.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The date from which payment terms are calculated for payables and receivables.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the business area or division (e.g., game publishing, esports, licensing) for cross-company code reporting.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared. Null if not cleared.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number that cleared this open item (for receivables, payables, or other clearing accounts). Null if not cleared.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The credit amount posted to the GL account in the document currency. Zero if the entry is a debit.

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The debit amount posted to the GL account in the document currency. Zero if the entry is a credit.

attributes.name: document_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the original transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document (invoice date, receipt date, etc.). May differ from posting date.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character code classifying the accounting document type (e.g., SA=GL account document, DR=customer invoice, KR=vendor invoice, DZ=payment document).

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was entered into the system by the user.

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the document was entered into the system.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert document currency to local or group currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year, typically 1-12 for regular periods, with additional periods (13-16) for year-end adjustments.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the accounting entry was posted. Four-digit year format (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classification of the entry by functional area (e.g., game development, marketing, operations) for cost-of-sales and functional expense reporting.

attributes.name: group_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the enterprise group reporting currency (typically USD for global gaming companies).

attributes.name: group_currency_credit_amount
attributes.description: The credit amount converted to the group reporting currency for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: group_currency_debit_amount
attributes.description: The debit amount converted to the group reporting currency for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Two-character code identifying the ledger (e.g., 0L=leading ledger, 2L=IFRS ledger, 3L=local GAAP ledger) for parallel accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New General Ledger

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the company code local currency.

attributes.name: local_currency_credit_amount
attributes.description: The credit amount converted to the company code local currency for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: local_currency_debit_amount
attributes.description: The debit amount converted to the company code local currency for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the payment terms (e.g., net 30, 2/10 net 30) for this entry.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accounting entry was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code that controls the posting behavior (debit or credit) and account type. Standard SAP posting keys: 40=debit GL, 50=credit GL, 01=debit customer, 11=credit customer, 31=debit vendor, 21=credit vendor.

attributes.name: reference_key
attributes.description: Free-text reference field containing additional document identifiers such as invoice numbers, purchase order numbers, or payment references.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this entry is a reversal of a previous posting. True if reversal, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original entry that this reversal entry is reversing. Null if not a reversal.

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Segment code for IFRS 8 and GAAP ASC 280 segment reporting, typically aligned with game titles, platforms, or geographic regions.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount calculated and posted for this entry in document currency.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Two-character code identifying the tax jurisdiction and rate applied to this entry (e.g., V1=standard VAT, I0=input tax exempt).

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the accounting entry (e.g., 'Deferred revenue recognition for Q1 season pass sales').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Text

attributes.name: user_name
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person who posted this accounting entry.

products.name: journal_entry

Captures debit/credit line items, posting date, document type, reference document, fiscal year/period, currency, and posting user. Covers manual journal entries, automated postings from SD/MM/CO, and period-end accruals including royalty accruals and deferred revenue from game title sales.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: legal_entity_id

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who posted this journal entry. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: journal_entry has profit_center (STRING) for P&L allocation at header level. Normalize by adding profit_center_id FK to profit_center.profit_center_id and removing profit_center string.

attributes.name: tertiary_journal_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who approved this journal entry. Populated when workflow approval is required and has been completed.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this journal entry was approved. Populated when workflow approval is required and has been completed.

attributes.name: assignment_reference
attributes.description: Assignment field used for grouping and sorting journal entries. Often contains project numbers, order numbers, or other business reference keys for reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The baseline date for payment terms calculation. Used to determine due dates and discount periods for payables and receivables.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area or division within the company to which this journal entry is assigned. Used for segment reporting and internal management accounting.

attributes.name: changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the journal entry was last modified. Null if the entry has never been changed after initial posting.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date when open items in this journal entry were cleared or reconciled. Applicable primarily to customer and vendor account postings.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the clearing document that reconciled open items in this journal entry.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the journal entry amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source document (invoice date, receipt date, etc.). May differ from posting date when documents are entered after their original date.

attributes.name: document_header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo at the document header level providing context about the purpose or nature of the journal entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Header Text (BKTXT)

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known accounting document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI. This is the business identifier used in financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry document. Draft entries are not yet posted; parked entries are saved but not yet final; posted entries are active in the ledger; cleared entries have been reconciled; reversed entries have been cancelled; cancelled entries are voided.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the accounting document indicating its origin and purpose. Examples include manual journal entries (SA), customer invoices (DR), vendor invoices (KR), payment documents (DZ), accruals (AA), and period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The calculated due date for payment based on payment terms and baseline date. Applicable to payable and receivable entries.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date when the journal entry was physically entered into the system by the user. Used for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: entry_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the journal entry was created in the system. Provides precise audit trail for when the entry was recorded.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert transaction currency amounts to local currency. Applicable when transaction currency differs from local currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when this journal entry was posted. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-4 for quarterly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this journal entry is posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-end closing processes.

attributes.name: functional_area

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the ledger or ledger group to which this journal entry is posted. Supports parallel accounting scenarios (e.g., local GAAP, IFRS, management reporting).

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: The local currency of the company code. All journal entries are also recorded in local currency for statutory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code applicable to this journal entry when it represents a payable or receivable (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. This is the principal business event timestamp that determines when the financial impact is recognized in the books.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit key that controls the type of posting (debit or credit) and the account type (general ledger, customer, vendor, asset). Standard keys include 40 (debit GL), 50 (credit GL), 01 (debit customer), 11 (credit customer), 31 (debit vendor), 21 (credit vendor).

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source document (invoice number, purchase order number, contract number, etc.). Used to trace the journal entry back to its originating business transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous entry. True if this document reverses another document.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the original journal entry (e.g., error correction, period adjustment, cancellation).

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or module that originated this journal entry (e.g., FI, CO, SD, MM, HR). Used to trace automated postings back to their originating business process.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code that determines the tax rate and tax accounts for this journal entry. Used for automatic tax calculation and tax reporting.

attributes.name: trading_partner
attributes.description: Identifier of the trading partner company code for intercompany transactions. Used to track and eliminate intercompany balances in consolidated reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: The SAP transaction code (T-code) used to create this journal entry (e.g., FB01 for manual entry, F-02 for general posting, MIRO for invoice verification).

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Withholding tax code applicable to this journal entry. Used for automatic withholding tax calculation on vendor payments and certain revenue transactions.

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Status of the approval workflow for this journal entry. Manual journal entries and certain automated postings may require approval before final posting.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: SAP S/4HANA CO cost center master data and allocation activity representing organizational units responsible for cost accumulation and distribution within Gaming. Includes studio cost centers (by team/discipline), game title development cost centers, platform engineering cost centers, esports operations cost centers, live ops cost centers, and corporate overhead. Each cost center has a responsible manager, validity period, hierarchy assignment, and cost center category. Also captures internal cost allocation and recharge records distributing shared costs (shared services, platform infrastructure, corporate overhead, engine licensing fees) across receiving cost centers and profit centers using defined allocation keys (headcount, revenue share, server usage). Supports internal cost allocation cycles, budget vs. actuals reporting, headcount cost tracking, EBITDA decomposition by organizational unit, and accurate title-level and studio-level P&L construction.

products.name: royalty_accrual
products.description: Royalty accrual, calculation, and statement records representing the complete royalty lifecycle for IP licensors, music rights holders, third-party engine licensors, and external developer partners. Captures accrual period, royalty base (net revenue, units sold, IAP revenue), applicable rate tiers, accrued amount, payment schedule, settlement status, formal statement details (statement period, counterparty breakdown, advances recouped, net payable/receivable), and statement issuance/receipt tracking. Supports royalty calculation, period-end accrual posting, statement generation and issuance to counterparties, royalty audit, dispute resolution, advance recoupment tracking, and accounting accrual posting to GL. Distinct from billing payments — this is the accounting accrual, reporting, and counterparty communication layer.

attributes.description: Classification of the capital project by business purpose: game development (title-specific capitalized development costs), engine technology (game engine licensing or internal development), infrastructure (servers, CDN, cloud), studio facility (physical office or production space), platform integration (console SDK, storefront integration), or other.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this capital project record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Jira, internal project management tool). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this capital project has specific regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR data infrastructure, PCI DSS payment systems, platform certification costs).

attributes.name: remaining_budget
attributes.description: Calculated remaining budget available for this project: approved_budget_amount minus (actual_spend_to_date plus committed_amount). May be negative if project is over budget.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS) Work Breakdown Structure element code for this capital project. Hierarchical project structure used for detailed cost tracking and reporting.

products.name: intangible_asset
products.description: Intangible asset register for Gaming's capitalized game development costs, acquired IP, engine technology, and brand assets. Captures asset class, acquisition/capitalization date, useful life, amortization method (straight-line, units-of-production), gross carrying amount, accumulated amortization, net book value, impairment charges, and disposal records. Supports GAAP ASC 350/985 and IFRS IAS 38 compliance for game development cost capitalization.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Accounting / IAS 38 / ASC 350

attributes.name: intangible_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intangible asset record. Primary key for the intangible asset register.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: intangible_asset has gl_account_code (STRING) for the intangible asset account. Normalize by adding chart_of_accounts_id FK to chart_of_accounts.chart_of_accounts_id and removing gl_account_code strin

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: intangible_asset has cost_center_code (STRING) identifying the cost center responsible for the asset. Normalize by adding cost_center_id FK to cost_center.cost_center_id and removing cost_center_code

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the studio that developed or owns this intangible asset. Applicable for studio-specific IP, development costs, and acquired goodwill from studio acquisitions.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the game title this intangible asset is associated with. Applicable for game IP, development costs, and title-specific brands. Null for corporate-level assets like goodwill or enterprise engine technology.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Intangible assets (capitalized game development costs, acquired IP, engine technology) are owned by specific legal entities for asset ownership, amortization, and tax purposes. This FK is essential fo

attributes.name: licensed_ip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to licensing.licensed_ip. Business justification: When licensed IP is acquired or capitalized (e.g., purchased engine licenses, acquired IP rights), it becomes an intangible asset. Required for impairment testing, amortization tracking, and linking a

attributes.name: ml_model_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.ml_model_registry. Business justification: ML models meeting capitalization criteria (internally developed, future economic benefit, technical feasibility) are recorded as intangible assets under IFRS/GAAP. Finance links asset records to model

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Intangible assets may be allocated to profit centers for segment-level asset tracking and ROI analysis. This FK enables tracking of intangible asset investment by business segment (e.g., title-level o

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: Accounting standard under which this intangible asset is recorded and reported. US GAAP follows ASC 350/985. IFRS follows IAS 38. Local GAAP applies jurisdiction-specific standards.
attributes.references: ASC 350 Intangibles - Goodwill and Other; ASC 985 Software; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: accumulated_amortization
attributes.description: Total amortization expense recognized to date since the asset was placed in service. Contra-asset account that reduces gross carrying amount to arrive at net book value.
attributes.references: ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: accumulated_impairment
attributes.description: Total impairment charges recognized to date for this intangible asset. Impairment occurs when the carrying amount exceeds recoverable amount per ASC 360 or IAS 36. Common for game IP when actual performance falls short of projections.
attributes.references: ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date the intangible asset was acquired or the date capitalized development costs were first recognized. For internally developed assets, this is the date development costs began to be capitalized per ASC 985-20.
attributes.references: ASC 985-20 Software - Costs of Software to Be Sold Leased or Marketed

attributes.name: acquisition_method
attributes.description: Method by which the intangible asset was acquired. Internal development represents capitalized development costs. Business acquisition represents assets acquired through studio or company acquisitions. Asset purchase represents direct purchase of IP or technology. License acquisition represents purchased licenses with capitalized costs.
attributes.references: ASC 805 Business Combinations; IFRS 3 Business Combinations

attributes.name: amortization_end_date
attributes.description: Expected date when the intangible asset will be fully amortized based on useful life and amortization method. Null for indefinite-lived assets.
attributes.references: ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill

attributes.name: amortization_method
attributes.description: Method used to amortize the intangible asset. Straight-line spreads cost evenly over useful life. Units-of-production amortizes based on actual revenue or usage relative to expected total (common for game development costs per ASC 985-20). Declining balance accelerates amortization. Not amortized applies to indefinite-lived assets like goodwill.
attributes.references: ASC 985-20 Software - Costs of Software to Be Sold Leased or Marketed; ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill

attributes.name: amortization_start_date
attributes.description: Date amortization of the intangible asset began. Typically the same as capitalization date when the asset is placed in service.
attributes.references: ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification of the intangible asset type. Game IP includes intellectual property rights for game titles and franchises. Engine technology includes proprietary game engines and middleware. Development costs represent capitalized game development expenditures. Goodwill arises from studio acquisitions. Player relationships represent acquired user bases. Licenses include third-party IP licenses. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: game_ip|engine_technology|brand|goodwill|player_relationships|development_costs|licenses — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASC 350 Intangibles - Goodwill and Other; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the intangible asset (e.g., 'Fortnite IP', 'Unreal Engine Technology', 'Studio XYZ Acquisition Goodwill').

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the intangible asset, typically assigned by the finance system. Used for external reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: asset_subclass
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the asset class (e.g., 'AAA Title IP', 'Mobile Game IP', 'Physics Engine', 'Rendering Technology', 'Character Brand', 'Studio Brand').

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date the intangible asset was placed in service and amortization began. For game development costs, this is typically the commercial release date (Gold Master or Hard Launch).
attributes.references: ASC 985-20 Software - Costs of Software to Be Sold Leased or Marketed; ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this intangible asset record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts (gross carrying amount, accumulated amortization, net book value). Typically USD for US-based gaming companies.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date the intangible asset was disposed of through sale, abandonment, or write-off. Null for assets still held.
attributes.references: ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: disposal_gain_loss
attributes.description: Gain or loss recognized on disposal of the intangible asset. Calculated as disposal proceeds minus net book value at disposal date. Positive values indicate gain, negative values indicate loss.
attributes.references: ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the intangible asset was disposed. Sale indicates the asset was sold to a third party. Abandonment indicates the asset was voluntarily relinquished. Write-off indicates the asset was removed due to impairment or obsolescence. Transfer indicates the asset was transferred to another entity within the group.
attributes.references: ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value of consideration received from disposal of the intangible asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal. Null for assets not yet disposed or disposed without proceeds.
attributes.references: ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: gross_carrying_amount
attributes.description: Original cost or fair value of the intangible asset at acquisition or capitalization, before any accumulated amortization or impairment. Represents the total capitalized cost for internally developed assets or purchase price for acquired assets.
attributes.references: ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: is_indefinite_lived
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the intangible asset has an indefinite useful life. True for goodwill and certain brands that are expected to generate cash flows indefinitely. Indefinite-lived assets are not amortized but tested annually for impairment.
attributes.references: ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: is_internally_developed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the intangible asset was internally developed (true) or externally acquired (false). Internally developed assets follow ASC 985-20 capitalization rules for game development costs.
attributes.references: ASC 985-20 Software - Costs of Software to Be Sold Leased or Marketed

attributes.name: last_impairment_charge_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent impairment charge recognized. Represents the write-down from carrying amount to recoverable amount. Null if no impairment has been recorded.
attributes.references: ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: last_impairment_charge_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent impairment charge recognized for this intangible asset. Null if no impairment has been recorded.
attributes.references: ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: last_impairment_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent impairment test performed on this intangible asset. Goodwill and indefinite-lived intangibles must be tested annually per ASC 350. Finite-lived intangibles are tested when indicators of impairment exist per ASC 360.
attributes.references: ASC 350-20 Intangibles - Goodwill and Other - Goodwill; ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this intangible asset record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the intangible asset in its lifecycle. Active indicates the asset is in use and being amortized. Fully amortized indicates the asset has reached the end of its useful life but may still be in use. Impaired indicates the asset has suffered an impairment charge. Disposed indicates the asset has been sold or written off. Under development indicates capitalized costs not yet placed in service.
attributes.references: ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the intangible asset on the balance sheet. Calculated as gross carrying amount minus accumulated amortization minus accumulated impairment. Represents the unamortized cost remaining.
attributes.references: ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the intangible asset. May include details about acquisition terms, impairment triggers, or special accounting treatments.

attributes.name: residual_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual or salvage value of the intangible asset at the end of its useful life. Typically zero for most intangible assets, but may have value for certain IP or technology that can be sold or licensed after primary use.

attributes.name: tax_basis
attributes.description: Tax basis of the intangible asset for income tax purposes. May differ from book basis due to different capitalization and amortization rules. Used to calculate deferred tax assets or liabilities per ASC 740.
attributes.references: ASC 740 Income Taxes; IAS 12 Income Taxes

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the intangible asset in years. For game IP, typically 2-5 years based on expected revenue generation period. For engine technology, typically 5-10 years. For goodwill, indefinite (not amortized but tested for impairment annually). Null for indefinite-lived assets.
attributes.references: ASC 350-30 General Intangibles Other than Goodwill; IAS 38 Intangible Assets

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: Internal cost allocation and recharge records distributing shared costs (shared services, platform infrastructure, corporate overhead, engine licensing fees) across receiving cost centers and profit centers using defined allocation keys (headcount, revenue share, server usage). Captures sender cost center, receiver cost center/profit center, allocation cycle, allocation key, allocated amount, and fiscal period. Supports accurate title-level and studio-level P&L construction.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost allocation record. Primary key for the cost allocation entity.

attributes.name: allocation_cycle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the allocation cycle or run during which this cost allocation was executed. Links to the batch or period in which allocations were processed.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: cost_allocation has cost_element_code and cost_element_name (STRING) referencing chart of accounts cost elements. Normalize by adding chart_of_accounts_id FK and removing redundant cost_element_code a

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game development studio to which the allocated cost is attributed. Used for studio-level P&L reporting. Nullable if allocation is not studio-specific.

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title to which the allocated cost is attributed. Used for title-level profitability analysis and P&L construction. Nullable if allocation is not title-specific.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Cost allocations occur within legal entity boundaries for proper accounting and to prevent improper intercompany allocations. This FK ensures allocations are tracked by legal entity for consolidation

attributes.name: original_allocation_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original cost allocation record that this entry reverses or adjusts. Nullable if this is not a reversal or adjustment.

attributes.name: primary_sender_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center that is the source of the allocated cost. References the cost center that incurred the original expense being distributed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling) Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: receiver_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center receiving the allocated cost. Used for title-level and studio-level P&L (Profit and Loss) construction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling) Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of cost allocated from the sender cost center to the receiver cost center or profit center. Expressed in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: allocation_base_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the allocation base value. Examples: FTE (Full-Time Equivalent), USD, hours, square_meters, transactions.

attributes.name: allocation_base_value
attributes.description: Quantitative value of the allocation key driver for the receiver. For example, headcount number, revenue amount, server hours, or square meters used by the receiver.

attributes.name: allocation_key_code
attributes.description: Code representing the allocation key or driver used to distribute costs. Examples include headcount, revenue share, server usage, square footage, or transaction volume.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Allocation Key Master Data

attributes.name: allocation_key_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the allocation key or driver used for cost distribution. Human-readable label for the allocation basis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Allocation Key Master Data

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the cost allocation. Direct assigns costs directly to receivers; step-down allocates in a sequential hierarchy; reciprocal accounts for mutual service exchanges; activity-based uses activity drivers.
attributes.references: Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) and Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context or explanation for this cost allocation. Used for documentation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total sender cost center expense allocated to this receiver. Represents the proportional share of the allocation key driver.

attributes.name: allocation_run_date
attributes.description: Date on which the allocation cycle was executed and this allocation record was created. Represents the processing date of the allocation batch.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Allocation Cycle Execution

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cost allocation record in its lifecycle. Indicates whether the allocation is preliminary, finalized, or has been adjusted or reversed.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Controlling area code representing the organizational unit for cost accounting purposes. Defines the scope of cost center and profit center accounting.

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: High-level category of the cost being allocated. Classifies the nature of the shared cost for reporting and analysis purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shared_services|platform_infrastructure|corporate_overhead|engine_licensing|it_services|facilities|hr_services|finance_services|legal_services|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Gaming Industry Cost Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost allocation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount. Standard currency identifier for financial reporting.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique document number assigned by the financial system for this cost allocation posting. Used for audit trail and reconciliation with general ledger.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which this cost allocation applies. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-4 for quarterly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this cost allocation applies. Four-digit year representing the financial reporting period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that last modified this cost allocation record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost allocation record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cost allocation was posted to the general ledger and cost accounting modules. Represents the accounting effective date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Document Posting Date

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this allocation record is a reversal of a previous allocation. True if this is a reversal entry; False otherwise.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which this cost allocation record originated. Typically SAP S/4HANA FI/CO or a custom allocation engine.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this cost allocation record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that created this cost allocation record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Intercompany financial transactions between Gaming's legal entities (parent company, studio subsidiaries, regional publishing entities, esports subsidiaries). Captures transaction type (intercompany loan, management fee, royalty transfer, cost recharge), sending entity, receiving entity, transaction amount, currency, elimination status, and reconciliation reference. Supports consolidated financial statement preparation and intercompany elimination in SAP FI.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Document Number

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: intercompany_transaction has gl_account_code (STRING) for the intercompany GL account. Normalize by adding chart_of_accounts_id FK to chart_of_accounts.chart_of_accounts_id and removing gl_account_cod

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: intercompany_transaction has cost_center_code (STRING) for cost allocation. Normalize by adding cost_center_id FK to cost_center.cost_center_id and removing cost_center_code string.

attributes.name: game_studio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game development studio associated with the intercompany transaction, if applicable (e.g., cost recharges to a studio).

attributes.name: game_title_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the game title associated with the intercompany transaction, if applicable (e.g., royalty transfers for a specific game).

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity originating the intercompany transaction (e.g., parent company, studio subsidiary, regional publishing entity).

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: intercompany_transaction has profit_center_code (STRING) for P&L allocation. Normalize by adding profit_center_id FK to profit_center.profit_center_id and removing profit_center_code string.

attributes.name: receiving_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity receiving the intercompany transaction (e.g., studio subsidiary, esports subsidiary, regional entity).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Indicates the approval workflow status of the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the person who approved the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction was approved.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the intercompany transaction amount is due for settlement between entities.

attributes.name: elimination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was eliminated in the consolidation process.

attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the intercompany transaction has been eliminated in the consolidated financial statements to avoid double-counting.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency to the functional or group currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction is recorded.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction is recorded for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: functional_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency of the sending entity.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the functional currency of the sending entity for local reporting.

attributes.name: group_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the group-level reporting currency (typically USD for Gaming).

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the group reporting currency for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context or details about the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the person who last modified the intercompany transaction record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms for the intercompany transaction (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Due on Receipt).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger, which may differ from the transaction date for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: reconciliation_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this transaction to the corresponding entry in the receiving entitys books for reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the intercompany transaction has been reconciled between the sending and receiving entities.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was fully settled (paid) between the entities.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the intercompany transaction has been settled (paid) between the entities.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount calculated on the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to the intercompany transaction for VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was executed or recorded in the financial system.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number or document reference for the intercompany transaction, typically generated by the ERP system.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the financial flow between entities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: intercompany_loan|management_fee|royalty_transfer|cost_recharge|service_fee|license_fee|dividend|equity_contribution — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the intercompany transaction price for tax compliance and regulatory purposes.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The withholding tax amount deducted from the intercompany transaction, if applicable for cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the person who created the intercompany transaction record in the system.

products.name: legal_entity
products.description: Master data for Gamings legal entities including parent holding company, wholly-owned studio subsidiaries, joint ventures, regional publishing entities, esports operating companies, and special purpose vehicles for IP holding. Captures legal entity name, registration number, jurisdiction, functional currency, consolidation method (full, proportional, equity), consolidation group, tax identification numbers, fiscal year variant, chart of accounts assignment, and intercompany partner number. Serves as the organizational anchor for all financial reporting hierarchies, statutory filings, and transfer pricing documentation.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the legal entity. Primary key for the legal entity master data table.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: legal_entity has chart_of_accounts_code (STRING) identifying the chart of accounts used by the entity. Normalize by adding chart_of_accounts_id FK to chart_of_accounts.chart_of_accounts_id and removin

attributes.name: parent_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediate parent legal entity in the corporate ownership hierarchy. Used to construct consolidation hierarchies and organizational reporting structures.

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_entity_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the top-level parent entity in the corporate group. Used for ultimate consolidation and group-level regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: audit_opinion_type
attributes.description: The type of audit opinion issued by the external auditor for the most recent fiscal year. Unqualified is clean; qualified indicates exceptions; adverse indicates material misstatement; disclaimer indicates scope limitation.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm responsible for statutory audit of this legal entity. Used for audit coordination and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: business_segment
attributes.description: The primary business segment or operating division to which this legal entity belongs. Used for segment reporting under IFRS 8 and management reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA company code representing this legal entity in the ERP system. Used as the organizational unit for financial accounting and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: consolidation_group_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the consolidation group or reporting unit to which this entity belongs. Used for segment reporting and management consolidation hierarchies.

attributes.name: consolidation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to consolidate this entity into group financial statements. Full consolidation for subsidiaries, proportional for joint ventures, equity method for associates, none for non-consolidated entities.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this legal entity record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially dissolved or deregistered. Null for active entities. Used for entity lifecycle tracking and historical reporting.

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: Current operational and legal status of the entity. Active entities are operational and reporting; dormant entities are registered but inactive; liquidation and dissolved entities are in wind-down or closed.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity structure. Determines consolidation treatment and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_month
attributes.description: The month number (1-12) in which the entitys fiscal year ends. Used for statutory reporting deadlines and audit planning.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Code representing the fiscal year calendar configuration for this entity. Defines the number of periods, period start/end dates, and year-end closing rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary economic environment currency in which the entity operates. Used for financial statement preparation and consolidation.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region in which the entity primarily operates. Used for geographic segment reporting and regional performance analysis.

products.name: deferred_revenue
products.description: Deferred revenue liability records tracking amounts received from players but not yet recognized as revenue under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. Covers GaaS season pass sales, annual subscription fees (Game Pass-style), game pre-orders, DLC bundles, virtual currency purchases, and battle pass revenue where performance obligations are satisfied over time. Captures contract liability balance, recognition schedule (straight-line over content delivery period, usage-based for virtual currency), recognition trigger events, associated title/SKU, platform, and period-by-period release to earned revenue. Critical for accurate P&L reporting of live-service games where revenue timing differs significantly from cash receipt.
products.reference: ASC 606 / IFRS 15 Deferred Revenue / SAP FI Revenue Recognition

products.name: compliance_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of regulatory compliance obligations to cost centers within Gaming. It captures the compliance responsibility allocation, budget allocation for compliance activities, and assessment tracking. Each record links one cost center to one regulatory obligation with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance responsibility assignment.. Existence Justification: In Gaming operations, regulatory compliance obligations (GDPR, COPPA, age ratings, loot box disclosures, platform-specific requirements) apply across multiple organizational cost centers, and each cost center must comply with multiple regulatory obligations simultaneously. The compliance team actively manages these allocations by assigning obligations to cost centers, budgeting compliance activities per cost center-obligation pair, tracking compliance status for each assignment, and scheduling assessments. This is an operational compliance management process where the allocation itself is a managed business entity.

products.name: budget_approval
products.description: This association product represents the approval authority relationship between employees and budgets in the gaming enterprise. It captures which employees have approval rights over which budgets, including their approval role (budget owner, finance approver, executive sponsor), approval level, delegation periods for temporary authority transfers, and spending limits for SOX compliance and financial controls. Each record links one employee to one budget with attributes that exist only in the context of this approval relationship.. Existence Justification: In gaming enterprises, budget approval is a multi-stakeholder governance process where multiple employees have approval authority over each budget (budget owner, finance approver, executive sponsor, studio head), and senior employees have approval authority over multiple budgets across cost centers and projects. The detection reasoning explicitly identifies this as an operational approval workflow with relationship-specific data (approval_role, approval_level, delegation periods, spending_authority_limit) required for SOX compliance and financial controls. This is not an analytical correlation but an actively managed business process.

products.name: entity_registration
products.description: This association product represents the jurisdictional registration relationship between legal entities and the jurisdictions in which they are registered, licensed, or authorized to operate. Gaming operates legal entities across multiple jurisdictions (a UK studio may be registered in UK, have EU regulatory licenses, and US state registrations), and each jurisdiction hosts multiple legal entities. Each record captures jurisdiction-specific registration details, license numbers, regulatory status, and compliance contacts that exist only in the context of a specific entity operating in a specific jurisdiction.. Existence Justification: Gaming legal entities operate across multiple jurisdictions simultaneously (e.g., a UK studio entity is incorporated in UK, holds EU publishing licenses, and has US state registrations for digital distribution). Each jurisdiction hosts multiple legal entities from the Gaming corporate group. The business actively manages jurisdictional registrations as operational compliance records, tracking license numbers, expiry dates, regulatory status, and jurisdiction-specific contacts for each entity-jurisdiction combination.

domains.name: analytics

products.name: telemetry_event
products.description: Immutable raw-to-silver game telemetry event record capturing every discrete in-game action, state change, or system signal emitted by a game client or server. Represents the atomic unit of the analytics event stream pipeline — covers movement events, combat events, economy events, UI interactions, and custom game-specific events. Each record carries event type, event schema version, game title reference, session reference, player reference, platform, region, client timestamp, server-ingestion timestamp, event payload schema ID, and pipeline processing metadata. This is the foundational fact table for all player behavior analysis.

products.name: event_schema
products.description: Master catalog of all registered telemetry event schemas used across game titles in the analytics pipeline. Each record defines an event type name, schema version, owning game title, payload field definitions (stored as JSON schema), required vs optional fields, deprecation status, and the pipeline ingestion topic it maps to. Acts as the schema registry for the telemetry event stream, enabling schema evolution governance and backward-compatibility validation. Consumed by data engineers and data scientists to understand event structure before querying telemetry_event.

attributes.name: event_type_name

attributes.description: Sample JSON payload demonstrating a valid event instance of this schema type. Used for developer onboarding and testing.

attributes.name: forward_compatible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether older consumers can safely ignore new fields added in this schema version. True enables gradual rollout of schema changes.

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: optional_fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of field names that are optional in event payloads of this type. Provides flexibility for context-specific data capture.

attributes.name: owning_team
attributes.description: Name of the engineering or analytics team responsible for this event schema. Used for accountability and change management routing.

attributes.name: payload_schema_json
attributes.description: JSON Schema definition of the event payload structure. Defines all fields, data types, constraints, and nested objects for this event type. Used for validation and documentation.

attributes.name: pii_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether events of this schema type contain personally identifiable information. True triggers additional privacy controls and compliance workflows.

attributes.name: platform_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of platforms where this event schema is supported (e.g., iOS, Android, PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch). Enables platform-specific analytics.

attributes.name: required_fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of field names that are mandatory in every event payload of this type. Used for validation and quality checks in the ingestion pipeline.

attributes.name: retention_days
attributes.description: Number of days that raw events of this schema type are retained in hot storage before archival or deletion. Driven by analytics needs and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Data Retention Policy, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date when this event schema will be or was retired from production. After this date, events of this type are no longer processed by the analytics pipeline.

attributes.name: sampling_rate
attributes.description: Decimal fraction (0.0000 to 1.0000) representing the percentage of events of this type that are captured. 1.0000 means all events are captured; 0.0100 means 1% sampling.

attributes.name: schema_hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 hash of the payload_schema_json field. Used for fast schema comparison and change detection without parsing full JSON.

attributes.name: schema_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the event schema. Active schemas are in production use; deprecated schemas are supported but discouraged; retired schemas are no longer processed.

attributes.name: schema_version
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the event schema following semver format (major.minor.patch). Enables schema evolution tracking and backward-compatibility validation.

attributes.name: sdk_version_max
attributes.description: Maximum version of the game analytics SDK that supports this event schema type. Null indicates no upper bound. Used for managing schema sunset.

attributes.name: sdk_version_min
attributes.description: Minimum version of the game analytics SDK required to emit events of this schema type. Ensures client-side compatibility.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of custom tags for categorizing and filtering event schemas (e.g., experiment, core_kpi, gdpr_relevant). Supports flexible schema organization.

attributes.name: usage_count_last_30d
attributes.description: Total number of events of this schema type received in the last 30 days. Used to identify unused schemas for deprecation and to monitor adoption of new schemas.

attributes.name: validation_rules
attributes.description: Additional business logic validation rules beyond JSON Schema constraints (e.g., cross-field dependencies, range checks, referential integrity). Applied during ingestion.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or service account that registered this event schema. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: previous_version_event_schema_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on event_schema (previous_version_event_schema_id)

attributes.name: actual_end_date

attributes.name: actual_sample_size

attributes.name: business_objective

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct

attributes.name: experiment_code

attributes.name: experiment_name

attributes.name: experiment_status

attributes.name: experiment_type

attributes.name: guardrail_metrics
attributes.description: List of secondary metrics monitored to ensure the experiment does not negatively impact other important KPIs, such as churn rate, session crashes, or player satisfaction.

attributes.name: hypothesis
attributes.description: The hypothesis being tested by this experiment, describing the expected outcome and rationale.

attributes.name: is_statistically_significant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the experiment results achieved statistical significance at the defined confidence level.

attributes.name: minimum_detectable_effect
attributes.description: The smallest effect size that the experiment is designed to detect with statistical significance, expressed as a percentage or absolute value.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the experiment record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context about the experiment, including any anomalies, external factors, or lessons learned.

attributes.name: p_value
attributes.description: Statistical p-value from the hypothesis test, indicating the probability of observing the results if the null hypothesis is true.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The originally planned date for experiment conclusion, based on required sample size and traffic allocation.

attributes.name: platform_filter
attributes.description: Platforms on which the experiment is running, such as iOS, Android, PC, console, or cross-platform. May be a comma-separated list.

attributes.name: randomization_unit
attributes.description: The unit of randomization for experiment assignment, such as player, session, device, or account.

attributes.name: required_sample_size
attributes.description: Calculated minimum number of players required in the experiment to achieve statistical power and detect the minimum detectable effect.

attributes.name: result_summary
attributes.description: Summary of experiment results, including key findings, statistical significance, and business impact.

attributes.name: rollout_decision
attributes.description: Decision on whether to roll out the winning variant to all players: full rollout (100% traffic), partial rollout (gradual increase), no rollout (revert to control), or pending (decision not yet made).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the experiment began collecting data and exposing players to treatment arms.

attributes.name: statistical_power
attributes.description: The probability that the experiment will detect an effect if one truly exists, typically set at 80% or higher.

attributes.name: statistical_test_type
attributes.description: Type of statistical test used for experiment analysis, such as t-test, Mann-Whitney U test, chi-square test, CUPED (Controlled-experiment Using Pre-Experiment Data), or Bayesian analysis.

attributes.name: target_segment
attributes.description: Definition of the player segment targeted for this experiment, such as new players, high-value players, specific geographic regions, or behavioral cohorts.

attributes.name: traffic_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of eligible players allocated to this experiment, ranging from 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: treatment_arm_count
attributes.description: Number of treatment arms (variants) in the experiment, excluding the control group.

attributes.name: treatment_arms_definition
attributes.description: Description of all treatment arm configurations, including the variations being tested and their respective settings or parameters.

attributes.name: winning_variant
attributes.description: Identifier of the treatment arm or control group that was determined to be the winner based on the primary success metric, if the experiment has concluded.

products.description: Transactional record of each player's assignment to an A/B experiment treatment arm. Captures experiment reference, player reference, assigned treatment arm ID, assignment timestamp, assignment method (deterministic hash, random), platform at assignment, game title version at assignment, and whether the player was exposed (i.e., actually encountered the treatment). Immutable once written. Used to construct experiment analysis cohorts and validate assignment integrity (SRM checks). Critical for causal inference and experiment result validity.

attributes.name: experiment_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each experiment assignment record. Primary key for the experiment assignment entity.

attributes.name: ab_experiment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the A/B experiment or test that this assignment belongs to. Links to the experiment definition containing hypothesis, metrics, and configuration.
